name: THE SINDH SERVICE TRIBUNALS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Second Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973 by substituting subsection (3) of section 3. The amendment specifies that a Tribunal shall consist of a Chairman and two Members appointed by the Government in consultation with the Chief Justice of the High Court of Sindh for a period not exceeding two years for one time only.

name: (REGULARIZATION OF CONTINGENT PAID OR WORK-CHARGED EMPLOYEES OF LEFT BANK OUTFALL DRAINAGE (LOBOD) ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Sindh (Regularization of Contingent Paid or Work-Charged Employees of Left Bank Outfall Drainage (LBOD) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for employees appointed on a contingent or work-charged basis within the Left Bank Outfall Drainage (LBOD) of the Irrigation Department in Sindh. It deems eligible employees validly appointed as civil servants on a regular basis from the date of commencement, subject to scrutiny by a Special Committee regarding qualifications and experience.

name: AGA KHAN PROPERTIES (SUCCESSION AND TRANSFER) ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Aga Khan Properties (Succession and Transfer) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the automatic and undisputed succession and transfer of properties belonging to the Aga Khan of the Shia Imami Ismaili Muslims within the Province of Sindh. It ensures continuity of custodianship without requiring probate, succession certificates, or other legal processes upon the demise of the Imam.

metadata.title: The Sind Adaptation of Laws Order, 1975
metadata.summary: This Order adapts existing federal and provincial laws to bring them into accord with the Constitution of Pakistan as applied to the Province of Sind. It authorizes the Governor of Sind to modify, add to, or omit provisions in specified Acts and Ordinances regarding terms like 'Central Government' or jurisdictional scope.

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 2025
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 2025 by inserting new tax rate provisions and substituting dates in specific sections. It also grants the Government power to amend schedules via notification during a financial year.

metadata.title: The Al-Kawthar University Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Al-Kawthar University in Karachi and provides for its incorporation as a body corporate. It outlines the structure of the university, including its authorities such as the Board of Governors, Academic Council, and various officers like the Vice Chancellor and Registrar.

metadata.title: The Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority Act, 1985
metadata.repeals: Sindh Ordinance III of 1985
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority as a body corporate to manage development in declared arid areas. It outlines the authority's constitution, powers, financial management, and provisions for offences and government control.

metadata.title: The Sindh Charities Registration and Regulation Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes provisions for the registration, administration, and regulation of charities within Sindh. It also covers the collection and utilization of charitable funds by various institutions.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It substitutes specific terms regarding district officials and omits subsection (7) of section 144.

metadata.title: The Sindh Employees Old-Age Benefits (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.amends: The Sindh Employees Old-Age Benefits Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Employees Old-Age Benefits Act, 2014 by substituting specific words in Section 7. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: EVACUEE TRUST PROPERTIES (MANAGEMENT AND DISPOSAL) ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Sindh Evacuee Trust Properties (Management and Disposal) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the management and disposal of evacuee properties attached to charitable, religious, or educational trusts or institutions in the Province of Sindh. It establishes a Board known as the Sindh Evacuee Trust Property Board with specific powers to acquire, hold, dispose of property, and maintain records.

metadata.title: The Sindh Explosives (Repeal) Act, 2024
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Explosives Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act is an enactment by the Sindh government to repeal the Sindh Explosives Act, 2019. It came into force immediately upon its promulgation on June 2, 2025.

metadata.title: The Sindh Factories (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Factories Act, 2015 to update terminology regarding child labor and introduce specific protections for women workers. Key changes include substituting 'woman or child' with 'adolescent' in several sections and mandating safe transportation facilities for women working late at night.

metadata.title: The Forest (Sind Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Forest (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 as it applies to the Province of Sind. It substitutes specific sections regarding magistrates, forest officer ranks, fines for various animals, and adds a new section on police requisitions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Immunization and Epidemics Control Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention and control of diseases and epidemics in the province of Sindh through immunization, vaccination, and scientific means. It consolidates laws relating to these topics and establishes duties for local authorities, parents, and guardians regarding vaccination and reporting.

name: INSTITUTE OF ADVANCED ENDOSCOPY AND GASTROENTEROLOGY ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Advanced Endoscopy and Gastroenterology Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Advanced Endoscopy and Gastroenterology at Karachi as a body corporate. It provides for the reconstitution of an existing institute, defines its functions, administration, and funding mechanisms.

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases in the Province of Sindh. It defines the Institute's functions, including modern treatment, research, and training, while also establishing its governing body structure.

name: INSTITUTE OF MOTHER AND CHILD HEALTH ACT, 2023.

metadata.title: The Institute of Mother and Child Health Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of Mother and Child Health at District Shaheed Benazirabad (Nawabshah) in Sindh. The Institute is created as a body corporate with powers to award degrees, conduct medical trainings, and provide technical support to other government health entities.

name: INSTITUTE OF MUSIC AND PERFORMING ART ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Music and Performing Art Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Music and Performing Art to provide training in vocal, instrumental music, and performing arts for young people. It creates a corporate body with perpetual succession, defines its constitution including a Board of Directors, and outlines the administrative and financial powers granted to the Board.

name: INSTITUTE OF OPHTHALMOLOGY AND VISUAL SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Act, 2013 to update its name and functions. It grants the Institute the power to award degrees, establish satellite centers, and coordinate with various organizations while modifying the composition of its governing Board.

name: INSTITUTE OF TRAUMATOLOGY ORTHOPEDICS AND REHABILITATION ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Traumatology, Orthopedics and Rehabilitation Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Traumatology, Orthopedics and Rehabilitation at Karachi as a body corporate. It outlines the Institute's functions, which include providing treatment, conducting research, offering postgraduate teaching programs, and awarding academic degrees in orthopedic surgery and related fields.

name: JINNAH POSTGRADUATE MEDICAL CENTER AND NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF CHILD HEALTH, KARACHI (REGULATION AND MANAGEMENT) ACT, 2026

metadata.title: The Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Center and National Institute of Child Health, Karachi (Regulation and Management) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and management of the Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Center (JPMC) and the National Institute of Child Health (NICH) in Karachi. It establishes a Board to oversee operations, defines the roles of various committees, and outlines provisions regarding funds, appointments, and the relationship between the Federal Government and the Government of Sindh.

metadata.title: The Karachi Metropolitan University Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and reorganizes the Karachi Medical and Dental College and Abbasi Shaheed Hospital into the Karachi Metropolitan University. It provides for the establishment of the university, its authorities, officers, and the framework for teaching, research, and administration.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 specifically for its application to the Province of Sindh. It inserts specific rank requirements regarding officers and adds 'and Collector' to certain sections of the said Act.

metadata.title: The Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Land Revenue Act, 1967 to introduce digital mechanisms for land record management. It defines new terms related to audit trails, biometric verification, and electronic transactions while updating specific sections of the parent Act.

metadata.title: The Larkana Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.amends: The Larkana Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Larkana Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Act, 2013. It substitutes specific clauses in section 4 regarding the composition of the Chairman's office to include a Local Member or eminent person nominated by the Government and a prominent lady with a background in social welfare and women development.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 by substituting references to 'the Council' with 'the Chief Executive of the Council' in specific sections. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh and assented to by the Governor on February 20, 2019.

metadata.title: The Sindh Mass Transit Authority (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Sindh Mass Transit Authority Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Mass Transit Authority Act, 2014 to update provisions regarding fare collection systems and licensing for developers and operators. It also introduces new offences related to unauthorized entry or interference with mass transit facilities and clarifies the process for imposing and collecting fines.

metadata.title: The Sindh Maternity Benefits Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides safeguards for working women's maternity benefits, proper child nursing, and job security in both public and private organizations within the Province of Sindh. It mandates specific paid leaves for pregnancy, delivery, miscarriage, still-birth, and premature delivery, while also requiring employers to establish day care facilities and permit nursing breaks.

metadata.title: The Sindh Medicolegal Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the medicolegal system, including its administration and all related examinations and postmortems within the Province of Sindh. It establishes specific bodies such as the Sindh Medicolegal Advisory Board and the Sindh Medicolegal Directorate to oversee these functions.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to incorporate new provisions regarding automated traffic detection systems and driver training requirements. It establishes a mandatory pre-license driver education course for heavy and light transport vehicles and introduces a demerit point system for various traffic violations.

name: NEW CAPTIVE POWER PLANTS SUBSIDY ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Sindh New Captive Power Plants Subsidy Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for tariff differential support to new captive power producers in the Province of Sindh who are facing economic non-viability due to fixed tariffs. It aims to alleviate suffering among industrial, commercial, and residential consumers caused by acute power shortages and load shedding. The legislation outlines the process for applying for subsidies, defines key terms related to power generation and agreements, and establishes penalties for false statements.

name: NIBD POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF LIFE SCIENCES ACT, 2014.

metadata.title: The NIBD Post Graduate Institute of Life Sciences Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the NIBD Post Graduate Institute of Life Sciences in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the powers and functions of the Institute, including conducting postgraduate teaching programs, undertaking research in medical and life sciences, and admitting students.

metadata.title: The Pakistan University, Karachi Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan University, Karachi as a body corporate owned and managed by the Dr. Nasim A. Khan Education Foundation. It outlines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, and powers to provide instruction, prescribe curricula, and manage property.

metadata.title: The Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services Act, 2019
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services (Amendment) Ordinance, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services Act, 2019 by substituting specific sections regarding the appointment of senior officers. It also repeals a previous Ordinance from 2025.

metadata.title: The Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and reforms the law relating to prisons and correctional facilities in Sindh. It establishes a policy for regulating these matters, including the establishment, management, control, and security of such facilities.

name: PROHIBITION OF INTEREST ON PRIVATE LOANS ACT, 2023.

metadata.title: The Sindh Prohibition of Interest on Private Loans Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the business and practices of private money-lending and advancing loans based on interest within the Province of Sindh. It establishes penalties for lenders who charge interest or engage in interest-based transactions, as well as those who abet such activities.

name: PROTECTION OF JOURNALISTS AND OTHER MEDIA PRACTITIONERS ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh Protection of Journalists and Other Media Practitioners Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework to promote and protect the independence, impartiality, safety, and freedom of expression for journalists and media practitioners in Sindh. It defines key terms such as 'journalist' and 'media practitioner' and mandates government steps to safeguard their right to life and security against violence and arbitrary restrictions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Procurement (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Public Procurement Act, 2009 to grant the Government power to exempt specific objects or classes of objects from procurement regulations when it is in the national interest. It also allows the Authority to recommend such exemptions to the Government for written reasons.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act re-enacts the Sindh Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978, with modifications and repeals the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989. It establishes the composition of the Commission, outlines the appointment process for the Chairperson and members, defines their terms and conditions of service, and sets procedures for removal.

name: REGULARIZATION OF CONTRACT EMPLOYEES OF KHAIRPUR MEDICAL COLLEGE, KHAIRPUR) ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Sindh (Regularization of Contract Employees of Khairpur Medical College, Khairpur) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for employees appointed on a contract basis at Khairpur Medical College, Khairpur. It deems these employees to have been validly appointed as civil servants on a regular basis from their original date of appointment, subject to scrutiny by a Special Committee.

name: REGULARIZATION OF VETERINARY DOCTORS APPOINTED ON CONTRACT BASIS ACT, 2018.

metadata.title: The Sindh Regularization of Veterinary Doctors Appointed on Contract Basis Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for certain veterinary doctors appointed on a contract basis under the district-wise Veterinary Service Program. It deems these doctors to have been validly appointed as civil servants on a regular basis from the date of the Act's commencement, provided they possess the required qualifications.

name: REGULATION OF AESTHETIC AND LASER TREATMENT ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Sindh Regulation of Aesthetic and Laser Treatment Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes regulations for laser and aesthetic skin treatments in Sindh to ensure public safety and prevent fraudulent practices. It defines key terms such as medical lasers and treatment centers, mandates on-site supervision by qualified professionals, and sets strict conditions for the sale of aesthetic equipment.

name: REGULATION OF ELECTRIC POWER SERVICES ACT, 2023.

metadata.title: The Sindh Regulation of Electric Power Services Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Electric Power Regulatory Authority to regulate electric power services within the Province of Sindh. It provides a legal framework for licensing generation, distribution, and supply, as well as setting tariffs and managing the competitive electricity market.

metadata.title: The Sindh Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Repeal) Act, 2017
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Sindh Removal from Service (Special Powers) Ordinance, 2000. It ensures that pending proceedings under the repealed Ordinance continue while transferring future disciplinary matters for government and corporation service personnel to applicable laws.

metadata.title: The Sindh Reproductive Healthcare Rights Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates reproductive healthcare and promotes reproductive health rights within the Province of Sindh. It establishes basic principles for accessing information, ensuring gender-neutral data, promoting equality, and protecting individuals from discrimination and ill treatment in reproductive matters.

metadata.title: The Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment Act, 2015 to address specific provisions regarding women workers. It modifies section 7 by omitting certain words and adding conditions for working beyond 7:00 PM with prior consent and mandatory transport arrangements. Additionally, it inserts a new section requiring employers to provide adequate washing facilities for female workers in every establishment.

name: SIND MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of the Ministers of Sind, including the Chief Minister. It defines terms such as 'Government' and 'Minister', outlines entitlements for travel expenses, official residence, and medical facilities, and sets specific monetary amounts for various benefits.

name: SIND SPEAKER’S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER’S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1975 (codified)

metadata.title: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of Sind. It details entitlements regarding official residence, transport, medical facilities, leave, and specific allowances such as sumptuary and travelling expenses.

name: SINDH CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) ACT, 2009

metadata.title: The Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service within the province of Sindh. It defines the constitution, functions, and powers of the service, including the appointment and duties of the Prosecutor General and other prosecutors.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2025
metadata.amends: Sindh Act No. II of 1899; Act No.IV of 1939; West Pakistan Act No.X of 1958; section 3 of West Pakistan Act No. XXXII of 1958; West Pakistan Act No.XXIV of 1964; Sindh Act No. XII of 2011; Sindh Act No.XLII of 2013; Sindh Act No. XVIII of 2017
metadata.repeals: West Pakistan Act No.X of 1958
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, levies, enhances, and reduces certain taxes and duties in the Province of Sindh. It also amends various existing laws within the province to update provisions related to vehicle insurance, taxation schedules, and service definitions.

name: SINDH INSTITUTE OF TEACHER EDUCATION ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Teacher Education Act, 2025
metadata.amends: Government College of Education, Federal B Area Block-15 Campus, Karachi
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and re-organizes the Government College of Education, Federal B Area Block-15 Campus, Karachi to establish a new degree-awarding institute. It creates the Sindh Institute of Teacher Education and defines its structure, authorities, officers, and functions.

name: SINDH LIVESTOCK REGISTRATION AND TRADE AUTHORITY ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Sindh Livestock Registration and Trade Authority Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Livestock Registration and Trade Authority to manage livestock registration, tagging, and identification within the province. It aims to develop activities related to livestock products, trade, and exports while improving sector practices to meet international standards.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Third Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 to enhance youth participation and adjust composition rules for local bodies. It introduces specific clauses defining 'youth', modifies membership requirements for Union Committees and Councils, and alters election methods and seat allocation formulas.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public-Private Partnership (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 27 of the Sindh Public-Private Partnership Act, 2010. It allows agencies or the government to agree on an arbitration seat and venue outside Pakistan for specific projects involving foreign investment or government-to-government arrangements, subject to Board recommendation and Government approval.

metadata.title: The Sindh Revenue Board (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Revenue Board Act, 2010 to update definitions regarding notifications and officers. It also modifies provisions related to the appointment of secretaries, meeting frequencies, job postings, and the authority to appoint law officers for litigation purposes.

metadata.title: The Sindh Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Sindh Zakat and Ushr Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Zakat and Ushr Act, 2011 to update provisions regarding Local Zakat and Ushr Committees. Specifically, it allows these committees to disburse funds or incur expenditure via cross cheques, order cheques, ATMs, or other determined methods.

name: SUKKUR INSTITUTE OF BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION ACT, 2006

metadata.title: The Sukkur Institute of Business Administration Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sukkur Institute of Business Administration as a degree-awarding institution in Sindh. It defines the institute's structure, including its officers, authorities, and governing bodies like the Senate and Syndicate.

name: SUKKUR WATER AND SEWERAGE CORPORATION ACT, 2023

metadata.title: The Sukkur Water and Sewerage Corporation Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sukkur Water and Sewerage Corporation to provide potable water and sewage disposal services within the territorial limits of the Sukkur Municipal Corporation. It outlines the corporation's powers, functions, organizational structure, and governance mechanisms including the Board of Directors and various executive officers.

metadata.title: The Sindh Terms of Employment (Standing Orders) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Sindh Terms of Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Terms of Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 2015 to include provisions for seasonal workers. It defines a seasonal factory and worker, adds new standing orders regarding their employment conditions, and mandates specific wage benefits upon the expiry of a season.

name: THAR COAL AND ENERGY BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2025.

metadata.title: The Thar Coal and Energy Board (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: Thar Coal and Energy Board Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Thar Coal and Energy Board Act, 2011 to update the functions of the Board, including tariff determination and fee levying. It also revises the appointment terms for the Managing Director and adds a validation section for actions taken since July 6, 2011.

name: THAR COAL AND ENERGY BOARD ACT, 2011.

metadata.title: The Thar Coal and Energy Board Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Thar Coal and Energy Board in the Province of Sindh to manage coal-related matters. It defines the Board's powers, composition, functions, and administrative structure, including provisions for its fund and accounts.

metadata.title: The Sindh Universities and Institutes Laws (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: certain laws relating to the Public Universities and Institutes in force in the Province of Sindh
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws governing public universities and institutes within the Province of Sindh. It specifically introduces new definitions for 'cadre officer' and 'Search Committee' and substitutes provisions regarding the appointment, qualifications, and age limits for Vice Chancellors.

name: UNIVERSITY OF ART AND CULTURE, JAMSHORO ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The University of Art and Culture, Jamshoro Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Art and Culture, Jamshoro as a body corporate owned and managed by the Pakistan Workers Institute. It defines the university's structure, including its Board of Governors, Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various academic authorities.

metadata.title: The University of Karachi Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: Sind ordinance of 1972 XVII
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and reorganizes the University of Karachi to grant it necessary autonomy and improve its administration. It establishes various authorities, including the Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council, and defines their powers and duties regarding teaching, examinations, and affiliation.

name: WILDLIFE PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Sindh Wildlife Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, conservation, preservation, and sustainable use of wildlife within the Province of Sindh. It establishes mechanisms for managing protected areas, regulating hunting and trade, and defining the duties and powers of relevant authorities.

metadata.title: The Sindh Workers Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014 by substituting a specific provision regarding the appointment of the Secretary. The amendment restricts eligible candidates for the Secretary position to officers from PAS, Secretariat Group, Ex-PCS, PMS, or PSS with a rank not below BPS-19 or BPS-20.

metadata.title: The Sindh Workers Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014 by substituting a specific clause in section 3 regarding the appointment of worker representatives. It came into force immediately upon enactment on July 13, 2026.

metadata.title: The Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Workers Welfare Fund within the Province of Sindh to support workers in industrial establishments. It defines the constitution of the Board and the Fund, outlines modes of payment and recovery from employers, and specifies the purposes for which fund moneys may be applied.

name: ABDUL MAJID BHURGRI INSTITUTE OF LANGUAGE ENGINEERING ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Abdul Majid Bhurgri Institute of Language Engineering Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Abdul Majid Bhurgri Institute of Language Engineering to promote the development and advancement of Sindhi language engineering. It creates a body corporate with perpetual succession, defines the composition and powers of its Board, and outlines the administrative and financial functions required for the Institute's proper functioning.

metadata.title: The Abkari Laws (Sind Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The Sind Abkari Act, 1878; The Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940; The West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act amends three specific pieces of legislation regarding intoxicants and opium in Sindh. It substitutes stricter penalties, including longer imprisonment terms and higher fines, across various sections of the amended acts.

metadata.title: The Abkari Laws (Sind Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The Sind Abkari Act, 1878; The Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940; The West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act further amends three specific existing laws regarding intoxicants and opium in Sindh. It substitutes stricter penalties, including higher fines and longer imprisonment terms, across various sections of the amended enactments.

metadata.title: The Abkari Laws (Sind Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The Sind Abkari Act, 1878; The Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940; The West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960
metadata.repeals: The Abkari Laws (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act further amends three specific laws regarding intoxicants and opium in the province of Sind. It substitutes sections to ensure that offences under these acts are cognizable and can only be tried by a Court of the Magistrate of the First Class. Additionally, it repeals the corresponding Ordinance from 1977 and transfers pending cases to the appropriate magistrate courts.

name: ADAM INSTITUTE OF SOCIAL AND MANAGEMENT SCIENCES (AISMS) ACT 2025

metadata.title: The Adam Institute of Social and Management Sciences (AISMS) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Adam Institute of Social and Management Sciences (AISMS) at Karachi. It provides for the institute's incorporation, governance structure including officers and authorities, and the framework for its statutes, regulations, and rules.

name: ADVISORS (APPOINTMENTS, POWERS, FUNCTIONS, SALARIES, ALLOWANCES, AND PRIVILEGES)(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Sindh Advisors (Appointments, Powers, Functions, Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Sindh Advisors (Appointments, Powers, Functions, Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Advisors (Appointments, Powers, Functions, Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 2003. It was deemed assented to by the Governor on August 4, 2021, after the prescribed deadline for returning the bill had elapsed.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This document publishes the Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Act, 2019 as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh. It amends section 8 of the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 by substituting the word 'Government' with 'Minister for Agriculture' wherever it occurs.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.repeals: The Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 by substituting the Director General of Agriculture Extension for the Director General of Bureau of Supply and Prices in Sindh. It also repeals the Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Ordinance, 1993.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act serves to further amend the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939. It specifically omits sections 3 and 4, including their provisos, from the original 1939 Act.

metadata.title: The AL GHAZALI University (یلازغلا ۃعماج), Karachi Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the AL GHAZALI University at Karachi as a body corporate owned and administered by the One Nation Foundation. It provides for the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and Board of Governors, while mandating that it operate on a non-profit basis open to all qualified individuals regardless of background.

name: ALTAF HUSSAIN UNIVERSITY AT HYDERABAD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Altaf Hussain University at Hyderabad (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Altaf Hussain University at Hyderabad Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Altaf Hussain University at Hyderabad Act, 2014 by substituting the name 'Mohtarma Fatima Jinnah' for 'Altaf Hussain'. It also modifies Section 17 to update references regarding nominees and adds a new clause concerning the Chairman of the Charter Inspection and Evaluation Committee.

name: ALTAF HUSSAIN UNIVERSITY AT HYDERABAD ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Altaf Hussain University at Hyderabad Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Altaf Hussain University at Hyderabad as a body corporate to be owned and managed by the Begum Akhter Rukhsana Memorial Welfare Trust. It provides for the university's structure, including its Board of Governors, Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various academic authorities, while ensuring open admissions regardless of sex, religion, race, creed, color, or domicile.

name: ALTAF HUSSAIN UNIVERSITY AT KARACHI (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Altaf Hussain University at Karachi (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Altaf Hussain University at Karachi Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Altaf Hussain University at Karachi Act, 2014 to substitute specific names and titles within the legislation. It updates references from 'Altaf Hussain' to 'Maulana Abdul Sattar Edhi' and modifies clauses regarding government nominees and committee chairmen.

name: ALTAF HUSSAIN UNIVERSITY AT KARACHI ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Altaf Hussain University at Karachi Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Altaf Hussain University at Karachi as a body corporate to be owned and managed by the Begum Akhter Rukhsana Memorial Welfare Trust. It provides for the university's structure, including its Board of Governors, Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various academic authorities.

metadata.title: The Anti-Terrorism (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Anti-Terrorism Act, 1997 specifically for its application to the Province of Sindh. It introduces new definitions, alters provisions regarding court appointments and tenure, and transfers certain federal powers to the Provincial Government.

name: AO POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF ORTHOPAEDIC SCIENCES ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The AO Post Graduate Institute of Orthopaedic Sciences Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the AO Post Graduate Institute of Orthopaedic Sciences in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the Institute powers to conduct postgraduate teaching programs, undertake research, admit students, and award academic degrees and diplomas.

metadata.title: The Sindh Apprenticeship Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act promotes, develops, and regulates systematic apprenticeship programs within the establishments of the Sindh province. It establishes minimum standards for skill acquisition and defines the rights and obligations of both employers and apprentices, including provisions for contracts, termination, and funding.

metadata.title: The Sindh Arms (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Arms Act, 2013 to update definitions regarding arms and firearms, introduce new clauses for shooting ranges and clubs, and modify licensing procedures. It also adds restrictions on carrying arms without basic training and adjusts provisions related to the import, export, and transportation of arms.

name: AROR UNIVERSITY OF ART, ARCHITECTURE, DESIGN, AND HERITAGE, SUKKUR (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Aror University of Art, Architecture, Design and Heritage, Sukkur (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: Aror University of Art, Architecture, Design and Heritage, Sukkur, Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Aror University of Art, Architecture, Design and Heritage, Sukkur, Act, 2019. It specifically modifies sections 5, 6, 19, 23, and the Schedule of the said Act to update faculty names and related provisions.

metadata.title: The Act for Avoiding Wagers (Amendment) Act, 1865
metadata.summary: This Act amends the legislation regarding avoiding wagers specifically for the region of Sind. It declares contracts made to further gaming or wagering agreements as null and void, prohibiting legal suits to recover money paid under such contracts or related commissions and fees.

metadata.title: The Badin Development Authority Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Badin Development Authority to oversee the development, improvement, and beautification of the Badin District. It defines the Authority's constitution, functions, financial management, and powers regarding water supply and property acquisition.

metadata.title: The Baqai Medical University Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Baqai Medical University in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the university's powers to conduct research, award degrees, and admit students from all backgrounds while maintaining autonomy.

name: BARRETT HODGSON INTERNATIONAL UNIVERSITY AT KARACHI (AMENDMENT), ACT 2016

metadata.title: The Barrett Hodgson International University at Karachi (Amendment), Act 2016
metadata.amends: The Barrett Hodgson International University at Karachi Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Barrett Hodgson International University at Karachi Act, 2015 by removing the word 'International' from its title and preamble. It also substitutes 'Chairman' with 'Chairperson' and restructures Section 17 to define the composition of the Board of Governors.

name: BARRETT HODGSON INTERNATIONAL UNIVERSITY AT KARACHI ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Barrett Hodgson International University at Karachi Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Barrett Hodgson International University at Karachi as a body corporate to be owned and managed by The Salim Habib Education Foundation. It grants the university powers to provide education, prescribe curricula, award degrees, and affiliate with other institutions while ensuring open admissions regardless of religion or race.

name: BARRETT HODGSON UNIVERSITY AT KARACHI (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Barrett Hodgson University at Karachi (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Barrett Hodgson University at Karachi Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Barrett Hodgson University at Karachi Act, 2015 to rename the institution as Salim Habib University. It also inserts new clauses regarding the Sindh Higher Education Commission and modifies references within the original Act.

name: BEGUM NUSRAT BHUTTO WOMEN UNIVERSITY SUKKUR ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Begum Nusrat Bhutto Women University Sukkur Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Begum Nusrat Bhutto Women University at Sukkur and provides for matters ancillary to its establishment. It outlines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, statutes, regulations, and rules, while also defining terms related to affiliated colleges and constituent institutions.

name: BENAZIR BHUTTO SHAHEED HUMAN RESOURCE RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT BOARD ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Benazir Bhutto Shaheed Human Resource Research and Development Board Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Benazir Bhutto Shaheed Human Resource Research and Development Board in the Province of Sindh. The Board is tasked with undertaking research for human resource development, providing skills and vocational training to unemployed persons, and facilitating employment for graduates.

name: BENAZIR BHUTTO SHAHEED UNIVERSITY AT LYARI KARACHI (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Benazir Bhutto Shaheed University at Lyari Karachi (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: Benazir Bhutto Shaheed University at Lyari Karachi Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 6 of the Benazir Bhutto Shaheed University at Lyari Karachi Act, 2009. Specifically, it substitutes the list of sub-divisions under which the university operates.

name: BENAZIR BHUTTO SHAHEED UNIVERSITY AT LYARI KARACHI (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Benazir Bhutto Shaheed University at Lyari Karachi (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: Benazir Bhutto Shaheed University at Lyari Karachi Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Benazir Bhutto Shaheed University at Lyari Karachi Act, 2009. It specifically modifies section 12 by adding a provision for a period of four years.

name: BENAZIR BHUTTO SHAHEED UNIVERSITY AT LYARI, KARACHI ACT, 2009

metadata.title: Benazir Bhutto Shaheed University at Lyari Karachi Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Benazir Bhutto Shaheed University at Lyari, Karachi. It defines the powers, duties, and constitution of various university authorities including the Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council.

name: BENAZIR INSTITUTE OF UROLOGY AND TRANSPLANT NAWABSHAH ACT, 2026.

metadata.title: The Benazir Institute of Urology and Transplant, Nawabshah Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Benazir Institute of Urology and Transplant in Nawabshah as an independent degree-awarding body. It provides for the transfer of properties, rights, and staff from the Peoples University of Medical and Health Sciences for Women to the new Institute.

name: BILAWAL INSTITUTE OF HISTORICAL RESEARCH ACT, 1995

metadata.title: The Bilawal Institute of Historical Research Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Bilawal Institute of Historical Research to promote the study and research of history, particularly with reference to the Province of Sindh. The institute is constituted as a body corporate with powers to acquire property, manage funds, and publish historical materials including journals and reference books.

name: BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972 to update definitions, modify board composition, and insert new sections regarding a Steering Committee. It specifically revises clauses related to cadre officers, university affiliations for various boards, and the powers of the Controlling Authority.

name: BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2025.

metadata.title: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Second Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972. It specifically updates section 15 regarding pay scales and adds a new sub-clause to the Schedule concerning the Deputy Secretary of the Universities & Boards Department.

name: CANAL AND DRAINAGE (EXTENSION TO ROHRI CANAL AREA) ACT, 1991

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage (Extension to Rohri Canal Area) Act, 1991
metadata.repeals: The Canal and Drainage (Extension to Rohri Canal Area) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act extends the application of the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 to areas irrigated by the Rohri Canal in Tando Adam Taluka, District Sanghar. It also excludes the Sind Irrigation Act, 1879 from applying to these specific areas while this Act is in force.

name: CANAL AND DRAINAGE ACT, 1873 (EXTENSION TO ROHRI AND GHOTKI CANALS AREA (REPEAL) ACT, 1972.

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 (Extension to Rohri and Ghotki Canals Areas) (Repeal) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 (VIII of 1878), in its application to the areas irrigated by the Rohri and Ghotki Canals; The Canal and Drainage (Extension to Rohri and Ghotki Canals Areas) Ordinance, 1970 (West Pakistan Ordinance XVII of 1970); The Canal and Drainage (Extension to Rohri Canal Area) (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1970 (Sind Ordinance XIV of 1970)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873, specifically regarding its application to areas irrigated by the Rohri and Ghotki Canals. It also repeals two related Ordinances from 1970 concerning these canal areas.

name: CANCELLATION OF BOGUS ENTRIES (IN THE RECORD-OF-RIGHTS) OF GOVERNMENT LAND ACT, 2009

metadata.title: The Cancellation of Bogus Entries (in the record-of-rights) of Government Land Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the cancellation of bogus entries made in the record-of-rights relating to government land based on forged documents or violations of law. It empowers the Secretary to Government of Sindh, upon authorization by the Chief Minister, to cancel such entries and revert the land to the government.

metadata.title: The Capital University Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Capital University in Karachi and provides for its incorporation, management, and administration. It defines the powers and functions of various authorities, including the Board of Governors, Academic Council, and officers such as the Vice Chancellor.

name: CENTER FOR EXCELLENCE ON COUNTERING VIOLENT EXTREMISM ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Sindh Centre for Excellence on Countering Violent Extremism Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Centre for Excellence on Countering Violent Extremism within the Province of Sindh. The Center is empowered to conduct research, develop strategies, provide training, and coordinate with various stakeholders to combat terrorism and radicalization.

metadata.title: The City University Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes The City University at Karachi as a body corporate in the private sector. It defines the university's structure, including its officers and authorities, and grants it academic, financial, and administrative autonomy.

metadata.title: The Civil Jails Act, 1874
metadata.repeals: Act IX of 1894
metadata.summary: This Act regulates civil jails in the province of Sind and establishes rules for enforcing discipline within them. It outlines the establishment of jails at district court seats, the duties of jail keepers (Nazirs), visitation schedules by judges, medical attendance, and provisions regarding prisoner subsistence and corpse disposal.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973 by substituting 'five percent' for 'two percent' in section 5. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Housing Authority (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Co-operative Housing Authority Ordinance, 1982. It substitutes time periods in section 14 and inserts a new section 14-A regarding eligibility for election after a society is taken over.

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Coastal Development Authority Act, 1994 by substituting the name of the authority and altering its governing body composition. It also inserts a new section regarding the appointment and powers of the Director General as the Chief Executive.

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Coastal Development Authority to oversee the development, improvement, and beautification of coastal areas in the Districts of Thatta, Badin, and Sujawal. It creates a body corporate with perpetual succession to manage these activities through a Governing Body comprising government secretaries, district officials, assembly members, and eminent persons.

name: CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Code of Civil Procedure (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.amends: The Code of Civil Procedure Act (Act No. V of 1908)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 to incorporate provisions for Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) methods such as mediation and conciliation. It establishes new definitions for ADR terms, mandates courts to consider ADR for expeditious disposal of civil cases, and outlines procedures for referring disputes to mediators or conciliators.

name: CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Code of Criminal Procedure (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It introduces mandatory DNA testing for rape victims within seventy-two hours and establishes protocols for preserving DNA evidence in hospitals or forensic labs.

metadata.title: The Colonization of Government Lands (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.amends: The Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912 by modifying section 10. It grants the Chief Minister the authority to extend project completion periods for land granted for education and health purposes when delays are not due to negligence.

metadata.title: The Colonization of Government Lands (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.amends: The Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912 to address issues regarding land grants and leases in Sindh. It introduces penalties for failing to deposit occupancy prices or using land for its intended purpose within specified timeframes, leading to automatic withdrawal or cancellation of grants. Additionally, it inserts a new section allowing the resumption of lands granted for specific purposes if used for other purposes, with exceptions for permanent agricultural holdings.

name: COLONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT LANDS (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995

metadata.title: The Colonization of Government Lands (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1995
metadata.amends: The Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912
metadata.repeals: The Colonization of Government Lands (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912 by inserting a new sub-section in section 10 and adding a proviso to section 17. These changes prohibit the exchange of specific government lands with private or kabuli land.

name: COLONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT LANDS (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Colonization of Government Lands (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912 specifically for its application to the Province of Sindh. It substitutes specific time periods within section 10 of the original Act regarding land colonization procedures.

metadata.title: The Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912
metadata.repeals: Act III of 1893
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better colonization and administration of government lands in the Province of Sindh. It establishes provisions regarding tenancies, proprietorship rights, succession rules, and penalties for breaches of conditions.

name: COMMECS INSTITUTE OF BUSINESS AND EMERGING SCIENCES ACT, 2009

metadata.title: The Commecs Institute of Business and Emerging Sciences Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Commecs Institute of Business and Emerging Sciences in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the powers, functions, and governance structure of the Institute, including its Board of Governors, Academic Council, and staff appointments.

metadata.title: The Sindh Companies Profits (Workers Participation) (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Sindh Companies Profits (Workers Participation) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Companies Profits (Workers Participation) Act, 2015. It deletes specific references to national ordinances and substitutes them with corresponding Sindh Acts regarding minimum wages and workers' welfare funds.

name: CONSTITUTION OF THE SEARCH COMMITTEE ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Constitution of the Search Committee Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Search Committee within the Province of Sindh to handle the appointment and performance evaluation of Vice Chancellors and other officers in public sector universities. The committee is constituted by the Chief Minister and performs functions such as setting recruitment criteria, shortlisting candidates, conducting interviews, and recommending suitable panels for appointment.

name: CONSTITUTIONAL BENCHES OF HIGH COURT OF SINDH (PRACTICE AND PROCEDURE) ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Constitutional Benches of High Court of Sindh (Practice and Procedure) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the practice and procedure of the Constitutional Benches of the High Court of Sindh. It establishes the composition, nomination process, and administrative powers regarding these benches under Article 202A of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Sindh Consumer Protection (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Consumer Protection Act, 2014 to update definitions and procedural terms. It specifically alters sections 2, 30, and 34 of the original act to replace references to the Consumer Council with the Consumer Court and adjust jurisdictional courts.

name: CONTROL OF NARCOTICS SUBSTANCE (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Control of Narcotics Substance (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Control of Narcotics Substance Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Control of Narcotics Substance Act, 1997 to apply specifically to the Province of Sindh. It introduces new definitions for various drugs, inserts a section prohibiting the manufacturing and selling of controlled substances, and substitutes existing sections with stricter penalties for contraventions.

name: CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2009. It specifically modifies Section 5 regarding control and supervision of prosecutors and omits specific subsections from Sections 5 and 6.

name: DADABHOY INSTITUTE OF HIGHER EDUCATOIN ACT, 2003

metadata.title: The Dadabhoy Institute of Higher Education Act, 2003
metadata.repeals: Sindh Ordinance No.III of 2003
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Dadabhoy Institute of Higher Education in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the powers and functions of the Institute, including conducting examinations, awarding degrees, and pursuing research, while ensuring openness to all regardless of sex or religion.

name: DAWOOD UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Dawood University of Engineering and Technology Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Dawood University of Engineering and Technology located in Karachi. It provides for the university's incorporation, assets, powers, officers, authorities, statutes, and provisions regarding affiliated educational institutions.

name: DENNING INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Denning Institute of Technology and Entrepreneurship Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Denning Institute of Technology and Entrepreneurship at Karachi as a body corporate owned by the Denning Educational Foundation. It grants the Institute autonomy to promote learning, conduct research, admit students, and award academic degrees while defining its internal structure and powers.

metadata.title: The Sindh Digital Technology Board Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Digital Technology Board to promote and regulate digital technologies within the province. It aims to boost the digital economy by enabling e-government, fostering innovation, and supporting the IT sector through collaboration at provincial, federal, and international levels.

metadata.title: The Domestic Violence (Prevention and Protection) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act institutionalizes measures to prevent and protect women, children, and vulnerable persons from domestic violence within the Province of Sindh. It establishes a Commission, defines key terms such as 'domestic violence' and 'aggrieved person', and provides for protection orders, monetary relief, and counseling services.

name: DOW UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2005

metadata.title: The Dow University of Heath Sciences (Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.amends: The Dow University of Heath Sciences Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Dow University of Heath Sciences Act, 2004 to allow transferred personnel to opt for service in the Health Department. It specifies a ninety-day window from the commencement of the Ordinance to exercise this option and grants the Government authority to approve such transfers or continued service.

name: DOW UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Dow University of Health Sciences (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Dow University of Health Sciences Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Dow University of Health Sciences Act, 2004 to introduce new definitions for various directorates and officers within the university. It also updates sections regarding property management, partnerships, constituent institutions, and the list of designated officers.

name: DOW UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCES ACT, 2004

metadata.title: The DOW University for Health Sciences Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Dow University of Health Sciences in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Senate, and Syndicate, while outlining powers, functions, and regulations for teaching, administration, and staff.

name: DR. ZIAUDDIN POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ACT, 1994

metadata.title: Dr. Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Dr. Ziauddin Post-Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences in Karachi as a corporate body with perpetual succession. It confers powers on the Institute to award postgraduate degrees, conduct research, manage affiliated institutions, and admit students regardless of sex, religion, race, caste, creed, color, or domicile.

metadata.title: The Drugs (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Drugs Act, 1976 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It substitutes references to the Federal Government with the Provincial Government and transfers powers regarding existing Drug Courts from the Federal to the Provincial Government.

metadata.title: The Education City (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends Section 3 of the Education City Act, 2013 to update the composition of the Board. It substitutes the previous list of members with a new structure including specific representatives from various government departments and nominated members.

metadata.title: The Education City (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Education City Act, 2013 to update definitions and modify the composition of the Board. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh and assented to by the Governor on December 17, 2021.

metadata.title: The Education City Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Education Cities within the Province of Sindh and creates a Board to oversee their administration. It defines the composition, powers, and functions of the Board, including strategic planning, land usage control, and infrastructure development.

name: EMAAN INSTITUTE OF MANAGEMENT AND SCIENCES AT KARACHI ACT, 2018.

metadata.title: The EMAAN Institute of Management and Sciences at Karachi Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the EMAAN Institute of Management and Sciences at Karachi as a body corporate owned and managed by the Al Hamd Educational Society. It grants the Institute autonomous powers to provide education, prescribe curricula, affiliate with other institutions, and acquire property.

metadata.title: The Sindh Employees Social Security (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.amends: The Sindh Employees Social Security Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Employees Social Security Act, 2016 to update its provisions regarding social security schemes. It substitutes various sections and definitions within the original act to reflect changes in wage limits, institutional names, and benefit structures.

metadata.title: The Sindh Employees Social Security (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Sindh Employees Social Security Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Employees Social Security Act, 2016 to include definitions for self-employed workers and smart cards. It also inserts a new section requiring self-employed workers to pay a fixed monthly contribution to the social security institution.

metadata.title: The Sindh Epidemic Diseases (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Epidemic Disease (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Epidemic Diseases Act, 2014 by updating section 3 to include Assistant Commissioners and other officers alongside Deputy Commissioners. It also substitutes section 4 with new provisions regarding penalties for disobeying government orders, including fines up to one million rupees or attachment of property.

name: ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES PRICE CONTROL AND PREVENTION OF PROFITEERING AND HOARDING (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2023

metadata.title: The Sindh Essential Commodities Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Sindh Essential Commodities Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Essential Commodities Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 2005. It introduces new definitions for authorized officers, inspectors, and hoarding, while granting powers to search premises without a warrant, seize articles, seal business places, and auction seized goods.

name: ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES PRICE CONTROL AND PREVENTION OF PROFITEERING AND HOARDING ACT, 2005

metadata.title: The Sindh Essential Commodities Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the price control and prevention of profiteering and hoarding of essential commodities in Sindh. It establishes powers for the government to regulate prices, production, movement, and distribution of these commodities while defining key terms such as 'dealer', 'essential commodity', and 'District Controller'.

name: ESTABLISHMENT OF THE OFFICE OF OMBUDSMAN FOR THE PROVINCE OF SINDH ACT 1991

metadata.title: The Establishment of the Office of Provincial Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Act, 1991
metadata.repeals: Sindh ordinance, IX of 1991
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Office of the Provincial Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh to diagnose, investigate, and redress injustices caused by mal-administration. It outlines the appointment process, tenure, powers, and functions of the Ombudsman, including the authority to enter premises and punish for contempt.

name: ESTABLISHMENT OF THE OFFICE OF OMBUDSMAN FOR THE PROVINCE OF SINDH (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Act, 1991. It specifically substitutes section 4 to allow the Governor to extend the term or reappoint the Ombudsman in appropriate cases.

name: ESTABLISHMENT OF THE OFFICE OF THE OMBUDSMAN FOR THE PROVINCE OF SINDH (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Establishment of the Office of the Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Establishment of the Office of the Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Establishment of the Office of the Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh, 1991 to shift authority from the Governor to the Chief Minister. It updates qualifications for the Ombudsman, sets a non-renewable four-year term, and substitutes references to the Governor with the Chief Minister throughout the original Act.

metadata.title: The Etihad University Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Etihad University in Karachi as an autonomous body. It outlines the university's structure, including its officers such as the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and Registrar, and defines their powers and functions regarding education, research, and administration.

metadata.title: The Sindh Explosives Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the manufacture, possession, use, sale, transport, and import of explosives within the Province of Sindh. It establishes punishments for causing explosions, attempts to cause explosions, and possessing explosives under suspicious circumstances.

metadata.title: The Sindh Factories (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This document publishes the Sindh Factories (Amendment) Act, 2022 as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh. It amends the existing Sindh Factories Act, 2015 by adding specific provisions regarding registration certificates and omitting certain sections.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance Act, 1972
metadata.amends: Sind Act V of 1878; West Pakistan Act V of 1958; Sindh Abkari Act, 1878; Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965; West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964; West Pakistan Finance Ordinance, 1969; West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act abolishes, continues, and levies certain taxes, duties, and fees within the Province of Sind. It amends several existing laws regarding local council taxation, immovable property tax, motor vehicle taxation, electricity duty, and related fees.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Stamp Act, 1899; The Sindh Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, levies, and enhances certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sindh. It also amends existing laws, specifically the Stamp Act, 1899 and the Sindh Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958, to update tax rates and schedules.

name: FISCAL RESPONSIBILITY AND DEBT MANAGEMENT ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Sindh Fiscal Responsibility and Debt Management Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act imposes fiscal and debt constraints to ensure the public financial management of the Sindh province is conducted in a prudent, disciplined, and sustainable manner. It establishes specific quantitative targets for budget deficits, debt servicing, and guarantees while creating a Debt Management Unit within the Finance Department.

metadata.title: The Sindh Food Authority Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Food Authority to oversee food safety and standards within the province. It defines key terms related to food, adulteration, and business operations to ensure hygienic conditions and protect consumer health.

metadata.title: The Sindh Forensic Science Agency Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Forensic Science Agency to conduct forensic examinations of documents, materials, and objects. It outlines the agency's functions, including rendering expert opinions for courts and tribunals, maintaining records, and promoting awareness on forensics.

metadata.title: The Forest Act (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Forest Act, 1927 specifically for its application to the Province of Sindh. It introduces stricter penalties for offences involving reserved or protected forests and timber exceeding a value of ten thousand rupees, including enhanced imprisonment terms and fines. Additionally, it empowers courts to confiscate stolen goods and tools used in offences and allows for rewards for information leading to arrests.

metadata.title: The Sindh Fund Management House Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Fund Management House within the Finance Department of the Government of Sindh. It defines the powers and functions of the House, its Board, and an Investment Committee to manage designated funds efficiently.

name: GAMBAT INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Gambat Institute of Medical Sciences (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Gambat Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Gambat Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2005 to update the institute's name. It substitutes 'The Pir Abdul Qadir Shah Jeelani Institute of Medical Sciences, Gambat' for the previous title throughout the existing legislation.

name: GAMBAT INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ACT, 2006

metadata.title: The Gambat Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Gambat Institute of Medical Sciences in Gambat by reconstituting and re-organizing existing local health facilities. It defines the Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession, outlines its functions including treatment, research, and teaching, and details the transfer of properties and personnel from previous health centers to the new Institute.

name: GAMBAT INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Gambat Institute of Medical Sciences (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Gambat Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2005
metadata.repeals: The Shaheed Mohtarma Benazir Bhutto Medical University Larkana Act, 2008
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Gambat Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2005 to grant the institute independent degree-awarding status and allow it to confer academic distinctions. It also substitutes specific terms in the original Act, replacing 'Governor' with 'Chief Minister' and updating committee composition. Additionally, provisions relating to the institute within the Shaheed Mohtarma Benazir Bhutto Medical University Larkana Act, 2008 are repealed.

metadata.title: The Gorakh Hills Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Gorakh Hills Development Authority Act, 2008
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Gorakh Hills Development Authority Act, 2008 to update the composition of the Authority. It substitutes the list of members in section 4 with specific representatives from various departments and local bodies.

metadata.title: The Gorakh Hills Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 4 of the Gorakh Hills Development Authority Act, 2008 to update the composition of the Authority. It substitutes the existing sub-section (1) with a new list of members including specific government secretaries, nominated MPAs, and departmental directors.

metadata.title: The Gorakh Hills Development Authority Act, 2008
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Gorakh Hills Development Authority (GHDA) for the planning, development, and management of hilly areas in Sindh. It defines the authority's constitution, functions, powers to acquire property, and financial provisions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Goth-Abad (Housing Scheme) (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Goth-Abad (Housing Scheme) Act, 1987 to update definitions and procedural timelines. It specifically revises sections regarding the Board of Revenue, local government ordinances, house settlement limits, and revision application periods.

metadata.title: The Government College University Hyderabad (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Government College University Hyderabad Act, 2018 by substituting specific words in section 10. The amendment replaces references to the Chief Minister of Sindh with the Governor of Sindh within subsection (1) of that section.

metadata.title: The Greenwich University Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Greenwich University in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university powers to provide education, confer degrees, affiliate with other institutions, and manage its own affairs autonomously.

metadata.title: The Habib University Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Habib University at Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, President, and various authorities like the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Sindh Habitual Offenders Monitoring Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act aims to check the menace of street crime and ensure safer cities in the urban areas of Sindh. It establishes a framework for the effective monitoring of habitual offenders using modern electronic technology.

metadata.title: The Hamdard University Karachi Act, 1991
metadata.repeals: Sindh Ordinance No.XII of 1991
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Hamdard University at Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the university's powers, including providing instruction, admitting students regardless of background, and conferring academic degrees.

name: HANDS INSTITUTE OF DEVELOPMENT STUDIES ACT, 2023

metadata.title: The HANDS Institute of Development Studies Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the HANDS Institute of Development Studies at Karachi as a body corporate owned and managed by the Sponsor. It grants the Institute autonomy to provide instruction, conduct research, admit students, hold examinations, and confer awards.

metadata.title: The Sindh High Density Development Board (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Sindh High Density Development Board Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh High Density Development Board Act, 2010 by omitting a specific clause in section 2 and substituting the entire text of section 3. The amendment redefines the composition of the Board to include representatives such as the Chief Minister, Local Government Minister, and heads of relevant authorities.

metadata.title: The Sindh Hindus Marriage (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Hindus Marriage Act, 2016 to establish a uniform law for protecting Hindu marriage rights in the province of Sindh. It outlines conditions for solemnizing marriages, including age requirements, consent, and witness presence, while also regulating marriage registration and procedures for judicial separation or annulment.

name: HOLY QURAN (PRINTING, RECORDING AND DISPSAL OF DAMAGED OR SHAHEED AND SACRED AURAQS) ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Sindh Holy Quran (Printing, Recording and Disposal of Damaged or Shaheed and Sacred Auraqs) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act ensures the publication of the Holy Quran text free from printing and recording errors. It also provides for the proper disposal of damaged or worn-out sacred copies.

name: HYDERABAD DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REVIVAL AND AMENDING) ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Hyderabad Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act revives the Hyderabad Development Authority Act, 1976, which had been repealed, treating it as if it never was. It amends specific sections of the revived Act to update the composition of the Authority and include provisions for land consolidation.

metadata.title: The Hyderabad Development Authority Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development, improvement, and beautification of urban areas within the Hyderabad Division. It also establishes a specific Authority to carry out these purposes.

name: HYDERABAD INSTITUTE OF ARTS, SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 2013
