metadata.title: The Hyderabad Institute of Arts, Science and Technology Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Hyderabad Institute of Arts, Science and Technology as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the powers and functions of the Institute, including providing instructions, admitting students, holding examinations, and awarding degrees.

name: HYDERABAD WATER AND SEWERAGE CORPORATION ACT, 2023

metadata.title: The Hyderabad Water and Sewerage Corporation Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Hyderabad Water and Sewerage Corporation to provide potable water and manage sewage disposal within the Hyderabad Municipal Corporation limits. It outlines the corporation's powers, functions, organizational structure, and regulatory mechanisms for service delivery and infrastructure management.

metadata.title: The Ibn-e-Sina University, Mirpurkhas Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ibn-e-Sina University at Mirpurkhas as a body corporate owned and administered by the Muhammad Foundation Trust. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and Board of Governors, while outlining its powers to provide education, affiliate institutions, and award degrees.

metadata.title: The ILMA University Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the upgradation of the Institute Business and Technology to the status of ILMA University at Karachi. It establishes the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession, defines its officers and authorities, and outlines its powers and functions.

metadata.title: The Sind District Police Act, 1867
metadata.repeals: Sind Laws Regulation, 1936 (Re. VI of 1936)
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the District Police in Sind and addresses public nuisances such as unauthorized construction, accumulation of offensive matter, and improper disposal of dead animals. It also establishes procedures for the pruning and removal of vegetation like prickly-pear from common or waste land to protect public health.

metadata.title: The Sind Ferries Act, 1868
metadata.amends: law relating to public ferries in Sind
metadata.repeals: Act XII of 1873
metadata.summary: This Act amends the law relating to public ferries in Sind, granting the Provincial Government powers to constitute, establish, or discontinue ferries. It also outlines regulations regarding toll rates, exemptions, appointments of servants, and penalties for violations.

metadata.title: The Sind Hindu Heirs' Relief Act, 1866
metadata.repeals: Act XII of 1873
metadata.summary: This Act limits the liability of sons, grandsons, or heirs of a deceased Hindu for their ancestor's debts to the extent of assets received. It also restricts the liability of a second husband of a Hindu widow and members of an undivided family who were unborn or minors at the time a debt was contracted.

name: INDUS INSTITUTE OF HIGHER EDUCATION ACT, 2004

metadata.title: The Indus Institute of Higher Education Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Indus Institute of Higher Education in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the institute's powers, functions, and governance structure, including the Board, Academic Council, and various committees.

metadata.title: The Indus University Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the upgradation of the Indus Institute of Higher Education to the status of the Indus University at Karachi. It establishes the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession, defines its officers and authorities, and outlines its powers regarding property acquisition and admission policies.

name: INDUS UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCES, ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Indus University of Health Sciences, Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Indus University of Health Sciences at Karachi as a body corporate. It defines the university's structure, including its Board of Governors, Chancellor, and various authorities, while outlining its powers to provide instruction, prescribe curricula, and confer academic degrees.

name: INDUS VALLEY SCHOOL OF ART AND ARCHITECUTRE AT KARACHI ACT, 1994

metadata.title: The Indus Valley School of Art and Architecture at Karachi Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Indus Valley School of Art and Architecture at Karachi by reconstituting an existing society-run school. It grants the institution a corporate status with perpetual succession and confers powers to award degrees, diplomas, and certificates while ensuring open admission regardless of religion, race, or creed.

metadata.title: The Indus Vessels Act, 1863
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of vessels playing on the River Indus and its tidal channels within Sind. It mandates that registered vessels be marked with a number, burthen, and place of registry, while also establishing fees for registration and penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Industrial Relations (Revival and Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act revives the Industrial Relations Act, 2008, which had been repealed, and amends specific sections of that revived act. It applies to the whole of the Province of Sindh and is deemed effective from May 1, 2010.

name: INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL HEALTH AT KARACHI ACT, 2018.

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Animal Health at Karachi Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of an Institute known as the Institute of Animal Health at Karachi. It defines the powers, duties, and structure of the Institute, including its Board, committees, and various officers.

metadata.title: The Institute of Business Administration Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and re-organizes the Institute of Business Administration, Karachi. It confers upon the Institute the power to award degrees, diplomas, and certificates while establishing its corporate structure and governance bodies.

name: INSTITUTE OF BUSINESS AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 2003

metadata.title: The Institute of Business and Technology Act, 2003
metadata.repeals: Sindh Ordinance No.III of 2003
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of Business and Technology at Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the powers, functions, and governance structure of the Institute, including its Board, Academic Council, and staff appointments.

metadata.title: The Institute of Business Management Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Institute of Business Management at Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It confers powers upon the Institute to award degrees, conduct examinations, and provide teaching and research in business management.

name: INSTITUTE OF CHILD HEALTH AND NEONATOLOGY ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Child Health and Neonatology Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Child Health and Neonatology at Karachi as an independent degree-awarding body corporate. It outlines the Institute's functions, which include providing medical treatment, conducting research, offering postgraduate teaching programs, and awarding academic distinctions in the fields of pediatrics and neonatology.

name: INSTITUTE OF PHYSICAL MEDICINE AND REHABILITATION ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation in Karachi by reconstituting and re-organizing the existing Institute of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation at Dow University of Health Sciences. It creates a body corporate with perpetual succession, defines its functions, administration, and funding mechanisms, while also addressing the transfer of properties, staff, and liabilities from the previous entity.

name: INSTITUTE OF PHYSICAL MEDICINE AND REHABILITATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2024

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.amends: The Sindh Institute of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Institute of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Act, 2019 by substituting references to the Health Department with the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPD). It also updates specific titles for ministers and secretaries within the amended sections.

metadata.title: The Isra University (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Isra University Act, 1997 to update provisions regarding the university's corporate status and appointment processes for key officials. It specifically alters sections concerning the Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and restrictions on Foundation members holding other office.

name: JACOBABAD INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Jacobabad Institute of Medical Sciences (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Jacobabad Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Jacobabad Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2013 to update its provisions regarding establishment, administration, and board composition. It introduces new powers for the institute to award degrees, affiliate with universities, and outsource services to the private sector while modifying the roles of the Governor and Chief Minister.

name: JACOBABAD INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Jacobabad Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Jacobabad Institute of Medical Sciences by reconstituting and re-organizing the District Headquarter Hospital Jacobabad. It defines the Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession, outlines its functions including treatment, teaching, research, and training, and details the transfer of properties and staff from the hospital to the new Institute.

name: JECOBABAD INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Jacobabad Institute of Medical Sciences (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Jacobabad Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Jacobabad Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2013 to update the composition of the governing board and establish a separate non-lapsable fund for the institute. It specifies new members for the board, including representatives from health ministries, local councils, USAID, and the Pakistan Air Force.

metadata.title: The Jinnah Sindh Medical University (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Jinnah Sindh Medical University Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Jinnah Sindh Medical University Act, 2013 to define constituent centers and institutes. Specifically, it inserts a new clause defining 'constituent center' and adds Section 4-A to designate the Jinnah Post Graduate Medical Center and National Institute of Child Health as constituent entities of the University.

metadata.title: The Jinnah Sindh Medical University Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Jinnah Sindh Medical University at Karachi and provides for its incorporation, assets, liabilities, and staff transfer. It outlines the powers of the university, the structure of its authorities including the Senate and Syndicate, and provisions regarding statutes, regulations, and rules.

metadata.title: The Jinnah University for Women Act, 1998
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Jinnah University for Women at Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's powers, including providing instructions in humanities and social sciences, admitting students regardless of religion or race, and conferring academic degrees.

name: KARACHI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REVIVAL AND AMENDING) ACT, 2016

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act revives the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957, which had been repealed. It also amends specific articles within that revived Order to update the composition of the Governing Body and omit certain clauses.

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority (Sind Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Sind (Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957 Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957 by omitting specific clauses and inserting new wording into articles regarding the Chairman and Director-General. It also repeals the preceding Sind (Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957 Amendment) Ordinance, 1973.

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.repeals: The Karachi Development Authority (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Karachi Development Authority Order of 1957 by substituting specific clauses regarding amenity plots. It explicitly repeals the Karachi Development Authority (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1994.

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Karachi Development Authority Order of 1957 by modifying Article 52-A. It introduces a provision allowing the Government (Cabinet) to convert or utilize specific amenity plots for government-sponsored mass transit projects if deemed of public importance.

metadata.title: The Karachi Division (Traffic Engineering) Act, 1985
metadata.repeals: Sind Ordinance V of 1985
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Karachi Transport Board and the Traffic Engineering Bureau to promote road safety and facilitate convenient use of roads in the Karachi Division. It defines the powers, functions, and constitution of these bodies, along with regulations regarding vehicles, road closures, and fund management.

metadata.title: The Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority (Amendment) Act, 1996
metadata.repeals: The Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1996
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1984 by substituting specific clauses regarding the composition of the Authority's members. It also repeals a previous amendment ordinance from the same year.

name: KARACHI INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Karachi Institute of Technology and Entrepreneurship Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Karachi Institute of Technology and Entrepreneurship in Karachi as a body corporate owned by the Educational Enrichment Foundation. It defines the institute's powers to promote learning, research, and entrepreneurship while setting up its internal structure, including various authorities and officers.

name: KARACHI MUNICIPAL CORPORATION WATER TAX (VALIDATION) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Karachi Municipal Corporation Water Tax (Validation) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act validates the water tax charged, collected, or realized by the Karachi Municipal Corporation in respect of the Karachi Port Trust Area. It deems these taxes validly levied from November 1st, 1949, to June 30th, 1972, regardless of any existing laws or court judgments.

name: KARACHI WATER AND SEWERAGE BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Karachi Water and Sewerage Board (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Karachi Water and Sewerage Board Act, 1996
metadata.repeals: The Karachi Water and Sewerage Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Karachi Water and Sewerage Board Act, 1996 to ensure safe water supply and take stern action against water theft. It introduces new penalties for damaging infrastructure, establishing illegal hydrants, or encroaching on Board land, punishable by up to ten years imprisonment and a fine of one million rupees.

name: KARACHI WATER AND SEWERAGE BOARD ACT, 1996

metadata.title: The Karachi Water and Sewerage Board Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Karachi Water and Sewerage Board to manage water supply and sewerage disposal in the Karachi Division. It defines the Board's constitution, including its Chairman, members, and the Managing Director, while outlining their respective powers and functions.

name: KARACHI WATER AND SEWERAGE CORPORATION ACT, 2023.

metadata.title: The Karachi Water and Sewerage Corporation Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Karachi Water and Sewerage Corporation to manage potable water supply and sewage disposal in the Karachi Division. It outlines the corporation's powers, functions, organizational structure, and responsibilities regarding infrastructure, licensing, and consumer services.

metadata.title: The Sindh Katchi Abadis (Second Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Katchi Abadis Act, 1987 to update institutional names and specific clauses within the legislation. It substitutes references to the 'Sindh Katchi Abadis Authority' with 'Human Settlement Authority' and modifies section 6 of the original act.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1992
metadata.repeals: The Land Acquisition (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It substitutes references to the Provincial Government with joint references to the Federal and Provincial Governments in several sections.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It introduces a proviso requiring compensation payment or deposit before taking possession and modifies specific sections regarding figures and subsections.

metadata.title: The Land Control (Karachi Division) (Sind Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Land Control (Karachi Division) (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Control (Karachi Division) Act, 1952, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It introduces a new section allowing authorized officers to requisition police assistance when exercising their powers under the Act.

metadata.title: The Land Preservation Act, 1900
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the better preservation and protection of certain portions of territories, specifically addressing sub-soil water conservation and erosion prevention. It empowers the Provincial Government to notify areas, regulate them through orders, delimit beds of nalahs, and award compensation to those whose rights are restricted or extinguished.

name: LAND REFORMS REGULATION SIND SECOND AMENDENT) ACT, 1972.

metadata.title: The Land Reforms Regulation (Sind Second Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act serves as a second amendment to the Land Reforms Regulation, 1972, specifically for the Province of Sind. It modifies provisions regarding land transfers by gift, exceptions for heirs and widowed sisters, allowances for tractor owners or tube-well installers, and definitions related to civil service status.

metadata.title: The Land Reforms Regulation (Sind Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Land Reforms Regulation, 1972 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes the word 'Governor' with 'Chief Minister' in paragraph 4, sub-paragraph (1) of the said Regulation.

metadata.title: The Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Land Revenue Act, 1967 by substituting the term 'Service Centre' with 'Peoples Service Centre' in section 4. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: LARKANA DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REVIVAL AND AMENDING) ACT, 2009

metadata.title: The Larkana Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act revives the Larkana Development Authority Act, 1994, which was previously repealed, and amends its provisions to align with current local government structures. It substitutes specific terms related to administrative divisions and councils, updates the composition of the Authority, and validates actions taken between July 2002 and the Act's commencement.

name: LARKANA DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REVIVAL AND AMENDING) ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Larkana Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Act, 2013
metadata.repeals: The Larkana Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act revives the Larkana Development Authority Act, 1994, as if it had never been repealed. It amends specific sections of the revived act to update definitions regarding land consolidation and restructure the composition of the Authority.

metadata.title: The Larkana Development Authority Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development, improvement, and beautification of urban areas within the Larkana Division. It also establishes a specific Authority to carry out these purposes.

name: LARKANA WATER AND SEWERAGE CORPORATION ACT, 2023

metadata.title: The Larkana Water and Sewerage Corporation Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Larkana Water and Sewerage Corporation to manage potable water supply and sewage disposal within the territorial limits of the Larkana Municipal Corporation. It outlines the corporation's powers, functions, organizational structure, and regulatory framework for service delivery.

metadata.title: The Sindh Laws (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends several laws in force in the Province of Sindh regarding salaries, allowances, and privileges. Specifically, it updates financial figures for members of the Provincial Assembly, the Speaker, Deputy Speaker, Ministers, and Special Assistants.

metadata.title: The Sindh Lawyer's Welfare and Protection Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act promotes the welfare and professional protection of Advocates practicing in the Province of Sindh. It provides for the constitution of a Welfare Fund and establishes a Trustee Committee to administer it.

name: LIAQUAT AND DOW MEDICAL AND HEALTH SCIENCES UNIVERSITIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2006

metadata.title: The Liaquat and Dow Medical and Health Sciences Universities (Amendment) Act, 2006
metadata.amends: Liaquat University of Medical and Health Sciences Ordinance, 2001; Dow University of Health Sciences Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Liaquat University of Medical and Health Sciences Ordinance, 2001 and the Dow University of Health Sciences Act, 2004. It updates provisions regarding the appointment of Vice Chancellors, defines the role of the Pro-Chancellor, and modifies sections related to the Registrar and Syndicate powers.

metadata.title: The Limitation (Amendment) Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Limitation Act, 1908 to exclude specific time periods when computing limitation for suits by mortgagees involving foreclosure or sale under the Agriculturists' Relief Act, 1879. It provides mechanisms for restoring dismissed claims if certain procedural grounds existed prior to the dismissal and protects third-party interests acquired during the interim period.

metadata.title: The Sindh Livestock Breeding Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act regulates livestock breeding services in the Sindh province to improve the genetic potential of breeds and protect indigenous livestock. It establishes a Livestock Breeding Services Authority, sets standards for breeding procedures and facilities, and provides for the registration of breeders and businesses.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 to update references regarding constituency delimitation and election procedures. It introduces new provisions concerning the removal of local government officials via votes of no-confidence, restrictions on official transfers during elections, and specific rules for resolving equality of votes in council elections.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 to specify procedures for electing Mayors, Deputy Mayors, Chairmen, and Vice Chairmen by show of hands. It also mandates that elected office holders must be elected as council members within six months of taking their oath.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Third Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 to update specific sections and schedules regarding municipal functions and inspection powers. It grants inspectors authority to impose fines for offences and establishes procedures for trying these offences by a Special Magistrate within thirty days.

name: LYARI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REVIVAL AND AMENDING) ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Lyari Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act revives the Lyari Development Authority Act, 1993, which had been repealed, and amends its provisions to regulate land consolidation and authority composition. It restores the legal validity of actions taken between July 2002 and the Act's commencement.

metadata.title: The Lyari Development Authority Act, 1993
metadata.repeals: Sindh Ordinance No.XXV of 1993
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Lyari Development Authority to develop specific areas within the Karachi Division. It aims to improve the socio-economic conditions of the people residing in these designated areas.

name: M.H PANHWAR INSTITUTE OF SINDH STUDIES ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The M.H. Panhwar Institute of Sindh Studies Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the M.H. Panhwar Institute of Sindh Studies to promote research in natural and social sciences. It creates a body corporate with perpetual succession to manage the institute's affairs, funds, and operations within the Province of Sindh.

name: MALIR DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REVIVAL AND AMENDING) ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Malir Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act revives the Malir Development Authority Act, 1993, as if it had never been repealed. It amends specific sections of the revived Act to update the authority's composition and powers regarding land consolidation.

metadata.title: The Malir Development Authority Act, 1993
metadata.repeals: Sindh Ordinance No.XXIV of 1993
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development of certain areas within the Karachi Division and aims to improve the socio-economic conditions of the people in those areas. It establishes the Malir Development Authority as a body corporate with perpetual succession to carry out these purposes.

name: MALIR UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY, KARACHI ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Malir University of Science and Technology, Karachi Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Malir University of Science and Technology in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university powers to provide general, technical, and professional education, including distance learning options for students who cannot leave their homes or jobs.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION NO.118 (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No.118 (Sind Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: Ordinance XIII of 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends Martial Law Regulation No.118 by omitting specific paragraphs and modifying paragraph 10. It was enacted to expedite changes to the regulation following presidential sanction.

name: MEHRAN ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1986

metadata.title: The Mehran Engineering and Technology University (Amendment) Act, 1986
metadata.amends: The Mehran University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Mehran Engineering and Technology University (Amendment) Ordinance, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Mehran University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977 to introduce the position of Pro-Vice-Chancellor. It grants the Chancellor the power to appoint a Pro-Vice-Chancellor for specific campuses with defined terms and delegated functions.

name: MEHRAN UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The Mehran University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977
metadata.repeals: Sind Ordinance IV of 1977
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Mehran University of Engineering and Technology at Jamshoro. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Pro-Chancellor, Senate, Syndicate, and various officers, while outlining their powers and duties.

metadata.title: The Metropolitan University, Karachi Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Metropolitan University, Karachi as a body corporate owned and managed by the MAB Foundation. It outlines the university's structure, including its Board of Governors, Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various authorities like the Academic Council. The legislation grants the university autonomy to manage property, set admission policies open to all regardless of religion or race, and establish campuses within Sindh.

name: MILLENNIUM INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY AND ENTREPRENEURSHIPACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Millennium Institute of Technology and Entrepreneurship Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Millennium Institute of Technology and Entrepreneurship at Karachi as a body corporate. It outlines the institute's powers to promote learning, conduct research, award degrees, and operate on a non-profit basis under the control of the Government of Sindh.

name: MIRPURKHAS WATER AND SEWERAGE CORPORATION ACT, 2023

metadata.title: The Mirpurkhas Water and Sewerage Corporation Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Mirpurkhas Water and Sewerage Corporation to manage water supply and sewage disposal within the Mirpurkhas Municipal Corporation limits. It outlines the corporation's powers, functions, organizational structure, and regulatory framework for service delivery.

metadata.title: The Sindh Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Sindh Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 by adding a new sub-clause regarding specific double cabin vehicle models to the private category. It also adds a new entry to the Schedule imposing a tax of Rs. 7000 per annum on all types of double cabin vehicles regardless of engine capacity.

metadata.title: The Mukhtiarkars' Courts Act, 1906
metadata.amends: law relating to the powers and procedure of Mukhtiarkar's Courts
metadata.repeals: Bombay Act III of 1876
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law regarding the powers and procedures of Mukhtiarkar's Courts in Sind. It defines the jurisdiction of these courts, outlines the process for filing suits, and details the powers of the Mukhtiarkar to issue injunctions and manage land disputes.

name: N.E.D UNIVERSITY ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1986

metadata.title: The N.E.D University of Engineering and Technology (Amendment) Act, 1986
metadata.amends: The N.E.D University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977
metadata.repeals: The N.E.D University of Engineering and Technology (Amendment) Ordinance, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act amends the N.E.D University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977 to introduce the office of Pro-Vice-Chancellor. It inserts specific clauses defining this role and outlining the powers delegated by the Chancellor for main or additional campuses.

name: N.E.D. UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The N.E.D. University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977
metadata.repeals: Sind Ordinance III of 1977
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the N.E.D. University of Engineering and Technology at Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Pro-Chancellor, Senate, Syndicate, and various officers, while outlining their respective powers and duties.

name: National Accountability Ordinance 1999 Sindh Repeal Act, 2017

metadata.title: National Accountability Ordinance 1999 Sindh Repeal Act, 2017
metadata.repeals: National Accountability Ordinance 1999 (XVIII of 1999)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the National Accountability Ordinance, 1999 to the extent of its applicability in the Province of Sindh. It transfers all pending proceedings and investigations under the repealed Ordinance to the Sindh Anti-Corruption Establishment and Provincial Anti-Corruption Courts.

name: NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF CARDIOVASCULAR DISEASES (SINDH ADMINISTRATION) ACT, 2014 (REVIVAL) ACT, 2026.

metadata.title: The National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (Sindh Administration) Act, 2014 (Revival) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (Sindh Administration) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act revives the National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (Sindh Administration) Act, 2014 to its original position as of January 17, 2019. The revival is enacted pursuant to an agreement between the Federal Government and the Government of Sindh dated August 8, 2023, regarding the management and operational control of the Institute.

name: NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF MANAGEMET, COMPUTER SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1999

metadata.title: The National University of Management, Computer Science & Technology, Act, 1999
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the National University of Management, Computer Science & Technology at Karachi. It defines the university as a body corporate owned by the National Education Foundation and outlines its powers, functions, and governance structure.

metadata.title: The Nazeer Hussain University Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Nazeer Hussain University at Karachi. It defines the university as a body corporate owned and managed by the Khidmat-e-Khalq Foundation, with powers to provide instruction, prescribe curricula, and admit students regardless of sex, religion, race, creed, color, or domicile.

name: NED UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDING) ACT, 2006

metadata.title: The N.E.D. University of Engineering and Technology (Amending) Act, 2006
metadata.amends: The N.E.D. University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act amends the N.E.D. University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977 by modifying Section 15. Specifically, it changes a punctuation mark in clause (xii) and adds a new clause (xiii) to include one representative of the Husein Ebrahim Foundation.

name: NED UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY, KARACHI (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The NED University of Engineering and Technology, Karachi (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: NED University of Engineering and Technology, Karachi Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act amends the NED University of Engineering and Technology, Karachi Act, 1977 by modifying section 15. Specifically, it adds a new clause to ensure one representative from the Hussein Ebrahim Foundation is included in the university's governing structure.

metadata.title: The Coasting-vessels Act, 1838
metadata.repeals: Repealed by the Repealing Act, 1870 (XIV of 1870)
metadata.summary: This Act regulates coasting, fishing, and harbour vessels belonging to citizens residing in Sind. It mandates that such vessels be marked with their place of origin and a specific number, which must be painted on the vessel in English figures and letters.

metadata.title: The Sindh Occupational Safety and Health Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes provisions for occupational safety and health conditions at all workplaces within the Province of Sindh. It aims to protect persons at work against risks of injury arising from workplace activities and to promote a safe, healthy, and decent working environment.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Institute of Management Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Pakistan Institute of Management in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the powers, functions, and governance structure of the Institute, including its Board, Academic Council, and various committees responsible for teaching, research, and administration.

name: PARLIAMENTARY SECRETARIES (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and privileges of Parliamentary Secretaries in Sind. It details specific entitlements including monthly salary, daily allowances during sessions, official accommodation, leave provisions, and various facilities such as medical reimbursement and travelling allowances.

metadata.title: The Partnership (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Partnership Act, 1932 specifically for its application to the Province of Sindh. It introduces new clauses regarding forms, registration procedures via portals, biometric verification, and restrictions on firm names.

name: PEOPLE'S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHA (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995

metadata.title: The People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah (Amendment) Act, 1995
metadata.amends: The People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act amends the People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Act, 1995 to update provisions regarding admission policies and personnel appointments. It specifically modifies sections related to the Chief Executive Director role and allows existing staff to opt for service within the Medical College.

name: PEOPLE'S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996

metadata.title: The People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah (Amendment) Act, 1996
metadata.amends: The People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act amends the People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Act, 1995. It modifies section 18 to adjust timelines for making options regarding service and substitutes references to 'Government' with 'the Board'. Additionally, it introduces provisions for transferring personnel required in the public interest to the Medical College on deputation.

name: PEOPLE’S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH (REPEAL) ACT, 1997

metadata.title: The People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah (Repeal) Act, 1997
metadata.repeals: The People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Act, 1995; The People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah (Repeal) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Act, 1995. It transfers the college and hospital to the Government and deems all associated rights, liabilities, and contracts as belonging to the Government.

name: PEOPLE’S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH ACT, 1995

metadata.title: The People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and re-organizes the existing Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah into a body corporate. It establishes a Board of Governors to administer the college, defines its objectives, and outlines the composition and duties of the board members.

name: PEOPLES UNIVERSITY OF MEDICAL AND HEALTH SCIENCES FOR WOMEN, SHAHEED BENAZIRABAD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Peoples University of Medical and Health Sciences for Women, Shaheed Benazirabad (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Peoples University of Medical and Health Sciences for Women, Shaheed Benazirabad Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Peoples University of Medical and Health Sciences for Women, Shaheed Benazirabad Act, 2010 to redefine constituent hospitals and centers. It transfers all property rights and liabilities of these facilities to the University and mandates the transfer of existing staff members under terms not less favorable than their previous conditions.

name: PEOPLES UNIVERSITY OF MEDICAL AND HEALTH SCIENCES FOR WOMEN, SHAHEED BENAZIRABAD ACT, 2009

metadata.title: The Peoples University of Medical and Health Sciences for Women, Shaheed Benazirabad Act, 2009
metadata.amends: The Peoples University of Medical and Health Sciences for Women, Shaheed Benazirabad Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Peoples University of Medical and Health Sciences for Women at Shaheed Benazirabad. It provides for the university's incorporation, assets, jurisdiction, teaching functions, and the constitution of its various authorities including the Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council.

name: PIR ABDUL QADIR SHAH JEELANI INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES, GAMBAT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Pir Abdul Qadir Shah Jeelani Institute of Medical Sciences, Gambat (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Pir Abdul Qadir Shah Jeelani Institute of Medical Sciences, Gambat Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 8 of the Pir Abdul Qadir Shah Jeelani Institute of Medical Sciences, Gambat Act, 2005. It replaces specific terms regarding district leadership and adds new provisions for nominating members to the institute's board.

metadata.title: The Police (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Police Act, 1861 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It comes into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Preston University Act, 1999
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Preston University at Karachi as a body corporate owned and managed by a Trust. It defines the university's composition, including officers like the Chancellor and Vice Chancellor, and outlines its powers to acquire property and admit students regardless of sex, religion, race, creed, colour, or domicile.

name: PREVENTATION OF CRUELTY TO ANIMALS (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1923

metadata.title: The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Sind Amendment) Act, 1923
metadata.amends: The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1890
metadata.summary: This Act serves to further amend the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1890 specifically for its application in Sind. It modifies Section II of the 1890 Act by inserting words regarding the abandonment or turning loose of animals as offences.

metadata.title: The Prisoners (Sind Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Prisoners Act, 1900 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It introduces a new clause regarding under-trial prisoners and adds specific wording to section 29 of the amended Act.

name: PRIVATE UNIVERSITIES AND EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTES LAWS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004

metadata.title: The Private Universities and Educational Institutes Laws (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The Private Universities and Educational Institutes Laws in force in the Province of Sindh
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws relating to private universities and educational institutes in the Province of Sindh. The primary purpose is to substitute references to the 'Chairman, University Grants Commission' with 'Chairperson, Higher Education Commission' across multiple specific university acts and ordinances.

name: PROHIBITION OF PREPARATION, MANUFACTURING, STORAGE, SALE AND USE OF GUTKA AND MANPURI (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh Prohibition of Preparation, Manufacturing, Storage, Sale and Use of Gutka and Manpuri (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Sindh Prohibition of Preparation, Manufacturing, Storage, Sale and Use of Gutka and Manpuri Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Prohibition of Preparation, Manufacturing, Storage, Sale and Use of Gutka and Manpuri Act, 2019. It substitutes specific terms in Section 2 regarding judicial authority and inserts a new section 17-A to transfer pending cases from the Court of Sessions to the Court of Judicial Magistrate.

name: PROHIBITION OF PREPARATION, MANUFACTURING, STORAGE, SALE, AND USE OF GUTKA AND MANPURI ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Sindh Prohibition of Preparation, Manufacturing, Storage, Sale and Use of Gutka and Manpuri Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prohibition of preparation, manufacturing, storage, sale, and use of Gutka and Manpuri in the Province of Sindh. It establishes penalties for contravention of these prohibitions and outlines powers for search, seizure, and investigation related to these substances.

name: PROTECTION AND PROMOTION OF BREAST-FEEDING AND YOUNG CHILD NUTRITION ACTION 2023

metadata.title: The Sindh Protection and Promotion of Breast-feeding and Young Child Nutrition Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of breast-feeding and adequate nutrition for infants and young children up to 36 months. It establishes an Infant and Young Child Nutrition Board to regulate the marketing, promotion, and sale of designated products, including infant formula and feeding accessories.

metadata.title: The Sindh Protection of Human Rights (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Sindh Protection of Human Rights Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Protection of Human Rights Act, 2011 to incorporate new definitions regarding business and human rights and the National Action Plan. It updates the composition and qualifications of the Human Rights Commission, including age limits and experience requirements for members, while expanding the commission's powers to investigate corporate entities and ensure access to remedy.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF SIND PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972.

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of Sind Privileges (Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.amends: The Provincial Assembly of Sind Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Assembly of Sind Privileges Act, 1972 to grant specific privileges to its members. It entitles members to VIP status, accommodation in government houses upon prior intimation, and access to local hospitals and institutions.

name: PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF SINDH PRIVILEGES ACT 1972

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of Sind Privileges Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act defines the privileges of the Provincial Assembly of Sind, its Members, and Committees. It establishes immunity for members from civil or criminal actions related to matters brought before the Assembly and restricts their detention or appearance in courts during assembly sessions.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to update vehicle classifications and insert new provisions regarding stage carriages. It also substitutes sections related to officer appointments and penalties for moving violations within the Twelfth Schedule.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to substitute insurance company certificates for bank guarantees in various sections. It also updates the Thirteenth Schedule to define specific compensation amounts payable for injuries or death occurring in stage or contract carriages.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to include specific provisions for persons with hearing impairments. It mandates the use of hearing aids or assistive technology for applicants with significant hearing loss and requires driving test administrators to know sign language. Additionally, it exempts these individuals from license fees while requiring mandatory stickers on their vehicles.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to introduce stricter safety standards for public service vehicles using alternative fuels like CNG. It establishes a Vigilance Force to control violations and mandates the installation of functional trackers on motorcycles and motor cars.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to update definitions related to fares and service providers for bus rapid transit systems. It introduces new provisions regarding fare fixation, fines for traffic violations, and amendments to the schedules governing moving violations.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 by inserting new sections regarding penalties for default registration and the issuance of number plates. It also prohibits transactions on open letters and mandates data sharing between manufacturers/assemblers and the Excise, Taxation & Narcotics Control Department.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to update penalties for failing to register imported or purchased motor vehicles within sixty days. It substitutes section 23-A of the Ordinance with new provisions regarding these penalties and registration fees.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Second Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to introduce specific definitions and provisions regarding Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) vehicles. It establishes new clauses for BRT and corridors, mandates convoy numbers for BRT vehicles operated by the Sindh Mass Transit Authority, and exempts these vehicles from certain existing provisions.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Sind Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It inserts specific wording into section 67 and adds an entry to the Sixth Schedule while repealing a previous amendment ordinance from 1976.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Sind Amendment) Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes a new subsection (7-A) to deem certain employees of specific organizations and the Karachi Transport Corporation as public servants under the Pakistan Penal Code.

name: PROVINCIAL SMALL CAUSES COURTS (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985

metadata.title: The Provincial Small Causes Courts (Sind Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: The Provincial Small Causes Courts Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Small Causes Courts Act, 1887, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes the term 'High Court' for 'District Court' in specific sections and modifies section 28 by omitting certain words.

name: PROVINCIAL SMALL CAUSES COURTS (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993

metadata.title: The Provincial Small Causes Courts (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1993
metadata.amends: The Provincial Small Causes Courts Act, 1887
metadata.repeals: The Provincial Small Causes Courts (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Small Causes Courts Act, 1887 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It specifically substitutes monetary figures in sections 15 and 27-A of the said Act and repeals a previous Ordinance from 1993.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Procurement (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This document amends the Sindh Public Procurement Act, 2009 by updating the definition of 'services' in section 2. Specifically, it clarifies that services include physical, maintenance, professional, intellectual, consultancy, or advisory types but explicitly excludes appointments to posts, advertisements, arbitration, conciliation, mediation, and legal advocacy.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010 by substituting the word 'District' with 'Division' in section 12. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public-Private Partnership (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Public-Private Partnership Act, 2010 to update definitions and provisions regarding public-private partnerships in the province. It introduces new terms such as 'Unit' and 'Project Support Facility', modifies clauses related to consortiums and agencies, and adjusts the functions of the Board.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public-Private Partnership (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Public-Private Partnership Act, 2010 to update definitions and procedures regarding board members and project management. It introduces provisions for evaluating restructuring proposals and approving innovations in ongoing projects.

name: QALANDAR SHAHBAZ UNIVERSITY OF MODERN SCIENCES ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Qalandar Shahbaz University of Modern Sciences Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Qalandar Shahbaz University of Modern Sciences located in Tando Muhammad Khan. It defines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, and governing bodies such as the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

name: QUAID-E-AWAM UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING, SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY, NAWABSHAH ACT, 1996

metadata.title: The Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering, Science and Technology, Nawabshah Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering, Science and Technology in Nawabshah. It defines the university as a corporate body with perpetual succession authorized to conduct classes and confer degrees in engineering, science, and technology subjects.

metadata.title: The Reformatory Schools (Sind Amendment) Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Reformatory Schools Act, 1897 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It mandates the establishment and maintenance of separate reformatory schools exclusively managed by females for female youthful offenders.

metadata.title: The Sind Regional Plan Organization Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sind Regional Plan Organization to prepare regional plans for the Province of Sindh. It defines the organization's constitution, including its Chairman and members, outlines its powers and functions, and provides for its fund, budget, and staff appointments.

metadata.title: The Registration (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Registration Act, 1908 to apply its provisions specifically to the Province of Sindh. It introduces new sections regarding the appointment of registrars, restrictions on registering documents contrary to land laws, and requirements for computerized records of rights.

name: REGULARIZATION OF DOCTORS APPOINTED ON CONTRACT OR ADHOC BASIS ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Regularization of Doctors Appointed on Contract or Adhoc Basis Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for all categories of doctors appointed on a contract or adhoc basis within the Health Department, Government of Sindh, or its projects and facilities. It deems these appointments as valid regular civil servant positions effective from the date of the Act's commencement, subject to verification of qualifications.

name: REGULARIZATION OF TEACHERS APPOINTED ON CONTRACT BASIS ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Sindh Regularization of Teachers Appointed on Contract Basis Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for teachers appointed on a contract basis in 2014 (with amendments extending to 2017) through the National Testing Service or Sindh University. It deems these teachers as validly appointed civil servants on a regular basis, subject to performance verification and completion of specific contract periods.

name: REGULARIZATION OF TEACHERS APPOINTED ON CONTRACT BASIS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Sindh Regularization of Teachers appointed on Contract Basis (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Sindh Regularization of Teachers appointed on Contract Basis Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This document is an Act of the Legislature of Sindh that amends the Sindh Regularization of Teachers appointed on Contract Basis Act, 2018. It was deemed to have been duly assented to after the Governor returned the Bill, following a legal opinion regarding constitutional obligations.

name: REPEAL OF POLICE ACT, 1861 AND REVIVAL OF POLICE ORDER 2002) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh (Repeal of Police Act, 1861 and Revival of Police Order 2002) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Sindh (Repeal of Police Act, 1861 and Revival of Police Order 2002) (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh (Repeal of Police Act, 1861 and Revival of Police Order 2002) (Amendment) Act, 2019. It updates definitions regarding deceased personnel, invalidated officers, and Shaheeds, and modifies recruitment rules for specific police ranks.

name: REPEAL OF THE POLICE ACT, 1861 AND REVIVAL OF POLICE ORDER, 2002) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Sindh (Repeal of the Police Act, 1861 and Revival of Police Order, 2002) (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.repeals: Police Act, 1861
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Police Act of 1861 and revives the Police Order, 2002 as it stood on July 13, 2011. It aims to redefine the police role, ensure professional functioning, and reconstruct the service for efficient crime prevention and maintenance of public order.

metadata.title: The Sindh Revenue Board (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Revenue Board Act, 2010 to update definitions regarding board members and government servants. It also modifies provisions related to member tenure, delegation of powers, and includes a validation section to confirm past actions taken by the Chairman.

metadata.title: The Sindh Safe Cities Authority (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Safe Cities Authority Act, 2019 to update definitions, committee compositions, and specific clauses within the original legislation. It introduces new roles such as the Project Director and modifies the membership of the Management Committee to include representatives from various government departments.

metadata.title: The Sindh Safe Cities Authority Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Safe Cities Authority to oversee the construction, development, and maintenance of a city-wide integrated command, control, and communications system. The Authority is tasked with ensuring the safety and security of people in the cities of the Province of Sindh through an integrated surveillance and management framework.

metadata.title: The Saifee Burhani University Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of an autonomous university known as the Saifee Burhani University in Pakistan. It outlines the powers, functions, and structure of the university, including its officers, authorities, and governing bodies.

name: SAIFEE BURHANI UNIVERSITY AT KARACHI ACT,2023.

metadata.title: The Saifee Burhani University at Karachi Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Saifee Burhani University at Karachi as a fully autonomous body owned by the Dawat-e-Hadiyah Trust. The legislation defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and Board of Governors, while granting it freedom to govern academic functions and establish campuses.

metadata.title: The Sindh Sales Tax on Services (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.amends: The Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011 to include specific activities regarding the supply of movable or immovable property by way of lease or rent. It also clarifies that sales tax levied on renting immovable property after July 1, 2015 is deemed validly collected.

name: SEHWAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (REVIVAL AND AMENDING) ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Sehwan Development Authority (Revival and Amending) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act revives the Sehwan Development Authority Act, 1993, which had been repealed since July 2002. It amends the revived act by substituting District Dadu with District Jamshoro and inserting new clauses regarding land consolidation and the composition of the Authority.

metadata.title: The Sehwan Development Authority Act, 1993
metadata.repeals: Sindh Ordinance No.XIX of 1993
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development, improvement, and beautification of Taluka Sehwan and other areas in Dadu District. It establishes the Sehwan Development Authority as a body corporate to carry out these purposes through various functions including infrastructure management and land acquisition.

metadata.title: The Sindh Senior Citizen Welfare (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Sindh Senior Citizen Welfare Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Senior Citizen Welfare Act, 2014 by substituting words in various sections and deleting specific clauses. It introduces changes regarding administrative management of old age homes, transport fare concessions, and penalties.

metadata.title: The Shah Abdul Latif University Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Shah Abdul Latif University at Khairpur in Sind. It defines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, and governing bodies such as the Senate and Syndicate.

name: SHAHDAD PUR INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Shahdadpur Institute of Medical Sciences (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Shahdadpur Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Shahdadpur Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2011 to update administrative structures and fund provisions. Specifically, it substitutes 'Chief Minister' for 'Governor' in certain sections and redefines the composition of the institute's governing board.

name: SHAHDADPUR INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Shahdadpur Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Shahdadpur Institute of Medical Sciences by reconstituting and re-organizing existing health facilities in Taluka Shahdadpur. It defines the Institute as a body corporate with powers to manage property, appoint staff, and conduct medical research, teaching, and treatment programs.

name: SHAHEED BENAZIR BHUTTO CITY UNIVERSITY ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Shaheed Benazir Bhutto City University Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Shaheed Benazir Bhutto City University in Karachi as a body corporate owned and administered by the National Education Foundation. It outlines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities like the Board of Governors and Academic Council, and provisions for statutes, regulations, and rules.

name: SHAHEED BENAZIR BHUTTO DEWAN UNIVERSITY ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Dewan University Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Dewan University at Karachi as a body corporate. It outlines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, and governing bodies like the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

name: SHAHEED BENAZIR BHUTTO INSTITUTE FOR DEMOCRACY AND FEDERALISM ACT, 2024

metadata.title: The Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Institute for Democracy and Federalism Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Institute for Democracy and Federalism as a body corporate with headquarters in Karachi. The legislation outlines the institute's functions, powers, duties, and administrative structure to advance principles of democracy, federalism, and social justice.

metadata.title: The Shaheed Mohtarma Benazir Bhutto University at Shaheed Banazirabad Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Shaheed Mohtarma Benazir Bhutto University at Shaheed Banazirabad as a body corporate owned and managed by a Trust. It defines the university's structure, including its Board of Governors, Chancellor, Vice Chancellor, and various academic authorities.

name: SHAHEED BENAZIR BHUTTO UNIVERSITY OF VETERINARY AND ANIMAL SCIENCES SAKRAND ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences Sakrand Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences at Sakrand. It provides for the university's incorporation, powers, officers, authorities, statutes, and regulations necessary for its operation.

name: SHAHEED BENAZIR BHUTTO UNIVERSITY, SHAHEED BENAZIRABAD ACT, 2009

metadata.title: The Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University, Shaheed Benazirabad Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University at Shaheed Benazirabad. It outlines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, statutes, regulations, and rules.

name: SHAHEED BENAZIR BHUTTO UNIVERSITY, SHAHEED BENAZIRABAD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University, Shaheed Benazirabad (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University, Shaheed Benazirabad Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 12 of the Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University, Shaheed Benazirabad Act, 2009. Specifically, it modifies subsection (1) of section 12 by replacing a full stop with a comma and adding a provision for a period of four years.

name: SHAHEED BENAZIRABAD (NAWABSHAH) WATER AND SEWERAGE CORPORATION ACT, 2023

metadata.title: The Shaheed Benazirabad (Nawabshah) Water and Sewerage Corporation Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Shaheed Benazirabad (Nawabshah) Water and Sewerage Corporation to manage water supply and sewage disposal within its territorial limits. It outlines the corporation's powers, functions, organizational structure, and administrative procedures for providing essential services.

name: SHAHEED MOHTARMA BENAZIR BHUTTO INSTITUTE OF TRAUMA AT KARACHI ACT, 2018

metadata.title: The Shaheed Mohtarma Benazir Bhutto Institute of Trauma at Karachi Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Shaheed Mohtarma Benazir Bhutto Institute of Trauma at Karachi by reconstituting and re-organizing the existing Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Trauma Centre. It defines the Institute as a body corporate with powers to acquire property, award degrees, and administer trauma centers across Sindh.

name: SHAHEED MOHTARMA BENAZIR BHUTTO MEDICAL UNIVERSITY LARKANA (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Shaheed Mohtarma Benazir Bhutto Medical University Larkana (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Shaheed Mohtarma Benazir Bhutto Medical University Larkana Act, 2008
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Shaheed Mohtarma Benazir Bhutto Medical University Larkana Act, 2008. It substitutes the name 'Chandka Dental College Larkana' with 'Bibi Aseefa Dental College Larkana' in section 3, subsection (7) of the amended Act.

name: SHAHEED MOHTARMA BENAZIR BHUTTO MEDICAL UNIVERSITY LARKANA ACT, 2008

metadata.title: The Shaheed Mohtarma Benazir Bhutto Medical University Larkana Act, 2008
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Shaheed Mohtarma Benazir Bhutto Medical University Larkana as a body corporate with the power to acquire property and award degrees. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Senate, and Syndicate, while outlining their respective powers and functions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Shaheed Recognition and Compensation (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Sindh Shaheed Recognition and Compensation Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Shaheed Recognition and Compensation Act, 2014 to update definitions regarding Shaheeds and official responsibilities. It specifically omits certain phrases related to acts of terrorism in the preamble while inserting new language concerning the discharge of official responsibilities.

name: SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT 1995

metadata.title: The Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the institute's powers, functions, and structure, including its governing bodies, staff, and authority to conduct research and confer degrees.

name: SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act, 1995 to expand the institute's scope into new disciplines such as law and medical sciences. It also modifies the governance structure by substituting references to the 'Governing Body' with a 'Board' in various sections and adding new clauses for faculty recruitment and property management.

name: SHAHEED ZULFIKAR ALI BHUTTO INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology Act, 1995 to clarify the Institute's establishment for educational purposes and its status as a non-profit organization. It mandates that the Board ensure the Institute maintains this non-profit status under relevant fiscal legislations, such as the Income Tax Ordinance 2001.

name: SHAHEED ZULFIQAR ALI BHUTTO UNIVERSITY OF LAW, KARACHI ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto University of Law, Karachi Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto University of Law at Karachi. It defines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, and governing bodies such as the Senate and Syndicate.

metadata.title: The Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment (Amendment) Ordinance, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment Act, 2015 by updating specific sections and forms related to establishment registration. It also repeals the previous Amendment Ordinance from 2020.

metadata.title: The Sind (Amendment of Laws) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws applicable to the Province of Sind by substituting references to the Provincial Government with the Commissioner. It also confers specific powers on Commissioners regarding project inspections and appeals, while repealing previous Ordinances.

name: SIND (TEACHING, PROMOTION AND USE OF SINDHI LANGUAGE (APPLICATION) ACT, 1972.

metadata.title: The Sind (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) (Application) Act, 1972
metadata.amends: The Sind (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Sind (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) (Application) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act clarifies the application of the Sind (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) Act, 1972 to ensure it does not prejudice the use of Urdu. It prohibits discrimination in civil service appointments or promotions based solely on a lack of knowledge of either Sindhi or Urdu for a period of twelve years starting from July 22, 1972.

name: SIND ABOLITION OF LAND REVENUE AND AGRICULTURE INCOME TAX ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The Sind Abolition of Land Revenue and Agriculture Income Tax Act, 1977
metadata.repeals: The Sind Abolition of Land Revenue and Agriculture Income Tax Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the abolition of land revenue and agriculture income tax in Sindh. It specifies that no such taxes shall be assessed or paid for the Rabi Crop of 1976-77 and thereafter, while also repealing a previous ordinance on the same subject.

metadata.title: The Sind Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the imposition of tax on income derived from agricultural land situated in the Province of Sindh. It establishes definitions, levy rates, assessment procedures, and rules regarding appeals and exemptions.

metadata.title: The Sind Agricultural Supplies Organization Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: Sind Ordinance XXIV of 1972
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sind Agricultural Supplies Organization in the Province of Sindh to increase agricultural production. It defines the organization as a body corporate with powers to procure and distribute seeds and fertilizers, while outlining its management structure, finances, and audit procedures.

metadata.title: The Sind Agriculture University (Amendment) Act, 1986
metadata.repeals: The Sind Agriculture University (Amendment) Ordinance, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Agriculture University Act, 1977 to insert references to the Pro-Vice-Chancellor in various sections. It also introduces a new section allowing the Chancellor to appoint a Pro-Vice-Chancellor for specific campuses with powers delegated by the Vice-Chancellor.

metadata.title: The Sind Agriculture University Act, 1977
metadata.repeals: Sind Ordinance V of 1977
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sind Agriculture University at Tandojam as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's powers, structure, and provisions for transferring existing properties and employees from the previous University of Sind to the new institution.

metadata.title: The Sind Agriculturists' Relief Act, 1879
metadata.summary: This Act provides specific relief measures for agriculturists in the province of Sind regarding suits, mortgages, and insolvency proceedings. It establishes special rules for instituting suits, determining debt amounts, and managing property to protect farmers from harsh legal consequences such as imprisonment or attachment of immovable property.

metadata.title: The Sind Amendment of Laws Act, 1976
metadata.amends: various laws including The Societies Registration Act, 1860; The Sind Industries (Control on Establishment and Enlargement) Ordinance, 1963; and The Privately Managed Schools and Colleges (Taking Over) Regulation, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Sind Amendment of Laws Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends several existing laws in Sindh to align them with clause (4) of Article 8 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. It specifically updates provisions regarding society governance, industrial establishment permissions, and regulations for privately managed schools and colleges.

name: SIND ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985

metadata.title: The Sind Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: The Sind Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974 to update salary figures and introduce new provisions. Specifically, it increases certain allowances, adjusts travel reimbursement rates, and establishes a daily subsidy for members without government accommodation.

name: SIND ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: Sind Act 5 of 1972
metadata.summary: This Act provides for salaries, allowances, and other facilities to members of the Provincial Assembly of Sindh, including the Leader of the Opposition. It consolidates existing laws regarding these benefits while granting specific privileges to opposition leaders.

name: SIND BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMEN T) ACT, 1972.

metadata.title: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.amends: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972. Specifically, it substitutes a clause regarding the nomination of the Vice-Chancellor of the University in both section 4 and the Schedule of the Principal Ordinance.

name: SIND BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EEUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972 to update definitions, restructure board compositions in Karachi and Hyderabad, and establish new committees. It also repeals specific earlier ordinances related to the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Hyderabad upon the constitution of new boards.

name: SIND BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970
metadata.repeals: The Sind Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970 by substituting specific clauses and sections to update board membership and terminology. It also adds a new section regarding the saving of rights and actions taken under the previous ordinance.

name: SIND BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Sind Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970
metadata.repeals: The Sind Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970 by adding restrictions on diploma issuance and defining punishments for contraventions. It also repeals the earlier Sind Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1975.

name: SIND BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind Boards of Intermediate And Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind Boards of Intermediate And Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972 by modifying specific clauses regarding board composition and meeting quorums. It also repeals a previous amendment ordinance from 1974.

name: SIND BORSTAL SCHOOLS AND THE SIND CHILDREN (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
