metadata.title: The Sind Borstal Schools and the Sind Children (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The Sind Borstal Schools Act, 1955 and the Sind Children Act, 1955
metadata.repeals: The Bombay Borstal Schools Act, 1929 (as applicable to Karachi) and the Sind Borstal Schools Act, 1929; The Sind Children Act, 1924 (as applicable to Karachi) and the Sind Children Act, 1924
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Borstal Schools Act, 1955 and the Sind Children Act, 1955 by updating titles, extending jurisdiction to the whole Province of Sind, and replacing references to acceding states with specific provincial designations. It also repeals earlier Bombay and Sind Acts from 1929 and 1924 that were applicable to Karachi.

metadata.title: The Sind Children (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Sind Children (Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Children Act, 1955 by adding specific words to section 1 regarding Khairpur District. It also repeals the preceding Sind Children (Amendment) Ordinance, 1974.

metadata.title: The Sind City Survey Act, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the survey of lands other than agricultural lands in Sind and provides for related matters. It establishes the powers of Survey Officers, defines key terms like 'city' and 'building site', and outlines procedures for assigning survey numbers and issuing sanads upon payment of fees.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 1988
metadata.repeals: The Sind Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973 by adding a proviso to section 13 regarding retirement procedures. It mandates that no civil servant can be retired without written notice of grounds and an opportunity to show cause. The Act also repeals the corresponding Ordinance from 1988.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: Sindh Ordinance X of 1973
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the appointment of persons to, and the terms and conditions of service for, civil servants in the Province of Sindh. It establishes definitions for key terms such as 'civil servant' and 'Government', outlines procedures for appointments, probation, promotion, and termination, and provides for matters connected with the service of Pakistan in connection with Sindh affairs.

name: SIND CIVIL SERVANTS WELFARE FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: The Sind Civil Servants Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Civil Servants Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1979 to clarify the distribution of funds paid to nominees. It specifies that such amounts must be distributed among all heirs of a deceased civil servant according to the personal law applicable to the deceased.

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 by substituting specific words in sections 7, 9, and 71. It replaces the word 'ten' with 'thirty' in certain clauses and changes 'person' to 'person or persons' where applicable.

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Societies Act, 1925
metadata.amends: law relating to co-operative societies in the Province of Sind
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to co-operative societies in the Province of Sind. It facilitates the formation and working of these societies to promote thrift, self-help, and mutual aid among agriculturists and others with common economic needs.

metadata.title: The Sind Court of Wards (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind Court of Wards Act, 1905
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Court of Wards Act, 1905 by substituting a proviso in section 4. The amendment restricts the assumption of property for disqualified land-holders or pension-holders to cases where the Provincial Government deems it expedient for public interest and economical management.

metadata.title: The Sind Court of Wards Act, 1905
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Court of Wards in the Province of Sind to manage the property and affairs of disqualified land-holders or pension-holders. It defines the powers of the court, including the assumption of superintendence over estates, appointment of managers, and protection of heirs' interests.

metadata.title: The Sind Crimes Control Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an effective legal machinery to prevent the commission and repetition of crimes within the Province of Sind. It consolidates existing laws relating to anti-social elements and disorderly persons by creating a specific Tribunal for inquiry and proceedings.

name: SIND CRIMINAL LAW (AMENDMENT) (VALUATION OF TRANSFER OF CASES) ACT, 1972.

metadata.title: The Sind Criminal Law (Amendment) (Validation of Transfer of Cases) Act, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.repeals: The Sind Criminal Law (Amendment) (Validation of Transfer of Cases) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act validates the transfer of cases under the West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963 to respective criminal courts. It deems such transfers and subsequent inquiries or trials as validly commenced from February 13, 1971, regardless of whether findings were submitted to District Magistrates.

metadata.title: The Sind Orphanages (Supervision and Control) Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: Sind Ordinance II of 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Board to supervise and regulate the working and control of orphanages in Sind. It provides for the constitution, functions, and powers of the Board, including the issuance and management of licenses for orphanages.

metadata.title: The Sind Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of a special allowance to employees in the province of Sind. It defines key terms such as employee, employer, and undertaking, and mandates that employers pay this allowance alongside wages.

name: SIND FANCY THERAPEUTIC SUBSTANCES, MAGIC REMEDIES, MIRACLE CURES AND GUARANTEED RELIEFS ADVERTISEMENT (CONTROL) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Sind Fancy Therapeutic Substances, Magic Remedies, Miracle Cures and Guaranteed Reliefs Advertisement (Control) Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Board to control advertisements regarding fancy therapeutic substances, magic remedies, miracle cures, and guaranteed reliefs in the Province of Sind. It defines these terms, sets up the Board's constitution and powers, bans unauthorized advertisements, and prescribes penalties for violations.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Finance Act, 1964 by substituting a new Seventh Schedule. The amendment establishes specific tax rates for various categories of persons, companies, and establishments engaged in professions, trades, or employment within Sind.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance Act, 1985
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1985; The West Pakistan Act V of 1958; The West Pakistan Act XXXIV of 1964; The Sind Finance Act, 1964; The Sind Finance Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes and abolishes certain taxes within the province of Sind. It amends several existing laws, including the West Pakistan Acts of 1958 and 1964, as well as the Sind Finance Acts of 1964 and 1977, to update tax rates and schedules.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance Act, 1973
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Act V of 1958; West Pakistan Act X of 1958; West Pakistan Act IX of 1963; West Pakistan Act XXXIV of 1964; West Pakistan Ordinance VII of 1969
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy or enhancement of certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sind. It amends several existing West Pakistan Acts and Ordinances to apply specific tax rates and definitions to the province.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance Act, 1974
metadata.amends: Court-fees Act, 1870; Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; West Pakistan entertainments duty act, 1958; West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, enhances, and levies certain taxes, duties, and fees within the Province of Sind. It amends several existing laws, including the Court-fees Act and various taxation acts from 1958 and 1965, to align them with the new financial framework.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance Act, 1975
metadata.amends: Court Fees Act, 1870; Stamp Act, 1899; Sind Urban immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; West Pakistan Act V of 1958; West Pakistan Ordinance VII of 1969; West Pakistan Act XXXIV of 1964
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, enhances, and levies certain taxes, duties, and fees within the Province of Sindh. It amends existing legislation including the Court Fees Act, Stamp Act, and Sind Urban immovable Property Tax Act to update fee structures and definitions.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; The Sind Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; The Sind Tobacco Vend Act, 1958; The Sind Finance Act, 1964; The Sind Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, levies, and enhances certain taxes and fees within the Province of Sind. It amends several existing laws from 1958, 1964, and 1966 to update tax rates, definitions, and procedural requirements.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance Act, 1986
metadata.amends: Stamp Act II of 1899; W.P Act X of 1958
metadata.repeals: W.P Act IX of 1963
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes and abolishes certain taxes and duties in the Province of Sind while amending existing laws. It specifically amends the Stamp Act of 1899 and the W.P Act of 1958 to update valuation methods and entertainment duty rates, and it repeals the W.P Act IX of 1963.

metadata.title: The Sind Fisheries (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.repeals: The Sind Fisheries (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sind Fisheries Ordinance, 1961 by substituting specific words in sections 4 and 26 and updating dates in the First Schedule. It also repeals the previous Sind Fisheries (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976.

metadata.title: The Sind Goth-Abad (Housing Scheme) Act, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act provides for housing facilities to deserving persons residing in the rural areas of the Province of Sind. It establishes mechanisms for land allotment, grant of proprietary rights, and the preparation of housing schemes by the Collector.

metadata.title: The Sind Highway Act, 1883
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the additional funds necessary to construct and maintain public roads used for local convenience in the Province of Sind. It authorizes the imposition of a tax on carriages, coaches, vans, carts, horses, and ponies within notified local areas to support these road maintenance efforts.

name: SIND INDUSTRIAL AND MINERAL DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION ACT, 1988

metadata.title: The Sind Industrial and Mineral Development Corporation Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sind Industrial and Mineral Development Corporation in the Province of Sind. The corporation is empowered to promote industrial and mineral development, particularly agro-based industries and fisheries, while also assuming control over the Sind Sugar Corporation.

name: SIND INDUSTRIAL TRADING ESTATE RECOVERY OF DUES ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Sind Industrial Trading Estate Recovery of Dues Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Sind Industrial Trading Estate Recovery of Dues Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the recovery of dues owed to the Sind Industrial Trading Estate. It allows the Government to declare such dues recoverable from defaulters as if they were arrears of land-revenue under the Revenue Recovery Act, 1890.

metadata.title: The Sind Irrigation (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Irrigation Act, 1879 to facilitate the recovery of costs for repairing tampered water modules from land revenue. It introduces new sections regarding cost recovery, expands penalties for offenses, and establishes procedures for serving notices when a person's whereabouts are unknown.

metadata.title: The Sind Katchi Abadis Act, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development and improvement of Katchi Abadi areas and their regularization. It also establishes an Authority to carry out these purposes.

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Land Revenue Act, 1967 by inserting new definitions for irrigated and un-irrigated land. It introduces provisions regarding the furnishing of land ownership information, exemptions from land revenue for specific land sizes, and enhanced tax rates for owners of larger land holdings.

name: SIND LAND REVENUE FIRST DRAFT ASSESSMENT LISTS (VALIDATION) ACT, 1974.

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue First Draft Assessment Lists (Validation) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Sind Land Revenue First Draft Assessment Lists (Validation) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act validates the first draft assessment lists created under the Sind Land Revenue Flat Rate Assessment Rules, 1973, even if the required public notice was not given. It further declares that any court orders or judgments affecting the validity of these lists shall have no legal effect.

name: SIND LANDING AND WHARFAGE FEES ACT, 1882

metadata.title: The Sind Landing and Wharfage Fees Act, 1882
metadata.repeals: Bombay Act III of 1879
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of fees for the use of public landing-places in certain ports in the Province of Sind. It defines terms such as Government, landing-place, and passengers, and empowers the Government to fix fee limits and define port boundaries.

metadata.title: The Sind Laws (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: The Sind Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966 and the Sind Finance Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966 and the Sind Finance Act, 1975. It specifically alters provisions regarding fees collected by cotton dealers and factories to fund agricultural development and local area schemes.

name: SIND LOANS FOR AGRICULTURAL PURPOSES ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind Loans for Agricultural Purposes Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Sind Loans for Agricultural Purposes Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides credit facilities to members of co-operative societies and banks in Sind for agricultural purposes. It establishes rules for loan delivery, repayment via agricultural produce or cash, and recovery procedures through the Collector.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1986
metadata.repeals: The Sind Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by omitting specific clauses and subsections from various sections. It also repeals the previous Sind Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1986.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1987
metadata.repeals: The Sind Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by modifying section 10 and inserting a new section 58-A regarding Advisory Committees. It also repeals the earlier Sind Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1987.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Fifth Amendment) Act, 1987
metadata.repeals: The Sind Local Government (Fifth Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by modifying section 16 regarding council dissolution. It also repeals the earlier Sind Local Government (Fifth Amendment) Ordinance, 1987.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Act, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to update provisions regarding municipal committees and corporations in Karachi. It introduces restrictions on political party symbols during elections, clarifies election eligibility, and adjusts rules concerning taxation powers between metropolitan corporations and zonal municipal committees.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 1988
metadata.repeals: The Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by omitting sub-section (3) of section 26. It also repeals the Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1988.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 1991
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by adding specific wording to section 45 regarding tax collection rights. It also validates contracts entered into by councils on or after January 1, 1991, without inviting officers in auction and repeals a previous 1991 ordinance.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Local Government (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by adding provisions for an Advisory Council and defining the appointment of Panchayat Chairmen. It also repeals the Sindh Local Government (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1994.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Sixth Amendment) Act, 1987
metadata.repeals: The Sind Local Government (Sixth Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by substituting a specific provision regarding council and electoral unit membership. It also repeals the earlier Sind Local Government (Sixth Amendment) Ordinance, 1987.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Third Amendment) Act, 1987
metadata.repeals: The Sind Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by modifying section 58 and Schedule I. It specifically addresses the reconstitution of councils when supersession periods are expiring within four months of their normal term.

name: SIND MINISTER’S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Sind Minister's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'first' for the word 'economy' in section 9, sub-section (2), clause (a) of the amended Act.

name: SIND MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1977

metadata.title: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1977
metadata.amends: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to update definitions regarding maintenance and official residence. It further substitutes section 7 to specify provisions for official accommodation, rent limits, furnishing allowances, appliance specifications, and entitlements upon ceasing office.

name: SIND MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985

metadata.title: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to update financial provisions for Chief Ministers and Ministers. It revises equipment allowances, discretionary grants, official residence benefits, and leave allowances.

name: SIND MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1972.

metadata.title: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act determines the salaries, allowances, and privileges for the Chief Minister and Ministers of Sind. It establishes specific monetary amounts for salaries, sumptuary allowances, and official residences, while also regulating travel expenses and transport facilities.

metadata.title: The Sind Motor Vehicles (Sind Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 specifically as it applies to the Province of Sind. It introduces textual changes to Section 91 regarding un-manned vehicles and adjusts monetary limits in Section 107.

name: SIND PARLIAMENTARY SECRETARIES (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985

metadata.title: The Sind Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: The Sind Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974. It specifically substitutes salary figures in sections 3 and 4 of the original Act.

name: SIND PARLIAMENTARY SECRETARIES (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1987

metadata.title: The Sind Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1987
metadata.amends: The Sind Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Sind Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974 to update salary figures and introduce new provisions regarding accommodation, facilities, leave, and travelling allowances. It also repeals the corresponding Ordinance from 1987.

metadata.title: The Sind People's Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Sind People's Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972 by modifying section 42 to allow councils to enter contracts without inviting offers with government approval. It also repeals the previous amendment ordinance from 1974.

metadata.title: The Sind People's Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Sind People's Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972 by substituting specific clauses regarding officers and administrators. It also repeals the Sind People's Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1974.

metadata.title: The Sind People's Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972 to redefine terms such as 'City', 'Corporation', and 'Municipality'. It also inserts new sections regarding the constitution of local councils, the declaration of urban areas, and the succession of existing councils.

metadata.title: The Sind People's Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972 by substituting specific penalty clauses in section 100 and adding new entries to Schedule X regarding objectionable slogans and failure to remove unauthorized writings. It also repeals the Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1973.

name: SIND PRIVATE SCHOOLS (MANAGEMENT AND CONTROL) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind Private Schools (Management and Control) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the control and management of private schools in Sind. It establishes a Board of Governors to oversee school administration, regulate teacher conditions, and streamline operations.

metadata.title: The Sind Provincial Assembly (Members) Privileges Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the privileges for members of the Provincial Assembly of Sind, including immunity from civil or criminal proceedings related to their official duties. It also grants protections against detention during assembly sessions, restricts court processes within assembly precincts, and provides VIP status and accommodation facilities.

name: SIND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (MEMBERS) WELFARE FUND ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Sind Provincial Assembly (Members) Welfare Fund Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Members Welfare Fund to provide financial aid to Members of the Provincial Assembly of Sind, their heirs, and ex-Members. It outlines the fund's composition, contribution rates, utilization rules, and the constitution of a committee responsible for managing the fund and sanctioning assistance.

name: SIND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES OF MEMBERS) ACT, 1972.

metadata.title: The Sind Provincial Assembly (Salaries and Allowances of Members) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act defines the salaries and allowances for members of the Provincial Assembly of Sind. It establishes specific rates for monthly salary, daily allowances, travelling, and mileage, while also outlining conditions under which these payments are not payable.

metadata.title: The Sind Public Authorities Seals Act, 1883
metadata.repeals: Bombay Act 2 of 1870
metadata.summary: This Act empowers the Provincial Government to prescribe official seals for Sessions Judges, Magistrates, and other public authorities in Sind. It allows the government to issue notifications specifying which officials must use these seals and provides the mechanism to modify or rescind such notifications.

metadata.title: The Sind Public Conveyances Act, 1920
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the licensing of public conveyances, horses, and drivers in Sind. It establishes requirements for licenses, fees, fare rates, and outlines penalties for operating without a license or other offenses.

metadata.title: The Sind Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind Public Service Commission Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Public Service Commission Act, 1973. It adds a new sub-section to section 5 of the existing Act, allowing the Commission to perform other functions as prescribed.

metadata.title: The Sind Race-Courses Licensing Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the licensing of race-courses within the Province of Sind to regulate horse-racing. It establishes penalties for holding races on unlicensed courses and contravening license conditions, while also prohibiting betting.

metadata.title: The Sind Regional Plan Organization (Amendment) Act, 1986
metadata.amends: The Sind Regional Plan Organization Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Regional Plan Organization Act, 1975. It specifically substitutes the Chief Minister of Sindh as the Chairman in section 4, subsection (1), clause (a) of the original Act.

metadata.title: Sind Regulation VIII of 1827
metadata.summary: This regulation provides for the formal recognition of heirs, executors, and administrators in the Province of Sind. It establishes procedures for courts to appoint administrators when no competent claimant exists or when succession is disputed.

metadata.title: Sindh Regulation XXII of 1827
metadata.repeals: Act XIII of 1889
metadata.summary: This regulation defines the relationship between military authority and civil power, specifically regarding assistance provided to marching troops. It outlines procedures for civil authorities to furnish aid, rules on impressment during emergencies, and mechanisms for compensating individuals for damages caused by troop movements.

metadata.title: Sind Regulation VIII of 1827
metadata.summary: This regulation provides for the formal recognition of heirs, executors, and administrators in the Province of Sind. It establishes procedures for courts to appoint administrators when no competent claimant exists or when succession is disputed.

metadata.title: The Sind Rented Premises (Amendment) Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979. It substitutes section 22 to specify that execution of final orders and related questions shall be determined by the Controller rather than through a separate suit.

metadata.title: The Sind Repealing and Amending Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act serves to expressly repeal certain laws in the Province of Sind that have become unnecessary or ceased to be in force. Additionally, it amends specific other laws currently in force within the province.

metadata.title: The Sind Revenue Jurisdiction Act, 1876
metadata.summary: This Act limits the jurisdiction of Civil Courts in Sind regarding matters connected with land revenue. It also establishes specific procedures for suits against revenue officers, including requirements to exhaust appeal rights before filing civil suits.

metadata.title: The Sind Securities Contracts Control Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Act regulates and controls contracts for the purchase and sale of securities within the Province of Sind. It defines key terms such as 'securities', 'stock-exchange', and 'ready delivery contract' while establishing the framework for recognizing stock-exchanges and making rules to govern their operations.

metadata.title: The Sind Seed Corporation Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sind Seed Corporation for the Province of Sind to handle production, procurement, processing, marketing, and distribution of seeds. It defines the corporation's constitution, including its Board of Directors and executive officers, and outlines its powers, functions, financial management, and audit procedures.

metadata.title: The Sind Service Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Sind Service Tribunals (Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Service Tribunals Act, 1973 by updating definitions of civil servants and modifying provisions regarding posts, appeals, and limitations. It also inserts a new section on limitation periods for appeals and repeals a previous ordinance.

metadata.title: The Sind Service Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Service Tribunals Act, 1973 by substituting specific wording in section 3 regarding the number of members. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Sind Service Tribunals (Second Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Sind Services Tribunals (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sind Service Tribunals Act, 1973 by substituting provisions regarding the appointment term of tribunal members and inserting a new section on the removal of Chairmen or members due to incapacity or misconduct. It establishes a committee procedure for enquiring into such matters and defines specific grounds for misconduct, including political influence and moral turpitude.

name: SIND SMALL INDUSTRIES AND HANDICRAFTS DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION ACT, 1972

metadata.title: The Sind Small Industries Corporation Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: Sind Ordinance XXIII of 1972
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Small Industries Corporation in the Province of Sind to take over the business and assets of the defunct West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation. It aims to promote the development of small and cottage industries within the province by providing loans, facilities, and establishing a dedicated estate for these enterprises.

metadata.title: The Sind Small Industries Corporation (Amendment) Act, 1987
metadata.amends: The Sind Small Industries Corporation Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Small Industries Corporation Act, 1972 by substituting a new definition for 'small industry' in section 2. The amendment specifies that a small industry includes cottage industries engaged in handicrafts or the manufacture of consumer and producer goods with fixed capital investment not exceeding ten million rupees.

metadata.title: The Sind Societies Registration (Amendment) Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 to allow members of dissolved societies to vote on distributing remaining property to the government. The distributed property must be utilized for purposes specified in section 1 of the said Act.

name: SIND SPEAKER’S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER’S (SALARIES ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1976

metadata.title: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975. It adds a new provision stating that the maintenance of the residence for the Speaker or Deputy Speaker shall be undertaken by the Government.

name: SIND SPEAKER’S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER’S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES & PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances & Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1972. It specifically substitutes certain numerical values in section 7 of the amended Act.

name: SIND SPEAKER’S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER’S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCE AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 1972.

metadata.title: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act defines the salaries, allowances, and privileges for the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Provincial Assembly of Sind. It establishes specific monetary amounts for their salaries and outlines rules regarding official residences, travel expenses, and medical facilities.

name: SIND SPEAKER’S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER’S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985

metadata.title: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.amends: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to update financial provisions. It introduces a new equipment allowance for the Speaker and Deputy Speaker upon their first election and revises salary figures, residence allowances, and other monetary benefits specified in the original 1975 Act.

name: SIND SPEAKER’S AND DEPUTY SPEAKERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'first' for the word 'economy' in section 9, sub-section (2), clause (a) of the amended Act.

name: SIND STANDARD WEIGHTS AND MEASURES ENFORCEMENT ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Sind Standard Weights and Measures Enforcement Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Sind Weights and Measures Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the enforcement of standard weights and measures in the Province of Sind. It establishes definitions, standards, licensing requirements, and penalties for violations related to trade weights and measures.

metadata.title: The Sind Tax Evasion (Punishment) (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Tax Evasion (Punishment) Act, 1974 by adding new entries to its Schedule. The amendment specifically includes references to the Sind Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966, the Sind Finance Act, 1975, and the Workers Children (Education) Ordinance, 1972.

metadata.title: The Sind Tax Evasion (Punishment) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides deterrent punishment for the evasion of tax payable under certain scheduled laws. It also makes special provisions regarding the trial of defaulters and defines specific terms such as 'Government' and 'Scheduled Law'.

name: SIND TEACHING PROMOTION AND USE OF SINDHI LANGUAGE ACT, 1972

metadata.title: The Sind (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act prescribes measures for the teaching, promotion, and use of the Sindhi language within the Province of Sind. It mandates Sindhi as a compulsory subject in schools from class IV to XII and authorizes the government to establish academies for cultural advancement.

metadata.title: The Tenancy (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Tenancy Act, 1950. It substitutes a specific subsection in section 1 of the original Act to extend its application to the whole Province of Sind.

metadata.title: The Sind Town-Planning Act, 1915
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the making and execution of town-planning schemes to regulate area development. It aims to secure proper sanitary conditions, amenity, and convenience for residents in specified areas.

metadata.title: The Sind Universities (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.amends: University of Sind Act, 1972 and the University of Karachi, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Sind Act, 1972 and the University of Karachi Act, 1972 to update administrative titles and structures. It introduces new roles such as Pro-Vice-Chancellor, establishes Boards of Governors for additional campuses, and modifies financial officer designations.

metadata.title: The University of Sind Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: Sind Ordinance XVI, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and re-organizes the University of Sind to grant it necessary autonomy and improve its administration. It establishes the structure for various authorities, including the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, Syndicate, and Senate, while defining their powers and duties.

name: SIND UNLAWFUL SALE AND STOCKING FOR SALE OF MEDICAL EQUIPMENT AND DRUGS ACT, 1974.

metadata.title: The Sind Unlawful Sale and Stocking for Sale of Medical Equipment and Drugs Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act provides for punishment regarding the unlawful sale and stocking for sale of drugs and medical equipment belonging to the Government of Sind. It defines key terms such as 'drug', 'equipment', and 'official mark', and establishes penalties including imprisonment and fines for unauthorized dealing or disposal of these items.

name: SIND URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to update tax scales for buildings and lands in various rating areas. It also substitutes provisions regarding revenue sharing between the Government and local councils, modifies penalties for wrong declarations, and adjusts specific sections of the parent Act.

name: SIND URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to extend tax levies on buildings and lands used for industrial purposes. Specifically, it inserts a new subsection requiring tax collection in the industrial areas of Dhabeji, Gharo, and Kotri within any urban area.

name: SIND URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975.

metadata.title: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 by substituting specific provisions regarding betterment tax levies. It establishes new tax scales for commercial and industrial properties while providing exemptions for smaller land areas.

name: SIND URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1976

metadata.title: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 1976
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act serves to further amend the Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958. It specifically substitutes the word 'five' for 'three' in section 7 of the parent Act.

name: SIND URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1987

metadata.title: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 1987
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to validate valuation lists prepared for industrial properties in Karachi Division from January 1, 1977. It also repeals the corresponding Amendment Ordinance of 1987.

name: SIND URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax (Second Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act serves to further amend the Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958. It specifically substitutes the phrase 'levied at the rate of twenty percent of' with 'assessed on' in sub-section (3) of section 3 of the 1958 Act.

name: SIND WILD LIFE PROTECTION (SECOND AMENDMENT ACT, 1972

metadata.title: The Sind Wild-life Protection (Second Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Sind Wild-life Protection (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Wild-life Protection Ordinance, 1972 by substituting a higher monetary penalty in Section 33. It also repeals the previous Second Amendment Ordinance of 1972.

metadata.title: The Sind Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Sind Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972 by substituting 'Chief Minister of Sind' for 'Governor of Sind' in section 4. It also repeals the earlier Sind Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972.

metadata.title: The Sindh (Amendment of Laws) Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief in certain taxes and amends specific existing laws within the Province of Sindh. It substitutes a fee amount in the Stamp Act, 1899, and deletes a section from the Sindh Finance Act, 1996.

name: SINDH (ERADICATION AND CURBING THE MENACE OF INVOLUNTARY DONATION OR FORCED CHANDA) ACT, 2003

metadata.title: The Sindh (Eradication and Curbing the Menace of Involuntary Donation or Forced Chanda) Act, 2003
metadata.repeals: The Sindh (Eradication and Curbing the Menace of Involuntary Donation or Forced Chanda) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the eradication and curbing of involuntary donations or forced 'Chanda' within the Province of Sindh. It prohibits the collection of funds at doorsteps, mandates forfeiture of illegally collected funds to the Government, and prescribes penalties including imprisonment and fines for contraventions.

name: SINDH (MARTIAL LAW ORDER NO.227) REPEAL ACT, 1989

metadata.title: The Sindh (Martial Law Order No.227) Repeal Act, 1989
metadata.repeals: Martial Law Order No.227 issued by Martial Law Administrator Zone 'C'
metadata.summary: This Act repeals Martial Law Order No.227, which was issued by the Martial Law Administrator of Zone 'C'. The legislation came into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Sindh (Poultry Vaccine Centre) Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Sindh Poultry Vaccine Centre in the province of Sindh. It outlines the constitution, administration, powers, duties, and financial provisions for the Centre and its Board.

name: SINDH (PROHIBITION OF TAKING MINERALS INCLUDING RETI (SAND) AND BAJRI FROM ANY LAND) ACT, 2003

metadata.title: The Sindh (Prohibition of taking minerals including reti (sand) and bajri from any land) Act, 2003
metadata.repeals: The Sindh (Prohibition of taking Minerals including reti(sand) bajri from any land) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the taking of minerals, specifically reti (sand) and bajri, from any land in the Province of Sindh through excavation or other means. It establishes restrictions requiring prior government sanction for such activities to protect topography, archaeology, ecology, and environments, while also defining punishments for contravention.

name: SINDH (REGULARIZATION OF ADHOC AND CONTRACT EMPLYEES) ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh (Regularization of Adhoc and Contract Employees) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for certain employees appointed on an adhoc or contract basis in the Province of Sindh. It deems eligible employees holding posts from BS-1 to BS-18 as having been validly appointed on a regular basis immediately before the commencement of this Act.

name: SINDH (REPEAL OF THE POLICE ORDER, 2002 AND REVIVAL OF THE POLICE ACT, 1861) ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh (Repeal of the Police Order, 2002 and Revival of the Police Act, 1861) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Sindh (Repeal of the Police Order, 2002 and Revival of the Police Act, 1861) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.repeals: Police Order, 2002 (Chief Executive's Order No.XXII of 2002)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Police Order, 2002 and revives the Police Act, 1861 as they stood on August 13, 2002. It also provides for the continuation of orders and proceedings made under the repealed order between its enactment and the date this Act comes into force.

name: SINDH (REPEAL OF THE SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ORDINANCE, 2001 AND REVIVAL OF THE SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ORDINANCE, 1979) ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh (Repeal of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 and Revival of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Sindh (Repeal of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 and Revival of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.repeals: Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 and revives the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979 as it stood on August 5, 2001. It ensures that all legal instruments, proceedings, and appointments made under the repealed ordinance between August 6, 2001, and the date of this Act's commencement remain in force until altered.

name: SINDH (REPEAL OF THE SINDH PEOPLES LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACT, 2012 AND REVIVAL OF THE SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ORDINANCE, 1979) ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh (Repeal of the Sindh Peoples Local Government Act, 2012 and Revival of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979) Act, 2013
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Peoples Local Government Act, 2012; The Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Sindh Peoples Local Government Act, 2012 and the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001. It simultaneously revives the original Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979 as it stood on September 7, 2012.

name: SINDH (TEACHING, PROMOTION AND USE OF SINDHI LANGUAGE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990

metadata.title: The Sindh (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) (Amendment) Act, 1990
metadata.amends: The Sindh (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Sindh (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1990
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) Act, 1972 by substituting specific words in sections 5 and 7 regarding administrative bodies. It also repeals the corresponding Amendment Ordinance from 1990.

name: SINDH ADVISORS (APPOINTMENT, POWERS, FUNCTIONS, SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 2003 (codified)

metadata.title: The Sindh Advisors (Appointment, Powers, Functions, Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment, powers, functions, salaries, allowances, and privileges of Advisors to the Chief Minister of Sindh. It defines key terms such as 'Advisor', 'Chief Minister', and 'Government', and establishes that no court proceedings shall be called in question regarding decisions made under this Act.

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the modification of tax on agricultural income within the Province of Sindh. It establishes definitions for terms such as agricultural income, assessment years, and the Agriculture Income Tax officer, while outlining provisions for liability, collection, computation, and penalties.

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Supplies Organization (Amendment) Act, 1989
metadata.amends: The Sind Agricultural Supplies Organization Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Agricultural Supplies Organization Act, 1973. Specifically, it deletes the words 'not exceeding seven' from subsection (1) of section 5 of the original Act.

name: SINDH ALLOPATHIC SYSTEM (PREVENTION OF MISUSE) ACT, 2014

metadata.title: The Sindh Allopathic System (Prevention of Misuse) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act prevents the misuse of the allopathic system of medicine and provides for matters connected therewith within the Province of Sindh. It regulates who can use the title 'doctor', prescribe dangerous drugs, perform surgical operations, and sell proprietary medicines.

metadata.title: The Sindh Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The Sind Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963 by substituting a specific clause regarding government notifications. It also repeals the earlier Sindh Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 2004.

metadata.title: The Sindh Arms (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Arms Act, 2013 by adding a new sub-section to section 12. The amendment allows the Licensing Authority to extend licenses to the whole of Pakistan upon receipt of an application with sufficient and valid reasons.

metadata.title: The Sindh Arms (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.repeals: The Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1995 (in its application to the Province of Sindh)
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Arms Act, 2013 by adding a new section regarding the repeal and saving of certain provisions. Specifically, it repeals the application of the Pakistan Arms Ordinance, 1995 to the Province of Sindh, with exceptions for manufacturing, conversion, export, and import of arms and ammunition.

metadata.title: The Sindh Arms (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Arms Act, 2013 to introduce new provisions regarding ballistic signatures for firearms. It mandates arms dealers to collect verified thumb impressions and CNIC copies from purchasers and submit empty cartridges to the Forensic Lab for registration.

metadata.title: The Sindh Arms (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Arms Act, 2013 by adding a proviso to section 8. The amendment excludes specific groups from the conditions of permanent resident status applicable in the Province of Sindh.

metadata.title: The Sindh Arms (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Arms Act, 2013 to update specific clauses regarding firearm disposal and court procedures. It substitutes the word 'enshrining' with 'including' in section 39 and adds new clauses concerning the disposal of firearms and rules for technological advances.

metadata.title: The Sindh Arms Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act reforms the legislation pertaining to arms and ammunition in the Province of Sindh. It aims to curb the proliferation of licensed and unlicensed arms to disrupt social harmony, vitiate law and order, and contribute to violence. The document establishes provisions for the acquisition, possession, manufacture, sale, import, and export of arms and ammunition through a licensing framework.

name: SINDH ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990

metadata.title: The Sind Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment) Act, 1990
metadata.amends: The Sind Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974 to update salary figures and introduce new benefits. It specifically adds provisions for free travelling vouchers and office maintenance allowances for assembly members.

name: SINDH ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Sind Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974 to update salary figures and allowances for assembly members. It substitutes specific monetary amounts in various sections of the original Act and adds a new provision regarding mobile phone charges.

name: SINDH ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES AND ALLOWANCES) ACT, 2025

metadata.title: The Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the salaries, allowances, and other facilities for members of the Provincial Assembly of Sindh, including the Leader of Opposition. It establishes a Parliamentary Committee to recommend these financial terms to the Government, which are binding on the Government.

name: SINDH ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES AND ALLOWNCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989

metadata.title: The Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment) Act, 1989
metadata.amends: The Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974 by inserting a new section regarding medical benefits. The amendment grants medical facilities to assembly members, their spouses, minor children, unmarried daughters, and wholly dependent family members residing with them.

metadata.title: The Sindh Bank Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Bank to provide commercial and investment banking services within the Province of Sindh. It defines the bank's structure, including its share capital, board composition, and shareholder qualifications.

name: SINDH BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Sindh Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Sindh Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970. It substitutes the words 'Chief Minister, Sindh' for 'Governor of Sindh' in section 10 of the said Ordinance.

name: SINDH BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND THE BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Sindh Board of Technical Education and the Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Sindh Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970 and the Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends two specific Ordinances from 1970 and 1972 regarding technical, intermediate, and secondary education in Sindh. It grants the respective Boards the power to issue certificates and diplomas to candidates promoted without examinations during epidemics, pandemics, or declared emergencies.

name: SINDH BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972. It comes into force immediately upon enactment.

name: SINDH BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2008

metadata.title: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 2008
metadata.amends: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972. It comes into force immediately upon enactment.

name: SINDH BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995

metadata.title: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 1995
metadata.amends: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972 to include a new Board at Larkana. It also repeals the previous Amendment Ordinance from 1995.

name: SINDH BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2005

metadata.title: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.amends: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972 to establish a new Board in Mirpurkhas. It also repeals the previous Amendment Ordinance from 2004.

metadata.title: The Sindh Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the abolition of the bonded labour system in the Province of Sindh to prevent economic and physical exploitation. It declares all customs, agreements, and practices related to bonded labour void and extinguishes liability to repay bonded debts.

metadata.title: The Sindh Building Control (Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Building Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Building Control Ordinance, 1979 by modifying Section 19 to add a proviso regarding offences related to building works. It also repeals the Sindh Building Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994.

metadata.title: The Sindh Building Control (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Building Control Ordinance, 1979 to incorporate changes regarding town planning and site development schemes. It introduces new sections for master plans, site development schemes, building erection procedures, and completion reporting requirements.

metadata.title: The Sindh Building Control (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Building Control Ordinance, 1979 to incorporate changes regarding town planning and site development schemes. It introduces new sections concerning master plans, site development procedures, building erection sanctions, and completion reporting requirements.

metadata.title: The Sindh Buildings Control (Amendment) Act, 1998
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Building Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979 by substituting a proviso in section 19 regarding offences related to building regulations. It also repeals the Sindh Building Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.

metadata.title: The Sindh Buildings Control (Second Amendment) Act, 1990
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Buildings Control (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1990
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sind Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979 by adding new provisions regarding the suspension or cancellation of no objection certificates. It defines 'completion of building' and mandates re-processing of matters if an order is passed under the new sub-sections.

metadata.title: The Sindh Child Marriages Restraint Act, 2013
metadata.repeals: The Child Marriage Restraint Act, 1929 (relating to the Province of Sindh)
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to restrain the solemnization of child marriages in Sindh. It defines a child as anyone under eighteen and establishes punishments for males, those who facilitate such marriages, and parents or guardians involved.

metadata.title: The Sindh Child Protection Authority (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Sindh Child Protection Authority Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Child Protection Authority Act, 2011 to update definitions regarding child abuse and missing children. It also modifies the composition of the Authority and establishes new rules for meetings and vacancy filling.

metadata.title: The Sindh Child Protection Authority Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Child Protection Authority as a body corporate to ensure the rights of children in need of special protection. It defines key terms such as 'child', 'abuse', and 'caregiver' while outlining the authority's composition, functions, and powers regarding protective measures and funds.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Act, 1991
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 by substituting specific sections regarding original jurisdiction and monetary limits. It also repeals the earlier Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 by substituting a specific monetary figure in section 18. It also repeals the earlier Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962. It substitutes a proviso in section 7 regarding the transfer of civil suits with values not exceeding five lacs of rupees from the High Court to District Courts in Karachi.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 to alter the original jurisdiction limits for District Judges and High Courts in civil suits. Specifically, it substitutes section 7 to define jurisdiction based on a value limit of fifteen million rupees instead of thirty lacs, while preserving pending cases in the High Court.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 to update monetary and date figures due to inflation. Specifically, it substitutes 'fifteen million' with 'sixty five million' in sections 7 and 24, and updates the year from 2010 to 2021.

name: SINDH CIVIL SERVANT (REGULARIZATION OF ADHOC APPOINTMENTS)(APPOINTMENT) ACT, 2014.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Regularization of Adhoc Appointments) (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.amends: The Sindh Civil Servants (Regularization of Adhoc Appointment) Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Civil Servants (Regularization of Adhoc Appointment) Act, 1994. It substitutes specific wording in section 3 regarding the date of appointment.

name: SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (REGULARIZATION OF ABSORPTION) ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Regularization of Absorption) Act, 2011
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Civil Servants (Regularization of Absorption) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for certain employees absorbed as civil servants in various departments of the Government of Sindh. It deems these employees to have been validly absorbed on a regular basis from their original absorption date and grants them seniority benefits based on equivalent posts held prior to absorption.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973 to facilitate the appointment of federal civil servants transferred to the province following the Eighteenth Amendment. It empowers the Government to appoint such individuals and determine their terms, conditions, cadre, and seniority in a prescribed manner.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973 by omitting specific words regarding basic pay scales in section 5. It was enacted on July 28, 2005, and comes into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973 to regulate appointments and promotions within the Police Department. It specifically regularizes out-of-turn promotions made immediately before its commencement and affirms their validity.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973 to include provisions for transgender appointments. Specifically, it mandates that 0.5% of appointments in basic pay scales 15 and below must be made from amongst transgenders, subject to availability and medical certification by the Standing Medical Board.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 13 of the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973. Specifically, it substitutes clause (b) regarding voluntary retirement conditions based on qualifying service or age.

name: SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (REGULARIZATION OF ADHOC APPOINTMENTS) ACT, 1989

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Regularization of Adhoc Appointments) Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for certain civil servants who were appointed on an adhoc basis in Sindh. It establishes procedures for terminating junior services when necessary to accommodate regularized personnel and defines the seniority ranking among regularized officers.

name: SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (REGULARIZATION OF ADHOC APPPOINTENTS) ACT, 1994

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Regularization of Adhoc Appointments) Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for certain civil servants who were appointed on an adhoc basis in Sindh. It deems such officers validly appointed on a regular basis if they hold posts in BS-16 or above and are in employment at the time the Act commences, subject to scrutiny by a Special Committee.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Second Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973 to provide for the regularization of services for certain employees absorbed or promoted under section 9-A. It grants the Government power to appoint retired civil servants based on expertise and public interest, while also validating previous absorptions or promotions made before this Act's commencement.

name: SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION ACT, 2005

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants Housing Foundation Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Civil Servants Housing Foundation to provide houses on a no-profit, no-loss basis. It applies to civil servants and retired civil servants in the province of Sindh.

metadata.title: The Sindh Co-operative Housing Authority (Amendment) Act, 1989
metadata.amends: The Sind Co-operative Housing Authority Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Co-operative Housing Authority Ordinance, 1982. It mandates that the Government must afford an opportunity of hearing to a society before taking action under section 6(2), with exceptions for emergent measures.

metadata.title: The Sindh Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 by adding a new section regarding the transfer of interest in housing societies. It stipulates that a member ceases to be a member when their interest in immovable property is transferred via sale, inheritance, or gift, and outlines the conditions for admitting the new person as a member.

metadata.title: The Sindh Co-operative Societies Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the law relating to cooperative societies in the Province of Sindh. It aims to facilitate the formation and working of these societies to promote thrift, self-help, and mutual aid among agriculturists and others with common economic needs.

metadata.title: The Sindh Coal Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and development of coal within the Province of Sindh. It establishes an Inspectorate of Coal Mines, defines key terms related to coal titles and mining operations, and outlines requirements for environmental assessments, safety plans, and corporate social responsibility.

metadata.title: The Sindh Coal Authority (Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Coal Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Coal Authority Act, 1994 by substituting specific clauses in section 7 regarding the nomination of members. It also repeals the earlier Sindh Coal Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994.

metadata.title: The Sindh Coal Authority (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Coal Authority Act, 1993 to update provisions regarding the Board's composition and meeting procedures. It also introduces new sections concerning gratuity and provident fund schemes, validates past appointments made after May 2002, and provides mechanisms for removing difficulties in implementing the Act.

metadata.title: The Sindh Coal Authority Act, 1993
metadata.repeals: Sindh Ordinance No.XXII of 1993
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Coal Authority as a body corporate to manage coal exploration, development, processing, and utilization in the Province of Sindh. It outlines the Authority's functions, powers, administrative structure, and financial provisions while repealing a previous ordinance.

metadata.title: The Sindh Coastal Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Sindh Coastal Development Authority Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Coastal Development Authority Act, 1994 to update definitions and composition of authorities. Specifically, it revises the definition of coastal areas to include Thatta, Sujawal, and Badin districts, and modifies section 5 regarding Deputy Commissioners and Provincial Assembly members.

name: SINDH COMMISSION ON THE STATUS OF WOMEN ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Sindh Commission on the Status of Women Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Commission on the Status of Women (SPCSW) to promote the social, economic, political, and legal rights of women in the province. It defines the composition, qualifications, and appointment procedures for the Chairperson and Members of the Commission.

name: SINDH COMMISSION ON THE STATUS OF WOMEN ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Sindh Information of Temporary Residents Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a legal framework for sharing information about tenants and temporary residents in the Province of Sindh with the police. It mandates property dealers, landlords, and hotel managers to provide specific details within set timeframes to help combat terrorism and other crimes.

metadata.title: The Sindh Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the participation of workers in the profits of companies operating in the Province of Sindh. It establishes a Workers' Participation Fund and constitutes a Board of Trustees to manage and administer that fund.

name: SINDH COMPULSORY IODIZATION OF SALT ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh Compulsory Iodization of Salt Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the compulsory iodization of edible salt within the Province of Sindh to prevent iodine deficiency disorders. It establishes regulations regarding the processing, import, storage, and sale of iodized salt, including requirements for labeling, quality standards, and licensing.

metadata.title: The Sindh Condominium Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the maintenance of public sale projects in the Province of Sindh. It establishes provisions for services, amenities, and common areas managed by residents or registered maintenance companies.

metadata.title: The Sindh Consumer Protection Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection and promotion of the rights and interests of consumers in the Province of Sindh. It establishes mechanisms for the speedy redress of consumer complaints, defines key terms such as 'consumer' and 'defective product', and outlines the powers of authorities and consumer courts.

metadata.title: The Sindh Control of Narcotic Substances (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.amends: The Sindh Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 2024 to update various sections regarding police roles, seizure procedures, and court functions. It includes specific changes to terminology, provisions for confiscation of valuable items, and rules for appointing judges to special courts.

name: SINDH CONTROL OF NARCOTIC SUBSTANCES ACT, 2024

metadata.title: The Sindh Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act provides laws relating to narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances, precursor chemicals, and control substances within the Province of Sindh. It regulates their production, processing, and trafficking while establishing prohibitions, punishments, and special courts for enforcement.

metadata.title: The Sindh Covid-19 Emergency Relief (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.amends: The Sindh Covid-19 Emergency Relief Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Covid-19 Emergency Relief Act, 2020 to introduce new provisions regarding free testing campaigns and paid leave for infected workers. It also mandates the wearing of face masks in public places to mitigate infection spread.

metadata.title: The Sindh Covid-19 Emergency Relief Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief to the people of Sindh during the emergency situation caused by the widespread pandemic of Corona Virus (Covid-19). It addresses challenges arising from government measures to stop disease spread and mitigates issues related to bans or lockdowns imposed throughout the province.

name: SINDH CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2009 to update the constitution, functions, and powers of the service. It introduces new sections regarding work distribution, guidelines for investigation, disciplinary actions, and specific powers for prosecutors to withdraw from cases or call for records.

name: SINDH CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2009 to clarify government superintendence over the service. It establishes specific terms for appointing a Prosecutor General and defines the tenure of office as non-extendable for three years.

name: SINDH CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS)(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014

metadata.title: The Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions & Powers) (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.amends: The Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions & Powers) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions & Powers) Act, 2009 to update provisions regarding the tenure of the Prosecutor General and terminology in section 6. It also substitutes section 7 to establish specific eligibility criteria for appointing a Prosecutor General, including citizenship, minimum age of forty-five years, and at least ten years of experience as an Advocate of the High Court.

metadata.title: The Sindh Cultural Heritage (Preservation) Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the preservation and protection of ancient places and objects in the Province of Sindh that hold architectural, historical, archaeological, artistic, ethnological, anthropological, or national interest. It establishes an Advisory Committee to assist the Government in identifying protected heritage, declaring premises as such, and managing their custody, maintenance, and acquisition.

name: SINDH DEVELOPMENT AND MAINTENANCE OF INFRASTRUCTURE CESS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018.

metadata.title: The Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure Cess (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.amends: The Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure Cess Act, 2017
metadata.repeals: section 9 of the Sindh Finance Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure Cess Act, 2017 by adding a new section. The added provision repeals section 9 of the Sindh Finance Act, 1994.

name: SINDH DEVELOPMENT AND MAINTENANCE OF INFRASTRUCTURE CESS ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure Cess Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the levy of a cess on goods entering into or leaving the Province of Sindh from or for outside the country via air or sea. The collected funds are designated for the development and maintenance of provincial infrastructure, including roads, public facilities, and traffic control.

name: SINDH DEVELOPMENT AND MAINTENANCE OF INFRASTRUCTURE CESS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2026

metadata.title: The Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure Cess (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.amends: The Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure Cess Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure Cess Act, 2017 to introduce new provisions for settling liabilities through agreements. It establishes specific payment schedules, conditions for withdrawing pending litigation, and reduced cess rates for compliant owners.
