name: SINDH DIFFERENTLY ABLE PERSONS (EMPLOYMENT, REHABILITATION AND WELFARE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Sindh Differently Able Persons (Employment, Rehabilitation and Welfare) (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Sindh Differently Able Persons (Employment, Rehabilitation and Welfare) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Differently Able Persons (Employment, Rehabilitation and Welfare) Act, 2014. Specifically, it substitutes the word 'five percent' for 'two percent' in subsection (1) of section 8 of the amended Act.

name: SINDH DIFFERENTLY ABLE PERSONS (EMPLOYMENT, REHABILITATION AND WELFARE) ACT, 2014

metadata.title: The Sindh Differently Able Persons (Employment, Rehabilitation and Welfare) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the employment, rehabilitation, and welfare of differently able persons in the Province of Sindh. It establishes a Council to execute policies, undertake welfare projects, and coordinate efforts regarding these individuals.

name: SINDH DISPOSAL OF URBAN LAND (REPEAL) ACT, 2005

metadata.title: The Sindh Disposal of Urban Land (Repeal) Act, 2005
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Disposal of Urban Land Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act serves to repeal the Sindh Disposal of Urban Land Ordinance, 2002. It was enacted by the Government of Sindh and came into force immediately upon its notification.

metadata.title: The Sindh Education Foundation Act, 1992
metadata.repeals: Sindh Ordinance No.III of 1992
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Education Foundation as a body corporate with perpetual succession to promote and develop education in the Province of Sindh. It outlines the composition of the Board, the appointment of officers, and the foundation's aims, which include expanding educational facilities and providing financial assistance to institutions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Emergency Procurement Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for emergency procurement specifically for the law enforcement agencies in the Province of Sindh. It was enacted to address urgent security needs arising from targeted attacks and threats, allowing agencies to procure items like armored vehicles and bulletproof gear without following standard procedures.

metadata.title: The Sindh Emergency Rescue Service Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Emergency Rescue Service (Rescue 1122) to handle emergencies in the Province of Sindh. It defines the service's functions, including preparedness, rescue operations, evacuation, and providing emergency medical treatment.

metadata.title: The Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Act, 1991
metadata.amends: The Sind Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986
metadata.repeals: The Sindh, Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986 to include an additional special allowance for employees. It mandates that every employee be paid an additional special allowance of two hundred rupees per month starting from December 1, 1990.

metadata.title: The Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Act, 1995
metadata.amends: The Sind Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986 to introduce an additional special allowance of one hundred rupees per month for employees employed on or after May 1, 1995. It also repeals the Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1995.

metadata.title: The Sindh Employees' Old-Age Benefits (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Sindh Employees' Old-Age Benefits Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Employees' Old-Age Benefits Act, 2014 to update various sections regarding contribution rates, eligibility criteria, and definitions. It introduces changes to clauses concerning insured persons, contractors, and specific benefits like Survivor's Pension and Invalidity Pension.

metadata.title: The Sindh Employees' Old-Age Benefits Act, 2014
metadata.amends: The Sindh Employees' Old-Age Benefits Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Employees' Old-Age Benefits Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and re-enacts the law relating to old-age benefits for persons employed in industrial, commercial, and other organizations within the Province of Sindh. It establishes provisions for compulsory insurance, contributions by employers and the government, and various benefit schemes including old-age pensions and survivor's pensions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Employees' Social Security Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act introduces a scheme of social security to provide benefits to employees or their dependents in cases of sickness, maternity, employment injury, or death. It establishes the Employees' Social Security Institution and outlines provisions for contributions, medical care, and dispute resolution.

metadata.title: The Sindh Enquiries and Anti-Corruption Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the constitution of a special agency known as the Enquiries and Anti-Corruption Establishment in Sindh. It outlines the powers of this establishment to investigate corruption offences and misconduct by public servants, including powers of search, arrest, and seizure.

metadata.title: The Sindh Entertainments Duty (Amendment) Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Entertainments Duty Act, 1958 by substituting specific words in section 3 and adding new text to section 11. It was enacted on March 4, 1993, but is deemed to have taken effect from May 17, 1992.

metadata.title: The Sindh Environmental Protection Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection, conservation, rehabilitation, and improvement of the environment in the Province of Sindh. It also establishes mechanisms for the prevention and control of pollution and promotes sustainable development through the creation of specific councils and agencies.

metadata.title: The Sindh Epidemic Diseases Act, 2014
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Epidemic Diseases Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the law relating to the prevention of the spread of dangerous epidemic diseases in the Province of Sindh. It empowers the Government to take special measures, prescribe temporary regulations, and delegate powers to Deputy Commissioners when ordinary laws are insufficient.

name: SINDH ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES PRICE CONTROL AND PREVENTION OF PROFITEERING AND HOARDING (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2008

metadata.title: The Sindh Essential Commodities Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and hoarding (Amendment) Act, 2008
metadata.amends: The Sindh Essential Commodities Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and hoarding Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sindh Essential Commodities Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and hoarding Act, 2005. It comes into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Sindh Eye Surgery (Restriction) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act prevents non-registered medical practitioners from performing eye surgeries in the Province of Sindh. It defines specific terms related to blindness and surgical operations, while prescribing punishments including imprisonment and fines for those who violate these restrictions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Factories (Second Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sindh Factories Act, 2015 to update registration requirements and penalty structures. It introduces new provisions for layout plan approvals and increases fines for non-compliance with factory registration.

metadata.title: The Sindh Factories Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates and amends the laws regulating labour in factories within the Province of Sindh. It establishes provisions for factory registration, inspecting staff powers, health and safety standards, working hour restrictions, and penalties for contraventions.

name: SINDH FACULTY OF PARAMEDICAL AND ALLIED HEALTH SCIENCES ACT, 2023

metadata.title: The Sindh Faculty of Paramedical and Allied Health Sciences Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Faculty of Paramedical and Allied Health Sciences to provide it with necessary autonomy. It aims to raise training standards, improve administration, and regulate the education and registration of paramedics in the Province of Sindh.

metadata.title: The Sindh Fertilizer (Control) Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the sale, distribution, and use of fertilizer and fertilizer material in Sindh. It establishes a Fertilizer Control Committee and a testing laboratory to oversee compliance with standards regarding purity, labelling, and usage.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance Act, 1977
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; West Pakistan Act V of 1958; West Pakistan Act XXXII of 1958; West Pakistan Act XXXVIII of 1958; West Pakistan Act XXIV of 1964; West Pakistan Ordinance XIX of 1965
metadata.repeals: West Pakistan Act XXXVIII of 1958
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, levies, and enhances certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sind. It also amends several existing laws related to stamp duties, urban immovable property tax, and valuation lists.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Act, 1991
metadata.amends: Sind Finance Act, 1964 and Sind Finance Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Finance Act, 1964 and the Sind Finance Act, 1975 to introduce new surcharges on cess and fees. The amendments specify rates for these surcharges to fund water supply and drainage schemes undertaken by local councils.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Act, 1995
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Finance Act, 1964 by substituting specific monetary values and restructuring the incidence of a sugar cess. It also repeals the earlier Sindh Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1995.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Act, 2007
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Finance Act, 1994 to rationalize cess rates for the maintenance and development of infrastructure. The changes aim to ensure smooth and safer movement of goods entering or leaving the province through air or sea.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Finance (Amendment) Act, 2007 to give it retrospective effect. It also adds provisions regarding the utilization of cess proceeds for infrastructure maintenance and restricts refunds for over-paid cess claims.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Finance Act, 1964 to introduce and regulate Electricity Duty levied on energy consumption starting April 1, 2013. It outlines assessment procedures for licensees, payment mechanisms for consumers, and recovery processes for unpaid duties including penalties.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Finance Act, 2014 to update tax rates applicable to real estate investment trusts (REITs) and EITS. It also modifies the Stamp Act, 1899 regarding duties on leases involving these trusts.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Finance Act, 1993 by substituting specific fee amounts in section 10. It changes the charge from fifty rupees per truck per trip to ten rupees per metric ton.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Finance Act, 2010 by omitting section 4. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh and assented to by the Governor on September 3, 2020.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance (Second Amendment) Act, 1995
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Finance (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Finance Act, 1964 by deleting specific entries regarding industrial undertakings and energy rates in its fifth Schedule. It also repeals the earlier Sindh Finance (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1995.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 1989
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; West Pakistan Act XXXII of 1958; West Pakistan Act XXXIV of 1964; Sind Act XV of 1975
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, enhances, and levies certain taxes, duties, and fees within the Province of Sindh. It amends several existing acts regarding stamp duties, motor vehicle taxation, and income tax schedules while also establishing a licensing regime for motor vehicle dealers.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 1990
metadata.amends: The Societies Registration Act, 1860; The Court-Fees Act, 1870; The Stamp Act, 1899; The Court Fees (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1977; The Court Fees (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: The Court Fees (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, enhances, and levies certain duties and fees within the Province of Sindh. It amends several existing laws, including the Societies Registration Act, 1860, the Court-Fees Act, 1870, and the Stamp Act, 1899, to update fee structures and definitions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 1993
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Sindh Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; Sindh Motor Vehicle Taxation Act, 1958; Sindh Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, levies, and enhances certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sindh. It amends several existing statutes, including the Stamp Act, Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, Motor Vehicle Taxation Act, and the Finance Act of 1964, to update rates and procedures.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 1994
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Act-XXXII of 1958; The Stamp Act, 1899
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes and enhances certain taxes, duties, and fees within the Province of Sindh. It amends the West Pakistan Act of 1958 and makes extensive amendments to the Stamp Act, 1899, including updating fee schedules and inserting new articles.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 1995
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Sindh Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; Sindh Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; Sindh Finance Act, 1964; Sindh Finance Act, 1977; Sindh Finance Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, levies, and enhances certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sindh. It amends several existing statutes to adjust tax rates on plots, flats, hotels, energy usage, and other specific transactions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 1996
metadata.amends: Act II of 1899; West Pakistan Act V of 1958; Sindh Act No. XIII of 1994; Sindh Act No. XVII of 1994
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes and enhances certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sindh. It amends existing legislation, including the Stamp Act of 1899, to update stamp duty rates for various instruments such as allotment orders, contracts, and conveyances.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2003
metadata.amends: Stamp Act II of 1890; W.P. Act V of 1958; Sindh Act XXVI of 1974; Sindh Act VII of 1977; Ordinance XII of 2000; Sindh Finance Act, 1977; Sindh Finance Act, 1994; Sindh Land Tax and Agriculture Income Tax Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes and provides relief in certain taxes and duties within the province of Sindh. It also amends several existing provincial laws, including the Stamp Act, Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, and various Finance Acts.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The Stamp Act, 1899; The Sind Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief in certain duties and taxes within the Province of Sindh. It also amends specific sections of the Stamp Act, 1899, and the Sind Finance Act, 1964.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2005
metadata.amends: West Pakistan Act XXXIV of 1964; Sind Act VII of 1977; Sindh Act No.XIII of 1994; Sindh Ordinance VII of 2000; Sindh Ordinance VIII of 2000; Sindh Finance (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes certain taxes and provides relief on specific taxes and fees within the Province of Sindh. It also amends several existing laws, including the West Pakistan Act of 1964 and various Sindh Ordinances from 2000 and 2001.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2006
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; West Pakistan Act XXXII of 1958; Sindh Act XXVI of 1974; Sindh Act VIII of 1975; Sindh Ordinance VIII of 2000; Sindh Act I of 2005
metadata.repeals: Sindh Ordinance XVII of 2006
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sindh. It also amends various existing laws, including the Stamp Act, 1899, and several other Acts from 1958 to 2005.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2007
metadata.amends: Sind Motor Vehicle Taxation Act, 1958; Sind Finance Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes certain taxes in the Province of Sindh and amends relevant laws. It specifically substitutes entries in the Sind Motor Vehicle Taxation Act, 1958, and section 8 of the Sind Finance Act, 1977.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2008
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Sindh Finance Act, 1994; Sindh Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000; Sind Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes certain duties and cess in the Province of Sindh. It also amends relevant existing laws, including the Stamp Act, Sindh Finance Act, Sales Tax Ordinance, and Motor Vehicles Taxation Act.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2009
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Sind Act VIII of 1977; West Pakistan Ordinance XIX of 1965; Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes certain duties and taxes in the Province of Sindh. It also amends relevant existing laws, including the Stamp Act, 1899, and the Sind Finance Act, 1977.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2010
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; WP Act V of 1958; Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes certain duties and taxes within the Province of Sindh. It specifically provides for the levy of Capital Value Tax on immovable property acquired through various means, excluding inheritance or specific family gifts.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2013
metadata.amends: Sindh Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; Sindh Finance Act, 1977; Sindh Finance Act, 1994; Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, levies, and enhances certain taxes, duties, and cess within the Province of Sindh. It also amends several existing laws, including the Sindh Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958, and the Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2014
metadata.amends: Sindh Finance Act XIII of 2010; Stamp Act No.II of 1899; Sindh Act No.XII of 2011; Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, levies, and enhances certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sindh. It also amends several existing laws in the province to update definitions, tax rates, and fee structures related to property transfers and services.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2015
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Sindh Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; Sindh Finance Act, 1994; Sindh Finance Act, 2010; Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, levies, and enhances certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sindh. It also amends several existing laws in the province to update tax rates, definitions, and provisions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes certain taxes in the Province of Sindh and amends specific laws within that province. It introduces amendments to the Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011, including changes to tax rates, input tax adjustment mechanisms, and penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2026
metadata.amends: Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011; Sindh Act No. II of 2025
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, levies, and enhances certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sindh. It also amends specific existing laws in the province to update tax provisions, penalties, and procedural rules.

name: SINDH FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh Financial Management and Accountability Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes provisions for the efficient and transparent management of the Provincial Consolidated Fund and Public Account in Sindh. It ensures proper accountability for all financial transactions within the province.

metadata.title: The Sindh Fisheries (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Fisheries (Amendment) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Fisheries Ordinance, 1980 by adding a new clause to section 2 regarding the definition of 'net' and substituting subsection (1) with new subsections (1) and (1A) in section 21. It establishes specific punishments for contravening provisions of sections 4, 5, 7, or 8 of the said Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Sindh Fisheries (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Fisheries Ordinance, 1980 to update terminology and definitions regarding fishermen and water bodies. It also substitutes sections related to fishing licenses and cancels prior leases.

metadata.title: The Sindh Food Fortification Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act mandates the fortification of staple foods like wheat flour, ghee, and edible oil to address severe micronutrient malnutrition in Sindh. It establishes legal requirements for importers, manufacturers, and retailers to ensure food safety and proper labeling while defining key terms and regulatory authorities.

metadata.title: The Sindh Freedom of Information Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act provides for transparency and freedom of information to ensure citizens of the Province of Sindh have improved access to public records. It aims to make the Provincial Government more accountable to its citizens by regulating how public bodies maintain, publish, and disclose official records.

metadata.title: The Sindh Fund Management House Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and regulates the Sindh Fund Management House to ensure the efficient management of investment funds belonging to the Government of Sindh and its entities. It provides for the constitution of the House, its Board, Investment Committee, and Internal Audit Committee, along with their respective functions, powers, and responsibilities.

metadata.title: The Sindh Goth-Abad (Housing Scheme) (Amendment) Act, 2008
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Goth-Abad (Housing Scheme) Act, 1987 to update definitions regarding rural areas and local government ordinances. It inserts a new section allowing the Government to declare specific dehs or towns as rural areas via notification.

name: SINDH GOVERNMENT SERVANTS BENEVOLENT FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989

metadata.title: The Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund (Amendment) Act, 1989
metadata.amends: The Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960 to update definitions regarding family members and omit certain clauses. It also modifies provisions related to housing schemes for serving servants and their families, and restructures the Boards of Management to allocate powers for investing funds and providing relief at provincial, divisional, and secretariat levels.

name: SINDH GOVERNMENT SERVANTS BENEVOLENT FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Sindh Government Servants Benevolent Fund (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.amends: The Sind Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960. It substitutes the words 'Divisional' and 'Division' with 'District' in section 6 of the said Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Sindh Health Foundation Act, 1992
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Health Foundation as a body corporate to promote, develop, and finance the health sector in the Province of Sindh. It specifically targets less developed, less privileged, and rural areas by enabling the foundation to establish health institutions, provide grants and loans, and assist private sectors in population welfare programs.

metadata.title: The Sindh Healthcare Commission Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Healthcare Commission to improve the quality of healthcare services in the Province of Sindh. It provides for the registration and licensing of healthcare establishments, sets standards for care, and aims to ban quackery in all its forms.

name: SINDH HEALTHCARE SERVICE PROVIDERS AND FACILITIES (PREVENTION OF VIOLENCE AND DAMAGE TO PROPERTY) ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh Healthcare Service Providers and Facilities (Prevention of Violence and Damage to Property) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides legal protection to healthcare service providers and prohibits violence against them. It also aims to prevent damage or loss to property within healthcare service facilities or those mandated for providing healthcare services.

metadata.title: The Sindh High Density Development (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Sindh High Density Development Board Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh High Density Development Board Act, 2010. It specifically substitutes the text of section 3 regarding the constitution and membership of the Board.

name: SINDH HIGH DENSITY DEVELOPMENT BOARD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh High Density Development Board (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Sindh High Density Development Board Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh High Density Development Board Act, 2010 to allow the Board to co-opt heads of local civil agencies and representatives of professional bodies as members. The amendment specifically modifies section 4 of the parent Act by replacing a full stop with a colon and adding the new proviso regarding member co-option.

name: SINDH HIGH DENSITY DEVELOPMENT BOARD ACT, 2010

metadata.title: The Sindh High Density Development Board Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the High Density Development Board to ensure coordinated and integrated development of high density zones in urban centers within the Province of Sindh. It defines the composition of the Board, outlines its powers to identify high-density zones, and authorizes the government to make rules for carrying out the Act's purposes.

metadata.title: The Sindh Higher Education Commission Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Higher Education Commission to promote and improve higher education, research, and development within the province. It defines the Commission's structure, including its Chairperson, members, and functions, while also outlining provisions for accounts, audit, and miscellaneous administrative matters.

metadata.title: The Sindh Hindus Marriage Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a formal legal framework for the registration of marriages among Hindus in the Province of Sindh. It outlines specific conditions for solemnization, including age requirements, consent, and witness presence, while mandating registration within 45 days at Union Councils or Municipal Authorities.

name: SINDH HIV AND AIDS CONTROL TREATMENT AND PROTECTION ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh HIV and AIDS Control Treatment and Protection Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act is enacted to control the transmission and spread of HIV within the Province of Sindh. It also provides measures for the treatment, care, and support of people living with HIV and AIDS.

metadata.title: The Sindh Home-Based Workers Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act formulates the law relating to persons working in the informal or unorganized sector within their homes or surrounding grounds. It aims to protect their rights, recognize their contribution to the economy, and provide mechanisms for settling disputes.

metadata.title: The Sind Incumbered Estates Act, 1896
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief for zamindars in Sind who are subject to debts or liabilities exceeding a certain threshold. It establishes procedures for applying for benefits, conducting inquiries into debts, appointing managers, and creating schemes for the liquidation of estates.

metadata.title: The Sindh Information Technology Board (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.amends: The Sindh Information Technology Board Ordinance, 2002
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Information Technology Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Information Technology Board Ordinance, 2002 to update definitions regarding board members and vice-chairpersons. It also modifies the composition of the Board to include private sector representatives and adjusts powers related to delegation.

metadata.title: The Sindh Industrial Relations Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the formation of trade unions and governs relations between employers and workmen in the Province of Sindh. It establishes mechanisms for dispute resolution, including conciliation, arbitration, and the establishment of Labour Courts and Tribunals to handle industrial disputes.

metadata.title: The Sindh Injured Persons (Medical Aid) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the medical aid and treatment of injured persons to save their lives and protect their health during emergencies. It establishes priority treatment protocols, restricts police interference during hospitalization, and outlines penalties for contravention.

name: SINDH INJURED PERSONS COMPULSORY MEDICAL TREATMENT (AMAL UMER) ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Sindh Injured Persons Compulsory Medical Treatment (Amal Umer) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Sindh Injured Persons Compulsory Medical Treatment (Amal Umer) Bill, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes provisions for providing immediate medical aid and treatment to injured persons in emergencies within the Province of Sindh. It mandates that hospitals must treat injured individuals without delay, regardless of medico-legal formalities or ability to pay, ensuring stabilization before any other procedures.

name: SINDH INSTITUTE OF MANAGEMENT AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Management and Technology Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Management and Technology at Karachi and other places in Sindh Province. It defines the institute's powers, functions, governance structure, and admission policies to ensure it remains open to all regardless of sex, religion, or race.

name: SINDH INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES, KARACHI ACT, 2009

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Medical Sciences, Karachi Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Medical Sciences, Karachi as a degree-awarding body. It defines the institute's powers to conduct education, research, examinations, and confer academic distinctions.

name: SINDH INSTITUTE OF OPHTHALMOLOGY AND VISUAL SCIENCES ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences at Hyderabad by reconstituting and re-organizing the Liaquat University Eye Hospital. It provides for the transfer of property, personnel, and liabilities from the previous hospital to the new body corporate, while defining its functions, administration, and financial management.

name: SINDH INSTITUTE OF UROLOGY AND TRANSPLANTATION ACT, 1991

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation Act, 1991
metadata.repeals: Sindh Ordinance VII of 1990
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation by reconstituting the Urology Department of Dow Medical College. It outlines the Institute's functions, including treatment, research, teaching, and staff appointments, while defining the composition and powers of its Board of Governors.

name: SINDH INSURANCE OF PUBLIC PROPERTY ACT 2015

metadata.title: The Sindh Insurance of Public Property Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act regulates and directs the procurement of non-life insurance for public property within the Province of Sindh. It mandates that such insurance must be placed with Sindh Insurance Limited, subject to specific exemptions and penalties for contravention.

metadata.title: The Sindh Irrigation (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Irrigation Act, 1879 to reserve natural and artificial depression courses for flood and rain water discharge. It mandates that any person in possession of such government land must vacate within seven days of the Act's commencement.

name: SINDH IRRIGATION AND DRAINAGE AUTHORITY ACT, 1997

metadata.title: The Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority Act, 1997
metadata.repeals: Sindh Ordinance No.III of 1997
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority as a body corporate to manage irrigation water distribution and drainage systems in the Province of Sindh. It provides for the constitution of the Authority's board, its powers and duties, financial management, and mechanisms for flood control and sustainable water resource management.

metadata.title: The Sindh Judicial Academy Act, 1993
metadata.repeals: Sindh Ordinance No.XVIII of 1993
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Judicial Academy as a body corporate with its headquarters in Karachi. It defines the functions of the Academy, which include training members of the subordinate judiciary, conducting seminars, and publishing legal research. The Act also constitutes a Board to oversee the Academy's administration and outlines the powers of this Board.

metadata.title: The Sindh Katchi Abadis (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Katchi Abadis Act, 1987. It comes into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Sindh Katchi Abadis (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Katchi Abadis Act, 1987 by updating a specific date in section 19. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh and assented to by the Governor on July 19, 2022.

metadata.title: The Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Land Revenue Act, 1967 to introduce new definitions and provisions regarding service centers for maintaining computerized records. It also updates sections related to electronic documents and the authentication of computerized records of rights for a Deh.

metadata.title: The Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2008
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Land Revenue Act, 1967 to facilitate the renaming of districts or talukas. It inserts a new section (6-A) that empowers the provincial assembly to pass resolutions for such renamings and requires the government to issue notifications accordingly.

metadata.title: The Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Land Revenue Act, 1967 to update terminology regarding administrative officers and revive original nomenclatures for divisions and talukas. It also substitutes specific sections within the parent Act to reflect changes in titles such as Commissioner and Collector, and repeals a previous ordinance on the same subject.

metadata.title: The Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This document publishes the Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2019 as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh. It amends section 52 of the Sindh Land Revenue Act, 1967 regarding the presumption of correctness in records of rights.

metadata.title: The Sindh Laws (Amending and Repealing) Act, 1993
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Laws (Amending and Repealing) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Act amends and repeals certain laws in force in the Province of Sindh that are considered spent, unnecessary, or no longer in force. It specifically modifies sections within various existing Acts related to agriculture, prisons, soil reclamation, children's welfare, cultural advancement, and corruption prevention, while also repealing a previous Ordinance from 1993.

metadata.title: The Sindh Laws (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act corrects the spelling of the province's name from 'Sind' to 'Sindh' in all legal documents within the Province of Sindh. It ensures conformity with Article 1 of the Constitution following the 18th Amendment by substituting the word 'Sindh' for 'Sind' in Acts, Ordinances, rules, regulations, and other instruments.

metadata.title: The Sindh Laws (Second Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws in force in the Province of Sindh to update official titles. Specifically, it substitutes terms like 'District Officer (Revenue)' with 'Collector' and 'Executive District Officer (Revenue)' with 'Commissioner' throughout the specified statutes.

metadata.title: The Sindh Lepers (Repeal) Act, 1989
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Lepers Act, 1947
metadata.summary: This Act was enacted to repeal the Sindh Lepers Act, 1947. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: SINDH LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION AND SUCCESSION CERTIFICATES ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act establishes an efficacious and speedy mechanism for the issuance of Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates in the Province of Sindh. It creates a Succession Facilitation Unit under NADRA to process applications, maintain records, and handle objections regarding legal heirship.

name: SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT AND RAWANGI MAHSOOL VALIDATING) ACT, 1989

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment and Rawangi Mahsool Validating) Act, 1989
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment and Rawangi Mahsool Validating) Ordinance, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to validate the levy of Rawangi Mahsool on specific commodities by District Councils. It also repeals the corresponding ordinance from 1989 that had previously addressed these matters.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 to update provisions regarding Union Committees and Wards. It specifically addresses changes in delimitation processes, council composition, and the extension or alteration of council areas.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1991
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by inserting a new sub-section regarding the extension of specific periods via notification. It also repeals the previous Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to establish metropolitan and district municipal corporations in cities like Karachi. It defines new terms such as 'Controlling Authority' and modifies provisions regarding elections, office holding, taxation powers, and unified municipal services.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to regulate elections on a party basis and introduce provisions for the dissolution of local governments. It establishes procedures for appointing civil servants as administrators following dissolution and mandates the holding of new elections within a specific timeframe.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 to update various sections regarding definitions, election procedures, and committee compositions. It introduces changes such as substituting specific clauses, omitting certain provisions, and adding new rules for reserved seats for women, non-Muslims, and laborers.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 by altering voting procedures in Section 18. Specifically, it substitutes the phrase 'secret ballot' with 'show of hands' in several subsections and clauses.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013. Specifically, it inserts words into section 27 regarding exceptions for the Chairman or Vice Chairman of Union Committees or Union Councils.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This document publishes the Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2021 as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh. It amends the existing Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 by substituting a reference to the Elections Act, 2017 for the Representation of Peoples Act, 1976 in section 71.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 to introduce new definitions for 'Town Municipal Corporation' and update reserved seat quotas. It specifically adds provisions for persons with disabilities and transgender persons in local government bodies while modifying existing clauses regarding district councils and delimitation.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Fifth Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Local Government (Fifth Amendment) Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001. It specifically substitutes a provision regarding elections held after the dissolution of local governments and repeals the previous Fifth Amendment Ordinance from 2010.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by substituting specific time periods in section 179-A. It replaces 'seventy five days' with 'six months' and '165 days' with 'nine months'. The Act also repeals the previous Fourth Amendment Ordinance from 2010.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 by reviving section 18-A, which was previously omitted. It further modifies the revived section to insert the word 'youth' after the word 'women' wherever it appears.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 1987
metadata.repeals: The Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by adding a new sub-section to Section 121 regarding the appointment of authorities when the Mayor and members cease their functions. It also validates certain actions taken under Chapter XVI of the Ordinance between February 15, 1987, and the appointment of the Chairman, while repealing the previous Second Amendment Ordinance from 1987.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to modify provisions regarding election eligibility and the structure of the Election Authority. Specifically, it restricts certain individuals from contesting elections on general seats and updates clauses concerning physical incapacity and moral turpitude.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to incorporate 'deh panchayats' into the local government structure. It introduces new definitions for 'deh' and 'deh panchayat', modifies election rules, and adjusts provisions regarding council dissolution and member representation.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001. It specifically updates section 179-A regarding the appointment of Administrators from Civil Servants to perform Nazim functions until newly elected officials take office.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 by reviving a specific proviso in section 15 that was previously omitted. It also substitutes a new proviso in Schedule-I regarding the continued existence of Town Committees and Municipal Corporations established prior to or after the 2001 Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 to modify the provisions regarding reserved seats for specific groups. It specifically substitutes clause (b) of section 18(9) to define the extent of reserved seats for women, youth, non-Muslim members, and labourers or peasants.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Third Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to alter various sections and schedules regarding municipal functions and taxes. It also transfers assets and liabilities from Zonal Municipal Committees to the Karachi Metropolitan Corporation and repeals a previous ordinance.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Third Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to add specific provisions regarding local governments and councils. It mandates that elections be held within a specified timeframe following the dissolution of these bodies.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Third Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 to update provisions regarding government supervision and council inspections. It also modifies rules concerning the establishment and maintenance of public gardens through various partnerships.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for local governments in the province of Sindh, including the constitution and composition of councils. It outlines procedures for elections, defines council functions and powers, and sets regulations regarding local taxation and finance.

metadata.title: The Sindh Madressatul Islam University Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Sindh Madressatul Islam University at Karachi. It outlines the university's incorporation, powers, officers, and various academic authorities such as the Senate and Syndicate.

metadata.title: The Sindh Mass Transit Authority Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Mass Transit Authority within the Province of Sindh. It empowers the Authority to plan, coordinate, construct, develop, operate, maintain, monitor, and regulate mass transit systems to ensure they are safe, efficient, comfortable, affordable, sustainable, and reliable.

metadata.title: The Sind Medical Colleges Act, 1987
metadata.repeals: The Sind Medical Colleges Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Act regulates admissions in medical colleges located in Sind and addresses ancillary matters such as student conduct and discipline. It empowers the Government of Sind to make rules regarding seat allocation, application forms, admission conditions, and the management of residential halls.

metadata.title: The Sindh Mental Health (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Mental Health Act, 2013 to include specific provisions regarding suicide attempts and accused persons of blasphemy. It mandates that such individuals be assessed by an approved physiatrist and treated appropriately if a mental disorder is found.

metadata.title: The Sindh Mental Health Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act regulates matters relating to mentally disordered persons in the Province of Sindh, including their care, treatment, and property management. It establishes the Sindh Mental Health Authority and outlines provisions for admission, discharge, guardianship, and forensic psychiatric services.

metadata.title: The Sindh Metalliferous Mines Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act consolidates the laws relating to the regulation and inspection of metalliferous mines in the Province of Sindh, excluding coal mines. It defines key terms such as 'metalliferous mine', 'employee', and 'occupier' while establishing the framework for managing mining operations and ensuring safety.

name: SINDH MINES AND MINERALS GOVERNANCE ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh Mines and Minerals Governance Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the effective regulation of minerals, mines, mining, and mineral dressing within the Province of Sindh. It aims to create a transparent and competitive business environment for investment while establishing institutional oversight for the mining sector.

metadata.title: The Sindh Minimum Wages (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Minimum Wages Act, 2015 by substituting specific clauses in section 3 regarding wage rates and independent members. It was passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on April 20, 2018, and received assent from the Governor on May 12, 2018.

metadata.title: The Sindh Minimum Wages Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act regulates minimum rates of wages and various allowances for different categories of workers employed in industrial and commercial undertakings within the Province of Sindh. It establishes a Minimum Wages Board to recommend and declare these rates, while also defining key terms such as employer, factory, and industrial establishment.

name: SINDH MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991

metadata.title: The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1991
metadata.amends: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to update financial provisions for ministers. It specifically revises grant limits, daily allowances, and introduces reimbursement rules for accommodation expenses incurred while traveling outside the province.

name: SINDH MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 by adding a new section 20. The new provision grants specific perks and privileges to a person who has served as Chief Minister for at least four years upon the expiry of their term.

name: SINDH MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996

metadata.title: The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1996
metadata.amends: The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1996
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 by inserting a new section regarding customs and sales tax exemptions for the Chief Minister. It specifically exempts one car, such as a Mercedes Benz 280 SEL or equivalent, from duties when imported or purchased out of bond for the Chief Minister's personal use upon appointment or during tenure.

name: SINDH MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2008

metadata.title: The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2008
metadata.amends: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975. It specifically substitutes the salary amount in section 7, subsection (2) of the original Act from thirty-nine thousand to fifty-four thousand six hundred.

name: SINDH MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996

metadata.title: The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Second Amendment) Act, 1996
metadata.amends: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act serves as a further amendment to the Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975. It specifically modifies Section 8-A of the parent Act by substituting the reference to a specific car model with a general description regarding engine capacity.

metadata.title: The Sindh Motion Pictures Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the censorship of films and the regulation of their exhibition by means of cinematographs within the Province of Sindh. It establishes a Board to examine, certify, and regulate films, including powers to grant certificates, impose restrictions, or refuse certification based on specific criteria.

metadata.title: The Sindh Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Sindh Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 to update engine power classifications and tax rates. It introduces specific kilowatt equivalents for various cubic centimeter engine sizes and adjusts tax provisions for commercial and non-commercial vehicles after ten or fifteen years of registration.

name: SINDH NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF CARDIOVASCULAR DISEASES (SINDH ADMINISTRATION) ACT 2014 Act, 2015

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases (Administration) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the proper administration of the affairs of the National Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases in Sindh, Karachi. It incorporates the Institute as a body corporate and vests its powers in a Governing Body consisting of government officials and nominated members.

metadata.title: The Sindh Newborn Screening Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes and integrates a sustainable newborn screening system within the public health delivery system of Sindh. It provides comprehensive procedures for early hearing screening, follow-up care, and the management of heritable conditions in newborns to prevent adverse effects on development.

name: SINDH PARLIAMENTARY SECRETARIES (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996

metadata.title: The Sindh Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1996
metadata.amends: The Sind Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974 to update salary rates, allowances, and privileges for Parliamentary Secretaries. It substitutes specific sections regarding salary amounts, car allowances, telephone facilities, medical reimbursement, and eligibility criteria while deleting an obsolete section.

name: SINDH PARLIAMENTARY SECRETARIES (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES, AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Sindh Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974 to update financial benefits for Parliamentary Secretaries. The legislation introduces new allowances, revises existing salary rates, and clarifies travel entitlements by air, train, road, and abroad.

metadata.title: The Sindh Payment of Wages Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the payment of wages to certain classes of persons employed in factories, industrial, and commercial establishments within the Province of Sindh. It provides for matters ancillary to wage regulation, including definitions, fixation of wage periods, permissible deductions, penalties for offenses, and powers of appointed authorities.

metadata.title: The Sindh Peoples Local Government Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for local governance in Sindh, defining the composition and functions of various local areas including metropolitan corporations, district councils, taluka administrations, and union councils. It outlines the powers, responsibilities, and administrative structures for these bodies across different levels of local government.

name: SINDH PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF THALASSEMIA ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh Prevention and Control of Thalassemia Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention and control of thalassemia within the Province of Sindh. It establishes obligations for the government to create diagnostic facilities, mandates pre-marital blood screening for relatives of patients, and sets penalties for non-compliance with testing requirements.

name: SINDH PREVENTION OF DEFACEMENT OF PROPERTY ACT 2013

metadata.title: The Prevention of Defacement of Property Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the prevention of property defacement and prohibits expressing matters on walls within the Province of Sindh. It establishes an Anti-Property Defacement Task Force to assess the scope of the issue and proposes a comprehensive program to combat it.

name: SINDH PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (REGULATION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003

metadata.title: The Sindh Private Educational Institutions (Regulation and Control) (Amendment) Act, 2003
metadata.amends: The Sindh Private Educational Institutions (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Private Educational Institutions (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2001 to update definitions regarding registering authorities and fee structures. It also introduces new requirements for infrastructure maintenance, curriculum standards, Sindhi language teaching, and procedures for dispute settlement between parents/staff and management.

name: SINDH PRIVATE TEACHERS TRAINING INSTITUTIONS (REGISTRATION AND CONTROL) ACT, 1994

metadata.title: The Sindh Private Teachers' Training Institutions (Registration and Control) Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the functioning of private teachers' training institutions within the Province of Sindh. It establishes a framework for the registration, establishment, and continuance of such institutions while providing mechanisms for suspension or cancellation of certificates.

name: SINDH PROHIBITION OF CORPORAL PUNISHMENT ACT, 2016

metadata.title: The Sindh Prohibition of Corporal Punishment Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits all forms of corporal punishment against children in various settings including schools, workplaces, and child care institutions. It establishes specific penalties for violations and ensures disciplinary measures respect the child's dignity.

name: SINDH PROHIBITION OF EMPLOYMENT OF CHILDREN ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Sindh Prohibition of Employment of Children Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the employment of children in any establishment and regulates the employment of adolescents in hazardous occupations. It also establishes a Sindh Coordination Committee on Child Labour to advise on legislative and administrative measures for eradicating child labour.

name: SINDH PROHIBITION ON MANUFACTURE, SALE AND USE OF POLYTHENE BAGS ACT, 2006

metadata.title: The Sindh Prohibition on Manufacture, Sale and Use of Polythene Bags Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act prohibits the manufacture, sale, and use of black polythene bags with a thickness below thirty microns in the Province of Sindh. It establishes penalties for contravention, including imprisonment and fines, and outlines procedures for cognizance of offences by authorized officers.

name: SINDH PROTECTION AND PROMOTION OF BREAST-FEEDING AND CHILD NUTRITION ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh Protection and Promotion of Breast-Feeding and Child Nutrition Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of breast-feeding and adequate nutrition for infants and young children in the Province of Sindh. It regulates the marketing and promotion of designated products, including breast milk substitutes and feeding bottles, while establishing an Infant Feeding Board to oversee implementation.

name: SINDH PROTECTION OF COMMUNAL PROPERTIES OF MINORITIES ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh Protection of Communal Properties of Minorities Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act protects the properties of minority communities in the Province of Sindh that are meant for their communal use. It prohibits the buying, selling, or transferring of such properties without a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Provincial Government and outlines penalties for violations.

name: SINDH PROTECTION OF HUMAN RIGHTS ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh Protection of Human Rights Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Human Rights Commission to protect human rights within the Province of Sindh. It defines the composition, powers, and functions of the Commission, including the appointment of its Chairperson and members.

metadata.title: The Sindh Province Pension Fund (Amendment) Act, 2006
metadata.amends: The Sindh Province Pension Fund Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Province Pension Fund Ordinance, 2002 to update provisions regarding investment returns and insurance contracts for pensionary benefits. It also modifies sections concerning the composition of the Board, the roles of the Chairman and Secretary, remuneration rules, and withdrawal procedures.

metadata.title: The Sindh Provincial Assembly (Members) Privileges (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Sindh Provincial Assembly (Members) Privileges Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Provincial Assembly (Members) Privileges Act, 1975 to align member privileges with those of Senate and National Assembly members. It inserts a new section granting former members and their spouses access to government guest houses, lifetime entry passes for assembly facilities, VIP lounge usage, official passports, and weapons licences.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Finance Administration Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the efficient and transparent management of the Provincial Consolidated Fund and Public Account of Sindh. It also establishes proper accountability for all transactions related to these funds.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Private Partnership (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Private Partnership Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Public Private Partnership Act, 2010 to update definitions regarding agreements and services. It also modifies provisions concerning civil society organizations, human resource policies, voluntary contributions, and approved sectors for partnership.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Private Partnership (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Private Partnership Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Public Private Partnership Act, 2010 to update specific clauses regarding ministerial positions and provincial assembly nominations. It substitutes existing text in section 4 to include new members for the Minister Law and Parliamentary Affairs, Minister Planning and Development, and two members nominated by the Chief Minister.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Procurement (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Public Procurement Act, 2009 to grant the Government power to exempt specific objects or classes of objects from procurement regulations when it is in the national interest. It also allows the Authority to recommend such exemptions to the Government for written reasons.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Procurement (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This document is an Act of the Legislature of Sindh that amends the Sindh Public Procurement Act, 2009. Specifically, it omits clause (xvii) from subsection (2) of section 6 of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Procurement (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Public Procurement Act, 2009 to include provisions regarding the disposal of public assets. It updates definitions for 'disposal' and 'public asset' and modifies specific sections related to technology terminology.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Procurement Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Public Procurement Regulatory Authority to regulate the procurement of goods, services, and works in the public sector within Sindh. It defines the powers and functions of the Authority, its Board, and Managing Director, along with financial provisions and regulatory mechanisms.

name: SINDH PUBLIC PROPERTY (REMOVAL OF ENCROACHMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2008

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) (Amendment) Act, 2008
metadata.amends: The Sind Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 1975 to update definitions and time limits regarding encroachment procedures. It also establishes an Anti-Encroachment Force and grants overriding effect to its provisions over other laws.

name: SINDH PUBLIC PROPERTY (REMOVAL OF ENCROACHMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010 by adding a definition for 'Special Court' and substituting section 26 regarding its composition. It also repeals the corresponding Amendment Ordinance from 2010.

name: SINDH PUBLIC PROPERTY (REMOVAL OF ENCROACHMENT) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) (Second Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010 by substituting sections regarding the composition and appointment of Presiding Officers for Tribunals and Special Courts. It also omits a specific subsection from section 23 and repeals the corresponding Second Amendment Ordinance from 2011.

name: SINDH PUBLIC PROPERTY (REMOVAL OF ENCROACHMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures for the removal of encroachments from public property in Sindh. It establishes a tribunal, outlines procedures for eviction and demolition of unauthorized structures, and details penalties for offenders.

name: SINDH PUBLIC PROPERTY (REMOVAL OF ENCROACHMENT) ACT, 2010

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides measures for the removal of encroachments from public property and to retrieve possession. It establishes tribunals, special courts, and an Anti-Encroachment Force to enforce these measures.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989 to allow the Government to curtail the term of office for the Chairman or Members appointed before July 31, 1994. The amendment was enacted on July 25, 1994, and came into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Service Commission (Amendment) Act, 2008
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989. It omits a specific clause from Section 2, substitutes the word 'Government' for 'Governor', and modifies Section 4 regarding the term of office for the Chairman and Members.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Public Service Commission for the Province of Sindh consisting of three Members appointed by the Government. It outlines the composition, term of office, functions regarding recruitment and advice on service conditions, and provides powers to make rules.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Service Commission Ordinance (Sind Ordinance VI of 1978)
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Public Service Commission Ordinance (Sind Ordinance VI of 1978)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals and re-enacts the Sindh Public Service Commission Ordinance of 1978 with certain modifications. It establishes the composition, appointment terms, and functions of the Sindh Public Service Commission for recruitment and advising the government.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public-Private Partnership Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act creates an enabling environment for private sector participation in infrastructure development projects within the province of Sindh. It establishes mechanisms to mobilize private resources, improve management efficiency, and incorporate principles of fairness and transparency into public-private partnership arrangements.

metadata.title: The Sindh Pure Food (Amendment) Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Pure Food Ordinance, 1960 to include iodized salt as a recognized food ingredient. It specifically adds definitions for iodized salt and modifies sections regarding prohibited ingredients and regulations.

metadata.title: The Sindh Race-Courses Licensing (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Race-Courses Licensing (Amendment) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Race-Courses Licensing Act, 1912 by inserting new sections and adding powers for the Government to make rules. It also repeals the previous Sindh Race-Courses Licensing (Amendment) Ordinance, 2003.

metadata.title: The Sindh Regional Plan Organization (Repeal) Act, 2006
metadata.repeals: The Sind Regional Plan Organization Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the Sind Regional Plan Organization Act, 1976. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Sindh Registration of Godowns Act, 1995
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Registration of Godowns Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the registration of godowns in the Province of Sindh to regulate the stocking of essential articles. It establishes definitions, outlines procedures for application and inspection, grants powers for search, and specifies penalties for contravention.

name: SINDH REGULARIZATION OF DOCTORS APPOINTED ON CONTRACT BASIS ACT, 2003

metadata.title: The Sindh Regularization of Doctors Appointed on Contract Basis Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regularization of services for doctors who were appointed on a contract basis in Sindh. It deems such doctors, employed for more than a year at the time of commencement, to be validly appointed as civil servants on a regular basis, provided they possess the required qualifications.

name: SINDH REGULATION AND CONTROL OF DISPOSABLE SYRINGES ACT, 2010

metadata.title: The Sindh Regulation and Control of Disposable Syringes Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and control of the use of disposable syringes in Sindh. It defines specific types of auto-destruct syringes, restricts the manufacture and sale of non-compliant syringes, and establishes penalties for contravention.

metadata.title: The Sindh Reproductive Healthcare Rights (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.amends: The Sindh Reproductive Healthcare Rights Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Reproductive Healthcare Rights Act, 2019 to introduce new definitions and provisions regarding marital counseling, maternal death surveillance, and telehealth services. It aims to promote healthy matrimonial life, address potential conflicts in relationships, and enhance reproductive health care through community workers and digital technologies.

metadata.title: The Sindh Revenue Board (Amendment) Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Revenue Board Act, 2010 to modify provisions regarding appointments and recruitment. It grants the Board authority to redesignate or regularize existing contract employees without consulting the Sindh Public Service Commission and updates sections related to board composition and departmental support.

metadata.title: The Sindh Revenue Board Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Revenue Board in the Province of Sindh to regulate fiscal and economic policies. It provides for the organization's powers, functions, management, and the imposition and collection of taxes, duties, and other levies using modern techniques.

name: SINDH REVISION OF EMOLUMENTS OF PUBLIC REPRESENTATIVES ACT, 1995

metadata.title: The Sindh Revision of Emoluments of Public Representatives Act, 1995
metadata.amends: Sind Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974; Sind Act VII of 1975; Sind Act VIII of 1975
metadata.summary: This Act revises the salaries and other emoluments for holders of representative offices in the Province of Sindh. It amends several existing laws, specifically Sind Act XXVI of 1974, to update financial provisions such as sumptuary allowances, daily allowances, conveyance, subsidies, accommodation, traveling expenses, telephone charges, and other benefits.

name: SINDH RIGHT OF CHILDREN TO FREE AND COMPULSORY EDUCATION ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the right to free and compulsory education for all children aged five to sixteen years in the province of Sindh. It establishes duties for the government, local authorities, parents, and private schools to ensure access to education without capitation fees or barriers.

name: SINDH SALES TAX ON SERVICES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Sindh Sales Tax on Services (Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Sales Tax on Services (Amendment) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011 to define renting of immovable property services and insert a validation section for past tax notifications. It also repeals the corresponding Amendment Ordinance from 2015.

metadata.title: The Sindh Safe Blood Transfusion (Amendment) Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 5 of the Sindh Blood Transfusion Act, 2017. It substitutes the requirements for appointing the Secretary of the Authority with specific educational and experience qualifications.

metadata.title: Sindh Sacked Employees' (Reinstatement) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act provides relief to employees in government, corporation, or autonomous services who were dismissed between February 3, 1997, and February 18, 2008, due to political victimization. It deems these individuals validly reinstated with their original scale, grade, and designation as of the date of reinstatement.

name: SINDH SALES TAX ON SERVICES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh Sales Tax on Services (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011 to update various sections regarding tax rates, definitions, and procedural notices. It specifically introduces new tariff headings for services provided by non-banking finance companies, port operators, and airport operators, while modifying existing clauses related to tax recovery and fraud.

name: SINDH SALES TAX ON SERVICES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh Sales Tax on Services (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011 to update definitions and provisions related to taxable services. It introduces new categories for active taxpayers, clarifies economic activities for employees, and expands the scope of IT-based system development consultants.

name: SINDH SALES TAX ON SERVICES ACT, 2011 (codified)

metadata.title: The Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the levy of a tax on services provided, rendered, initiated, received, originated, executed, or consumed in the Province of Sindh. It establishes the legal framework for the imposition, administration, collection, and enforcement of this specific tax within the province.

name: SINDH SCHOOL EDUCATION STANDARS AND CIRRICULUM ACT, 2014

metadata.title: The Sindh School Education Standards and Curriculum Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Curriculum Wing and the Sindh Curriculum Council to oversee school education standards in the Province of Sindh. It provides for the supervision of research-based curricula, textbooks, and assessment processes from early years through grade twelve. The legislation aims to improve the quality of learning materials and teaching practices to maximize student learning outcomes.

name: SINDH SECURITY OF VULNERABLE ESTABLISHMENTS ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Sindh Security of Vulnerable Establishments Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act establishes effective security arrangements for vulnerable establishments to prevent terrorism and other crimes. It creates a Security Advisory Committee responsible for identifying, inspecting, and advising managers on necessary security measures for designated locations.

name: SINDH SEIZED AND FREEZED FACILITIES (HOSPITALS AND DISPENSARIES) ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Sindh Seized and Freezed Facilities (Hospitals and Dispensaries) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Hospitals and Dispensaries Management Board in the Province of Sindh. The Board is empowered to manage seized and frozen facilities and ensure the mainstreaming of their employees.
