name: SINDH SEIZED AND FREEZED INSTITUTIONS (MADAARIS AND SCHOOLS) ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Sindh Seized and Freezed Institutions (Madaaris and Schools) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Madaaris and Schools Management Board in the Province of Sindh to manage seized and frozen educational institutions. It aims to ensure the mainstreaming of students and employees from these institutions while providing for related matters.

metadata.title: The Sindh Senior Citizens Welfare Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the welfare of senior citizens in the Province of Sindh by establishing a council and old age homes. It outlines provisions for medical care, the creation of a welfare fund, and defines offences related to the exposure or abandonment of senior citizens.

metadata.title: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973 to update provisions regarding tribunal composition and member appointments. It specifies that a Tribunal consists of a Chairman and two Members appointed by the Government in consultation with the Chief Justice of the High Court of Sindh.

metadata.title: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 1991
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Service Tribunals Act, 1973 to establish a new Tribunal consisting of three High Court Judges for members of the subordinate judiciary. It grants this new Tribunal exclusive jurisdiction over their terms and conditions of service, including disciplinary matters, while repealing the previous Amendment Ordinance from 1991.

metadata.title: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Service Tribunals Act, 1973 to define corporations established by provincial enactment as part of provincial service. It also declares employees of such corporations to be deemed civil servants and provides for the abatement of pending suits or appeals relating to their service terms upon the Act's commencement.

metadata.title: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Service Tribunals Act, 1973 by modifying section 5. Specifically, it changes punctuation in sub-section (2) and adds a new clause regarding the execution of tribunal decisions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973 by updating section numbers and substituting specific terms within the text. It replaces references to '5-(A)' with '5-A' and changes the word 'Provincial' to 'Principal' in the relevant sections.

metadata.title: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Fourth Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends section 3 of the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973. Specifically, it substitutes clause (ii) regarding the appointment of members to the tribunals.

metadata.title: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Second Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Service Tribunals Act, 1973 by inserting a new definition for 'member of the subordinate judiciary' in section 2. The amendment clarifies that this term includes various judicial ranks and officers under the administrative control of the District and Sessions Judge.

metadata.title: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Third Amendment) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973 to expand the Chairman's authority. Specifically, it designates the Chairman as the Provincial Accounting Officer and grants powers to re-appropriate funds, create new posts, and abolish old posts without requiring Government approval.

metadata.title: The Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act establishes Service Tribunals to exercise jurisdiction over matters relating to the terms and conditions of service for civil servants in Sindh. It defines key terms, outlines the composition and appointment of Tribunal members, and provides for specific tribunals for subordinate judiciary and employees of corporations.

name: SINDH SHAHEED RECOGNITION AND COMPENSATION ACT, 2014.

metadata.title: The Sindh Shaheed Recognition and Compensation Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act honors and recognizes the services of persons who sacrifice their lives in acts of terrorism while performing duty. It provides for monetary compensation to the legal heirs of such individuals and grants powers to the Government to take further welfare steps, including scholarships and medical cover.

name: SINDH SHAHEED RECONGNOTION AND COMPENSATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Sindh Shaheed Recognition and Compensation (Amendment) Act, 2017
metadata.amends: The Sindh Shaheed Recognition and Compensation Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Shaheed Recognition and Compensation Act, 2014. It specifically substitutes subsection (5) of section 3 to allow the government to appoint two family members of a Shaheed person into service with relaxed qualification and age conditions.

name: SINDH SHOPS AND COMMERCIAL ESTABLISHMENT ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment Act, 2015
metadata.amends: The Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act amends and consolidates the laws relating to the hours and other conditions of work and employment in shops, commercial, industrial, and other establishments within the Province of Sindh. It defines key terms such as employee, employer, and establishment, while establishing regulations for weekly holidays, opening/closing hours, overtime wages, leave entitlements, and penalties for violations.

metadata.title: The Sindh Small Industries Corporation (Amendment) Act, 1989
metadata.amends: The Sind Small Industries Corporation Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Small Industries Corporation Act, 1972 to update the composition of its Board. It specifies new members including government officials, provincial assembly representatives, and industry stakeholders.

metadata.title: The Sind Smoke-nuisances Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the abatement of nuisances arising from the smoke of furnaces in Sind. It establishes a Smoke-nuisances Commission to supervise and control the working of the Act, defines key terms such as furnace and inspector, and grants powers to prohibit kilns, order demolitions, and impose penalties for excessive smoke emission.

metadata.title: The Sindh Solid Waste Management Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the collection and disposal of solid waste and the arrangement of effective sanitation services in Sindh. It also aims to create a pollution-free environment by establishing Solid Waste Management Boards throughout the province.

name: SINDH SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT BOARD ACT, 2014

metadata.title: The Sindh Solid Waste Management Board Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Solid Waste Management Board to oversee the collection and disposal of solid waste in the Province of Sindh. It aims to arrange effective sanitation services, provide a pollution-free environment, and address other relevant matters concerning waste management.

metadata.title: The Sindh Sound System (Regulation) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act regulates and controls the use of sound systems in the Province of Sindh to prevent public nuisance and maintain public order. It prohibits loud or unnecessary noise, restricts usage near hospitals, schools, and places of worship during specific times, and outlines penalties for violations including imprisonment and fines.

name: SINDH SPEAKER AND DEPUTY SPEAKER (SALAIRES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 2007

metadata.title: The Sindh Speaker and Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 2007
metadata.amends: The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Ordinance, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 by substituting Section 7 regarding official car entitlements. It also repeals the corresponding Ordinance from 2006.

name: SINDH SPEAKER’S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER’S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989

metadata.title: The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1989
metadata.amends: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975. It introduces provisions for discretionary grants to the Speaker and entitlement to use telephones at office and residence.

name: SINDH SPEAKER’S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER’S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PIVILEGES) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995

metadata.title: The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Second Amendment) Act, 1995
metadata.amends: The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends Section 13 of the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975. Specifically, it substitutes the phrase regarding the maximum period of absence from office in subsection (1) to limit it to three months in a year instead of during the whole term.

name: SINDH SPEAKER’S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER’S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2009

metadata.title: The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.amends: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to update financial provisions and benefits. It specifically revises salary amounts, car allowances, mobile phone privileges, and other entitlements for the Speaker and Deputy Speaker.

name: SINDH SPEAKER’S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER’S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 by adding a new section regarding perks and privileges. The amendment grants specific benefits to individuals who have served as Speaker for at least four years upon the expiry of their term.

name: SINDH SPEAKER’S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER’S (SALARIES, ALLOWNCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989

metadata.title: The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1989
metadata.amends: The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975. It specifically modifies Section 6 to delete certain words regarding the Speaker's additional allowances and inserts 'or Deputy Speaker' into the relevant clause.

name: SINDH SPECIAL ASSISTANTS (APPOINTMENT, POWERS, FUNCTIONS, SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2008

metadata.title: The Sindh Special Assistants (Appointment, Powers, Functions, Salaries Allowances and Privileges) Act, 2008
metadata.amends: The Sindh Special Assistants (Appointment, Powers, Functions, Salaries Allowances and Privileges) Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the Sindh Special Assistants (Appointment, Powers, Functions, Salaries Allowances and Privileges) Act, 2003. It specifically substitutes the number of special assistants in section 8 from eleven thousand to fifteen thousand four hundred.

name: SINDH SPECIAL ASSISTANTS (APPOINTMENT, POWERS, FUNCTIONS, SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) ACT, 2003

metadata.title: The Sindh Special Assistants (Appointment, Powers, Functions, Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 2003
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the appointment, powers, functions, salaries, allowances, and privileges of Special Assistants to the Chief Minister of Sindh. It establishes specific financial benefits including salary, sumptuary allowance, transport, official residence, and equipment allowances for these officials.

metadata.title: The Sindh Special Development Board Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Special Development Board to facilitate and undertake low-cost housing schemes. It specifically aims to rehabilitate katchi abadis, slum areas, and gothabad schemes while providing for multi-story and high-rise buildings in the Province of Sindh.

metadata.title: The Sindh Sports Board (Amendment) Act, 1993
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Sports Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Sports Board Ordinance, 1980 by adding a specific item to Section 4 regarding the Secretary to Government of Sindh and substituting the text of sub-section (2) to define the roles of the Secretary Culture Department and Director of Sports. It also repeals the Sindh Sports Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 1993.

metadata.title: The Sind Steam-Vessels Act, 1864
metadata.repeals: Act VI of 1884
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the periodical survey of steam-vessels operating in the ports, harbours, rivers, or waters of Sind. It declares that specific sections and schedules of the Merchant Shipping Act are applicable to these vessels and establishes a penalty conversion rate of ten rupees per pound sterling.

metadata.title: The Sindh Students Union Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a system to create and regulate Students Unions within educational institutions in the Province of Sindh. It defines key terms, outlines the composition and functions of these unions, and sets rules against prejudicial activities within campuses.

metadata.title: The Sindh Tax Evasion (Punishment) (Amendment) Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Tax Evasion (Punishment) Act, 1974 to modify penalties for contravention of specific sections. It adds a proviso regarding imprisonment terms linked to the Sindh Finance Act, 1994 and updates the Schedule.

name: SINDH TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010

metadata.title: The Sindh Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.amends: The Sindh Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2009. It specifically omits subsections (4), (5), and (6) of section 15 from the original Act.

name: SINDH TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016

metadata.title: The Sindh Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.amends: The Sindh Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2009. It comes into force immediately upon enactment.

name: SINDH TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY ACT, 2009

metadata.title: The Sindh Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (STEVTA) to manage and regulate technical education and vocational training in the Province of Sindh. The Authority is tasked with formulating policies, aligning programs with industry requirements, and overseeing institutions through collaboration with relevant commissions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Telemedicine and Telehealth Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act facilitates and improves access to healthcare through distant health platforms to address the shortage of healthcare professionals in Sindh. It defines key terms such as telemedicine, telehealth, and registered medical practitioners while establishing a regulatory framework for digital practice.

metadata.title: The Sindh Tenancy (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Tenancy Act, 1950 by substituting specific revenue officer titles and modifying various sections regarding labor, crop expenditure, and dispute resolution timelines. It also omits certain clauses related to free labor and pasture definitions while inserting new provisions on mechanical equipment usage.

name: SINDH TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT (STANDING ORDERS) ACT, 2015

metadata.title: The Sindh Terms of Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act regulates industrial and commercial employment within the Province of Sindh. It establishes standing orders covering terms of service, wages, leave, termination, and other conditions for workers in specified establishments.

metadata.title: The Sindh Textbook Board (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Textbook Board Ordinance, 1970 by substituting specific references to 'Government' with 'Chief Minister' or 'Chief Secretary, Sindh' in designated sections. The changes are intended to update administrative responsibilities within the ordinance.

metadata.title: The Sindh Tourist Guides Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the regulation and control of the profession of tourist guides in the Province of Sindh. It establishes a regulatory committee, sets out procedures for licensing, defines codes of conduct, and prescribes penalties for unauthorized practice or violations.

name: SINDH TRANSFUSION OF SAFE BLOOD ACT, 1997

metadata.title: The Sindh Transfusion of Safe Blood Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the transfusion of safe and healthy blood and blood products free from viruses and infective agents. It establishes a Provincial Blood Transfusion Authority to oversee the registration, licensing, and monitoring of blood banks within the Province of Sindh.

name: SINDH TRANSPLANTATION OF HUMAN ORGANS AND TISSUES ACT, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the removal, storage, and transplantation of human organs and tissues for therapeutic purposes within the Province of Sindh. It establishes specific procedures for living and deceased donors, defines key medical terms, and creates committees to oversee the evaluation and monitoring of transplant processes.

metadata.title: The Sindh Travel Agencies Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development, regulation, and control of the profession of travel agencies in the Province of Sindh. It establishes a regulatory committee, outlines licensing requirements and fees, defines prohibited activities, and sets up mechanisms for complaints and penalties.

metadata.title: The Sindh Trusts (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Trusts Act, 2020 to introduce provisions for specialized trusts and modify definitions regarding natural persons. It establishes new requirements for registration, renewal of registration fees, and compliance with specific regulators.

metadata.title: The Sindh Trusts Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act defines and amends the law relating to trusts in the Province of Sindh. It addresses gaps in the Trust Act 1882 regarding monitoring and evaluation purposes while establishing better administrative control.

metadata.title: The Sindh Tuberculosis Notification Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the legal framework for developing and distributing Tuberculosis notification forms to medical practitioners, clinics, hospitals, and community leaders in Sindh. It outlines specific duties for notifying authorities about TB cases, defines various health-related terms, and provides powers to the District Health Officer and Provincial Program for implementation.

metadata.title: The Sindh Universities and Institutes Laws (Amendment) Act, 2014
metadata.amends: The Universities and Institutes laws in force in the Province of Sindh
metadata.summary: This Act amends various laws relating to universities and institutes in the Province of Sindh. It primarily substitutes provisions regarding the appointment, qualifications, and tenure of Vice Chancellors and Directors across multiple institutions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Universities Laws (Amendment) Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Preamble and specific sections of various university acts in Sindh. It inserts a proviso regarding employee retirement to ensure written notice of grounds and an opportunity to show cause before action is taken.

metadata.title: The Sindh Universities Laws (Amendment) Act, 2013
metadata.amends: The Sindh University Act, 1972; The University of Karachi Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends certain laws relating to universities in the Province of Sindh to maintain uniformity in their organization, management, and control. It specifically updates provisions regarding the appointment of Vice-Chancellors, Pro-Vice-Chancellors, Registrars, and other officers by the Government or Chancellor.

metadata.title: The Sindh Vocational Training Council Act, 2006
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Vocational Training Council as a body corporate with perpetual succession in the Province of Sindh. It outlines the council's constitution, functions, powers, and financial arrangements to administer vocational training institutes.

metadata.title: The Sindh Waqf Properties Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the proper management and administration of Waqf Properties within the Province of Sindh. It establishes a hierarchy of administrators, defines key terms related to Waqf properties and beneficiaries, and outlines the powers and liabilities of these officials.

metadata.title: The Sindh Water Management (Amendment) Act, 2005
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Water Management (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Water Management Ordinance, 2002 by substituting specific clauses regarding the Chairman's appointment and restricting political office holding for members. It also modifies the terms of service and eligibility for re-appointment for the Chairman and Members.

metadata.title: The Sindh Water Management (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Water Management Ordinance, 2002 to increase women's participation in water management bodies. It inserts specific clauses requiring the inclusion of prominent women activists and agriculturalists in various sections of the ordinance.

name: SINDH WHOLESALE AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS (DEVELOPMENT AND REGULATION) ACT, 2010

metadata.title: The Sindh Wholesale Agricultural Produce Markets (Development and Regulation) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the development and regulation of competitive and transparent wholesale agricultural produce markets in the Province of Sindh. It enables the establishment of private sector markets, promotes private investment, and facilitates the transfer of existing market committees to market companies.

metadata.title: The Sind Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Act, 1990
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 1990
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972 by substituting a specific provision regarding the Chief Game Warden and Chairman of the Board. It also repeals the Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 1990.

metadata.title: The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Act, 1993
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972 by updating specific clauses regarding birds and fish and prohibiting commercial fishing in wildlife sanctuaries. It also annuls any prior leases or agreements related to these activities that were granted before the amendment took effect.

metadata.title: The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Act, 2008
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sind Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972 to update penalties for illegal hunting of specific game animals. It substitutes new punishment clauses in section 17 and revises fine amounts in section 33 of the said Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Sindh Witness Protection Act, 2013
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the protection of witnesses to enable them to give evidence in criminal proceedings within the Province of Sindh. It establishes a Witness Protection Programme, a Board, and a Unit headed by a Chief Witness Protection Officer to manage these protections.

metadata.title: The Sindh Workers Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.amends: The Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014 to update specific clauses regarding the Standing Committee on Labour and Human Resources. It also modifies provisions related to the Secretary's appointment rank and substitutes certain words in the original act.

metadata.title: The Sindh Workers Welfare Fund (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Workers Welfare Fund Act, 2014 to update references to relevant legislation and modify assessment procedures. It substitutes specific clauses within sections 2, 4, 5, and 6 of the parent Act, omits certain sections, and aligns contribution collection with provisions from the Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011.

metadata.title: The Sindh Workers' Compensation Act, 2015
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the payment of compensation to workers or their legal heirs by certain classes of employers in case of injury or death resulting from an accident. It establishes the liability of employers, defines terms such as 'employer', 'worker', and 'compensation', and outlines the procedures for claiming benefits, including medical examinations and appeals.

metadata.title: The Sindh Zakat and Ushr Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the assessment, collection, and disbursement of Zakat and Ushr in the Province of Sindh. It establishes the legal framework for these obligations, including exemptions for those who declare they do not follow the relevant fiqh, and outlines the administrative structure involving various Zakat committees.

name: SIR COWASJEE JAHANGIR INSTITUTE OF PSYCHIATRY AND BEHAVIORAL SCIENCES, HYDERABAD ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Sir Cowasjee Jahangir Institute of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences, Hyderabad Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sir Cowasjee Jahangir Institute of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at Hyderabad by reconstituting an existing mental hospital. It defines the Institute as a body corporate with powers to manage property, affiliate with universities, and provide treatment for mental disorders and drug addicts.

name: SIR SYED UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY ACT, 1995

metadata.title: The Sir Syed University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sir Syed University of Engineering and Technology in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's powers to provide instruction in engineering and technology, admits students regardless of sex, religion, race, creed, colour, or domicile, and outlines its structure including officers, authorities, and governing boards.

metadata.title: The Sindh Social Protection Authority (Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.amends: The Sindh Social Protection Authority Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Social Protection Authority Act, 2022 to update specific sections regarding nominations and recruitment terms. It also revises financial limits and designations within the authority's structure.

metadata.title: The Sohail University Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sohail University at Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the university's powers to provide higher education, conduct examinations, award degrees, and affiliate with other educational institutions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Sports Board (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Sports Board Ordinance, 1980 to update the composition of the Board and its administrative structure. It substitutes specific sections regarding board members, presiding officers, and secretaries while changing references from Governor to Chief Minister.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Sind Amendment) Act, 1985
metadata.summary: This Act amends the application of the Stamp Act, 1899 to the Province of Sind. It specifically inserts new clauses into Section 2 of the 1899 Act to expand the definitions of 'public office' and 'public officer'.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1994
metadata.repeals: The Stamp (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Act amends the application of the Stamp Act, 1899 to the Province of Sindh. It specifically deletes a clause regarding exemptions in Article 5 of the Schedule and repeals the corresponding Ordinance from 1994.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stamp Act of 1899 specifically for its application to the Province of Sindh. It substitutes terms like 'Provincial Government' with 'Government' and updates references to include specific articles relevant to Sindh. The legislation also introduces new definitions for terms such as 'Board of Revenue', 'Commissioner', and 'electronic', while modifying sections regarding surcharges and appellate authorities.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Stamp Act 1899 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It introduces definitions for 'e-stamps' and 'Chief Revenue Authority', modifies provisions regarding electronically generated instruments, and inserts new sections concerning certificates for e-stamps, surcharges for unpaid duties, appeals against stamp orders, and expanded inspection powers.

metadata.title: The Sindh Street Children Shelter Home Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes 'Hamara Ghar', a shelter home facility for street children in the province of Sindh. It outlines the constitution, functions, and terms of a Board of Directors responsible for administering the facility and ensuring the welfare, education, and health of residents until they turn 18 or become self-sufficient.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories Control (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1993
metadata.repeals: The Sugar Factories Control (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950, as applicable to Sindh. It deletes references to cooperative societies and modifies various sections regarding cane procurement, government roles, and penalties.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories Control (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950 as applicable to Sindh. It inserts a new section requiring factories established after its commencement to install a core sampler of specified standards.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories Control (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950 specifically for its application to Sindh. It introduces changes regarding the composition of the Board, the appointment of an Additional Cane Commissioner, prohibitions on certain sugarcane varieties, and regulations concerning the sale, purchase, and payment for cane.

metadata.title: The Sukkur IBA University (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sukkur IBA University Act, 2017 to update provisions regarding the Vice Chancellor's appointment, qualifications, and powers. It also modifies sections concerning departmental representation and financial reporting within the university.

name: SYED ABDULLAH SHAH INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ACT, 2012

metadata.title: The Syed Abdullah Shah Institute of Medical Sciences Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Syed Abdullah Shah Institute of Medical Sciences at Sehwan by reconstituting and re-organizing existing Taluka Hospitals and Rural Health Centres. It defines the Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession, outlines its functions including treatment, research, and teaching programs, and details the transfer of properties and personnel from the former health facilities to the new Institute.

metadata.title: The SZABIST University Act, 2023
metadata.repeals: Sindh Act No. XI of 1995
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and reorganizes the Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology (SZABIST) to establish it as a University known as SZABIST University. It defines the powers, functions, and structure of the new university body, including its authorities, officers, and governing boards.

metadata.title: The Sindh Teachers Education Development Authority Act, 2012
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Teachers Education Development Authority as a body corporate to manage and regulate teachers education in the Province of Sindh. It outlines the Authority's powers, functions, management structure, and administrative procedures for ensuring coordinated development and maintaining standards in teacher training.

name: TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND VOCATIONAL TRAINING AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT)ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Sindh Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.amends: The Sindh Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority Act, 2009. It specifically alters provisions regarding the nomination of members to the Authority and substitutes references to the Government with the Chief Minister in certain sections.

name: THE AROR UNIVERSITY OF ART, ARCHITECTURE, DESIGN, AND HERITAGE, SUKKUR, ACT, 2019

metadata.title: The Aror University of Art, Architecture, Design and Heritage, Sukkur, Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Aror University of Art, Architecture, Design and Heritage located in Sukkur. It provides for the university's incorporation, assets, powers, organizational structure including officers and authorities, and general provisions regarding its statutes and regulations.

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2019
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Coastal Development Authority Act, 1994 by updating its title and preamble to reflect the Province of Sindh rather than specific districts. It also modifies sections 2 and 5 of the original Act to redefine coastal areas and adjust the composition of nominated members in the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The Education City (Amendment) Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Education City Act, 2013 by substituting a specific clause regarding the chairperson of an Educational Expert. It was enacted as Sindh Act No. XII of 2023 and is intended to come into force immediately.

name: THE GOVERNMENT COLLEGE UNIVERSITY HYDERABAD ACT, 2018.

metadata.title: The Government College University Hyderabad Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the Government College University at Hyderabad and matters ancillary thereto. It outlines the university's incorporation, powers, officers, authorities, statutes, and provisions regarding affiliated educational institutions.

metadata.title: The Registration (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Registration Act, 1908 specifically for its application to the Province of Sindh. It introduces new definitions regarding ban lists, biometric verification, and digital scanning units while substituting references to 'Pakistan' with 'Sindh' in certain sections.

name: THE SHAHEED ALLAH BUKSH SOOMRO UNIVERSITY OF ART, DESIGN AND HERITAGES JAMSHORO ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Shaheed Allah Buksh Soomro University of Art, Design and Heritages Jamshoro Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes and reorganizes the Centre of Excellence in Arts and Design at Mehran University of Engineering and Technology, Jamshoro into a new entity called the Shaheed Allah Buksh Soomro University of Art, Design and Heritages, Jamshoro. It establishes the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, statutes, and regulations for affiliation with educational institutions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Act, 2025
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 by substituting and inserting new sections regarding original jurisdiction and the transfer of pending suits. It also modifies specific subsections within the existing ordinance to omit certain provisos and establish precedence over other laws.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973 to update provisions regarding retirement and pension benefits. It substitutes sections 13 and 20 of the original act to introduce defined contribution pension schemes and clarify entitlements for civil servants appointed before or after the amendment's commencement.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Act, 2024
metadata.amends: Sindh Act No. II of 1899; West Pakistan Act No. XXXII of 1958; Sindh Act XXIV of 1964; Sindh Act No. XII of 2011; Sindh Act No. XVIII of 2017
metadata.summary: This Act rationalizes, levies, and enhances certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sindh. It also amends several existing laws in the province to update stamp duty rates and definitions.

name: THE SINDH INSTITUTE OF REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH KARACHI

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Reproductive Health Karachi Act, 2026
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Institute of Reproductive Health at Karachi by reconstituting and reorganizing an existing specialized institute. It defines the Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession, outlines its functions in training specialists and paramedics, and details the transfer of properties, assets, and staff from the previous government institute to the new entity.

name: THE SINDH SAFE BLOOD TRANSFUSION ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The Sindh Safe Blood Transfusion Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act regulates the collection, testing, processing, storage, distribution, and issuance of human blood and blood components. It aims to ensure health protection and prevent transfusion-transmissible diseases within the Province of Sindh.

name: THE SINDH SOCIAL PROTECTION AUTHORITY ACT, 2022

metadata.title: The Sindh Social Protection Authority Act, 2022
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Sindh Social Protection Authority to provide a comprehensive and efficient institutional mechanism for social protection in the Province of Sindh. It creates a body corporate with specific powers to manage funds, appoint staff, and implement programs aimed at reducing economic vulnerability among poor and marginalized communities.

name: THE SINDH TEACHING HOSPITALS (ESTABLISHMENT OF MANAGEMENT BOARD) ACT, 2020

metadata.title: The Sindh Teaching Hospitals (Establishment of Management Board) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a Management Board for teaching hospitals in the Province of Sindh to ensure quality and affordable health care. It defines the composition, powers, and functions of the Board, including its role in approving budgets, managing finances, and overseeing hospital administration.

name: THE UNIVERSITY OF MODERN SCIENCE, AT TANDO MUHAMMAD KHAN ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The University of Modern Sciences, at Tando Muhammad Khan Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Modern Sciences at Tando Muhammad Khan as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the university's powers to provide education, conduct examinations, award degrees, and undertake research while ensuring non-discrimination based on sex, religion, or race.

metadata.title: The Town Improvement Act, 1922
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the framework for the creation and constitution of Improvement Trusts in Punjab. It outlines the powers, duties, and procedures regarding town improvement schemes, land acquisition, finance, and penalties for non-compliance.

name: TRANSPARENCY AND RIGHT TO INFORMATION ACT,2016

metadata.title: The Sindh Transparency and Right to Information Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act establishes a practical regime for citizens to secure access to information from public authorities in Sindh at low cost and rapidly. It creates the Sindh Information Commission to oversee these processes and ensures transparency in the working of every public authority within the province.

metadata.title: The UIT University Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the UIT University at Karachi. It creates a body corporate owned and administered by the Usman Memorial Foundation with powers to manage property, set up campuses, and conduct research.

metadata.title: The University of East Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of East at Hyderabad within the Province of Sindh. It defines the university's structure, including its officers and authorities, and grants powers to provide instruction, prescribe curricula, conduct examinations, and confer degrees.

metadata.title: The University of Larkano Act, 2023
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of the University known as the University of Larkano. It outlines the powers, duties, and constitution of various authorities within the university, including the Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The University of Mirpurkhas Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of a new institution known as the University of Mirpurkhas. It outlines the powers, duties, and constitution of various university authorities including the Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council.

name: UNIVERSITY OF MODERN SCIENCES, AT TANDO MUHAMMAD KHAN ACT, 2017

metadata.title: The University of Modern Sciences, at Tando Muhammad Khan Act, 2017
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the University of Modern Sciences at Tando Muhammad Khan as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the university's powers to provide education, conduct examinations, award degrees, and undertake research while ensuring non-discrimination based on sex, religion, or race.

metadata.title: The University of Sind (Amendment) Act, 1988
metadata.repeals: The University of Sind (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This Act amends the University of Sind Act, 1972 by modifying section 40-A regarding age limits for teachers. It also repeals the earlier University of Sind (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988.

metadata.title: The Sindh Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 2024
metadata.amends: Sindh Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: Article 3 of the Cantonments (Urban Immovable Property Tax and Entertainments Duty) Order, 1979
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to allow tax levies in cantonments. It mandates that Cantonment Boards continue to assess and collect taxes while paying fifteen percent of net proceeds to the Provincial Government after deducting collection charges.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ANIMALS SLAUGHTER CONTROL (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control (Sind Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Animal Slaughter Control (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It defines useful animals for breeding and draught purposes and establishes procedures for trying offences under the amended act.

name: WEST PAKISTAN COTTON CONTROL (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Cotton Control (Sind Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Cotton Control (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1 of 1975
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes sections 26 and 27 of the said Ordinance to regulate cotton prices and ginning charges while defining associated penalties for contravention.

name: WEST PAKISTAN EMPLOYEES’ SOCIAL SECURITY (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security (Sind Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Employees' Social Security (Sind Repeal of Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes specific clauses in Section 5 and Section 12 to define the composition of the Governing Body and omit certain provisions.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ENTERTAINMENTS DUTY (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty (Sind Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: West Pakistan Entertainments Duty (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958 specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It comes into force immediately upon enactment and includes provisions to omit specific clauses, sections, and schedules from the parent Act as well as repealing a previous Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ENTERTAINMENTS DUTY (SIND SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty (Sind Second Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Entertainments Duty (Sind Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Entertainments Duty Act, 1958 as it applies to the Province of Sind. It substitutes specific monetary values and multipliers in sections 6 and 11 of the said Act and repeals a previous Ordinance from 1974.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ESSENTIAL ARTICLES (CONTROL) (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) (Sind Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Essential Articles (Control) Act, 1958 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes the word 'nineteen' for 'fourteen' in section 1, subsection (3) of the parent Act and repeals a previous Ordinance on the same subject.

name: WEST PAKISTAN ESSENTIAL SERVICE (MAINTENANCE) (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT 1973.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) (Sind Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1958
metadata.repeals: The Essential Services (Maintenance) (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1958 to apply it to the Province of Sind. It renumbers specific sections and adds provisions allowing the government to apply the Act to educational autonomous bodies via notification.

name: WEST PAKISTAN FAMILY COURTS (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Family Courts (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1997
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Family Courts (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964 to apply specifically to the Province of Sindh. It grants the High Court authority to transfer suits, proceedings, and appeals between different Family Courts or District Courts within the province.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) (Sind Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It introduces a new section regarding minimum imprisonment terms for ration document offences and modifies provisions on court cognizance and trial procedures.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) (Sind Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) (Sindh Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It adds a new provision punishing officers who issue or abet the issuance of bogus ration documents with imprisonment up to three years or a fine.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Goats (Restriction) (Sind Repeal) Act, 1972
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the West Pakistan Goats (Restriction) Ordinance, 1959, specifically as it applies to Sind. It came into force immediately upon enactment.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GOVERNMENT EDUCATIONAL AND TRAINING INSTITUTIONS (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions (Sind Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes specific wording regarding committee membership in Section 4 and omits references to 'West Pakistan' in Sections 4 and 5.

name: WEST PAKISTAN GOVERNMENT EDUCATIONAL AND TRAINING INSTITUTIONS (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions (Sind Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes the word 'sixteen' for 'fourteen' in a specific subsection and repeals a previous 1974 Ordinance.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Highways (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Highways Ordinance, 1959, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sindh. It omits a specific clause in section 2 and substitutes text in section 8 concerning building erection near highways.

name: WEST PAKISTAN HISTORICAL MOSQUES AND SHRINES FUND CESS (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess (Sind Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes the word 'twelve' with 'fifteen' in a specific subsection and deems this change effective from October 1, 1971.

name: WEST PAKISTAN LAND REVENUE (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Revenue (Sind Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes terms like 'deh' for 'estate', introduces produce index units for land assessment, and omits or revises various sections related to revenue calculation and displaced persons resettlement.

name: WEST PAKISTAN LAND REVENUE (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Revenue (Sind Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes terms like 'District' with 'Division', inserts new clauses regarding the appointment and powers of Commissioners and Collectors, and modifies references to the Board of Revenue throughout the said Act.

name: WEST PAKISTAN LAND REVENUE (SIND AMENDMENT) Ordinance,1973

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Revenue (Sind Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Land Revenue (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967 specifically regarding its application to Barani and Sailabi lands in the Province of Sind. It declares that amendments made by a previous Ordinance are deemed never to have been effected for these specific land types and repeals that earlier Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN LAND REVENUE (SINDH SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Land Revenue (Sind Second Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Land Revenue Act (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the West Pakistan Land Revenue Act, 1967 as it applies to the Province of Sind. It substitutes specific terms and figures within section 164 of the parent Act and repeals a previous Sind Amendment Ordinance from 1972.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Sind Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes the term 'Government Officers' with 'Officials and Non-Officials' in section 46, subsection (2) of the said Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Sind Amendment) Act, 1974
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It introduces new registration mark groups for Karachi District to be used after existing letter series are exhausted and repeals a previous 1974 amendment ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Sind Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It adds a note concerning temporary vehicle registration to the Sixth Schedule and repeals the previous 1974 Amendment Ordinance.

name: WEST PAKISTAN MOTOR VEHICLES (SIND SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Sind Second Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles (Sind Amendment) Act, 1974 and The Motor Vehicles (Sind Amendment) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Act further amends the West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes a new note in the Sixth Schedule to introduce 'KC' as a registration mark series for Karachi District after previous letters are exhausted.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PREVENTION OF GAMBLING (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling (Sind Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1961, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It introduces new clauses defining 'Tourist Complex' and grants the government power to issue licenses for such complexes and make rules regulating their operation.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PRIMARY EDUCATION AND LOCAL COUNCILS HIGH SCHOOLS (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Primary Education and Local Councils High Schools (Sind Amendment) Act, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Primary Education Ordinance, 1962 and the West Pakistan Local Councils High Schools (Taking Over) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Primary Education and Local Councils High Schools (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Primary Education Ordinance, 1962 and the West Pakistan Local Councils High Schools (Taking Over) Ordinance, 1970 to apply them to the Province of Sind. It specifically adds references to municipalities and municipal corporations to the definitions within these ordinances.

name: WEST PAKISTAN PURE FOOD (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Pure Food (Sind Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Pure Food (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes sections 23 and 31 of the principal Ordinance with new provisions detailing penalties for contraventions and procedures for trial.

name: WEST PAKISTAN TENDOO LEAVES (PROHIBITION ON POSSESSION AND USE) (SIND REPEAL) ACT, 1973.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) (Sind Repeal) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) Ordinance, 1966; The West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) (Sind Repeal) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) Ordinance, 1966, specifically as it applies to the Province of Sind. It also repeals a previous Sind Repeal Ordinance from 1973 regarding the same subject matter.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Highways (Sind Amendment) Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Highways (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Act amends the West Pakistan Highways Ordinance, 1959, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It introduces new definitions for 'Super Highway', establishes bans on acts damaging roads or obstructing traffic, creates mobile courts for trial on the spot, and increases fines and imprisonment terms for offenses.

metadata.title: The Sindh Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.amends: The Sindh Zakat and Ushr Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This document publishes the Sindh Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Act, 2018 as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh. It amends section 14 of the Sindh Zakat and Ushr Act, 2011 to require the Council to constitute a District Zakat and Ushr Committee in each Revenue District.

metadata.title: The Sindh Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Sindh Zakat and Ushr Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Zakat and Ushr Act, 2011 by substituting a specific provision regarding the appointment of the Council Chairman. The amendment stipulates that the Chairman must be a retired High Court Judge or a retired civil servant in basic pay scale 20 or above.

metadata.title: The Ziauddin University Act, 1995
metadata.repeals: Sindh Act XXIX of 1994
metadata.summary: This Act reconstitutes the Dr. Ziauddin Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences and establishes it as Ziauddin University. It defines the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession, open to all persons regardless of sex, religion, race, creed, colour, or domicile, and operates on a non-profit basis.

metadata.title: The Ziauddin University (Amendment) Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ziauddin University Act, 1995 to update specific clauses regarding financial agreements and appointments. It substitutes text in sections 5, 8, and 18 of the original Act to reflect changes in investment powers, Chancellor appointment procedures, and commission representation.

metadata.title: The Ziauddin University (Amendment) Act, 2020
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ziauddin University Act, 1995 to address force majeure scenarios by allowing asset transfer to the Dr. Ziauddin Hospital Trust if the university becomes non-functional. It also updates section 5 of the said Act to permit campus establishment within or outside Pakistan and compliance with Pakistani tax laws.

metadata.title: The Ziauddin University Examination Board (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ziauddin University Act, 1995 to update provisions regarding medical centers, partnerships, and academic governance. It establishes new boards for studies and advanced research to oversee curriculum, examinations, and research degrees within the university.

metadata.title: The Ziauddin University Examination Board (Amendment) Act, 2021
metadata.amends: The Ziauddin University Examination Board Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Ziauddin University Examination Board Act, 2018 to update provisions regarding examination administration, curriculum prescription, and online testing. It also revises sections concerning board composition, officer appointments, committee structures, and employee services.

metadata.title: The Ziauddin University Examination Board Act, 2018
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Ziauddin University Examination Board to provide facilities in education and improve evaluation standards through a public-private partnership. It grants the Board autonomy to administer examinations up to the higher secondary level, prescribe curricula, and issue certificates for affiliated private educational institutions.

metadata.title: The Zulfikarabad Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.repeals: The Zulfikarabad Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Zulfikarabad Development Authority Act, 2010 by substituting the composition of its Governing Body and adding provisions for a Vice Chairman and Secretary. It also repeals the corresponding Amendment Ordinance from 2011.

metadata.title: The Zulfikarabad Development Authority (Amendment) Act, 2016
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Zulfikarabad Development Authority Act, 2010 to include District Sujjawal alongside District Thatta within the authority's jurisdiction. It updates various sections of the original Act to reflect this expansion and modifies the composition and functions of the Governing Body.

metadata.title: The Zulfikarabad Development Authority Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act establishes the Zulfikarabad Development Authority to create a modern city in District Thatta. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with powers to acquire property and outlines the composition of its Governing Body.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Second Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Stamp Act, 1899 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It introduces specific changes regarding employee definitions, banking company provisions, stamp duty rates for various instruments, and penalties for obstruction or concealment of information.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 to update definitions of agricultural produce and modify provisions regarding market areas and licensing. It introduces new rules for open auction trading in notified areas, sets specific fees for dealer licenses, and outlines conditions for license cancellation or suspension.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of Sind to amend the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939. It specifically modifies sections 16 and 19-A of the said Act by substituting terms, adding new clauses regarding authorized officers, and omitting references to leave salary.

metadata.title: The Sind Agricultural Supplies Organization (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: The Sind Agricultural Supplies Organization Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Agricultural Supplies Organization Act, 1973 to alter the composition and duties of the Board. Specifically, it substitutes Section 5 to define the appointment terms for the Operational Director and outlines their responsibilities regarding administrative matters, procurement, and account maintenance.

metadata.title: The Sind Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: The Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970. Specifically, it substitutes the reference to 'The Secretary, Government of Sind' with 'The Minister for Education, Sind or in his absence the Education Secretary, Government of Sind' within section 10.

metadata.title: The Sind Building Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Building Control Ordinance, 1979 to update definitions and provisions regarding building authorities. It establishes a fund for the Authority and outlines the appointment of officers, experts, and committees to oversee construction activities in Sind.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Courts Act, 1926 and the Karachi Courts Order, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 to alter jurisdiction limits and procedural rules for civil suits. It also repeals the Sindh Courts Act, 1926 and the Karachi Courts Order, 1956.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Courts (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 and the Sind Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 and the Sind Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981. It modifies specific sections regarding jurisdiction limits for suits in Karachi Districts and substitutes fee amounts from twenty-five thousand rupees to fifty thousand rupees.

metadata.title: The Sind Cotton Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966 to update terminology and structure within the legislation. Specifically, it substitutes terms like 'Advisory Committees' with 'Cotton Committees' and replaces 'Cotton Control Board' with 'Sind Cotton Board'. Additionally, it modifies Section 2 of the parent Ordinance by omitting a specific clause and inserting a new definition for 'Cotton Committee'.

metadata.title: The Sindh Disposal of Plots Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the disposal of residential plots and flat sites within the Province of Sindh. It establishes specific rules regarding plot sizes, auction procedures, eligibility requirements for applicants, and the categorization of plots for different groups.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Finance Act, 1964 to update energy charge rates for various purposes. It substitutes the Fifth Schedule with new fee structures for domestic, commercial, industrial, and agricultural energy supplies.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Finance Act, 1964 by substituting specific terms in its seventh Schedule. It changes 'share capital' to 'paid up share capital' and reduces a monetary limit from Rs.5,000 to Rs.2,500.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance Ordinance, 1980
metadata.amends: Stamp Act, 1899; Sind Entertainments Duty Act, 1958; Sind Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; Sind Finance Act, 1964; Sind Finance Ordinance, 1971; Sind Finance Act, 1972; Sind Finance Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance rationalizes and enhances certain taxes and duties in the Province of Sind. It also amends several existing laws related to stamp duties, entertainments, motor vehicles, and finance acts.

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957 by substituting specific clauses and explanations in Article 52-A. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Karachi Water Management Board Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Karachi Water Management Board to manage water supply in the Karachi Division. It defines the Board's constitution, powers, and functions, including the responsibility for water distribution and maintenance of works after filter plants.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1992
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It substitutes references to the Provincial Government with joint references to both the Federal and Provincial Governments in specific sections.

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Land Revenue Act, 1967 to update headings and specific sections regarding land records. It establishes procedures for recording rights acquired by individuals, including requirements for notification to local officers and the creation of cells within Mukhtiarkar offices to manage these records.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to update provisions regarding panchayat constitution, council membership disqualifications, and accounts committees. It also introduces new sections concerning the disposal of complaints by panchayats under specific acts.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to address council composition after declarations and establish rules for naming or renaming local areas. It introduces provisions for separate panchayats for minority communities, defines honoraria for officials, and sets guidelines for replacing foreign place names with Pakistani or Islamic ones.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to alter the composition of taluka councils and modify specific sections regarding penalties, levies, and optional functions. It also updates Schedule V to specify toll collection rules for goods exported as Rawangi Mahsool.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979, specifically regarding section 51. It allows the government to disqualify council members who act in contravention of specific provisions without a prior hearing and provides a mechanism for such members to seek review of their disqualification within sixty days.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by substituting subsection (2) of section 62. The amendment specifies that the Chief Executive must issue a notification to give effect to a direction within the timeframe specified by the Government.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by adding a new clause to section 37. The amendment restricts council members from being associated with groups or associations formed for council activities or styling themselves as leaders of the House or Opposition.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by modifying section 51. Specifically, it alters the presiding officer requirements for meetings where no confidence motions are moved against specific offices or when elections are held.

name: MEHRAN UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1980

metadata.title: The Mehran University of Engineering and Technology (Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.amends: The Mehran University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Mehran University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977 to formally establish a University college at Nawabshah. It modifies specific sections of the original act to include provisions for this new college within the university's administration and governance structure.

metadata.title: The Military Courts (Validation of Orders) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Act IX of 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain orders passed by Military Courts under Martial Law Order No.20 in Zone 'C' on or after August 16, 1977. It deems these orders to have been passed under the Sindh Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979, and allows aggrieved persons to prefer an appeal to the High Court within thirty days of commencement.

metadata.title: The Muhammad Ali Jinnah University Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Muhammad Ali Jinnah University in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, President, and various authorities like the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Pakistan Institute of Management Ordinance, 2008
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Pakistan Institute of Management in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the institute's powers, functions, and governance structure, including its Board, Academic Council, and various committees.

metadata.title: The Sind Rented Premises (Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979 by omitting specific subsections and adding new provisions regarding landlord penalties for reletting premises or changing their use. It also inserts a new section to penalize landlords who relet buildings within one year of obtaining possession and modifies sections concerning pending cases and order execution.

metadata.title: The Sind Rented Premises (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979 by substituting a proviso to section 14. The amendment specifies that certain provisions do not apply when a landlord rents out a building after retiring or reaching the age of sixty, or upon becoming a widow or orphan.

metadata.title: The Sind People's Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972. It specifically modifies section 42 to allow councils to enter into contracts without inviting auction offers with government approval.

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.amends: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994 to update provisions regarding tax assessment and definitions. It also amends sections of the Land Revenue Act, 1899, specifically concerning the powers of collectors and procedures for tax collection.

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.amends: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994 to update definitions regarding cropped areas and tax years. It establishes new tax rates based on crop type and area, introduces penalties for failure to furnish declarations or comply with notices, and sets a future transition to net income assessment.

name: SINDH ARID ZONE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997

metadata.title: The Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.amends: The Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority Act, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority Act, 1985 to introduce a Vice Chairman position. It defines the role of the Vice Chairman, specifies that the office is not a whole-time remunerated position, and outlines the assignment of duties by the Chairman.

metadata.title: The Sindh Healthcare Commission Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Healthcare Commission to improve the quality of healthcare services and ban quackery in the Province of Sindh. It provides for the establishment of a Board, defines various terms related to healthcare establishments and services, and outlines procedures for licensing, inspection, accreditation, and adjudication of fines.

metadata.title: The Sindh (Textile Institute of Pakistan) Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Textile Institute of Pakistan in the Province of Sindh to provide instruction in textile sciences and related fields. It creates a body corporate with perpetual succession, defines its powers regarding admissions, examinations, and research, and ensures the institute is open to all persons regardless of sex, religion, or race.

name: SINDH BOARD OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1995

metadata.title: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1995
metadata.amends: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
