metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972 to establish a new Board at Larkana. It substitutes references to Sukkur with 'Sukkur or Larkana' throughout the text and adds specific clauses regarding the new Board and its directors.

metadata.title: The Sindh Buildings Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979 by substituting a proviso in section 19 regarding offences related to building works. It specifically addresses the compounding of offences for violations of regulations framed under section 21-A.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 by substituting the monetary limit in section 18 from two lacs and fifty thousand to five hundred thousand. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973 by omitting section 9-A. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Compulsory Primary Education Ordinance, 2001
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Primary Education Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for compulsory primary education for every child in the Province of Sindh. It establishes authorities to ensure school attendance and outlines penalties for parents who fail to comply with these requirements.

metadata.title: The Sindh Development Authorities (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.amends: The Sehwan Development Act (3), 1993; The Badin Development Authority Act, 1995; The Sindh Act V of 1994; The Lyari Development Authority Act, 1993; The Malir Development Authority Act, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends several laws relating to development authorities in specific areas of the Province of Sindh. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: SINDH DISPOSAL OF URBAN LAND ORDINANCE, 1999

metadata.title: The Sindh Disposal of Urban Land Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the disposal of urban land within the Province of Sindh. It establishes procedures for selling land via public auction at market prices and outlines specific rules for amenity plots, residential conversions, and housing schemes.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Finance Act, 1964 by deleting specific words regarding industrial undertakings and energy rates in the Fifth Schedule. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: SINDH HEALTH INSTITUTIONS (ESTABLISHMENT AND MANAGEMENT) ORDINANCE, 2008

metadata.title: The Sindh Health Institutions (Establishment and Management) Ordinance, 2008
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment and management of health institutions in the Province of Sindh, granting them autonomy to deliver quality healthcare. It establishes a Board of Governors as the principal governing body with powers to appoint officers, manage funds, and constitute committees.

metadata.title: The Sindh Information Technology Board Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Information Technology Board as a body corporate within the Province of Sindh. It outlines the Board's constitution, functions, powers, and administrative procedures including rules and regulations.

metadata.title: The Sindh Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends various laws in force in the Province of Sindh to implement the devolution of powers at the grassroots level. It substitutes terms like 'Collector' and 'Commissioner' with new designations such as 'District Officer (Revenue)' across federal and provincial acts applicable to Sindh.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by adding new sub-sections to Section 16. The amendments establish provisions for an Advisory Council and define the appointment, tenure, and resignation procedures for its members.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to transfer functions and assets from zonal municipal committees to the Karachi Metropolitan Corporation. It also deletes specific clauses, provisos, and entries related to these bodies across various sections and schedules of the parent Ordinance.

name: SINDH MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2008

metadata.title: The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008
metadata.amends: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to provide specific facilities for Chief Ministers and Ministers. The amendment grants entitlements to government guest houses, rest houses, circuit houses, and Sindh House at Islamabad and Murree, along with pick-and-drop car services during their stay.

name: SINDH PRIVATE TEACHERS’ TRAINING INSTITUTIONS (REGISTRATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1994

metadata.title: The Sindh Private Teachers' Training Institutions (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the functioning of private teachers' training institutions in the Province of Sindh by establishing a registration and control framework. It provides for the application process, conditions for granting certificates, and penalties for operating without registration.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989 to allow the Government to curtail the term of office for the Chairman and members appointed before its commencement. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Registration (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Registration Act, 1908, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sindh. It adds a new clause to Section 17 to include power of attorney for selling immovable property in the list of documents requiring registration.

metadata.title: The Sindh Registration of Godowns Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the registration of godowns in the Province of Sindh to ensure proper storage of essential articles. It establishes the procedures for application, inspection, and maintenance of records by owners, along with penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Sindh Sports Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 1992
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Sports Board Ordinance, 1980 to include the Secretary to Government of Sindh in the Culture and Tourism Department as a new member. It also substitutes the text of section 4(2) to clarify that the Secretary and Director of Sports shall serve as the Joint Secretary and Secretary of the Board, respectively.

metadata.title: The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 1992
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972 to update definitions and restrict commercial activities in wildlife sanctuaries. It specifically prohibits leasing or using fishing waters within sanctuaries for commercial purposes like fishing or collecting lotus roots.

metadata.title: The Sind Sports Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Sports Board Ordinance, 1980 by substituting specific terms related to registration and affiliation within its sections. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind on January 30, 1982, pursuant to the Provisional Constitution Order, 1981.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the application of the Stamp Act, 1899 to the Province of Sind. It specifically substitutes clauses regarding duty on shares and debentures within Schedule I of the Act.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Stamp Act, 1899 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It adds new sections regarding the verification of sale consideration for deeds executed under power of attorney and establishes penalties for obstructing revenue authorities or concealing information.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Stamp Act, 1899 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950. It substitutes the name 'Sugar Factories Control Board' for 'Sugarcane Control Board' within sections 2 and 3 of the amended Act.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Finance Act, 1963 by modifying section 16. Specifically, it substitutes subsection references and inserts provisions regarding officers authorized by the Government or subordinate authorities.

metadata.title: The Sind Universities Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.amends: The University of Sind Act, 1972; The University of Karachi Act, 1972; The N.E.D. University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977; The Mehran University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1997; The Sind Agriculture University Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends several existing acts relating to universities in Sind to update appointment criteria based on National Scales of Pay. Specifically, it substitutes clauses regarding posts up to grade 16 and posts in grades 17 and above across various university acts.

metadata.title: The Sindh University Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.amends: University Laws; University of Sind Act, 1972; University of Karachi Act, 1972; N.E.D. University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977; Mehran University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977; Sind Agriculture University Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends various University Acts in Sindh to update provisions regarding the Syndicate, audit requirements, and academic disciplines. It specifically introduces a compulsory Islamic and Pakistan Studies discipline for Muslim students while offering an alternative Ethics course for non-Muslim students. Additionally, it modifies the composition of university syndicates and statutes related to appointments and staff service.

metadata.title: The Sind University Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University Laws of Sind to introduce the position of Pro-Vice-Chancellor and modify the composition of university authorities. It also updates provisions regarding faculty appointments, attendance requirements for members, and the transfer of officers between government posts and universities.

metadata.title: The Sind Waqf Properties (Amendment) Ordinance, 1981
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1979 by adding a new sub-section to section 7. The amendment empowers the Government to transfer waqf properties taken over under specific provisions to councils constituted under the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979.

metadata.title: The Sind Abkari (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Abkari Act, 1878 to restrict the issuance of licenses, permits, or passes to Muslims except for specific purposes defined by the Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) Order, 1979. It also inserts a new section requiring that persons likely to be affected must be given an opportunity of being heard before any order is passed in appeal or revision.

metadata.title: The Abkari Laws (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.amends: The Sind Abkari Act, 1878; The Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940; The West Pakistan Prohibition of Opium Smoking Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends three specific laws regarding intoxicants and opium in the province of Sind. It substitutes sections to ensure that all offences under these acts are cognizable and can only be tried by a Court of the Magistrate of the First Class.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Produce Markets (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 to incorporate specific procedural safeguards. It ensures that affected persons and market committees are given a reasonable opportunity to be heard before orders are passed or actions are taken.

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.amends: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994 to update definitions regarding cropped areas and tax years. It substitutes sections on tax levies with new rates based on crop type and land area, while also introducing specific penalties for failure to furnish declarations or conceal cropped areas.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 to update regulations regarding market committees, licensing requirements, and auction procedures. It also introduces provisions for land acquisition by market committees and modifies specific sections related to fees, penalties, and administrative roles.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 by substituting specific references to the Director General of the Bureau of Supply and Prices with the Director General of Agricultural Extension. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 to update administrative references within the law. Specifically, it substitutes the title of the Director General of Agriculture, Extension for the Director General of Supply and Prices in Sindh.

metadata.title: The Sind Agricultural Supplies Organization (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Agricultural Supplies Organization Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Agricultural Supplies Organization Act, 1973, following a directive from the Federal Shariat Court. It specifically adds a new sub-section to section 14 regarding rent assessments and their liability to increase according to existing provisions.

metadata.title: The Sind Agriculture University (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Agriculture University Act, 1977 to address directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It modifies specific sections regarding appeal procedures and the requirement for orders to be made in good faith.

metadata.title: The Sind Agriculturists' Loans (Amendment) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1958 to make loans and seed sold on credit interest-free. It specifically designates relief loans for small land holders as 'Qarz-e-Hasana' and outlines recovery procedures.

name: AO POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF ORTHOPAEDIC SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 2013

metadata.title: The AO Post Graduate Institute of Orthopaedic Sciences Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the AO Post Graduate Institute of Orthopaedic Sciences in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the institute's powers to undertake postgraduate teaching programs, research, and training in various orthopaedic sciences and related fields.

metadata.title: The Badin Development Authority Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Badin Development Authority to oversee the development, improvement, and beautification of the Badin District. It defines the Authority's composition, functions, and powers regarding schemes, water supply, and property management.

metadata.title: The Baqai University Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Baqai University at Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's officers, authorities, and powers regarding instruction, property acquisition, and admission policies.

metadata.title: The Sind Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.amends: The Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970 by adding a new clause to Section 4. The amendment specifically includes the Chairman of the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Sukkur, in the relevant list.

metadata.title: The Sind Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970 to address directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It specifically modifies section 6 to ensure that no board member is removed without first being given an opportunity to be heard.

name: BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.title: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972. It specifically adds a proviso to section 6 requiring that no member be removed without giving them an opportunity to be heard.

metadata.title: The Boilers Act (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Boilers Act, 1923 to apply specifically to the Province of Sind. It substitutes provisions regarding exemptions for railway and nuclear-powered boilers and establishes a new Sind Boilers Board with six specific members.

metadata.title: The Sind Buildings Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979, in response to directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It introduces specific provisos to sections 14 and 17 of the said ordinance to ensure that affected persons or applicants are given an opportunity of being heard before any action is taken or appeals are disposed of.

name: CANAL AND DRAINAGE (EXTENSION TO ROHRI CANAL AREA) ORDINANCE, 1990

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage (Extension to Rohri Canal Area) Ordinance, 1990
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the application of the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 to areas irrigated by the Rohri Canal in Tando Adam Taluka, District Sanghar. It simultaneously excludes the Sind Irrigation Act, 1879 from applying to these specific areas while the Ordinance is in force.

name: CANAL AND DRAINAGE (EXTENSION TO ROHRI CANAL AREA) (SIND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage (Extension to Rohri Canal Area) (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: Canal and Drainage (Extension to Rohri Canal Area) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Canal and Drainage (Extension to Rohri Canal Area) Ordinance, 1970. It updates references in the principal Ordinance to include the Ghotki Canal alongside the Rohri Canal.

name: CANAL AND DRAINAGE (EXTENSION TO ROHRI CANAL AREA) ORDINANCE, 1991

metadata.title: The Canal and Drainage (Extension to Rohri Canal Area) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance extends the application of the Canal and Drainage Act, 1873 to areas irrigated by the Rohri Canal in Tando Adam Taluka, District Sanghar. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh because the Provincial Assembly was not in session at the time.

metadata.title: The Sind Children (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Children Act, 1955 by omitting section 14 and modifying section 90. The amendments substitute references to a 'putative father' with 'the state' in specific subsections.

metadata.title: The Civil Courts (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: Karachi Courts Order, 1956; West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Courts Order of 1956 and the West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance of 1962. It specifically increases the monetary limit for original civil suits in the District Judge's court from twenty-five thousand to fifty thousand rupees.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973 by substituting specific wording in section 18 regarding charge basis. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind on July 8, 1982, and comes into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973 by substituting terms like 'grade' with 'post', 'cadre', or 'service' throughout various sections. It also omits specific references to grades and adds provisions regarding seniority retention upon promotion.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973 by modifying section 5. The amendment mandates that one percent of appointments be made from among disabled persons, subject to availability.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants Welfare Fund (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Civil Servants Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Civil Servants Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1979 to replace references to 'grade' with 'basic scale'. It also updates definitions regarding civil servants and omits specific clauses related to grades within the original ordinance.

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Housing Authority Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sind Co-operative Housing Authority to re-organize, regulate, and supervise co-operative societies involved in housing development within the Province of Sind. It defines the Authority's corporate status, composition, appointment of officers like the Managing Director, and powers to intervene in societies failing to perform their duties.

name: CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES AND CO-OPERATIVE BANKS (RE-PAYMENT OF LOANS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Societies and Co-operative Banks (Re-payment of Loans) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Co-operative Societies and Co-operative Banks (Re-payment of Loans) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Co-operative Societies and Co-operative Banks (Re-payment of Loans) Ordinance, 1966. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind in pursuance of a Federal Shariat Court direction to make certain amendments.

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 to address the transfer of shares or interests upon a member's death. It specifically adds a new provision regarding the disbursement of such value among heirs according to personal law.

name: COLONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT LANDS (SINDH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1995

metadata.title: The Colonization of Government Lands (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1995
metadata.amends: The Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912 by substituting specific wording in Section 17 regarding land types. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Colonization of Government Lands (Amendment) Ordinance, 2010
metadata.amends: The Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Preamble and Section 10 of the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912. It grants the Chief Minister the authority to extend project completion periods for land granted specifically for education and health purposes when delays are not caused by negligence.

name: COLONIZATION OF GOVERNMENT LANDS (SINDH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2005

metadata.title: The Colonization of Government Lands (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.amends: The Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912 specifically for its application to the Province of Sindh. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary. The document adds specific words to the title and preamble, substitutes section 3 with new definitions for various land types and authorities, and modifies section 1.

metadata.title: The Consumer Protection Ordinance, 2004
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Consumers Protection Council and Consumer Courts in Sindh to promote and protect consumer interests. It defines key terms such as 'consumer', 'goods', and 'services' while outlining the powers of the Council and courts, including provisions for product safety and price exhibition.

metadata.title: The Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940, following directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It specifically adds a definition for 'consume or consumption' to include taking intoxicating drugs by injection and modifies penalty clauses in sections 3, 4, and 5.

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the development, improvement, and beautification of the coastal areas in the Districts of Thatta and Badin. It also establishes a specific Authority to carry out these purposes.

metadata.title: The Sind Cotton Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966, to introduce a new sub-section regarding appeals against government orders. It grants aggrieved persons the right to prefer an appeal within seven days of an order, with the Government's decision being final provided the appellant was heard.

metadata.title: The Sind Councils (Validation of Tax) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates certain taxes, rates, tolls, or fees levied under the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979. It deems such levies made on or after June 3, 1980 as validly collected and allows for the recovery of unpaid amounts.

metadata.title: The Court Fees (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Court Fees Act, 1870 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It establishes a maximum limit on court fees payable under the Act, ensuring that fees do not exceed fifteen thousand rupees in any case.

metadata.title: The Court Fees (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Court Fees Act, 1870 to apply specifically to the Province of Sind. It abolishes court fees for criminal cases and civil cases where the value does not exceed twenty-five thousand rupees.

metadata.title: The Court Fees (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Court-fees Act, 1870 as it applies to the Province of Sind. It omits specific sections and articles from the Act and its schedules while inserting a new article regarding fees for probate and certificates.

metadata.title: The Sind Court of Wards (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Court of Wards Act, 1905
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Court of Wards Act, 1905 to address procedural requirements regarding notice delivery and cost entitlement in specific suits. It also modifies section 44 of the said Act to ensure affected persons are given an opportunity to be heard before any order is revised or reversed.

metadata.title: The Sind Cultural Advancement Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Cultural Advancement Board Act, 1955
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Cultural Advancement Board Act, 1955 to address directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It inserts a new section prohibiting the patronization or undertaking of activities that are indecent, obscene, or tend to inculcate immorality or advance eroticism.

name: DADA BHOY INSTITUTE OF HIGHER EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 2003

metadata.title: The Dadabhoy Institute of Higher Education Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Dadabhoy Institute of Higher Education in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the institute's powers, functions, and internal authorities, including the Board, Academic Council, and various committees responsible for teaching, research, and administration.

name: DEFENCE HOUSING AUTHORITY SUFFA UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Defence Housing Authority Suffa University Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Defence Housing Authority Suffa University at Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the powers and functions of the University, including providing instructions, training, research, and examining students.

metadata.title: The Sind Deti Leti (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Deti Leti Act, 1939 to substitute the word 'Muslims' for 'Muhammadans' in section 1, subsection (3). It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind on December 10, 1984, following a directive from the Federal Shariat Court.

name: DORAB PATEL POST GRADUATE TRAINING INSTITUTE FOR NEPHROLOGY AND UROLOGY ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Dorab Patel Post Graduate Training Institute for Nephrology and Urology Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and reorganizes the Kidney Centre Karachi into a new body known as the Dorab Patel Post Graduate Training Institute for Nephrology and Urology. It establishes the institute as a corporate body with powers to manage property, provide medical care, conduct research, and offer training in nephrology, urology, and transplantation.

name: DOW UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2014

metadata.title: The Dow University of Health Sciences (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.amends: The Dow University of Health Sciences Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Dow University of Health Sciences Act, 2004 to allow the Governor to extend the tenure of a Vice Chancellor who ceased office due to the Sindh Universities Laws (Amendment) Act, 2013. The amendment permits such an individual to continue in office for a period not exceeding two years based on their performance.

name: DOW UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2005

metadata.title: The Dow University of Health Sciences (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.amends: The Dow University of Health Sciences Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Dow University of Health Sciences Act, 2004 to address personnel transfers. It grants individuals transferred to the university the option to serve in the Health Department instead, with a deadline to exercise this choice.

name: DOW UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 2003

metadata.title: The Dow University of Health Sciences Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Dow University of Health Sciences in Karachi. It provides for the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and various authorities like the Senate and Syndicate.

name: DR. ZIAUDDIN POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 1994

metadata.title: Dr. Ziauddin Post Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Dr. Ziauddin Post-Graduate Institute of Medical Sciences in Karachi as a corporate body with perpetual succession. It confers powers on the Institute to conduct postgraduate courses, award degrees and diplomas, manage research, and affiliate institutions.

name: ESTABLISHMENT OF THE OFFICE OF OMBUDSMAN FOR THE PROVINCE OF SINDH (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2012

metadata.title: The Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh (Amendment) Ordinance, 2012
metadata.amends: The Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Act, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Act, 1991. It specifically substitutes Section 4 to allow the Governor to extend the term or reappoint the Ombudsman in appropriate cases.

name: ESTABLISHMENT OF THE OFFICE OF OMBUDSMAN FOR THE PROVINCE OF SINDH (codified)

metadata.title: The Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the office of the Provincial Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh to diagnose, investigate, and rectify injustice caused by mal-administration. It outlines the appointment process, tenure, powers, functions, and conditions of service for the Ombudsman and their staff.

name: ESTABLISHMENT OF THE OFFICE OF OMBUDSMAN FOR THE PROVINCE OF SINDH ORDINANCE, 1991

metadata.title: The Establishment of the Office of Ombudsman for the Province of Sindh Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the office of the Provincial Ombudsman for Sindh to diagnose, investigate, and rectify injustices caused by mal-administration. It outlines the appointment, tenure, powers, and functions of the Ombudsman, as well as the terms of service for staff and procedures for handling complaints.

name: ESTABLISHMENT OF THE SINDH MEDICAL UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 2012

metadata.title: The Sindh Medical University Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Medical University located in Karachi. It provides for the incorporation of the university, defines its officers and authorities, and outlines the framework for its statutes, regulations, and rules.

metadata.title: The Factories Act (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Factories Act, 1934 as it applies to the Province of Sind. Specifically, it substitutes certain words and figures in section 60 regarding references to other sections of the Act.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance Ordinance, 1981
metadata.amends: The Court Fees Act, 1870; The Stamp Act, 1899; The West Pakistan Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958; The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1964; The West Pakistan Finance Act, 1965; The Sind Finance Ordinance, 1971; The Sind Finance Act, 1975
metadata.repeals: Section 2 of the Sind Finance Ordinance, 1971; Section 10 of the Sind Finance Act, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to rationalize, enhance, and provide relief in certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sind. It also amends several existing laws regarding court fees, stamp duties, motor vehicle taxation, and company finance acts.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance Ordinance, 1982
metadata.amends: The Stamp Act, 1899; West Pakistan Act (XXXII) of 1958; West Pakistan Act XXXIV of 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to levy, rationalize, and enhance certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sind. It also serves to amend specific existing laws, including the Stamp Act of 1899 and acts from West Pakistan.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance grants certain tax relief in Sindh by amending section 4 of the Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958. It substitutes specific monetary values within that Act and comes into force immediately as of July 1, 1984.

metadata.title: The Forest (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Forest Act, 1927 as it applies to the Province of Sind. It substitutes specific terms in sections 67 and 68, updates fine amounts for various animals in section 71, and adds a new section 79-A regarding police assistance.

metadata.title: The Greenwich University Ordinance, 1997
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Greenwich University at Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university autonomy to provide education, confer degrees, affiliate with other institutions, and manage its own affairs including statutes and regulations.

metadata.title: The Hamdard University Karachi Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Hamdard University at Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the powers and functions of the University, including its autonomy to provide instruction, admit students, confer degrees, and conduct research.

metadata.title: The Hamdard University Karachi Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Hamdard University at Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It grants the university autonomy to provide instruction, admit students, confer degrees, and conduct research while ensuring open access regardless of sex, religion, or race.

metadata.title: The Sind Holy Quran (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Holy Quran Act, 1940 to update specific provisions regarding the printing, publishing, and selling of the Holy Quran. It substitutes section 3 of the original Act with new text defining penalties for non-Muslims who handle the Quran outside of Muslim agency.

metadata.title: The Sindh Horse Race Betting Tax (Repeal) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Horse Race Betting Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh to repeal the Sindh Horse Race Betting Tax Act, 1958. The legislation comes into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Hyderabad Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Hyderabad Development Authority Act, 1976 by omitting specific words from section 4. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Hyderabad Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Hyderabad Development Authority Act, 1976 in response to directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It introduces specific provisions regarding the removal of non-official members, mosque inclusion in residential schemes, compensation determination, and procedural safeguards for affected parties.

metadata.title: The Hyderabad Development Authority Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the development, improvement, and beautification of urban areas within the Hyderabad Division. It also establishes a specific Authority to carry out these functions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Incumbered Estates (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Incumbered Estates Act, 1896, following directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It comes into force immediately and omits specific references to 'jagirdars' while substituting terms related to 'Zamindar' in various sections of the original Act.

name: INDUS INSTITUTE OF HIGHER EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 2004

metadata.title: The Indus Institute of Higher Education Ordinance, 2004
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Indus Institute of Higher Education in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the institute's powers, functions, and internal authorities, including the Board, Academic Council, and various committees.

name: INDUS VALLEY SCHOOL OF ART AND ARCHITECTURE KARACHI ORDINANCE 1993

metadata.title: The Indus Valley School of Art and Architecture at Karachi Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Indus Valley School of Art and Architecture in Karachi as a fully autonomous body. It confers powers to award degrees, diplomas, and certificates while ensuring the school remains open to all persons regardless of sex, religion, race, creed, colour, or domicile.

name: INDUS VALLEY SCHOOL OF ART ARCHITECTURE KARACHI ORDINANCE, 1993

metadata.title: The Indus Valley School of Art and Architecture Karachi Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Indus Valley School of Art and Architecture in Karachi by reconstituting an existing society-run school. It grants the institution autonomous status to govern its academic functions, award degrees, and operate without interference.

metadata.title: The Institute of Business Administration Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance re-constitutes and re-organizes the Institute of Business Administration in Karachi. It confers upon the Institute the power to award degrees, diplomas, and certificates while establishing its corporate structure and functions.

name: INSTITUTE OF BUSINESS AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 2003

metadata.title: The Institute of Business and Technology Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Institute of Business and Technology in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the institute's powers, including providing instructions, admitting students, holding examinations, and awarding degrees, while subjecting its functions to instructions from the Government of Sindh.

metadata.title: The Iqra University Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a University at Karachi known as the Iqra University. It defines the university's structure, including its officers, authorities, and powers to provide instruction in various disciplines.

metadata.title: The Iqra University Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Iqra University in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its patron, chancellor, board, and academic council, while granting powers to confer degrees and award distinctions.

metadata.title: The Sind Irrigation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Irrigation Act, 1879, following a directive from the Federal Shariat Court. It modifies section 36 to require an opportunity for the appellant to be heard before deciding appeals and alters section 40 regarding specific time limits.

metadata.title: The Sind Irrigation Water Users Associations (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Irrigation Water Users Associations Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Irrigation Water Users Associations Ordinance, 1982, following a directive from the Federal Shariat Court. It specifically modifies Section 4 by adding a proviso to ensure that parties in an appeal are given an opportunity to be heard before any order is made.

metadata.title: The Sind Irrigation Water Users Associations Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the formation and operation of irrigation water users associations to improve agricultural productivity through better use of surface and ground water. It establishes the legal framework for creating these associations, defining their powers, structure, and duties while overriding other conflicting laws.

metadata.title: The Isra University Ordinance, 1996
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Isra University at Hyderabad as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the university's powers to provide instruction, prescribe curricula, and award degrees, while mandating adherence to Islamic moral and ethical codes derived from the Holy Quran and Sunnah.

metadata.title: The Isra University Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the establishment of Isra University at Hyderabad and matters ancillary thereto. It establishes the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession, defines its officers and authorities, and outlines its powers and functions regarding instruction and property.

name: JAMIA QUAID-I-AZAM SINDH MADRESSAH-TUL-ISLAM AT KARACHI, 1993

metadata.title: The Jamia Quaid-e-Azam Sindh Madressah-tul-Islam at Karachi, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Jamia Quaid-e-Azam Sindh Madressah-tul-Islam at Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's officers, authorities, and functions while ensuring admission is open to all persons regardless of sex, religion, race, creed, colour, or domicile.

metadata.title: The Jinnah University for Women Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Jinnah University for Women as a body corporate in Karachi. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, and Vice Chancellor, and stipulates that it is open to females of all religions, races, and creeds.

name: KARACHI DEVELOPMENT AND BEAUTIFICATION AUTHORITY ORDINANCE, 1988

metadata.title: The Karachi Development and Beautification Authority Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Karachi Development and Beautification Authority to oversee the development, improvement, and beautification of roads, streets, and adjoining areas in Karachi. It provides for the appointment of the Authority, its administration by a committee, the preparation and approval of schemes, and powers regarding property management and encroachment removal.

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1996
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957 by modifying Article 52-A. It allows amenity plots vested in the Karachi Transport Corporation to be converted or utilized for other purposes with prior government approval.

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957 by modifying Article 52-A. It allows amenity plots vesting in the Karachi Transport Corporation to be converted or utilized for other purposes with prior government approval.

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957 to modify provisions regarding water supply agreements and rates. It specifically grants the Authority the power to reduce or disconnect water supply if a consumer fails to pay claimed sums within one month of receiving a demand notice.

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957 to update provisions regarding the composition of the Governing Body and member appointments. It specifically revises clauses related to the tenure of members, their remuneration, and the quorum required for meetings.

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957 to update provisions regarding authorized officers for different pay grades. It substitutes specific clauses in Article 8 to define which officials can authorize orders based on the grade of the post holder.

metadata.title: The Karachi Development Authority (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957 by substituting specific clauses within Article 52-A. It strictly prohibits the conversion or utilization of amenity plots reserved for specified purposes for any other use.

metadata.title: The Karachi Division (Traffic Engineering) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Karachi Transport Board and a Traffic Engineering Bureau to promote road safety within the Karachi Division. It defines the powers, functions, and constitution of these bodies while providing regulations for vehicle use, road closures, and fund management.

metadata.title: The Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1984 by modifying section 5. The amendment allows the Chairman to exercise the powers and perform the functions of the Board until it is duly constituted.

metadata.title: The Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1996
metadata.amends: The Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1984. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

metadata.title: The Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment of the Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority as a body corporate. It defines the powers, functions, and constitution of the Authority's Board, including the appointment of officials and management structure.

name: KARACHI INSTITUTE OF ECONOMICS AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 2000

metadata.title: The Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Karachi Institute of Economics and Technology in Karachi. It defines the institute's powers, functions, and governance structure, including the establishment of a Board, Academic Council, and various authorities.

metadata.title: The Karachi Metropolitan Transport Authority Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Karachi Metropolitan Transport Authority to create a safe, economical, and efficient transport system in Karachi. It provides for the establishment of the authority's governing body, management structure, and outlines its powers and functions regarding the metropolitan transport system.

name: KARACHI ROADS DEVELOPMENT AND BEAUTIFICATION AUTHORITY ORDINANCE, 1988

metadata.title: The Karachi Roads Development and Beautification Authority Ordinance, 1988
metadata.repeals: Sind Ordinance, III of 1988
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Karachi Roads Development and Beautification Authority to oversee the development, improvement, and beautification of roads and streets in Karachi. It provides for the appointment of an authority body, defines its responsibilities regarding schemes and environmental quality, and repeals a previous ordinance from 1988.

name: KHADIM ALI SHAH BUKHARI INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Khadim Ali Shah Bukhari Institute of Technology Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Khadim Ali Shah Bukhari Institute of Technology in Karachi as a degree-awarding body corporate. It defines the institute's powers, including conducting instruction, examinations, and research across various disciplines, while outlining its governance through a Board, Academic Council, and specific officers.

name: KIDNEY CENTRE POST GRADUATE TRAINING INSTITUTE ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Kidney Centre Post Graduate Training Institute Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Dorab Patel Post Graduate Training Institute for Nephrology and Urology Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance re-constitutes and re-organizes the Kidney Centre in Karachi to establish it as The Kidney Centre Post Graduate Training Institute. It creates a new training and research centre known as the Dorab Patel Post Graduate Training and Research Centre while transferring all properties and staff from the existing entity.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It substitutes specific terms regarding revenue officers within the Act and was promulgated by the Governor under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (West Pakistan Amendment) (Repeal) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.repeals: The Land Acquisition (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Land Acquisition (West Pakistan Amendment) Act, 1969, and deems its amendments to the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as never having been enacted. It further stipulates that interest on compensation payable under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 shall be calculated at a rate of six per centum simple interest per annum, regardless of any prior court judgments.

metadata.title: The Land Acquisition (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It introduces time limits for notifications, declarations, and awards, deeming proceedings ended if these deadlines are missed, and mandates the payment of additional compensation for delays.

metadata.title: The Land Control (Karachi Division) (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Control (Karachi Division) Act, 1952 to apply specifically to the Province of Sind. It adds a new section allowing authorized officers to requisition police assistance when exercising their powers under the Act.

metadata.title: The Land Reforms Regulation (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Reforms Regulation, 1972 to further regulate land transfers and ownership in the Province of Sind. It specifically addresses exemptions for gifts to heirs or widowed sisters, limits on additional land acquisition for owners of tractors or tube-wells, and definitions regarding civil service posts.

metadata.title: The Land Reforms Regulation (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Land Reforms Regulation, 1972, as it applies to the Province of Sind. It re-enacts amendments previously made during the Emergency period that expired in 1978, specifically regarding definitions of tenants, partition procedures for jointly owned holdings, alienation rights, and tenant ejection processes.

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Land Revenue Act, 1967 to substitute the term 'deh' for 'estate' throughout the legislation. It updates definitions regarding assessment circles and net assets while introducing new exemptions for small land owners based on acreage and irrigation status.

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Land Revenue Act, 1967, in response to directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It substitutes the word 'Friday' for 'Sunday' in specific subsections of sections 95 and 110 of the amended act.

metadata.title: The Larkana Development Authority Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the development, improvement, and beautification of urban areas within the Larkana Division. It also establishes a specific Authority to carry out these purposes.

name: LIAQUAT AND DOW MEDICAL AND HEALTH SCIENCES UNIVERSITIES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2005

metadata.title: The Liaquat and Dow Medical and Health Sciences Universities (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.amends: Liaquat University of Medical and Health Sciences Ordinance, 2001; Dow University of Health Sciences Act, 2004
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Liaquat University of Medical and Health Sciences Ordinance, 2001 and the Dow University of Health Sciences Act, 2004 to update their administrative structures. It specifically changes provisions regarding the appointment of Pro-Chancellors, Vice Chancellors, Registrars, and Syndicate roles, as well as procedures for acting when a Chancellor is incapacitated.

name: LIAQUAT UNIVERSITY OF MEDICAL AND HEALTH SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 2000

metadata.title: The Liaquat University of Medical and Health Sciences Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance upgrades Liaquat Medical College Jamshoro to the status of the Liaquat University of Medical and Health Sciences. It establishes the university's constitution, powers, assets, liabilities, and the framework for its various authorities, including the Senate, Syndicate, and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Sind Livestock Improvement (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Livestock Improvement Act, 1933 to ensure procedural fairness in licensing and administrative proceedings. Specifically, it requires that applicants or affected persons be given an opportunity of being heard before a license is refused/revoked or before orders are modified.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979. It removes the requirement for previous government sanction in a specific subsection and substitutes a new provision requiring councils to specify effective dates for levied taxes, rates, tolls, or fees.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to update compulsory and optional functions of local bodies. Specifically, it adds provisions for promoting adult education in municipal committees and corporations while modifying sections regarding local cess rates.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001. It adds a new section prohibiting internal recall motions against elected nazims until December 31, 2002.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to update various sections regarding council composition and functions. It introduces provisions for divisional, district, and taluka co-ordination committees and modifies rules concerning member resignation and removal.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to include new optional functions for local bodies. Specifically, it adds provisions for earmarking land for mosques, providing religious education, and undertaking the construction and maintenance of mosques.

metadata.title: The Lyari Development Authority Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Lyari Development Authority to oversee the development of specific areas within the Karachi Division. It aims to improve the socio-economic conditions of the people in these designated areas and grants the Authority powers similar to a local council, including land acquisition and scheme execution.

metadata.title: The Malir Development Authority Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Malir Development Authority to develop specific areas within the Karachi Division. It aims to improve the socio-economic conditions of the people residing in these designated areas.

name: MARTIAL LAW REGULATION NO.118 (SIND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: Martial Law Regulation No.118 (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends Martial Law Regulation No.118 by omitting specific paragraphs and modifying wording in paragraph 10. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind under the Interim Constitution due to the Provincial Assembly not being in session.

name: MEHRAN ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY UNIVERSITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1986

metadata.title: The Mehran Engineering and Technology University (Amendment) Ordinance, 1986
metadata.amends: The Mehran University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Mehran University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977 to introduce the position of Pro-Vice-Chancellor. It inserts references to this new role in various sections regarding university governance and appoints powers for the Chancellor to designate a Pro-Vice-Chancellor for specific campuses.

name: MEHRAN ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1977

metadata.title: The Mehran Engineering and Technology University Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Mehran Engineering and Technology University in Nawabshah, Sind. It defines the university's structure, including its authorities such as the Senate and Syndicate, and outlines the roles of officers like the Vice-Chancellor.

name: MEHRAN UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,1984

metadata.title: The Mehran University of Engineering and Technology (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Mehran University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Mehran University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977 to incorporate specific changes regarding appeal procedures. It ensures that no orders in appeal or review are made without providing an opportunity for the appellant or applicant to be heard, and inserts a requirement for actions to be done in good faith.

metadata.title: The Sind Milk Boards (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Milk Boards Ordinance, 1963 to address specific procedural requirements regarding civil suits instituted against the Board. It inserts a new sub-section into Section 33 that limits the plaintiff's entitlement to costs if a settlement is reached or the claim is conceded within two months of the suit's institution.

name: MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.title: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975, following a directive from the Federal Shariat Court. It adds a new subsection to Section II regarding the distribution of compensation paid to nominees among the heirs of deceased individuals.

metadata.title: The Muhammad Ali Jinnah University Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Muhammad Ali Jinnah University in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, President, and Board of Governors, while outlining powers for instruction, research, and degree conferral.

metadata.title: The Muhammad Ali Jinnah University Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Muhammad Ali Jinnah University in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the university's powers to provide instruction, admit students, confer degrees, and conduct research while ensuring open access regardless of sex, religion, race, or domicile.

metadata.title: The Muhammad Ali Jinnah University Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Muhammad Ali Jinnah University in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, President, and Board of Governors, while ensuring open admission regardless of sex, religion, race, or domicile.

name: N.E.D. UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,1984

metadata.title: The N.E.D. University of Engineering and Technology (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The N.E.D. University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the N.E.D. University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977 to ensure that appellants or applicants are given an opportunity to be heard before orders in appeal or review are made. It also requires that certain actions be done in good faith and modifies specific sections regarding appeals and procedural requirements.

name: N.E.D.UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1986

metadata.title: The N.E.D. University of Engineering and Technology (Amendment) Ordinance, 1986
metadata.amends: The N.E.D. University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the N.E.D. University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977 to introduce the position of Pro-Vice-Chancellor. It grants the Chancellor the power to appoint a Pro-Vice-Chancellor for specific campuses with terms not exceeding four years at a time.

name: NADIRSHAW EDULJI DINSHAW ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY UNIVERSITY ORDINANCE, 1977

metadata.title: The Nadirshaw Edulji Dinshaw Engineering and Technology University Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This ordinance establishes the Nadirshaw Edulji Dinshaw Engineering and Technology University in Karachi. It defines the university's structure, including its authorities, officers, and affiliated colleges, while outlining powers for teaching, examinations, and administration.

metadata.title: National Accountability Ordinance 1999 Sindh Repeal Act, 2017
metadata.repeals: National Accountability Ordinance 1999 (XVIII of 1999)
metadata.summary: This Act repeals the National Accountability Ordinance, 1999 to the extent of its applicability in the Province of Sindh. It transfers all pending proceedings and investigations under the repealed Ordinance to the Sindh Anti-Corruption Establishment and Provincial Anti-Corruption Courts.

metadata.title: The Sind National Calamities (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind National Calamities (Prevention and Relief) Act, 1958. It adds a new sub-section to section 8 of the amended Act requiring that a person likely to be affected by a revision order must be afforded an opportunity of being heard before the order is passed.

metadata.title: The Newborn Screening (Sindh) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes and integrates a sustainable newborn screening system within the public health delivery system of Sindh. It provides recommended procedures for audiologists, defines key terms related to heritable conditions and screening protocols, and mandates the dissemination of educational materials to stakeholders.

name: NEWPORTS INSTITUTE OF COMMUNICATIONS AND ECONOMICS ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Newports Institute of Communications and Economics Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Newports Institute of Communications and Economics at Karachi as a body corporate. It defines the institute's powers, functions, and structure, including provisions for admissions, examinations, research, and the appointment of various authorities such as the Board and Academic Council.

name: NIBD POST GRADUATE INSTITUTE OF LIFE SCIENCES ORDINANCE, 2013

metadata.title: The NIBD Post Graduate Institute of Life Sciences Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the NIBD Post Graduate Institute of Life Sciences as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the institute's powers to undertake postgraduate teaching programs in medical and life sciences, including epidemiology, biotechnology, and nursing.

metadata.title: The Sind Orphanages (Supervision and Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Orphanages (Supervision and Control) Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Orphanages (Supervision and Control) Act, 1976, following directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It substitutes specific terms like 'orphanage' with 'Darul-Atfal' throughout the Act and adds new definitions and provisos regarding hearings for members and appellants.

name: PEOPLE’S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH ORDINANCE, 1995

metadata.title: The People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Ordinance reconstitutes and reorganizes the Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah in Sindh. It establishes a body corporate with perpetual succession to manage the institution's affairs, property, and operations through a newly constituted Board of Governors.

name: PEOPLE’S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1997

metadata.title: The People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah (Repeal) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.repeals: The People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Act, 1995
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Act, 1995. It transfers the college, its assets, liabilities, and employees to the Government of Sindh, renaming it the Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah.

metadata.title: The Police (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Police Act, 1861 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes a clause in section 15-A regarding the fixation and payment of compensation equal to diyat, ursh, or daman under Sharia law.

metadata.title: The Police (Sind Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Police Act, 1861 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It modifies section 30 by adding a proviso that allows magistrates to refuse licenses if they determine the grant would breach peace or prejudice public safety.

name: PRESTON INSTITUTE OF MANAGEMENT, SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Preston Institute of Management, Science and Technology Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Preston Institute of Management, Science and Technology in Karachi as a body corporate. It outlines the institute's powers to provide instruction, award degrees, acquire property, and establish various faculties and research centers.

name: PREVENTION OF DEFACEMENT OF PROPERTY ORDINANCE, 2013

metadata.title: The Prevention of Defacement of Property Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the prevention of property defacement and prohibits expressing matters on walls within the Province of Sindh. It establishes an Anti-Property Defacement Task Force to assess the scope of defacement and propose enforcement programs, while also mandating the removal of existing defacement.

metadata.title: The Prisoners (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the application of The Prisoners Act, 1900 to the Province of Sind. Specifically, it deletes certain commas and words from section 40 of that Act following a direction from the Federal Shariat Court.

metadata.title: The Prisons and Prisoners (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Prisons Act, 1894 and the Prisoners Act, 1900 specifically for their application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes the word 'Director' with 'Inspector General' wherever it occurs in the aforementioned Acts.

metadata.title: The Sind Private Colleges (Management and Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970. It inserts a new sub-section into Section 5 regarding the removal of Chairmen or members from office, ensuring they are given an opportunity to be heard before any removal order is passed.

metadata.title: The Sind Private Schools (Management and Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Private Schools (Management and Control) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Private Schools (Management and Control) Act, 1974 to address directions from the Federal Shariat Court. Specifically, it modifies Section 5 of the parent Act to ensure that no member is removed without first being given an opportunity to be heard.

name: PRIVATE UNIVERSITIES AND EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTES LAWS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Private Universities and Educational Institutes Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: Private Universities and Educational Institutes Laws
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends laws relating to private universities and educational institutes in the Province of Sindh. It introduces provisions for patron-led inspections, monitoring charges, and powers regarding university closure.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, to update provisions regarding ticket systems and traffic violation penalties. It substitutes specific sections and schedules within the parent ordinance to modify enforcement procedures.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 to update penalties for various traffic violations. It substitutes specific sections and introduces a Twelfth Schedule containing detailed fine amounts for offenses such as speeding, overloading, and using mobile phones while driving.

metadata.title: The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It updates compensation amounts and schedules regarding injuries to passengers in stage or contract carriages.

name: PROVINCIAL SMALL CAUSES COURTS (SINDH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1993

metadata.title: The Provincial Small Causes Courts (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.amends: The Provincial Small Causes Courts Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Small Causes Courts Act, 1887, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sindh. It substitutes specific monetary figures in sections 15 and 27-A of the said Act to increase jurisdictional limits.

name: PROVINCIAL SMALL CAUSES COURTS (SINDH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1993

metadata.title: The Provincial Small Causes Courts (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.amends: The Provincial Small Causes Courts Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Small Causes Courts Act, 1887, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sindh. It substitutes specific monetary figures in sections 15 and 27-A of the said Act to increase jurisdictional limits.

name: PROVINCIAL SMALL CAUSES COURTS (SINDH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,1993

metadata.title: The Provincial Small Causes Courts (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.amends: The Provincial Small Causes Courts Act, 1887
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Provincial Small Causes Courts Act, 1887 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It substitutes specific monetary figures in sections 15 and 27-A of the said Act to increase jurisdictional limits.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Conveyances (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Public Conveyances Act, 1920, in response to directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It introduces provisions ensuring that persons likely to be affected by certain orders are given an opportunity of being heard before those orders are passed.

metadata.title: The Sind Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978. It specifically substitutes Section 4 to define the appointment process for the Chairman and Members, set term limits, and outline resignation procedures.

metadata.title: The Sind Qaumi Razakars (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Qaumi Razakars Ordinance, 1965, to address directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It specifically modifies Section 7 of the parent Ordinance by adding a proviso that requires members of the Qaumi Razakars to be given an opportunity to show cause and be heard before any order of dismissal is passed against them.

name: QUAID-E-AWAM UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING, SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY, NAWABSHAH ORDINANCE, 1996

metadata.title: The Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering, Science and Technology, Nawabshah Ordinance, 1996
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering, Science and Technology in Nawabshah. It defines the university's corporate structure, including its authorities, officers, and teaching departments.

metadata.title: The Sind Race-Courses Licensing (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Race-Courses Licensing Act, 1912 to prohibit betting and wagering in race-course licenses. It achieves this by omitting specific clauses allowing bets on horses and adding a new subsection explicitly forbidding such terms in licenses.

metadata.title: The Reformatory Schools (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Reformatory Schools Act, 1897 as it applies to the Province of Sind. Specifically, it deletes certain wording from section 17 regarding citizenship requirements for board members.

metadata.title: The Sind Regional Plan Organization (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Regional Plan Organization Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Regional Plan Organization Act, 1975 in response to directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It specifically alters provisions regarding the removal of non-official members and land acquisition procedures within the province of Sind.

name: REGISTRARS OF TRADE UNIONS (VALIDATION OF APPOINTMENTS AND ORDERS) (SIND) ORDINANCE, 1983

metadata.title: The Registrars of Trade Unions (Validation of Appointments and Orders) (Sindh) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates appointments of Registrars of Trade Unions and orders passed by them in Sindh. It deems the Director Labour, Sindh, to have continued as the Registrar for the whole province, ensuring all actions taken are valid.

metadata.title: The Registration (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1996
