metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Registration Act, 1908 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It specifically adds a new clause regarding powers of attorney that authorize the sale of immovable property.

metadata.title: The Sind Relief of Indebtedness (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Relief of Indebtedness Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Relief of Indebtedness Ordinance, 1960, following directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It specifically substitutes section 8 to exempt certain milk animals and draught animals used for a debtor's maintenance from attachment or sale in execution of decrees.

metadata.title: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.amends: Removal from Service (Special Powers) Sindh Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Removal from Service (Special Powers) Sindh Ordinance, 2000 to update procedures regarding the dismissal of government servants convicted of corruption or moral turpitude. It substitutes references to the Governor with the Chief Minister and introduces new sections to handle cases where court convictions lead to departmental action.

metadata.title: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Amendment) Sindh Ordinance, 2004
metadata.amends: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) Sindh Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Removal from Service (Special Powers) Sindh Ordinance, 2000 to substitute 'Chief Minister' for 'Governor' in specific sections. It introduces new provisions regarding dismissal for corruption or moral turpitude and establishes a review process for penalties imposed on government servants.

name: REMOVAL FROM SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS) (AMENDMENT) SINDH ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) (Amendment) Sindh Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) Sindh Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Removal from Service (Special Powers) Sindh Ordinance, 2000 to update grounds for dismissal and removal from service. It introduces new provisions regarding plea bargaining, asset return, and procedural requirements for inquiries into allegations against government servants.

name: REMOVAL FROM SERVICE (SPECIAL POWERS) SINDH ORDINANCE, 2000

metadata.title: The Removal from Service (Special Powers) Sindh Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the dismissal, removal, compulsory retirement from service, and reduction to a lower post or pay scale of certain persons in Government and corporation service. It establishes procedures for inquiry committees to investigate misconduct, corruption, inefficiency, or subversive activities that justify such actions.

metadata.title: The Sind Rented Premises (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979 by omitting specific provisos and sections related to tenant evictions and building reconstruction. It also substitutes a new section regarding penalties for landlords who relet premises or change their use within one year of obtaining possession.

name: REPEAL OF THE SINDH LAND REVENUE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011 (SINDH ACT NO.XXIII OF 2011) ORDINANCE, 2011

metadata.title: The Repeal of the Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2011 Ordinance, 2011
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh to repeal the Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Act, 2011. It also revives all provisions that were substituted by the repealed Act and validates actions taken under it.

metadata.title: The Sind Requisitioned Land (Continuance) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Requisitioned Land (Continuance) Act, 1958, following a direction from the Federal Shariat Court. It specifically adds a requirement to publish notices in two daily newspapers alongside the official Gazette.

name: REQUISITIONING OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (TEMPORARY POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.title: The Sind Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1956, in response to directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It introduces provisions to enhance compensation payable to property owners, ensuring it is not less than the rent of similar buildings and allowing for increases up to ten percent per annum under specific conditions.

metadata.title: The Sind Securities Contracts Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Securities Contracts Control Act, 1925
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Securities Contracts Control Act, 1925 to ensure stock-exchanges are given an opportunity to be heard before any order of refusal or withdrawal of recognition is made. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind on October 24, 1984, following directions from the Federal Shariat Court.

metadata.title: The Sind Seed Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Seed Corporation Act, 1976 to address directions from the Federal Shariat Court. Specifically, it modifies Section 7 by adding a proviso that ensures the Managing Director is given an opportunity to be heard before any order of removal is passed.

metadata.title: The Sehwan Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sehwan Development Authority Act, 1994 to change the appointment process for the Chairman and define their term of office. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh due to the suspension of the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The Sehwan Development Authority Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sehwan Development Authority to oversee the development, improvement, and beautification of taluka Sehwan and other areas in Dadu District. It defines the Authority's constitution, functions, financial management, and powers regarding property acquisition and public works.

metadata.title: The Sind (Amendment of Laws) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.repeals: The Sind (Amendment of Laws) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends various federal, provincial, and local acts applicable to the Province of Sind. It confers specific powers on Commissioners regarding project inspection, land acquisition decisions, and the transfer of pending appeals from Revenue Commissioners to Commissioners.

metadata.title: The Sind (Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957 Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957 to update its administrative provisions. Specifically, it omits Clause (3) of Article 5 and inserts 'Chairman and the' before 'Director-General' in clause (1) of Article 6.

name: SIND (TEACHING, PROMOTION AND USE OF SINDHI LANGUAGE) ACT, (APPLICATION) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The Sind (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) Act, (Application) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: The Sind (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance clarifies the application of the Sind (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) Act, 1972 to ensure no discrimination against Urdu speakers in civil services. It prohibits removing or denying appointments/promotions based solely on a lack of knowledge of Sindhi or Urdu for a period of twelve years.

name: SIND (TOWN COMMITTEE, BHIRYA ROAD) VALIDATION OF OCTROI TAX ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The Sindh (Town Committee, Bhirya Road) Validation of Octroi Tax Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates octroi tax charged, collected, or realized by the Town Committee of Bhirya Road in District Nawabshah between March 24, 1966, and August 24, 1970. The validation applies despite the lack of required sanction from the Commissioner under existing rules at that time.

metadata.title: The Sind Abkari Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Abkari Act, 1878 by substituting specific monetary fines and imprisonment terms in several sections. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind under Martial Law to increase penalties related to abkari offenses.

name: SIND ABOLITION OF LAND REVENUE AND AGRICULTURE INCOME TAX ORDINANCE, 1977

metadata.title: The Sind Abolition of Land Revenue and Agriculture Income Tax Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the abolition of land revenue and agriculture income tax in Sindh. It specifies that no such taxes shall be assessed or paid for the Rabi Crop of 1976-77 and thereafter, while also defining how recoverable revenue is deemed payable under a flat rate system.

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Supplies Organization Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Agricultural Supplies Organization as a body corporate within the Province of Sind. It grants the organization powers to procure and distribute agricultural inputs such as seeds and fertilizers, while defining its management structure through a Board of Members.

metadata.title: The Sind Agriculture University (Amendment) Ordinance, 1986
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Agriculture University Act, 1977 to introduce the position of Pro-Vice-Chancellor. It inserts references to the Pro-Vice-Chancellor in various sections and establishes a new section allowing the Chancellor to appoint this officer for specific campuses.

metadata.title: The Sind Agriculture University Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sind Agriculture University at Tandojam as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Chancellor, Pro-Chancellor, Senate, Syndicate, and various officers, while outlining their respective powers and duties.

metadata.title: The Sind Amendment of Laws Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends several existing laws in the province of Sind to address specific administrative and legal issues. It includes provisions for superseding society governing bodies, modifying industrial control regulations, and updating rules regarding privately managed schools and colleges.

name: SIND ARID ZONE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ORDINANCE, 1985

metadata.title: The Sind Arid Zone Development Authority Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sind Arid Zone Development Authority as a body corporate to manage development in designated arid areas. It outlines the authority's constitution, including the Chief Minister as Chairman and appointed members, along with their powers, functions, and financial provisions.

name: SIND BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970 to update institutional names and substitute 'Controlling Authority' for 'Government'. It also modifies board composition clauses, changes specific section numbers, and adds a saving clause regarding actions taken by the previous board.

name: SIND BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1975

metadata.title: The Sind Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.amends: The Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970 to exclude persons undergoing apprenticeship from its application. It further inserts new sections restricting the unauthorized issuance of diplomas and establishing penalties for contraventions.

name: SIND BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977

metadata.title: The Sind Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.amends: The Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970 by substituting the word 'Secretary' for 'Minister' in section 10. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh on October 22, 1977, and comes into force immediately.

name: SIND BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Sind Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance constitutes and establishes the Sind Board of Technical Education as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the composition of the Board, outlines the powers and duties of its members, and provides for the making of regulations and rules.

name: SIND BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972. It modifies specific sections regarding clause formatting and adds new clauses concerning chairmen of other boards.

name: SIND BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1978

metadata.title: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972 to clarify university affiliations for boards in Karachi versus other locations. It also adds a new board at Sukkur and modifies specific clauses within the original Ordinance regarding definitions and committee compositions.

name: SIND BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1988

metadata.title: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.amends: The Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972. It specifically substitutes clause (u) in section 2 to define which universities correspond to the Boards in Karachi, Hyderabad, and Sukkur.

metadata.title: The Sind Children (Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Children Act, 1955 to include Khairpur District within its scope. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973 by substituting the retirement age limit from fifty-eight years to sixty years. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973 by substituting a specific proviso in section 18. The amendment addresses pay structures for temporary appointments to higher posts during exigencies of service.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973 by inserting a proviso into section 13. The amendment ensures that no civil servant can be retired without being informed in writing of the grounds for the action and given a reasonable opportunity to show cause against it.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the appointment of persons to and the terms and conditions of service for civil servants in the Province of Sind. It provides a comprehensive framework covering definitions, tenure, probation, promotion, pay, leave, pension, and disciplinary matters.

name: SIND CIVIL SERVANTS WELFARE FUND ORDINANCE, 1979

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants Welfare Fund Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a welfare fund to provide financial security and assistance for civil servants of Sind and their families. It outlines the constitution of separate boards to administer different parts of the fund, rules for contributions, and provisions for utilizing the funds for insurance premiums and other benefits.

name: SIND CO-OPERATIVE FARMING SOCIETIES (REGULARIZATION OF GRANTS OF LAND) ORDINANCE, 1978

metadata.title: The Sindh Co-operative Farming Societies (Regularization of Grants of Land) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regularizes grants of government land made to Co-operative Farming Societies in the Kotri Barrage area. It also authorizes the laying down of conditions for such grants in accordance with the Colonization of Government Lands Act, 1912.

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Housing Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.amends: The Sind Co-operative Housing Authority Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Co-operative Housing Authority Ordinance, 1982 to adjust time periods regarding office terms and disqualifications. It specifically substitutes 'one year' for 'six months' and 'two years' for 'one year' in section 14, while also inserting a new section 14-A that restricts the eligibility of removed or disqualified persons to contest elections.

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Amending Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Act, 1977 by substituting specific subsection references in section 4. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind on December 26, 1977, and is deemed to have taken effect from June 28, 1977.

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Co-operative Societies Act, 1925 by substituting specific wording in section 52. It replaces the reference to a Central Co-operative Bank with the Provincial Co-operative Bank.

metadata.title: The Sind Consumers' Council (Dissolution) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the dissolution of the Consumers' Council and provides for the utilization of its assets. It deems the Council to have been validly dissolved on August 25, 1977, and transfers all assets and liabilities to the Price Stabilization Board.

name: SIND CONSUMPTION OF INTOXICANTS RESTRICTION ACT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act (Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Consumption of Intoxicants Restriction Act, 1940. It specifically omits clause (a) of section 35 of that Act and comes into force immediately.

metadata.title: The Sind Cooperative Housing Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.amends: The Sind Cooperative Housing Authority Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Cooperative Housing Authority Ordinance, 1982 to require the Government to afford a hearing opportunity to societies before taking action under section 6. It also provides for dispensing with this hearing in emergent cases and allows for interim orders to prevent mischief or abuse.

name: SIND CRIMINAL LAW (AMENDMENT) (VALIDATION OF TRANSFER OF CASES) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The Sind Criminal Law (Amendment) (Validation of Transfer of Cases) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Criminal Law (Repeal) (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This ordinance validates the transfer of cases under the West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1963 to respective criminal courts. It deems such transfers and subsequent legal actions as valid from February 13, 1971, despite the Provincial Assembly not being in session.

metadata.title: The Sind Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Ordinance, 1986
metadata.summary: This ordinance provides for the payment of a special allowance to employees in the province of Sind whose wages do not exceed one thousand rupees. It defines key terms such as 'employee', 'employer', and 'undertaking' and establishes the specific rates and timing for this allowance.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance continues and levies certain taxes and surcharges in the Province of Sindh. It establishes procedures for assessment, collection, and recovery while barring suits in civil courts regarding these levies.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the sharing of property tax between the Government and local bodies in Sind. It also grants tax relief to urban property owners by amending specific sections of the existing Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958.

metadata.title: The Sind Finance Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: The Court Fees Act, 1870; The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958; The Sind Finance Act, 1964
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the sharing of betterment tax between the Government and local bodies in Sind. It also grants certain tax reliefs by amending existing acts related to court fees, urban immovable property tax, and the finance act.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated to rationalize, levy, and enhance certain taxes and duties within the Province of Sindh. It amends several existing acts, including the Societies Registration Act, 1860, and the Stamp Act, 1899, to update fees and valuation procedures.

metadata.title: The Sind Fisheries (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Sind Fisheries Ordinance, 1961 to update administrative references and lease conditions. It substitutes specific wording in sections regarding district councils and fishing rights leasing, while also correcting dates in the First Schedule.

metadata.title: The Sind Goth Abad (Housing Scheme) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for housing facilities to deserving persons residing in rural areas of the Province of Sind. It establishes mechanisms for land allotment, grant of proprietary rights, and the preparation of housing schemes by the Collector.

name: SIND GOVERNMENT EDUCATIONAL AND TRAINING INSTITUTION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977

metadata.title: The Sind Government Educational and Training Institutions (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.amends: The Sind Government Educational And Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960. It specifically revises sections regarding the composition of the Board, the appointment of its Chairman and Secretary, member tenure, and the powers delegated to the Secretary.

name: SIND HISTORICAL MOSQUES AND SHRINES FUND CESS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979

metadata.title: The Sind Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: The Sind Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Historical Mosques and Shrines Fund Cess Ordinance, 1960. It specifically substitutes section 3 to alter the period for which the cess is levied.

name: SIND INDUSTRIAL TRADING ESTATE RECOVERY OF DUES ORDINANCE, 1973.

metadata.title: The Sind Industrial Trading Estate Recovery of Dues Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the recovery of dues owed to the Sind Industrial Trading Estate. It empowers the Government of Sindh to declare such dues recoverable from defaulters as if they were arrears of land-revenue, allowing recovery under the Revenue Recovery Act, 1890.

metadata.title: The Sind Katchi Abadis Ordinance, 1986
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sind Katchi Abadis Authority to oversee the development and improvement of Katchi Abadi areas. It provides for the regularization of these settlements and creates a governing body with specific powers to manage affairs, finances, and schemes related to housing and rehousing.

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Land Revenue Act, 1967 to define irrigated and un-irrigated land. It introduces exemptions from land revenue for owners of small plots and mandates enhanced revenue rates for owners of larger land holdings.

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: The Sind Abolition of Land Revenue and Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Land Revenue Act, 1967 to adjust specific figures regarding land revenue assessment. It also repeals the Sind Abolition of Land Revenue and Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1977, to restore the previous legal framework for revenue recovery.

name: SIND LAND REVENUE FIRST DRAFT ASSESSMENT LISTS (VALIDATION) ORDINANCE, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue First Draft Assessment Lists (Validation) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind Land Revenue Flat Rate Assessment Rules, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance validates the first draft assessment lists created under the Sind Land Revenue Flat Rate Assessment Rules, 1973. It deems these lists valid and legally effective even though the required public notice was not given, and nullifies any court orders challenging their validity.

metadata.title: The Sind Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Stamp Act, 1899; The Sind Cooperative Societies Act, 1925; The Sind Finance Act, 1963; The Sind Cooperative Societies and Cooperative Banks (Repayment of Loans) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends several existing financial laws in Sind to facilitate the introduction of an Islamic economy. Specifically, it updates definitions regarding interest and returns, exempts certain banking instruments from duties, and modifies provisions related to cooperative societies and finance acts.

name: SIND LOANS FOR AGRICULTURAL PURPOSES ORDINANCE, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind Loans for Agricultural Purposes Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for credit facilities to members of co-operative societies and banks in Sind specifically for agricultural purposes. It establishes mechanisms for using pass-books as title deeds, delivering agricultural produce for loan repayment, and recovering defaults through land revenue procedures.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to restrict political party activities during elections. It prohibits candidates from displaying party affiliation, seeking votes based on party manifestos, or accepting financial assistance from political parties.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1972 to update terminology and enhance public safety powers. It grants specific authorities the power to seize dangerous articles and seal premises, while also regulating utility connections for trades requiring licenses.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1986
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by omitting specific clauses and subsections from sections 21, 37, 37-A, and 51. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to address specific provisions regarding council supersession and the appointment of Advisory Committees. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to validate the levy of Rawangi Mahsool on specific commodities by District Councils in Sindh. It also validates a previous government notification regarding this tax and deems past levies as validly collected.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Fifth Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by modifying section 16. It grants the Government the power to dissolve a council at any time upon the expiry of its term and appoints an authority to perform the council's functions following such dissolution.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to update definitions and structural provisions for municipal bodies in Sindh. It introduces restrictions on political party symbols during elections and establishes specific rules regarding the composition and functions of metropolitan corporations and zonal municipal committees.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by adding a new sub-section to section 37-A. The amendment empowers the Election Authority to require a Judicial Officer of the rank of District Judge or Additional District Judge to conduct an enquiry and pass orders as deemed fit.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979, to address vacancies in the Karachi Metropolitan Corporation. It grants the Government power to appoint a person or authority to perform functions when the Mayor and members cease to hold office.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by omitting subsection (3) of section 26. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Sixth Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979. It substitutes a new provision in section 20 regarding restrictions on holding membership in multiple councils or electoral units simultaneously.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to update council composition rules and member liabilities. It specifically substitutes sections regarding council membership criteria, financial limits, and restrictions on political activities or speech by council members.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by modifying section 58 regarding council reconstitution during supersession periods. It also updates Schedule I of the said Ordinance by substituting specific figures in entry 1.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This ordinance establishes the constitution, composition, and functions of local councils in Sind. It outlines procedures for elections, local taxation, fund management, and the powers of executive officers.

name: SIND MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977

metadata.title: The Sind Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.amends: The Sind Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960. It adds a new clause to Section 3 regarding acts punishable under the Passports Act, 1974.

metadata.title: The Sind Medical Colleges Ordinance, 1987
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates admissions in medical colleges located in Sind and addresses ancillary matters such as student conduct and discipline. It empowers the Government of Sind to make rules regarding seat allocation, application forms, admission conditions, and the management of residential halls.

metadata.title: The Sindh Mining Concessions (Cancellation) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the cancellation of mining concessions granted in an irregular manner or as a political favor between January 1, 1972 and July 4, 1977. It establishes a mechanism for appointing arbitrators to determine compensation for losses sustained by concession holders due to such cancellations.

metadata.title: The Sind Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Sind Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1958 to allow tax payments in quarterly or half-yearly installments. It also introduces provisions for remitting tax on vehicles out of use and grants rebates for early tax payment.

metadata.title: The Sind Orphanages (Supervision and Control) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Board to supervise and regulate the working and control of orphanages in Sind. It provides for the constitution, functions, and powers of the Board, including the issuance and renewal of licenses for orphanages.

name: SIND PARLIAMENTARY SECRETARIES (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1987

metadata.title: The Sind Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.amends: The Sind Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Parliamentary Secretaries (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1974 to update salary figures and introduce new provisions. It grants official residence or house rent allowances, entitlements for staff and telephone charges, leave benefits, and travelling allowances for Parliamentary Secretaries.

name: SIND PEOPLE’S LOCAL GOVERNMENT (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind People's Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This ordinance further amends the Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1974. It substitutes a specific clause regarding the duties of officers and administrators until properly constituted councils assume office.

metadata.title: The Sind People's Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.amends: The Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972, to increase penalties for specific offenses. It substitutes imprisonment and higher fines in Section 100 and adds new entries regarding objectionable slogans and failure to remove notices in Schedule X.

metadata.title: The Sind People's Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.amends: The Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972, specifically regarding public safety regulations and petrol pump installations. It also validates petrol pump fees collected by the Karachi Municipal Corporation between April 16, 1960, and the date this Ordinance came into force.

metadata.title: The Sind People's Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.amends: The Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972 to redefine terms such as 'City', 'Corporation', and 'Municipality'. It provides for the conversion of existing Town Committees into Municipalities or People's Municipal Committees and establishes new Metropolitan Corporations. The document also outlines procedures for declaring urban areas and altering their limits.

metadata.title: The Sind People's Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972 by omitting the word 'People's' from its title and text. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind on January 4, 1979, pursuant to a specific proclamation.

metadata.title: The Sind Prevention of Gambling (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: The Sind Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1978 by inserting a new section 5-A. The amendment grants Police Officers of Sub-Inspector rank or higher specific powers to arrest without warrant, search persons, and seize gaming instruments and moneys suspected in connection with offences under section 5.

metadata.title: The Sindh Prevention of Gambling Ordinance, 1978
metadata.repeals: Prevention of Gambling Act, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the prevention of gambling in Sindh by re-enacting provisions previously found in the Prevention of Gambling Act, 1977. It defines terms such as 'common gaming-house' and 'gaming', prescribes penalties for owning or operating such houses, playing in public or private places, and grants specific powers to police officers.

name: SIND PRIVATE COLLEGES (MANAGEMENT AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The Sindh Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the control and management of private colleges in the province of Sindh. It establishes a Governing Body for each college to streamline administration, regulate teacher conditions, and maximize academic efficiency.

name: SIND PUBLIC PROPERTY (REMOVAL OF ENCROACHMENT) ORDINANCE, 1975

metadata.title: The Sind Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Ordinance, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures for the removal of encroachments from public property in Sindh. It empowers the government to issue orders for removing unauthorized structures, facilitates appeals and reviews, authorizes forceful eviction if necessary, and outlines penalties for non-compliance.

metadata.title: The Sind Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Public Service Commission for the Province of Sind to conduct recruitment tests and examinations. It also empowers the Government to advise on terms and conditions of service for provincial civil servants and provides for the composition, tenure, and functions of the Commission.

metadata.title: The Sind Public Service Commission Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Sind Public Service Commission Act, 1973
metadata.repeals: The Sind Public Service Commission Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals and re-enacts the Sind Public Service Commission Act, 1973 with certain modifications. It establishes the composition, appointment, terms, and conditions of service for the Chairman and Members of the Sind Public Service Commission.

metadata.title: The Sind Regional Plan Organization (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Sind Regional Plan Organization Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Regional Plan Organization Act, 1975. It substitutes the reference to the Chief Minister of Sind with the Martial Law Administrator for Zone 'C' in section 4 of the original act.

metadata.title: The Sind Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the relations between landlords and tenants to protect their interests regarding rented premises in urban areas of Sind. It establishes a Controller system, defines terms like fair rent and personal use, and sets procedures for agreements, repairs, and eviction.

metadata.title: The Sind Service Tribunals (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Sind Service Tribunals Act, 1973 to facilitate the removal of a Chairman or member due to physical or mental incapacity or misconduct. It establishes a three-person inquiry committee with civil court powers to investigate such matters and authorizes the Government to remove officials based on the committee's report.

metadata.title: The Sind Service Tribunals Ordinance, 1973
metadata.repeals: West Pakistan Ordinance XXVIII of 1969
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Service Tribunals to exercise exclusive jurisdiction over matters relating to the terms and conditions of service for civil servants in Sindh. It defines the composition of these tribunals, outlines the process for filing appeals against departmental orders, and grants the tribunals specific powers similar to civil courts.

metadata.title: The Sind Service Tribunals (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Service Tribunals Act, 1973 by inserting a new sub-section (4-A) into section 3. The amendment grants the Government authority to appoint members before the coming into force of the specific sub-section.

name: SIND SMALL INDUSTRIES AND HANDICRAFTS DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1978

metadata.title: The Sind Small Industries and Handicrafts Development Corporation (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Sind Small Industries and Handicrafts Development Corporation Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Small Industries and Handicrafts Development Corporation Act, 1972. Specifically, it substitutes the words 'at Hyderabad' for 'in Karachi' in section 3, subsection (3) of the said Act.

name: SIND SMALL INDUSTRIES AND HANDICRAFTS DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1978

metadata.title: The Sind Small Industries and Handicrafts Development Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Sind Small Industries and Handicrafts Development Corporation Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Small Industries and Handicrafts Development Corporation Act, 1972 to update the composition of the Board and related sections. It substitutes specific members in the Board, changes the title of the head from Director to Managing Director, and omits certain words regarding Provincial Assembly membership in Section 7.

name: SIND SMALL INDUSTRIES AND HANDICRAFTS DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1977

metadata.title: The Sind Small Industries And Handicrafts Development Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1977
metadata.amends: The Sind Small Industries And Handicrafts Development Corporation Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Small Industries And Handicrafts Development Corporation Act, 1972. It substitutes specific titles for officials and changes references within sections 5 and 36 of the original Act.

name: SIND SMALL INDUSTRIES AND HANDICRAFTS DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979

metadata.title: The Sind Small Industries and Handicrafts Development Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: The Sind Small Industries and Handicrafts Development Corporation Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Small Industries and Handicrafts Development Corporation Act, 1972. It omits specific words regarding handicrafts development and substitutes a higher capital amount in section 2 of the said Act.

name: SIND SMALL INDUSTRIES AND HANDICRAFTS DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The Sind Small Industries and Handicrafts Development Corporation Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Small Industries and Handicrafts Development Corporation in the Province of Sind. It is designed to take over assets from the West Pakistan Small Industries Corporation and promote small and cottage industries within the province.

metadata.title: The Sind Small Industries Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: The Sind Small Industries Corporation Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Small Industries Corporation Act, 1972 by updating specific financial figures within section 19. It substitutes the monetary limit of two lac rupees with three lac rupees and eight lac rupees with twelve lac rupees in the relevant clauses.

metadata.title: The Sind Special Tribunal (Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Special Tribunal Ordinance, 1970 to exclude specific provisions of the Code of Criminal Procedure and the Pakistan Criminal Law Amendment Act from applying to scheduled cases. It also substitutes a new Schedule listing specific First Information Reports (F.I.R.) related to corruption cases under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947.

metadata.title: The Sind Special Tribunal (Repeal) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.repeals: The Sind Special Tribunal Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of Sind and Martial Law Administrator to repeal the Sind Special Tribunal Ordinance, 1970. It ensures that pending cases before the special tribunal are transferred to the Court of Special Judge for disposal as if originally instituted there.

metadata.title: The Sindh Special Tribunal Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a Special Tribunal in Sindh to try specific scheduled cases, particularly those involving anti-corruption. It outlines the tribunal's constitution, powers, procedures, and restrictions on adjournments to ensure swift justice.

metadata.title: The Sindh Textbook Board Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Textbook Board as a body corporate to manage the production and publication of textbooks for schools and colleges in the Province of Sindh. It defines the board's constitution, powers, duties, and the qualifications and removal procedures for its Chairman and members.

metadata.title: The Sind Universities (Amendment) Ordinance, 1976
metadata.amends: University of Sind Act, 1972 and the University of Karachi Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of Sind Act, 1972 and the University of Karachi Act, 1972 to update administrative titles and structures. It introduces new roles such as Pro-Vice-Chancellor, modifies financial officer designations, and establishes provisions for managing additional campuses.

metadata.title: The Sind University of Sind (Amendment) Ordinance, 1988
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of Sind Act, 1972 by modifying section 40-A. Specifically, it omits a comma and certain words regarding teacher age limits within clause (ii) of that section.

name: SIND URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1978

metadata.title: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 by inserting a new section 7-A. The inserted provision ensures that existing valuation lists for properties (excluding industrial ones) as of June 30, 1978, remain in force until new lists are enforced or December 31, 1979.

name: SIND URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979

metadata.title: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to continue existing valuation lists for non-industrial properties until new lists are enforced or December 31, 1979. It also specifies that annual value determinations must follow provisions as they stood before July 1, 1977, and adds a sub-section stating amendments take effect from the date of necessity.

name: SIND URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1980

metadata.title: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1980
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 by substituting specific figures in section 3-A and omitting certain words in section 7-A. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind on March 5, 1980, to take effect immediately.

name: SIND URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1987

metadata.title: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1987
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to address valuation lists for industrial properties. It specifically modifies sections 7-A and 8-A of the said Act to validate lists prepared on January 1, 1977, within the Karachi Division limits.

name: SIND URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.amends: The Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This ordinance further amends the Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to update betterment tax scales for commercial and industrial properties. It specifically substitutes subsections (3-A) and (3-B) of section 3 in the parent act with new provisions regarding tax rates and exemptions based on land area.

metadata.title: The Sind Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the proper management and administration of Waqf Properties in the Province of Sind. It establishes the appointment of a Chief Administrator and Deputy Administrators to oversee these properties, defines waqf property, and outlines powers regarding eviction, lease termination, and income application.

metadata.title: The Sind Wild-life Protection Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law regarding the preservation, conservation, and management of wildlife in Sind. It establishes a Sindh Wild-life Management Board to oversee these activities and defines specific terms related to wild animals, game reserves, and hunting restrictions.

metadata.title: The Sind Wild-Life Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Wild-Life Protection Ordinance, 1972 to substitute the words 'Governor of Sind' with 'Chief Minister of Sind' in section 4, subsection (4). It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind under the Interim Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: SIND WILD-LIFE PROTECTION SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1972

metadata.title: The Sind Wild-life Protection (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Wild-life Protection Ordinance, 1972 by substituting the penalty amount in section 33 from five hundred to one thousand and five hundred. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under the Interim Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sind Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972. Specifically, it inserts a provision regarding the person exercising powers in the absence of the Chief Minister into section 4.

metadata.title: The Sind (Amendment of Laws) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.amends: certain laws applicable to the Province of Sind
metadata.repeals: The Bombay Mamlatdars' Courts Act, 1906 (in its application to Khairpur District)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends various central acts and local laws applicable to the Province of Sind. It primarily substitutes references to the 'Commissioner' or 'Revenue Commissioner' with the 'Provincial Government' or 'Board of Revenue' across multiple statutes.

name: SINDH (ERADICATION AND CURBING THE MENACE OF INVOLUNTARY DONATION OF FORCED CHANDA) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Sindh (Eradication and Curbing the Menace of Involuntary Donation of Forced Chanda) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance aims to eradicate and curb the menace of involuntary donations or forced 'Chanda' within the Province of Sindh. It prohibits the collection of funds at a donor's doorstep and mandates that any illegally collected funds be forfeited to the Government.

metadata.title: The Sindh (Poultry Vaccine Centre) Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Poultry Vaccine Centre as a body corporate to promote vaccine production and scientific research. It defines the constitution, administration, and functions of the Centre and its Board.

name: SINDH (PROHIBITION OF TAKING MINERALS INCLUDING RETI (SAND) AND BAJRI FROM ANY LAND) ORDINANCE, 2003

metadata.title: The Sindh (Prohibition of Taking Minerals Including Reti (Sand) and Bajri from Any Land) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the taking of minerals, specifically reti (sand) and bajri, from any land in the Province of Sindh through excavation or other means. It establishes penalties for violations, including imprisonment and fines for first and subsequent convictions, and outlines procedures for cognizance of offences and rule-making.

name: SINDH (REPEAL OF THE POLICE ORDER, 2002 AND REVIVAL OF THE POLICE ACT, 1861) ORDINANCE, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh (Repeal of the Police Order, 2002 and Revival of the Police Act, 1861) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.repeals: The Police Order, 2002 (Chief Executive's Order No.XXII of 2002)
metadata.summary: This Ordinance revives the Police Act, 1861 as it stood on August 13, 2002, treating it as if it had never been repealed. Simultaneously, it repeals the Police Order, 2002 (Chief Executive's Order No.XXII of 2002) to the extent of its application to the Province of Sindh with immediate effect.

name: SINDH (REPEAL OF THE SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ORDINANCE, 2001 AND REVIVAL OF THE SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ORDINANCE, 1979) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh (Repeal of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 and Revival of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.amends: The Sindh (Repeal of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 and Revival of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979) Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh (Repeal of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 and Revival of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979) Act, 2011 to promote peace and harmony in the Province of Sindh. It specifically modifies section 3 of the amended Act to limit the repeal of the 2001 Ordinance regarding Karachi and Hyderabad Districts.

name: SINDH (REPEAL OF THE SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ORDINANCE, 2001 AND REVIVAL OF THE SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ORDINANCE, 1979) ORDINANCE, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh (Repeal of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 and Revival of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This ordinance repeals the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 and revives the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979 as it stood on August 5, 2001. It was promulgated by the Governor under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: SINDH (REPEAL OF THE SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ORDINANCE, 2001 AND REVIVAL OF THE SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ORDINANCE, 1979) (SINDH ACT NO.XXIV OF 2011), ORDINANCE, 2011

metadata.title: The Repeal of the Sindh (Repeal of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 and Revival of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979) Act, 2011
metadata.amends: The Repeal of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 and Revival of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979 Act, 2011
metadata.repeals: The Repeal of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 and Revival of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979 Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance repeals the Sindh (Repeal of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 and Revival of the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979) Act, 2011. It simultaneously revives the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 as if it had never been repealed.

name: SINDH (TEACHING, PROMOTION AND USE OF SINDHI LANGUAGE) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1990

metadata.title: The Sindh (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1990
metadata.amends: The Sind (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Sind (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) Act, 1972. It substitutes specific words in sections 5 and 7 regarding Academies and Boards with an Authority.

metadata.title: The Sindh (Textile Institute of Pakistan) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Textile Institute of Pakistan in Karachi to provide instruction in textile sciences and related fields. It defines the institute's powers, including admitting students, prescribing courses, holding examinations, and awarding academic distinctions.

metadata.title: The Sindh (Textile Institute of Pakistan) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Textile Institute of Pakistan in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It outlines the institute's powers to conduct textile science education, award degrees, and manage its affairs under the general control of the Government of Sindh.

metadata.title: The Sindh (Textile Institute of Pakistan) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Textile Institute of Pakistan in the Province of Sindh to provide instruction in textile sciences and related fields. It defines the institute's powers, including admitting students, prescribing courses, holding examinations, and awarding degrees, while ensuring the body is open to all persons regardless of sex, religion, or race.

metadata.title: The Sindh Abkari (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Abkari Act, 1878 to add a new clause regarding Methanol. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh on October 31, 2002, following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

name: SINDH ADHOC PUBLIC ACCOUNTS COMMITTEE (COMPOSITION AND FUNCTIONS) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Sindh Adhoc Public Accounts Committee (Composition and Functions) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the constitution of an Adhoc Public Accounts Committee in the Province of Sindh. It outlines the committee's composition, terms of office, procedures, and functions regarding the examination of government accounts and Auditor-General reports.

name: SINDH AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX (AMENDMENT) AMENDING ORDINANCE, 2000

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Amending Ordinance, 2000
metadata.amends: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000 to adjust the effective date of certain provisions. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh because the Provincial Assembly was suspended at the time.

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1996
metadata.amends: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994 to update definitions regarding cropped areas and tax years. It establishes new tax rates based on land holding size and area type (barage, non-barage, barani, orchards) while introducing specific penalties for failure to declare crops or conceal information.

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.amends: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994 to update definitions regarding cropped area and tax years. It substitutes sections on tax levy rates, penalties for failure to furnish declarations or comply with notices, and provisions for concealed cropped areas.

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999
metadata.amends: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994 to update definitions regarding cropped areas and tax years. It substitutes sections on tax levy rates, penalties for failure to furnish declarations or comply with notices, and provisions for concealed cropped areas.

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999
metadata.amends: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994 to update definitions of cropped area and tax year, adjust tax rates based on crop type and land holding size, and introduce new penalties for non-compliance. It also changes the basis of tax assessment from cropped area to net income effective August 1, 1999.

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.amends: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994 to update definitions regarding cropped areas and declarations. It also revises tax levies based on irrigated and un-irrigated land types and introduces new penalties for failing to furnish declarations or concealing cropped areas.

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the imposition of tax on income derived from agricultural land situated in the Province of Sindh. It establishes the rates of tax, procedures for assessment and collection by the Collector, and includes provisions for exemptions, appeals, and rule-making powers.

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Produce Markets (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.amends: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994 to update definitions regarding cropped area and tax years. It substitutes sections on tax levy rates, penalties for failure to furnish declarations or comply with notices, and provisions for concealed cropped areas.

metadata.title: The Sind Agricultural Supplies Organization (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.amends: The Sind Agricultural Supplies Organization Act, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Agricultural Supplies Organization Act, 1973 by substituting specific words in sections 5, 15, and 20. The amendment replaces the term 'Operational Director' with 'Managing Director' within those sections.

metadata.title: The Sindh Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 2004
metadata.amends: The Sind Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963
metadata.summary: This document is an Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of Sindh to amend the Sind Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963. It was issued because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary under Article 128 of the Constitution.

metadata.title: The Sindh Archives Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the acquisition, custody, and preservation of public records and archival materials of historical and national significance to the Province of Sindh. It establishes the management structure involving a Director and an Advisory Board to oversee these responsibilities.

name: SINDH ARID ZONE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998

metadata.title: The Sindh Arid Zone Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.amends: The Sind Arid Zone Development Authority Act, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Arid Zone Development Authority Act, 1985 to introduce a Vice Chairman position and define their powers. It specifies that the Vice Chairman must be a member of the Provincial Assembly and clarifies that the office is not a whole-time remunerated position.

metadata.title: The Sindh Bank Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Bank to provide commercial and investment banking services within the Province of Sindh. It defines the bank's structure, including its share capital, board composition, and shareholder qualifications.

name: SINDH BOARD OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Sindh Board of Technical Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: The Sindh Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Board of Technical Education Ordinance, 1970. It specifically substitutes section 10 to designate the Governor of Sindh as the Controlling Authority of the Board.

name: SINDH BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2004

metadata.title: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Ordinance, 2004
metadata.amends: The Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972 to include a new Board in Mirpurkhas. It substitutes references to Hyderabad with combined references to Hyderabad and Mirpurkhas throughout the relevant sections and schedule.

metadata.title: The Sindh Buildings Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1990
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979 by adding new provisions regarding the suspension or cancellation of no objection certificates. It empowers the Government to suspend such certificates if construction is deemed not in the public interest before a building's completion.

metadata.title: The Sindh Buildings Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979 to address specific provisions regarding building works. It modifies section 19 of the parent ordinance by changing punctuation and adding a proviso that prevents the compounding of offences related to building works commenced or carried out in violation of approved plans.

metadata.title: The Sindh Buildings Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979 by modifying section 19 to prevent the compounding of offences related to building works carried out in violation of approved plans. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Buildings Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979 to provide mechanisms for compounding offences related to building works. It introduces specific conditions and enhanced fees for compounding violations regarding approved plans, hazardous activities, parking space misuse, and deviations in footprints or open spaces.

metadata.title: The Sindh Buildings Control (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1990
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979 to allow the Government to suspend or cancel no objection certificates if construction is deemed not in the public interest. It also defines 'completion of building' for these purposes and mandates re-processing of matters where such orders are passed.

metadata.title: The Sindh Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation of town planning, construction quality, and building control in the Province of Sindh. It also covers the pricing and publicity regarding the disposal of buildings and plots by builders and societies, as well as the demolition of dangerous structures.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 to alter jurisdictional limits and monetary thresholds for civil suits. It substitutes specific sections regarding the original jurisdiction of District Judges and High Courts in Karachi, as well as updating financial limits in other relevant sections.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 by substituting a specific monetary limit in section 13. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Courts (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 to alter the original and appellate pecuniary jurisdiction of District Judges. It specifically increases the monetary limit for civil suits from five lacs to thirty lacs of rupees and transfers pending matters within this new limit from the High Court to the concerned District Judge.

name: SINDH CIVIL SERVANT (ASSESSMENT OF SUITABILITY OF APPOINTMENTS) (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Assessment of Suitability of Appointment) (Repeal) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Civil Servants (Assessment of Suitability of Appointments) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh to repeal the Sindh Civil Servants (Assessment of Suitability of Appointments) Ordinance, 2001. It was issued under the authority of the Proclamation of October 14, 1999, due to the suspension of the provincial Assembly.

name: SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (REGULARIZATION OF ABSORPTION) ORDINANCE, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Regularization of Absorption) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regularization of services for certain employees who were absorbed as civil servants in various departments of the Government of Sindh. It deems these employees to have been validly absorbed on a regular basis from the date of their original absorption and grants them seniority benefits based on their equivalent posts held prior to absorption.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973 by substituting specific wording in section 5 regarding appointment percentages. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh on June 26, 2001, following the dissolution of the provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973 by inserting a new section regarding exceptional performance. It allows for out-of-turn promotions or awards to be granted to civil servants who prove gallantry or exhibit very exceptional performance beyond their call of duty.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973 to clarify definitions regarding absorption and deputation. It grants the Chief Minister powers to award out-of-turn promotions for gallantry or exceptional performance and establishes new rules for appointing personnel on deputation or absorption into provincial civil service cadres.

name: SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (ASSESSMENT OF SUITABILITY OF APPOINTMENTS) ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Assessment of Suitability of Appointments) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the assessment of suitability for persons appointed to specified posts without reference to the Sindh Public Service Commission or those transferred who were not eligible under existing rules. It mandates that individuals appointed between 1985 and 1997 must appear before the Commission for interviews and tests upon the Ordinance's commencement, with provisions for immediate termination if they fail to comply or are found unsuitable.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973 by substituting the word 'twenty' for 'twenty-five' in section 13(i). It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh on December 8, 2001, following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973 by inserting new sections regarding indemnity for civil servants acting in good faith. It also bars legal proceedings against orders made or taken under the Act by the Governor or authorized officers.

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973 to further regulate promotions and awards for civil servants exhibiting gallantry or exceptional performance. It substitutes section 9-A of the parent Act with new provisions regarding out-of-turn promotions and deems previous such promotions as regular.

name: SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 2005

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants Housing Foundation Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Civil Servants Housing Foundation to provide houses on a no-profit, no-loss basis. It applies to civil servants and retired civil servants in the Province of Sindh.

metadata.title: The Sindh Coal Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Coal Authority Act, 1994 to update the composition of its members. It substitutes specific clauses in section 7 regarding nominations by the Assembly and appointments by the Government.

metadata.title: The Sindh Coal Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Coal Authority Act, 1993 by substituting specific words within sections 7 and 10. It replaces the word 'Industries' with 'Mines' in section 7 and substitutes 'Government' with 'Authority' in section 10.

metadata.title: The Sindh Coal Authority Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Coal Authority as a body corporate to manage coal-related activities in the Province of Sindh. It outlines the Authority's functions, including planning, promoting, and implementing projects for exploration, development, exploitation, mining, processing, and utilization of coal resources.

metadata.title: The Sindh Coal Authority Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Coal Authority to oversee the exploration, development, processing, exploitation, mining, and utilization of coal in the Province of Sindh. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with powers to acquire property, formulate schemes, and promote joint ventures for coal resource development.

metadata.title: The Sindh Coal Authority Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Coal Authority as a body corporate to manage coal-related activities in the Province of Sindh. It outlines the Authority's functions, including planning, promoting, and implementing projects for exploration, development, exploitation, mining, processing, and utilization of coal resources.

metadata.title: The Sindh Cotton Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966, to update terminology regarding cotton grading and adjust timeframes for compliance. It substitutes specific words in sections of the original ordinance to reflect changes in standards and reporting periods.

metadata.title: The Sindh Cotton Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966 to regulate the transportation and handling of cotton. It introduces new requirements for ginning factories regarding machinery, storage platforms, and staff training, while also prohibiting the use of non-cotton bags or twine for picking and storing cotton.

metadata.title: The Sindh Cotton Control (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Sindh Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966 to update definitions regarding cotton bales and factory owners. It introduces new conditions for licenses related to machinery maintenance and facility standards while modifying various sections of the parent ordinance.

name: SINDH CRIMINAL PROSECUTION SERVICE (CONSTITUTION, FUNCTIONS AND POWERS) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.amends: The Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Criminal Prosecution Service (Constitution, Functions and Powers) Act, 2009. It specifically substitutes a provision regarding the term of office for the Prosecutor General.

metadata.title: The Sindh Development Authorities Laws (Repeal) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.repeals: The Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957; The Hyderabad Development Authority Act, 1976; The Sehwan Development Authority Act, 1993; The Lyari Development Authority Act, 1993; The Malir Development Authority Act, 1993; The Larkana Development Authority Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh to repeal various enactments relating to Development Authorities in the province. It came into force on July 1, 2002, following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

name: SINDH DISPOSAL OF URBAN LAND (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 2005

metadata.title: The Sindh Disposal of Urban Land (Repeal) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Disposal of Urban Land Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh to immediately repeal the Sindh Disposal of Urban Land Ordinance, 2002. It was issued under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: SINDH DISPOSAL OF URBAN LAND ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Sindh Disposal of Urban Land Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the disposal of urban land within the Province of Sindh. It establishes procedures for public auctions, defines various types of plots, and sets rules regarding reserve prices and agreements with government authorities.

name: SINDH DOW UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2004

metadata.title: The Sindh Dow University of Health Sciences (Amendment) Ordinance, 2004
metadata.amends: Dow University of Health Sciences Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Dow University of Health Sciences Ordinance, 2003 to update its provisions regarding jurisdiction, officers, and faculty composition. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Education Foundation Ordinance, 1992
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Education Foundation to promote and develop education within the Province of Sindh.
