It provides for the foundation's corporate status, management structure including a Board and Managing Director, and outlines its aims such as expanding educational facilities.

metadata.title: The Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.amends: The Sind Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1990
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986 to mandate an additional special allowance of two hundred rupees per month for employees. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1995
metadata.amends: The Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986 to introduce an additional special allowance. The new provision mandates that every employee employed on or after May 1, 1995, shall receive an extra payment of one hundred rupees per month.

metadata.title: The Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Ordinance, 1990
metadata.amends: The Sind Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Employees Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986 to introduce an additional special allowance for employees. It specifies payment rates based on wage levels and provides conditions for setting off this allowance against cost-of-living relief payments.

metadata.title: The Sindh Enquiries and Anti-Corruption Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a special agency known as the Enquiries and Anti-Corruption Establishment to investigate corruption offences and misconduct by public servants in Sindh. It defines the powers of the Chairman, Directors, and officers, including search, arrest, and seizure capabilities similar to police officers.

metadata.title: The Sindh Entertainments Duty (Amendment) Ordinance, 1992
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Entertainments Duty Act, 1958 to adjust specific monetary values and add references to foreign country cinema owners and film exhibitors. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: SINDH ESSENTIAL COMMODITIES PRICE CONTROL AND PREVENTION OF PROFITEERING AND HOARDING ORDINANCE, 2005

metadata.title: The Sindh Essential Commodities Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the price control and prevention of profiteering and hoarding on essential commodities in Sindh. It empowers the Government to make orders regulating prices, production, movement, and distribution of these commodities.

metadata.title: The Sindh Eye Surgery (Restriction) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prevents persons who are not registered medical practitioners from performing eye surgeries. It defines specific terms such as complete blindness, partial blindness, and eye surgery, while establishing penalties for unauthorized practice or holding oneself out as an eye surgeon.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.amends: Sind Finance Act, 1964 and the Sind Finance Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Finance Act, 1964 and the Sind Finance Act, 1975 to introduce new surcharges on cess and fees. The amendments are intended to fund expenses related to water supply and drainage schemes undertaken by local councils.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1995
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Finance Act, 1964 to update financial provisions within Section 12. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Finance Act, 1994 to levy a cess for the special maintenance and development of infrastructure. The proceeds are intended to support the smooth and safer movement of goods entering or leaving the province via air or sea.

metadata.title: The Sindh Finance (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Finance Act, 1994 to introduce a new cess for infrastructure maintenance and development on goods transported by road, air, or sea. It also adds specific definitions regarding the value of goods and restricts refunds for over-paid cess claims unless made within three months.

metadata.title: The Sindh Financial Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance aims to rationalize and abolish certain taxes and fees within the Province of Sindh. It achieves this by amending specific sections and schedules of existing acts related to urban immovable property tax, motor vehicles taxation, and finance acts.

metadata.title: The Sindh Fisheries (Amendment) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Fisheries Ordinance, 1980 to update definitions and penalties. It specifically adds a new clause defining 'net' and substitutes provisions in section 21 to establish imprisonment terms and fines for contraventions of specific sections.

metadata.title: The Sindh Fisheries Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and consolidates the law relating to fisheries in the Province of Sindh. It establishes regulations regarding fishing permits, prohibited gear, fish sanctuaries, marketing practices, and penalties for illegal activities.

metadata.title: The Sindh General Clauses (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Sindh General Clauses Act, 1956 by inserting a new section 19-A. The amendment mandates that all rules, notifications, orders, regulations, and circulars having the effect of law must be published in the official Gazette.

name: SINDH GENERAL PROVIDENT INVESTMENT FUND ORDINANCE, 2008

metadata.title: The Sindh General Provident Investment Fund Ordinance, 2008
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh General Provident Investment Fund to manage investments for government employees. It outlines the constitution of a Board, rules for fund maintenance and withdrawal, and provisions for annual auditing and reporting.

name: Sindh Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960

metadata.title: The Sindh Government Educational and Training Institutions Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes Boards of Governors to manage and control educational and training institutions in Sindh. It defines the composition, powers, and functions of these boards, including authority over property, staff recruitment, and financial administration.

name: SINDH GOVERNMENT LAND (CANCELLATION OF ALLOTMENTS, CONVERSIONS AND EXCHANGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Sindh Government Land (Cancellation of Allotments, Conversions and Exchanges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: The Sindh Government Land (Cancellation of Allotments, Conversions and Exchanges) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Government Land (Cancellation of Allotments, Conversions and Exchanges) Ordinance, 2001. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh due to the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

name: SINDH GOVERNMENT SERVANTS BENEVOLENT FUND (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2008

metadata.title: The Sind Government Servants Benevolent Fund (Amendment) Ordinance, 2008
metadata.amends: The Sind Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Government Servants Benevolent Fund Ordinance, 1960. It substitutes the word 'District' for 'Divisional' and 'Division' in section 6 of the original Act.

name: SINDH HEALTH INSTITUTIONS (ESTABLISHMENT AND MANGEMENT) ORDINANCE, 2005

metadata.title: The Sindh Health Institutions (Establishment and Management) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the establishment and management of health institutions in the Province of Sindh, granting them autonomy to deliver quality healthcare. It establishes a Board of Governors as the principal governing body with powers to appoint officers, manage funds, and oversee operations.

name: SINDH HIGH DENSITY DEVELOPMENT BOARD (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh High Density Development Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.amends: The Sindh High Density Development Board Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh High Density Development Board Act, 2010 to update the composition of the Board. It substitutes Section 3 of the original Act with new provisions detailing the members of the Board, including the Chief Minister, Ministers, and other officials.

name: SINDH HIV AND AIDS CONTROL TREATMENT AND PROTECTION ORDINANCE, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh HIV and AIDS Control Treatment and Protection Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance aims to control the transmission and spread of HIV within the Province of Sindh. It also provides measures for the treatment, care, and support of people living with HIV and AIDS.

name: SINDH INFORMATION OF TEMPORARY RESIDENTS ORDINANCE 2015

metadata.title: The Sindh Information of Temporary Residents Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a legal framework for sharing information regarding tenants and other temporary residents with the police in the Province of Sindh. It mandates that landlords, property dealers, and hotel managers provide specific details about occupants to the police within set timeframes to help combat terrorism and other crimes.

metadata.title: The Sindh Information Technology Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 2004
metadata.amends: The Sindh Information Technology Board Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Information Technology Board Ordinance, 2002 to update definitions and board composition. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Information Technology Board Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Information Technology Board as a corporate body within the Province of Sindh. It outlines the Board's constitution, functions, powers, and the procedures for its meetings and operations.

name: SINDH INSTITUTE OF UROLOGY AND TRANSPLANTATION ORDINANCE, 1990

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation Ordinance, 1990
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation by reconstituting and re-organizing the Urology Department of the Dow Medical College and Civil Hospital Karachi. It defines the Institute as a body corporate with perpetual succession and outlines its functions, which include treatment, research, teaching, and staff training in urology and transplantation.

name: SINDH INSTITUTE OF UROLOGY AND TRANSPLANTATION ORDINANCE, 1990

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation Ordinance, 1990
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation by reconstituting the Urology Department of Dow Medical College. It defines the Institute's functions, which include treatment, research, teaching, and staff training, while establishing a Board of Governors to administer its affairs.

metadata.title: The Sind Irrigation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Irrigation Act, 1879 by adding a new section to allow the government to levy drainage rates on cultivated land with specific facilities. It also provides for the recovery of such amounts as arrears of land revenue and includes provisions regarding exemptions for the first two seasonal crops after facility availability.

metadata.title: The Sindh Irrigation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Irrigation Act, 1879 to adjust time limits and monetary penalties related to irrigation water distribution. It also declares certain specific orders granting water through canals as abrogated and annulled without compensation.

metadata.title: The Sindh Irrigation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Irrigation Act, 1879 by increasing fines and extending time limits for certain provisions. It also designates offences under specific sections of the said Act as non-bailable.

metadata.title: The Sindh Irrigation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Irrigation Act, 1879 to allow the government to resume natural or artificial depression courses used for flood and rain water discharge. It mandates that any person in possession of such land must vacate within seven days of the Ordinance's commencement.

name: SINDH IRRIGATION AND DRAINAGE AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: The Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority Act, 1997 to update the composition of farmer representatives and modify specific clauses regarding bye-laws. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh due to the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

name: SINDH IRRIGATION AND DRAINAGE AUTHORITY ORDINANCE, 1997

metadata.title: The Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority Ordinance, 1997
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority as a body corporate to manage irrigation water distribution and drainage systems in the Province of Sindh. It provides for the constitution of the Authority, its powers and duties, financial management, and the establishment of Area Water Boards to facilitate beneficiary participation.

metadata.title: The Sindh Judicial Academy Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Judicial Academy as a body corporate with headquarters in Karachi. It defines the functions of the Academy, which include training members of the subordinate judiciary, conducting legal research, and organizing seminars. The document also constitutes a Board to oversee the Academy's administration and outlines its powers.

metadata.title: The Sindh Land Revenue (Abolition) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance abolishes land revenue in the Province of Sindh effective immediately. It defines key terms such as 'Act' and 'land revenue' while clarifying that liabilities for periods before Kharif 1999-2000 remain unaffected.

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Land Revenue Act, 1967 by adding a new clause to section 56. The amendment specifically addresses land on which ushr or contribution in lieu thereof has been charged according to the Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 1980.

metadata.title: The Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Land Revenue Act, 1967 to promote peace and harmony within the Province of Sindh. It specifically modifies section 9 of the parent Act by adding a proviso that excludes the Districts of Hyderabad and Karachi from its application.

metadata.title: The Sindh Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Land Revenue Act, 1967 to update terminology and administrative nomenclature within Sindh. It substitutes specific words such as 'Sind' with 'Sindh' and revives original terms like 'Division' and 'Sub-Division'. The document also revises sections regarding revenue officers, their appointments, and the division of the province into administrative units.

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Land Revenue Act, 1967 to adjust land revenue assessment rates for various categories of land owners. It substitutes specific acreage limits and percentage rates in sections 56-A and 70-A of the said Act.

name: SINDH LAND TAX AND AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax Ordinance, 2000. It introduces new definitions for District Officer, modifies clauses regarding land ownership, adds specific deductions for agricultural expenditures, and renumbers existing sections to include provisions for filing statements by owners holding multiple lands.

name: SINDH LAND TAX AND AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: The Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax Ordinance, 2000. It specifically substitutes figures with new values in the First Schedule under the exemption heading.

name: SINDH LAND TAX AND AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: The Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Land Tax and Agricultural Income Tax Ordinance, 2000. It specifically substitutes a clause in the First Schedule to update tax rates for matured orchards involving banana and betal leaf cultivation.

name: SINDH LAND TAX AND AGRICULTURAL INCOME TAX ORDINANCE, 2000

metadata.title: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Ordinance, 2000
metadata.amends: The Sindh Agricultural Income Tax Act, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the imposition of tax on income derived from agricultural land and its produce in the province of Sindh. It was promulgated to revise provisions of the previous Act, 1994, due to the suspension of the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The Sindh Laws (Amending and Repealing) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.repeals: The Sind Criminal Procedure (Elections Offences) (Amendment) Act, 1935; The Sind Agriculturists Relief (Amendment) Act, 1943; The Sind Abkari (Amendment) Act, 1943; The Sind Provincial Collection Taxes Act, 1948; The West Pakistan Drugs (Extension) Act, 1958; The Cinematograph (Sind Amendment) Act, 1958; The West Pakistan (Agricultural Development Finance Corporation) (Recovery of Arrears) Act, 1958; The West Pakistan Graveyard (Preservation and Maintenance) Act, 1958; The Prevention of Corruption Act (West Pakistan Extension) Ordinance, 1958; The Cinematograph (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1959
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends and repeals certain laws in force in the Province of Sindh that are considered spent, unnecessary, or no longer in force. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to establish the Karachi Water and Sewerage Board. It defines the board's constitution, including its members and officers, and outlines the specific powers and functions regarding water supply, sewerage services, and financial management.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by inserting a new sub-section into section 58. It allows the government to extend the period mentioned in that section via notification, with a maximum extension of six months.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1992
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to extend the period of supersession for certain councils and modify section 58 regarding the extension of specific periods. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by adding a new clause to Section 62 regarding tax exemptions. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to update references regarding union councils and deh panchayats. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to update references regarding district governments and modify provisions related to fund allocation and property tax rates. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh on September 26, 2001, following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to update various sections regarding definitions, schedules, and officer appointments. It introduces changes to the powers of Zila Nazims, modifies recall procedures, and adjusts references to other ordinances within the text.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to update various sections regarding definitions, schedules, and officer appointments. It introduces new clauses concerning misconduct, modifies recall procedures for Zila Nazims, and adjusts provisions related to Union Council functions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Eight Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to address various administrative and financial provisions. It includes changes to fund names, budget approval procedures, account keeping methods, and specific section substitutions within the parent Ordinance.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Fifth Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to regulate dual membership for Nazims and other local government officials. It substitutes section 158 to specify conditions under which a Nazim may contest another political office after resigning, while allowing council members to contest without resigning provided they do not hold more than one office simultaneously.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Fifth Amendment) Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to update provisions regarding elections following the dissolution of local governments. It specifically substitutes subsection (5) of section 179-A to clarify the government's role in requesting election dates from the Chief Election Commissioner after new laws are enacted.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001, to insert specific text into section 111 and modify the Second Schedule. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979. Specifically, it substitutes text in section 39 regarding how certain matters are dealt with and tried.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001, specifically altering time limits in section 179-A. It substitutes 'four months' for 'seventy five days' and 'nine months' for '165 days' within subsection (5) of that section.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Ninth Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to regulate internal recall motions for Nazims. It specifically prohibits moving such motions against Taluka, Town, or Union Nazims before December 31, 2002, and against Zila Nazims before June 30, 2003.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to update terminology and procedural rules. It introduces specific changes regarding budget allocations for the fiscal year 2001-2002, dispute settlement mechanisms involving Musalihat Anjuman, and election timelines.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to update qualifications and disqualifications for council members. It introduces a bar on contesting elections based on political party affiliation and modifies provisions regarding member removal.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by adding specific wording to section 45 regarding leasing rights for tax collection. It validates contracts entered into on or after January 1, 1991, that lease out tax collection rights without an auction, even if contrary to existing rules.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to update definitions, modify specific sections regarding audit and cattle markets, and adjust financial provisions. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh due to the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to update references to other laws and modify administrative provisions. It introduces new definitions for misconduct, adjusts schedules, and alters sections regarding district creation, union council functions, and the powers of the Zila Nazim.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Act amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to regulate elections on a party basis and introduce provisions for the dissolution of local governments. It establishes procedures for appointing civil servants as administrators following dissolution and mandates the holding of new elections within a specific timeframe.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 to address specific administrative and electoral changes. It includes provisions for omitting certain clauses, adding restrictions on jurisdiction, modifying union committee compositions, and updating election candidate eligibility rules.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Seventh Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001. It specifically substitutes time limits in Section 156 regarding administrative actions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Sixth Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 by substituting the word 'four' for 'three' in section 159. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh on October 8, 2002, following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 to update member numbers and clarify minority community representation formulas. It substitutes specific figures in Section 14 and Schedule I of the original ordinance.

metadata.title: Sindh Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 1996
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Local Government Ordinance, 1979 by inserting specific words into section 33. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to address administrative definitions and powers. It substitutes various sections regarding disaster management, mal-administration, and financial allocations while inserting new provisions for Town Municipal Administrations.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to update terminology and schedules following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly. It substitutes specific words in sections regarding district governance and modifies provisions related to forest management and rule schedules.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to add specific provisions regarding local governments and councils. It establishes timelines for requesting elections after dissolution and mandates that elections be conducted under this amendment if no new law is passed.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013 to update definitions regarding political parties and modify provisions related to delimitation and election processes. It introduces new sections concerning reserved seats for women, peasants, laborers, and non-Muslims, including rules for filling vacancies and managing candidate lists.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for holding elections to establish local governments in the Sindh Province. It defines key terms such as 'local area', 'Nazim', and 'union', and outlines the constitution of various local government bodies including Zila councils and Union councils.

name: SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government Elections (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000 to further regulate local government elections in Sindh. It introduces changes regarding reserved seats for minorities and women, mandates non-party basis elections, and establishes disqualification rules for candidates using political resources.

name: SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government Elections (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000. It adds a specific explanation to section 19 regarding the definition of a holder of an elective office.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government Elections (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.amends: The Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000 to update definitions regarding population census villages and adjust seat allocation rules. It specifically adds provisions for minimum worker representation in certain sections and substitutes clauses related to special minority seats and union council member elections.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government Elections (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000 by adding an explanation to section 10. The amendment stipulates that union council members notified as returned candidates under this Ordinance are deemed to be members of the electoral college.

name: SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (FOURTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government Elections (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000 to provide specific procedures for filling vacant seats through by-elections. It establishes timelines for electing new members for various council positions and outlines rules for appointing officiating Nazims when a seat remains unfilled.

name: SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government Elections (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.amends: The Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000 to address procedures for filling casual vacancies in council seats and Nazim offices. It also grants the Chief Election Commissioner powers to punish for contempt of court similar to those of a High Court Judge.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This ordinance establishes the framework for local governments in the province of Sindh, defining their composition, functions, and powers across various administrative levels. It outlines the structure for District, Taluka, Town, Union, Village, and Neighborhood councils, along with provisions for finance, property ownership, and dispute resolution mechanisms.

metadata.title: The Sindh Mental Health Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates matters relating to the care, treatment, and property management of mentally disordered persons in Sindh. It establishes the Sindh Mental Health Authority and provisions for community care, admission procedures, and judicial proceedings.

name: SINDH MINISTER (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983

metadata.title: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.amends: The Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to update financial provisions for ministers. It introduces new sections regarding equipment allowances, discretionary grants, telephone facilities, leave salary, and official residences.

name: SINDH MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996

metadata.title: The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1996
metadata.amends: The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 by inserting a new section regarding tax exemptions for the Chief Minister. Specifically, it exempts one Mercedes Benz 280 SEL or equivalent car from custom duties or sales tax when imported or purchased out of bond for the Chief Minister's personal use.

name: SINDH MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to update specific monetary figures regarding ministerial salaries and allowances. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh on July 15, 2002, following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The Sindh Motion Pictures Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the censorship of films and the regulation of their exhibition by means of cinematographs within the Province of Sindh. It establishes a Board to examine and certify films for public exhibition, outlines procedures for certification including excisions or refusal, and sets penalties for unauthorized exhibitions.

metadata.title: The Sind People's Local Government Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance consolidates and amends the law relating to local government in the Province of Sind. It also provides for the constitution of People's Local Councils within that province.

metadata.title: The Sindh Peoples Local Government Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This ordinance establishes the framework for local governance in Sindh, defining the composition and functions of various administrative bodies. It outlines the structure for Metropolitan Corporations, District Councils, Taluka Municipal Administrations, Union Councils, and Village/Neighbourhood Councils.

name: SINDH PLANTATION, MAINTENANCE OF TREES AND PUBLIC PARKS ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Sindh Plantation, Maintenance of Trees and Public Parks Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the plantation, maintenance of trees, and management of public parks within the Province of Sindh. It establishes rules regarding permissions for cutting trees, obligations for planting on vacant land, and penalties for offences related to tree destruction.

name: SINDH PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF THALASSEMIA ORDINANCE, 2013

metadata.title: The Sindh Prevention and Control of Thalassemia Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a framework for the prevention and control of thalassemia within the Province of Sindh. It mandates compulsory blood testing before marriage, requires reporting of test results to data banks, and outlines the state's obligation to provide genetic counseling and diagnostic facilities.

name: SINDH PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (REGULATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Sindh Private Educational Institutions (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation and control of private educational institutions in the Province of Sindh. It establishes procedures for the establishment, registration, monitoring, and inspection of such institutions, including provisions for certificates of registration and penalties for non-compliance.

name: SINDH PRIVATE MEDICAL EDUCATION INSTITUTIONS (REGULATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE 2001

metadata.title: The Sindh Private Medical Education Institutions (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation and control of private institutions imparting medical education in the Province of Sindh. It establishes an Authority to oversee these institutions, sets requirements for their establishment or continuation, and outlines procedures for approval, registration, and penalties.

name: SINDH PRIVATE MEDICAL EDUCATION INSTITUTIONS (REGULATION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE. 2001

metadata.title: The Sindh Private Medical Education Institutions (Regulation and Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Sindh Private Medical Education Institutions (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sindh Private Medical Education Institutions (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2001. It substitutes specific wording in the long title of the original ordinance to clarify the scope of institutions covered.

name: SINDH PRIVATE SECURITY AGENCIES (REGULATION AND CONTROL) ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Sindh Private Security Agencies (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation and control of private security agencies within the province of Sindh. It establishes a Licensing Authority, outlines procedures for obtaining licenses, sets conditions for agency operation, and regulates the possession of arms and other equipment.

metadata.title: The Sindh Privatisation Commission Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Privatization Commission as a body corporate to implement the Government of Sindh's privatization policy. It provides for the commission's functions, administration, financial management, and procedures for conducting fair and transparent privatization transactions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Privatization Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Privatization Commission Ordinance, 2001 by inserting a new section 39-A. The amendment allows the Commission to provide privatization programs and lay down guidelines for property valuation until specific rules are framed.

metadata.title: The Sindh Prohibition Ordinance, 1978
metadata.summary: This Ordinance prohibits the manufacture, sale, and consumption of intoxicating liquors in Sindh. It establishes penalties for violations, defines terms related to liquor production and sale, and outlines powers for prohibition officers regarding arrests, searches, and licences.

metadata.title: The Sindh Province Pension Fund Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Provincial Pension Fund in the Sindh Province with an initial seed money of Rs. 1200 million. It creates a Board to control and operate the fund, outlines procedures for meetings and rule-making, and mandates annual statements and audits.

metadata.title: The Sindh Provincial Pension Fund (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.amends: The Sindh Province Pension Fund Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Province Pension Fund Ordinance, 2002 to update provisions regarding investment returns and insurance contracts for pensionary benefits. It also revises the composition of the Board, meeting procedures, remuneration rules, and withdrawal signatures.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Private Partnership (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Private Partnership Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Public Private Partnership Act, 2010 to update definitions regarding agreements and services. It also modifies sections concerning civil society organizations, human resource policies, voluntary contributions, and the scope of sectors eligible for partnership.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public-Private Partnership Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes a comprehensive legal framework for private entities to participate in the social and economic development of the Province of Sindh. It creates structures such as a Policy Board, Public-Private Partnership Unit, and Departmental Nodes to manage project identification, approval, and implementation.

name: SINDH PUBLIC PROPERTY (REMOVAL OF ENCROACHMENT) (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010 to update provisions regarding tribunals and special courts. It specifically substitutes sections related to the composition, appointment, tenure, and removal of presiding officers for these judicial bodies.

name: SINDH PUBLIC PROPERTY (REMOVAL OF ENCROACHMENT) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2010

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2010
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010 to update definitions and court composition rules. It specifically adds a definition for 'Special Court' and substitutes section 26 to mandate that such courts consist of a retired Sessions Judge appointed by the Government.

name: SINDH PUBLIC PROPERTY (REMOVAL OF ENCROACHMENT) ORDINANCE, 2010

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment) Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides measures for the removal of encroachments from public property and to retrieve possession. It establishes an Anti-Encroachment Force, Special Courts, and outlines procedures for eviction, punishment for non-compliance, and the recovery of arrears.

name: SINDH PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Service Commission (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989 by substituting the word 'Government' with 'Governor' in specific sections. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989 to allow the Government to curtail the term of office of a Chairman appointed before its commencement. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989 to allow the Government to curtail the terms of office for the Chairman and members appointed before this section came into force. The amendment must be implemented no later than February 28, 1998.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989 by substituting the word 'Government' with 'Governor' in specific sections. It also inserts a new section allowing the Governor to appoint honorary members for a period not exceeding ninety days.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.amends: The Sind Public Service Commission Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Public Service Commission Act, 1989 by adding a new proviso to Section 5. The amendment allows the Government to permit employment for Members who have ceased office due to completing their term or resigning, provided it is done in an individual case and in the public interest.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Public Service Commission Act, 1989 to replace references to 'Government' with 'Governor' in various sections. It also modifies the composition of the Commission, sets specific tenure rules for members, and omits section 5-A of the original Act.

metadata.title: The Sindh Race-Courses Licensing (Amendment) Ordinance, 2003
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Race-Courses Licensing Act, 1912 to allow the Government to appoint an Administrator for regulating horse races. It also adds a new section empowering the Government to make rules via official gazette notification to carry out the Act's purposes.

metadata.title: The Sindh Regional Plan Organization (Repeal) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Regional Plan Organization Act, 1976
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh to immediately repeal the Sindh Regional Plan Organization Act, 1976. It was issued under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

name: SINDH REGULARIZATION OF TEACHERS APPOINTED ON CONTRACT BASIS ORDINANCE, 2012

metadata.title: The Sindh Regularization of Teachers Appointed on Contract Basis Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regularization of services for teachers appointed on a contract basis through specific testing centers in the years 2008 and 2009. It deems these teachers to be validly appointed as civil servants on a regular basis, subject to performance verification and completion of their contract period.

name: SINDH REGULATION AND CONTROL (USE OF PLOTS AND CONSTRUCTION OF BUILDINGS) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Sindh Regulation and Control (Use of Plots and Construction of Buildings) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the regulation and control of plot usage and building construction within the Province of Sindh. It defines key terms such as 'plot', 'building', and 'autonomous body' while establishing rules for converting plots, regularizing existing unauthorized constructions, and overriding conflicting laws.

metadata.title: The Sind Relief of Indebtedness (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.amends: The Sind Relief of Indebtedness Ordinance, 1960
metadata.repeals: Section 5 of the Sind Relief of Indebtedness Ordinance, 1960
metadata.summary: This document is an ordinance promulgated by the Governor of Sind to amend the Sind Relief of Indebtedness Ordinance, 1960. It specifically repeals Section 5 of the aforementioned 1960 ordinance and comes into force immediately upon enactment.

metadata.title: The Sindh Rented Premises (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Rented Premises Ordinance, 1979 to address issues arising from the suspension of the Provincial Assembly. It modifies specific sections regarding rent arrears payment methods, jurisdiction over appeals by substituting High Court references with District Judges, and procedures for transferring pending cases.

metadata.title: The Sindh Reproductive, Maternal, Neo-natal and Child Health Authority Ordinance, 2014
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Reproductive, Maternal, Neo-natal and Child Health Authority within the Province of Sindh. The Authority is empowered to manage affairs related to employees of the National Program for Primary Health Care and Family Planning, as well as oversee reproductive and child health initiatives.

name: SINDH SALES TAX ON SERVICES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2011

metadata.title: The Sindh Sales Tax on Services (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.amends: The Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Sales Tax on Services Act, 2011 to update specific sections regarding tax definitions, rates, and procedures. It introduces new clauses for handling cases of fraud or collusion and modifies tariff headings in the schedules to include services by non-banking financial institutions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the levy of sales tax on services rendered or provided in the Province of Sindh. It establishes a tax rate of fifteen percent and applies relevant provisions from the Sales Tax Act, 1990 regarding payment, registration, and enforcement.

metadata.title: The Sindh Security of Vulnerable Establishments Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes effective security arrangements for vulnerable establishments to prevent acts of terrorism and other crimes. It creates a Security Advisory Committee responsible for identifying, inspecting, and advising managers on necessary security measures for these locations.

metadata.title: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973 to allow the Government to curtail the term of office for the Chairman or members appointed before its commencement. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

metadata.title: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Service Tribunals Act, 1973 to update definitions regarding post grades and remuneration adjustments. It also modifies provisions on appeals against departmental authority decisions and inserts new sections concerning limitation periods and tribunal composition rules.

metadata.title: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment) Ordinance, 1991
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Service Tribunals Act, 1973 to establish a new Tribunal for members of the subordinate judiciary. It grants this new Tribunal exclusive jurisdiction over their terms and conditions of service, including disciplinary matters, while transferring pending cases from the previous tribunal.

metadata.title: The Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment) Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973 to update the composition and appointment criteria for Tribunal members. It specifies that a Tribunal consists of a Chairman and two Members appointed by the Government in consultation with the Chief Justice of the High Court of Sindh.

metadata.title: The Sindh Shops and Establishments (Security) Ordinance, 2009
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides security and protection to persons and property within commercial, industrial establishments, and shops in the Province of Sindh. It defines key terms such as 'commercial establishment' and 'employer', establishes procedures for compliance and reporting, and outlines penalties for contravention of orders.

metadata.title: The Sind Small Industries Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.amends: The Sind Small Industries Corporation Act, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Small Industries Corporation Act, 1972 by substituting a specific clause regarding the definition of 'small industry'. The amendment updates the criteria for fixed assets to include industries engaged in handicrafts or consumer/producer goods with total fixed assets not exceeding Rupees 5.0 millions.

name: SINDH SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT BOARD ORDINANCE, 2014.

metadata.title: The Sindh Solid Waste Management Board Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sindh Solid Waste Management Board to oversee the collection and disposal of solid waste in the Province of Sindh. It aims to arrange effective sanitation services, provide a pollution-free environment, and address other relevant matters regarding waste management.

metadata.title: The Sindh Sound System (Regulation) Ordinance, 2015
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates and controls the use of sound systems in the Province of Sindh to prevent public nuisance and maintain public order. It prohibits loud or annoying noise, restricts usage near sensitive locations like hospitals and places of worship during prayer times, and outlines penalties for violations.

name: SINDH SPEAKER'S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 to update salary figures and allowances. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly in October 1999.

metadata.title: The Sindh Sports Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Sports Board Ordinance, 1980 to update its composition and secretariat structure. It specifically adds the Secretary to the Government of Sindh, Culture Department as a new member and substitutes the roles of the Secretary and Joint Secretary within the Board.

metadata.title: The Sindh Sports Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Sports Board Ordinance, 1980 to update the board's secretariat structure. It specifically inserts a new item regarding the Secretary to the Government of Sindh in the Culture Department and substitutes provisions to redefine the roles of the Secretary and Director of Sports within the Board.

metadata.title: The Sindh Tenancy (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Tenancy Act, 1950 to update definitions regarding landlords and tenants, adjust financial obligations between them, and modify administrative roles. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh due to the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The Sindh Tenancy (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Sindh Tenancy Act, 1950 to regulate debt recovery and tenant rights. It prohibits landlords from recovering advances or debts from agricultural produce and forbids forced labor, restraint of movement, or involuntary transfer of tenants.

name: SINDH TRANSFUSION OF SAFE BLOOD (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2005

metadata.title: The Sindh Transfusion of Safe Blood (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.amends: The Sindh Transfusion of Safe Blood Act, 1996
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Transfusion of Safe Blood Act, 1996 to update specific sections regarding blood bank oversight and penalties. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: SINDH TRANSPLANTATION OF HUMAN ORGANS AND TISSUES ORDINANCE, 2012

metadata.title: The Sindh Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Ordinance, 2012
metadata.summary: This Ordinance regulates the removal, storage, and transplantation of human organs and tissues for therapeutic purposes in Sindh. It establishes definitions, procedures for living and deceased donors, and creates committees and authorities to oversee the process while prohibiting commercial transactions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Universities Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: The University of Sindh Act, 1972; The University of Karachi Act, 1972; The N.E.D University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977; The Mehran University of Engineering and Technology Act, 1977; The Sindh Agricultural University Act, 1977; The Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering and Technology Nawabshah Act, 1996; The Shah Abdul Latif University Act, 1986; The Liaquat University of Medical and Health Sciences Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends various university acts in the Province of Sindh to change meeting frequencies from twice a year to once a year. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh because the Provincial Assembly was dissolved and immediate action was deemed necessary.

name: SINDH UNIVERSITY AND BOARDS EXAMINATION (ERADICATION OF MALPRACTICE) ORDINANCE 2000.

metadata.title: The Sindh Universities and Boards Examination (Eradication of Malpractice) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the eradication of malpractices in examinations held by universities or boards in the Province of Sindh. It defines various terms related to examinations and outlines punishments for offenses such as question paper leaks, answer book tampering, and result falsification.

name: SINDH UNIVERSITY AND BOARDS EXAMINATIONS (ERADICATION OF MALPRACTICES) ORDINANCE, 1999

metadata.title: The Sindh University and Boards Examinations (Eradication of Malpractices) Ordinance, 1999
metadata.summary: This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh to eradicate malpractices in examinations held by universities or boards in the province. It defines key terms related to examinations and establishes punishments for various offenses, including question leaks, cheating, falsification of results, and assault on examination staff.

name: SINDH UNIVERSITY AND INSTITUTES LAWS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002

metadata.title: The Sindh Universities and Institutes Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.amends: various Acts and Ordinances relating to Universities and other educational Institutes in the Province of Sindh
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends various laws relating to universities and educational institutes in the Province of Sindh. Specifically, it inserts provisions requiring nominees not below the rank of an Additional Secretary for certain appointments across multiple university acts.

name: SINDH URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (Amendment) ORDINANCE, 1999

metadata.title: The Sindh Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999
metadata.amends: The Sindh Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to introduce new tax rates and valuation methods. It also adds provisions regarding exemptions for religious places and allows for the recovery of unrecovered tax as arrears of land revenue.

name: SINDH URBAN STATE LAND (CANCELLATION OF ALLOTMENTS, CONVERSIONS AND EXCHANGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001

metadata.title: The Sindh Urban State Land (Cancellation of Allotments, Conversions and Exchanges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.amends: The Sindh Urban State Land (Cancellation of Allotments, Conversions and Exchanges) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Urban State Land (Cancellation of Allotments, Conversions and Exchanges) Ordinance, 2001. It substitutes specific terms regarding urban state land with 'Government Land' and inserts conditions about encumbrances into section 5.

name: SINDH URBAN STATE LAND (CANCELLATION) OF ALLOTMENTS, CONVERSIONS AND EXCHANGES) ORDINANCE, 2000

metadata.title: The Sindh Urban State Land (Cancellation of Allotments, Conversions and Exchanges) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the cancellation of urban state land allotments, conversions, or exchanges granted at rates lower than market value in violation of law or ban from January 1, 1985. It establishes a committee to assess losses caused to the government and regularizes transactions made at market value or where assessed losses have been paid.

metadata.title: The Sind Vagrancy (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983
metadata.repeals: The Vagrancy (Karachi Division) Act, 1950
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Vagrancy Ordinance, 1958, by altering sentencing periods and penalties in sections 9 and 10. It also repeals the Vagrancy (Karachi Division) Act, 1950.

metadata.title: The Sindh Water Management (Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Water Management Ordinance, 2002 to update provisions regarding the Chairman and Members of the Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority. It specifically alters clauses related to political office restrictions for the Chairman and modifies the tenure terms for these officials.

metadata.title: The Sindh Water Management Ordinance, 2002
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Act, 1997
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes systems for the distribution and delivery of irrigation water, removal of drainage water, and management of flood waters in Sindh on a sustainable and participatory basis. It creates legal frameworks for various bodies including Area Water Boards (AWBs), Farm Organizations (FOs), and a Regulatory Authority to manage these resources transparently and accountably.

name: SINDH WILD LIFE PROTECTION SECOND (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2001

metadata.title: The Sindh Wildlife Protection Second (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972 to exclude oil and gas exploration activities from certain restrictions. The amendments apply specifically when such activities are undertaken in accordance with an environmental impact assessment as defined by the Pakistan Environmental Protection Act, 1997.

metadata.title: The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 1990
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972. It substitutes a specific provision in section 4 to designate the Chief Minister of Sindh or their nominee as the Chief Game Warden and ex-officio Chairman of the Board.

metadata.title: The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972 to prohibit commercial fishing and lotus collection in wildlife sanctuaries. It also annuls any leases or permissions granted for these activities before the Ordinance came into force.

metadata.title: The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972 to include fish alongside birds in protected categories and restricts commercial fishing activities in wildlife sanctuaries. It also annuls any leases or permissions granted for prohibited purposes before its commencement.

metadata.title: The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972 to impose stricter penalties for hunting specific animals. It inserts a new subsection into section 17 that prescribes fines and imprisonment terms for hunting rabbits, deer, hooders, paras, Sindh ibexes, or wild-sheep in contravention of the law.

metadata.title: The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972, to allow for the laying of underground pipelines using non-blasting techniques that do not disturb wildlife. It also updates specific monetary fines and provisions regarding the conservation of sanctuaries and national parks within the existing law.

metadata.title: The Sindh Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sindh Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972 to allow government activities in wildlife sanctuaries for eco-friendly resorts and eco-tourism. These permitted activities must not permanently disturb wildlife or the environment and are subject to prescribed terms and conditions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Zakat and Ushr Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance provides for the assessment, collection, and disbursement of Zakat and Ushr in the Province of Sindh. It establishes various committees and councils responsible for managing these funds while ensuring compliance with Shariah principles.

name: SIR SYED UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY ORDINANCE, 1993

metadata.title: The Sir Syed University of Engineering and Technology Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sir Syed University of Engineering and Technology in Karachi as a body corporate with perpetual succession. It defines the university's structure, including its Patron, Chancellor, Vice-Chancellor, and various authorities like the Board of Governors and Academic Council.

metadata.title: The Societies Registration (Second Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 to apply specifically to the province of Sindh. It introduces new regulations for the registration and reporting requirements of Deeni Madaris (religious institutions), including deadlines for existing and new institutions. Additionally, it prohibits these institutions from teaching or publishing literature that promotes militancy, sectarianism, or religious hatred.

metadata.title: The Societies Registration (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 2005
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 to apply specifically to the province of Sindh. It mandates that all Deeni Madaris must be registered under the Act and requires them to submit annual reports and audited accounts to the Registrar.

metadata.title: The Societies Registration (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Societies Registration Act, 1860 as it applies to the Province of Sind. Specifically, it adds a proviso to section 16-A requiring that no governing body be superseded without first providing them an opportunity to be heard.

metadata.title: The Sind Sports Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Sports Board Ordinance, 1980 by adding new clauses to section 4 regarding board members. It also grants the Governor the power to amend the board's composition through notifications.

metadata.title: The Sind Sports Board (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1982
metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the Sind Sports Board Ordinance, 1980 by modifying section 4. Specifically, it substitutes a new clause regarding the Vice-Chairman and adds a role for the Secretary to the Government of Sind in the Education Department.

metadata.title: The Sind Sports Board (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Sports Board Ordinance, 1980 to introduce a proviso regarding member removal. It mandates that no order of removal can be passed unless the concerned member is given an opportunity to show cause and be heard.

metadata.title: The Sind Sports Board Ordinance, 1980
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Sind Sports Board as a body corporate with perpetual succession to manage sports activities in Sind. It defines the composition of the Board, including official and non-official members, and outlines its functions, powers, and financial provisions.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Fifth Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Stamp Act, 1899 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh following the dissolution of the Provincial Assembly.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Fourth Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Stamp Act, 1899 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It specifically substitutes Article 19 in the Schedule to define financing documents related to banking instruments executed under non-interest-based finance modes.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Stamp Act, 1899 specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It inserts the phrase 'including a Participation Term Certificate' into the description of instruments in Schedule I, Article 27.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1996
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to apply specifically to the Province of Sindh. It introduces new provisions regarding the verification of sale consideration for deeds executed under power of attorney and establishes penalties for obstructing revenue authorities.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 2000
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Stamp Act, 1899 to apply specifically to the Province of Sindh. It introduces new provisions regarding the verification of sale consideration in power of attorney deeds and establishes penalties for obstructing revenue authorities or concealing information.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 2001
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Stamp Act, 1899 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It introduces a new article regarding stamp duty fees for domestic and international airline tickets and modifies Article 22-A by omitting specific words related to airline tickets.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the application of the Stamp Act, 1899 to the Province of Sindh. It substitutes specific article references within various sections of the Act and renumbers certain sections. Additionally, it provides a detailed schedule defining stamp duties on instruments like receipts and acknowledgements, along with specific exemptions for military personnel and government-related documents.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Third Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance further amends the Stamp Act, 1899 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It substitutes the words 'five percent' with 'three percent' in Article 16 of the Schedule within that Act.

metadata.title: The Stamp (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1994
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Stamp Act, 1899 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh because the Provincial Assembly was not in session and immediate action was deemed necessary.

name: STANDARD WEIGHTS AND MEASURES ENFORCEMENT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984

metadata.title: The Sind Standard Weights and Measures Enforcement (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Standard Weights and Measures Enforcement Act, 1975
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Standard Weights and Measures Enforcement Act, 1975. It specifically adds a proviso to section 25 requiring that an aggrieved person be given an opportunity of being heard before any order in revision is made.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories Control (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950, as applicable to Sind. It introduces provisions for quality premiums based on sucrose recovery and establishes specific penalties for failing to comply with section 16 or related directions.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories Control (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1993
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950, as applicable to Sindh. It deletes references to cooperative societies and modifies various sections regarding cane procurement, definitions, and administrative procedures.

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories Control (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 2002
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950, as applicable to the Province of Sindh. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sindh because the Provincial Assembly was dissolved and immediate action was deemed necessary.

name: SUGAR FACTORIES CONTROL ACT (SIND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The Sugar Factories Control Act (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sugar Factories Control Act, 1950, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes an existing proviso in section 8 with a new requirement for occupiers to start crushing not later than a date specified by the Provincial Government.

metadata.title: The Sind Tenancy (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Tenancy Act, 1950 to incorporate specific changes regarding tenancy rights and procedures. It addresses issues such as the devolution of rights upon a deceased Muslim tenant, management of tenancies by physically or mentally incapacitated tenants, and modifications to sections concerning legal representation and appeals.

metadata.title: The Sind Text Book Board (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.amends: The Sind Text Book Board Ordinance, 1970
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Text Book Board Ordinance, 1970 to address directions from the Federal Shariat Court. It specifically modifies Section 5 to ensure that no order of removal is passed without giving the Chairman or Member an opportunity to be heard.

metadata.title: The Sind Town Planning (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Town Planning Act, 1915 to incorporate specific provisions regarding mosque plots in development schemes. It also modifies compensation rules for land acquisition by adding a fifteen percent sum on market value and an additional annual interest payment.

metadata.title: The Tuberculosis Notification Ordinance, 2013
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the framework for developing Tuberculosis notification forms and distributing them to registered medical practitioners, private clinics, hospitals, and community leaders in Sindh. It outlines the duties of various healthcare providers and institutions regarding the notification of suspected or confirmed TB cases to the District Health Officer.

metadata.title: The University of Karachi (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of Karachi Act, 1972 to ensure that appellants are given an opportunity to be heard before orders in appeal or review are passed. It also inserts a requirement for actions to be done in good faith within the said Act.

metadata.title: The University of Karachi Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This ordinance reconstitutes and reorganizes the University of Karachi to grant it necessary autonomy and improve its administration. It establishes the university as a body corporate with perpetual succession, defining its powers regarding instruction, research, examinations, and property management.

metadata.title: The University of Sind (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the University of Sind Act, 1972 to ensure that appellants and applicants are given an opportunity to be heard before orders in appeal or review are passed. It also inserts a requirement for actions to be done in good faith within the said Act.

metadata.title: The University of Sind Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This ordinance reconstitutes and reorganizes the University of Sind to grant it necessary autonomy and improve its administration. It establishes the University as a body corporate with perpetual succession, defining its structure, officers, and powers regarding instruction, research, examinations, and property management.

metadata.title: The Sind Waqf Properties (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Sind Waqf Properties Ordinance, 1979 to incorporate specific changes regarding the appointment of administrators and the usage of property sale proceeds. It introduces new provisions requiring administrators to be Muslim and mandates that sale proceeds must serve the main purpose of the waqf.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Highways (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Highways Ordinance, 1959, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It introduces new definitions for 'Super Highway', establishes bans on damaging road structures or cutting trees without permission, creates Mobile Courts for summarily trying offences, and increases fines and imprisonment terms for violations.

The document also modifies provisions regarding board member resignations and the review of proceedings.
