metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Cotton Control Ordinance, 1966, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes and adds provisions related to the government's power to fix cotton prices and the penalties for contravening such notifications.

metadata.summary: This ordinance amends the West Pakistan Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, (Repeal) Ordinance, 1969 to apply it to the Province of Sind. It modifies specific sections regarding previous operations and adds provisions for transferring cases from Tribunals to criminal Courts.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Employees' Social Security Ordinance, 1965, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Family Courts Act, 1964 to apply specifically to the Province of Sindh. It grants the High Court the power to transfer suits, proceedings, and appeals between different Family Courts or District Courts within the province.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Finance Act, 1963, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sindh. It inserts new clauses requiring property sellers to submit statements within seven days of a transfer and mandates registrars to provide copies of documents within fifteen days.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Fisheries (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1974
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Fisheries Ordinance, 1961, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes the word 'July' for 'August' in the First Schedule of the parent Ordinance.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Fisheries (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1972
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Fisheries Ordinance, 1961, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes Section 4 and Clause (d) of Section 26 of the Principal Ordinance to grant District Councils powers to lease water for fishing and to replace the Director of Fisheries with the District West Pakistan Council.

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It introduces a new section requiring a minimum imprisonment term of one month for ration-related offences and modifies provisions regarding court cognizance and trial procedures.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958 specifically for its application to the Province of Sind. It adds a new subsection to Section 9 that prescribes imprisonment or fines for officers who issue bogus ration documents.

metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Pure Food Ordinance, 1960, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It substitutes sections 23 and 31 of the principal Ordinance, omits section 23-A, and establishes specific penalties for contraventions while defining the procedure for trial by Magistrates.

name: WEST PAKISTAN QAUMI RAZAKARS (SIND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Qaumi Razakars (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Qaumi Razakars Ordinance, 1965
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Qaumi Razakars Ordinance, 1965 to apply specifically to the Province of Sind. It grants reinstatement rights to Qaumi Razakars released from service or training after November 1, 1971, and establishes penalties for employers who fail to comply with these reinstatement obligations.

name: WEST PAKISTAN REQUISITIONING OF IMMOVABLE PROPERTY (TEMPORARY POWERS) (SIND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1956
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Requisitioning of Immovable Property (Temporary Powers) Act, 1956, specifically regarding its application to the Province of Sind. It omits certain procedural requirements for hearing owners and inserts new subsections allowing aggrieved persons to apply for a review of requisition orders.

name: WEST PAKISTAN TENDOO LEAVES (PROHIBITION ON POSSESSION AND USE) (SIND REPEAL) ORD. 1973

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) (Sind Repeal) Ordinance, 1973
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) Ordinance, 1966
metadata.summary: This ordinance repeals the West Pakistan Tendoo Leaves (Prohibition on Possession and Use) Ordinance, 1966 specifically within its application to the Province of Sind. It was promulgated by the Governor of Sind under Article 128 of the Constitution because the Provincial Assembly was not in session.

name: WEST PAKISTAN TOBACCO VEND ACT (SIND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1970
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Tobacco Vend Act, 1958 as it applies to the Province of Sindh. Specifically, it substitutes the term 'any Magistrate' with 'an Excise and Taxation Officer' in section 7 of the amended Act.

name: WEST PAKISTAN URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX ACT (SIND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1971

metadata.title: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act (Sind Amendment) Ordinance, 1971
metadata.amends: The West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the West Pakistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 to apply specifically to the Province of Sind. It substitutes references to 'West Pakistan' with 'Sind' and adjusts relevant sections to reflect provincial governance structures.

metadata.title: The Zulfikarabad Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011
metadata.summary: This Ordinance amends the Zulfikarabad Development Authority Act, 2010 to alter the composition and functions of its Governing Body. It substitutes specific subsections regarding the members of the body and introduces provisions for appointing a Vice Chairman and Secretary.

metadata.title: The Zulfikarabad Development Authority Ordinance, 2010
metadata.summary: This Ordinance establishes the Zulfikarabad Development Authority to develop a modern city in District Thatta. It defines the Authority as a body corporate with powers to acquire property, prepare development schemes, and manage local infrastructure.

metadata.title: Sindh Local Councils (Conduct of Business) Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the conduct of business for local councils in Sindh, including procedures for calling meetings, preparing agendas, and seating arrangements. They define the roles of the convener and nazim regarding notice periods, adjournment, suspension, and postponement of council sittings.

metadata.title: The Sindh City Survey Rules, 1988
metadata.summary: These rules provide the framework for survey operations in cities within Sindh, including traversing land, holding enquiries to determine ownership and encroachments, and mapping building sites. They establish specific procedures for issuing notices, preparing records, conducting hearings, and appealing against orders of the Survey Officer.

name: KARACHI (POSSESSION OF RECTIFIED SPIRIT) AND THE MANUFACTURE OF ORIGINAL HOMOEOPATHIC TINCTURES) RULES,1965

metadata.title: The Karachi (Possession of Rectified Spirit and the Manufacture of Original Homoeopathic Tinctures) Rules, 1965
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for granting permits to homoeopathic chemists and practitioners to possess rectified spirit at reduced rates. They outline requirements for applications, security bonds, account maintenance, and conditions for the manufacture of original homoeopathic tinctures.

metadata.title: The Banking Companies (Court) Rules, 1972
metadata.summary: These rules frame the practice and procedure for proceedings under the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962 before the High Court of Sind and Baluchistan. They establish specific registers to be maintained by the Registrar and Liquidator regarding petitions, applications, appearances, and liquidation matters.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants (Advance Increments) Rules, 1976
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for granting advance increments to civil servants in Sindh, subject to specific eligibility conditions and service requirements. An Advisory Committee assesses the suitability of candidates based on factors such as integrity, behavior, and work output before recommending them for increments.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants Language Examination Rules, 1981
metadata.repeals: The Sind Government Servant Language Examination Rules, 1963
metadata.summary: These rules mandate that civil servants in Grade 5 and above must pass a language examination in Urdu or Sindhi, depending on their mother tongue. The regulations specify the examination standards, frequency, exemptions for certain grades or ages, and provide financial rewards for passing within the prescribed time limit.

name: Coastal Development Authority (Accounts Wo0rks, Property and Record) Rules, 1999.

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority (Accounts, Works, Property and Record) Rules, 1999
metadata.summary: These rules govern the maintenance of accounts, management of property, and record-keeping for the Coastal Development Authority in Sindh. They establish procedures for cash books, receipts, contracts, and audits to ensure proper financial administration.

metadata.title: The Sind Darul Atfal (Supervision and Control) Rules, 1987
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the supervision and control of Darul Atfal (orphanages) in Sindh under the Sind Darul Atfal (Supervision & Control) Act, 1976. They outline procedures for granting and renewing licenses, maintaining financial accounts, submitting annual reports, and conducting medical examinations for children.

metadata.title: The Sind Drainage Rates Rules, 1983
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for levying and collecting drainage rates in Sindh under the Sind Irrigation Act, 1879. They define key terms, specify how bills are issued bi-annually, set payment deadlines for different crop seasons, and provide procedures for remission due to natural calamities or crop failure.

name: EXECUTION OF THE PUNISHMENT OF WHIPPING RULES, 1986.

metadata.title: The Sind Execution of the Punishment of Whipping Rules, 1986
metadata.summary: These rules were framed by the Government of Sind under section 7 of the Execution of the Punishment of Whipping Ordinance, 1979. They establish procedures for nominating warders to execute whipping punishments, ensuring female executioners for female convicts and prohibiting male witnesses during such acts.

metadata.title: Sindh Gothabad (Housing Scheme) Rules, 2008
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of Sindh to regulate the allotment of land under the Sind Gothabad (Housing Scheme) Act, 1987. They establish procedures for forming allotment committees, conducting surveys, defining eligibility for plots, and setting terms regarding construction timelines and transfer restrictions.

name: HIGH COURT OF SIND BENCHES RULES, 1987

metadata.title: The High Court of Sind Benches Rules, 1987
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for Benches of the High Court of Sind, defining terms and assigning areas to specific benches. They grant the Chief Justice powers to transfer cases, modify bench assignments, and manage registry operations across the court's jurisdiction.

name: KATCHI ABADIS AUTHORITY, (REGULARISATION, IMPROVEMENT, AND DEVELOPMENT) REGULATIONS, 1993

metadata.title: The Sindh Katchi Abadis Authority, (Regularisation, Improvement, and Development) Regulations, 1993
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the Sindh Katchi Abadis Authority to prepare master lists, conduct surveys, and formulate regularization schemes for unauthorized settlements. The document outlines specific requirements for public participation, lease rates, and procedures for converting amenity plots or removing encroachments within designated areas.

name: KMC EMPLOYEES WELFARE BOARD FUND RULES, 1971.

metadata.title: The K.M.C. Employees Welfare Fund Rules, 1971
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Karachi Municipal Corporation (KMC) Employees Welfare Fund to provide financial support and insurance benefits for permanent KMC employees. The document outlines the fund's establishment, custody, investment, accounting procedures, and the constitution of a Board to manage its powers and meetings.

metadata.title: The Sind Law Colleges (Board of Governors) Rules, 1983
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the Boards of Governors for Law Colleges in Sind, defining their composition, meeting procedures, and quorum requirements. They also outline regulations regarding the management of funds, budget preparation, maintenance of accounts, and the submission of annual activity and expenditure statements to the Government.

metadata.title: The Sindh Mining Concession Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Government of Sindh to regulate mining concessions, licenses, and permits within the province. They establish administrative procedures for granting mineral titles, define obligations for holders, and set financial requirements including royalties.

metadata.title: The Sindh Motor Vehicles Dealers Licence Rules, 1989
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for granting licences to motor vehicle dealers in Sindh under the powers of the Sindh Finance Act, 1989. They outline eligibility criteria, application procedures, conditions for licence holders, and provisions for renewal, suspension, or cancellation.

name: NARA CANAL AREA WATER BOARD ELECTION (MEMBER)REGULATIONS, 2004

metadata.title: The Nara Canal Area Water Board Election (Member) Regulations, 2004
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the elections for the chairman of the Nara Canal Area Water Board. They establish qualifications and disqualifications for candidates, define the election committee's powers, and outline voting procedures.

metadata.title: The Sind Provincial Assembly (Members) Welfare Fund Rules, 1976
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the management of the Sind Provincial Assembly (Members) Welfare Fund, including custody and investment of moneys. They also define the procedures for committee meetings, decision-making processes, auditing requirements, and the disbursement of grants and allowances to members.

name: PROVINCIAL COUNCIL REHABILITATION OF DISABLED PERSONS RULES, 1983.

metadata.title: Sind Provincial Council for Rehabilitation of Disabled Persons Rules, 1983
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedural framework for the Sind Provincial Council for Rehabilitation of Disabled Persons. They define key terms, outline meeting schedules and notice requirements, and set guidelines for motions, amendments, and minutes.

name: PROVINCIAL LOCAL GOVERNMENT COMMISSION (CONDUCT OF BUSINESS) RULES, 2017

metadata.title: The Provincial Local Government Commission (Conduct of Business) Rules, 2017
metadata.summary: These rules establish the conduct of business for the Provincial Local Government Commission in Sindh, including meeting procedures and agenda management. They also define key terms, outline executive authority, and grant the Commission powers equivalent to a civil court for inspections and inquiries.

name: REGIONAL PLAN ORGANIZATION EMPLOYEES ((GENERAL SONDITIONS OF sERVICE) RULES, 1987.docx 13-7-2015

metadata.title: The Sind Regional Plan Organization Employees (General Conditions of Service) Rules, 1987
metadata.summary: These rules establish the general conditions of service for employees of the Sind Regional Plan Organization. They cover definitions, pay scales, allowances, appointment procedures, transfers, and termination of service.

name: REGIONAL PLAN ORGANIZATION EMPLOYEES (EFFICIENCY AND DISCIPLINE) RULES, 1988.docx

metadata.title: The Sind Regional Plan Organization Employees (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 1988
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for imposing penalties on employees of the Sind Regional Plan Organization due to inefficiency, misconduct, corruption, or subversive activities. They define key terms such as 'accused' and 'misconduct', outline minor and major penalties including dismissal, and prescribe the inquiry procedures that must be followed by authorized officers.

metadata.title: The Sindh Registration of Godowns Rules, 1996
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of Sindh under section 9 of the Sindh Registration of Godowns Act, 1996 to regulate the registration and management of godowns. They establish procedures for applications, renewals, fee payments, and the maintenance of stock registers for essential articles.

name: RULES OF PROCEDURE OF THE PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF SINDH

metadata.title: Rules of Procedure of the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
metadata.amends: Rules of Procedure of the Provincial Assembly of Sindh (1973)
metadata.summary: These rules were drafted to replace the 1973 Rules of Procedure for the Provincial Assembly of Sindh, bringing them into conformity with the Constitution (Eighteenth Amendment) Act, 2010. The document outlines the procedures for summoning the assembly, election of officers, sittings, questions, and privileges.

name: SIND INFORMATION AND PUBLIC RELATIONS DEPARTMENT DELEGATION OF POWERS RULES, 1970.

metadata.title: The Sind Information and Public Relations Department Delegation of Powers Rules, 1970
metadata.amends: Information Department Delegation of Powers Rules, 1962
metadata.summary: These rules delegate specific authorities for appointment, appeal, punishment, transfer, and controlling travelling allowance within the Sind Information and Public Relations Department. They supersede the previous Information Department Delegation of Powers Rules, 1962, applicable to the Province of Sind.

name: SIND LOCAL COUNCIL AND MUNICIPAL COMMITTEE SERVANTS (REST AND RECREATION ALLOWANCE) RULES, 1970.

metadata.title: The Sind Local Council and Municipal Committee Servants (Rest and Recreation Allowance) Rules, 1970
metadata.summary: These rules establish provisions for recreation leave and a corresponding allowance for members of the Local Council Service and servants of Local Councils or Municipal Committees in Sind. The document outlines eligibility criteria, such as service duration and confirmation status, required to receive the allowance, which is capped at one thousand rupees.

metadata.title: The Sind Prohibition Rules, 1979
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Government of Sind to carry into effect the provisions of the Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) Order, 1979. They define key expressions, designate officers with specific powers, and establish procedures for confiscation, destruction of intoxicants, and appeals against prohibition orders.

metadata.title: The Sind Ushr (Assessment and Collection) Rules, 1983
metadata.summary: These rules provide the framework for the assessment and collection of Ushr in the Province of Sind. They establish procedures for defining liability, dividing districts into circles, determining crop yields and prices, and managing the collection process by local committees.

name: SINDH COUNCILS MAYOR, DEPUTY MAYOR, CHAIRMAN, AND VICE CHAIRMAN (HONORARIA AND PRIVILEGES) RULES, 2017

metadata.title: The Sindh Councils Mayor, Deputy Mayor, Chairman and Vice Chairman (Honoraria and Privileges) Rules, 2017
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the honoraria, official residence, vehicle, telephone, medical, and office accommodation facilities for Mayors, Deputy Mayors, Chairmen, and Vice Chairmen of various councils in Sindh. They also define the travel allowances and staff entitlements admissible to these officials based on their specific positions.

name: SINDH HIGH COURT ESTABLISHMENT (APPOINTMENT AND CONDITIONS OF SERVICE) RULES, 2006.

metadata.title: The Sindh High Court Establishment (Appointment and Conditions of Service) Rules, 2006
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the appointment and conditions of employment for officers and servants of the High Court of Sindh. They cover topics including the strength of staff, methods of recruitment, qualifications, promotion criteria, and terms of service.

metadata.title: SKAA Low-Cost Housing Scheme Regulations 2008
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the Sindh Katchi Abadis Authority to launch low-cost housing schemes providing plots ranging from 80 to 120 square yards. The document outlines the powers of the Authority, including land acquisition and disposal, as well as the specific functions of field offices regarding plot demarcation, utility coordination, and fund management.

name: Sindh law Officer (Conditions of Service) Rules, 1940.

metadata.title: Sindh law Officer (Conditions of Service) Rules, 1940
metadata.amends: Government notification No. 1778, dated the 31st August, 1923
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the conditions of service for Law Officers in Sindh, including the Advocate-General, Public Prosecutors, and Government Pleaders. They establish procedures for appointments, define eligibility criteria based on years of standing at the Bar, and outline terms of office and removal processes.

metadata.title: Sindh Local Council (Contract) Rules, 2016
metadata.summary: These rules govern the making of contracts by local councils in Sindh, defining terms and establishing procedures for authority, execution, and registration. They mandate adherence to public procurement principles, including tender invitations and security requirements, to ensure transparency and fair competition.

name: SINDH LOCAL COUNCILS (AUCTIONING OF COLLECTION RIGHTS) RULES, 2016

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Councils (Auctioning of Collection Rights) Rules, 2016
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure for Local Councils in Sindh to auction collection rights for various incomes. They define key terms, establish requirements for public notices and auctions, and set conditions for accepting bids or resorting to negotiation.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government Contract Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These Rules prescribe the authority, manner, and procedures for making contracts by local governments in Sindh. They cover requirements for inviting tenders, security deposits, and the personal responsibilities of the contracting authority.

name: SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT TMA UA SERVANTS (EFFICIENCY AND DISCIPLINE RULES, 2001.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government TMA/UA Servants (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules establish the grounds for imposing penalties on servants of Taluka Municipal Administration (TMA) and Union Administration. They define specific minor and major penalties, including censure, removal, and dismissal, while outlining the inquiry procedures to be followed when a servant is accused of misconduct or corruption.

name: SINDH OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH RULES, 2019

metadata.title: The Sindh Occupational Safety and Health Rules, 2019
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Sindh Occupational Safety and Health Act, 2017 to establish specific definitions and general duties for employers, self-employed persons, and others regarding workplace health and safety. The document outlines responsibilities such as determining worker safety, cooperating with occupational health committees, and adhering to government regulations and standards.

name: THE SIND EXCISE AND TAXATION DEPARTMENTAL EXAMINATIONS RULES,1970.

metadata.title: The Sind Excise and Taxation Departmental Examinations Rules, 1970
metadata.repeals: Resolution No. 10-R/43 dated 11th December, 1943; Notification No. S-16(7) Rev-51 dated 15th July, 1959
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the syllabus, qualifying standards, and procedures for departmental examinations required for confirmation in the West Pakistan Excise and Taxation Service (Class II) and Subordinate Service within the Government of Sind. They establish a committee to conduct exams twice a year, define failure limits based on appointment type, and specify exemptions for personnel over forty-five years of age.

metadata.title: The Sindh Transfusion of Safe Blood Rules, 2003
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for registering blood banks and granting licenses under the Sindh Transfusion Safe Blood Act, 1997. They outline procedures for applications, committee inquiries, annual reporting, and the monitoring or cancellation of licenses.

metadata.title: The Sind Agriculturists' Loans Rules, 1983
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of Sind under the powers of the Sind Agriculturists' Loans Act, 1958. They define key terms, specify authorities and limits for granting loans, outline application procedures, and set conditions for repayment and security.

metadata.title: The Sindh Auqaf Guards Rules, 2004
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for appointing guards to protect Auqaf properties in Sindh. They define eligibility criteria, including age limits, physical fitness, and educational qualifications, as well as the terms and conditions of service.

name: BOARD OF SECONDARY EDUCATION, KARACHI EMPLOYEES (EFFICIENCY AND DISCIPLINE) REGULATIONS,1976.

metadata.title: Board of Secondary Education, Karachi Employees (Efficiency and Discipline) Regulation, 1976
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for imposing penalties on employees of the Board of Secondary Education, Karachi due to inefficiency, misconduct, corruption, or subversive activities. They define specific grounds for action, categorize penalties into minor and major types, and outline the inquiry procedures that must be followed by authorized officers.

metadata.title: Sindh Boilers (Renewal Certificate Fees) Rules, 1990
metadata.summary: These rules establish the fees payable for the renewal of boiler certificates based on specific capacity ranges. They also specify that contraventions are punishable under Section 30 of the Boilers Act, 1923.

metadata.title: Sindh Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of Sindh under the powers of section 24 of the Sindh Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 2015. They establish authorities to handle cases regarding the restoration of property for bonded labourers and define the powers and duties of Deputy Commissioners in implementing the Act.

name: Central Rescue Station (Coal Coke Mines) Rules, 1986

metadata.title: The Central Rescue Station (Coal Coke Mines) Rules, 1986
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for creating and managing Central Rescue Stations specifically for coal and coke mines in Sindh. They define the composition of rescue stations, outline the functions of the governing Board, and prescribe duties related to training, equipment maintenance, and accident prevention.

metadata.title: The Thar Coal Tariff Determination Rules, 2014
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Thar Coal Tariff Determination Committee to assist the Board in matters relating to coal tariffs. They define key terms, outline the committee's composition and duties, and set forth procedures for filing petitions and determining tariffs for the Thar Coalfield.

name: COASTAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (CONDUCT OF BUSINESS) REGULATIONS, 2000.

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2000
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the procedural framework for the conduct of business at meetings of the Coastal Development Authority. They define terms, outline meeting procedures including notice periods and quorum requirements, and specify rules regarding agenda preparation, voting, and minute recording.

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority (Employee Pension) Rules, 1999
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Employees Fund for the Coastal Development Authority and define eligibility for various types of pensions, including superannuation, retiring, invalid, and compassionate pensions. They also outline procedures for calculating pensions, determining entitlement upon death or disability, and managing family pension distribution.

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority Employees (Appeal) Rules, 1998
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for employees of the Coastal Development Authority to file appeals against orders made by the competent authority regarding their terms and conditions of service. The document defines key terms such as 'appellate authority' and 'competent authority', outlines the requirements for submitting an appeal memorandum, and details the process for hearing appeals and communicating final orders.

name: COASTAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY EMPLOYEES (GENERAL PROVIDENT FUND) RULES, 1999

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority Employees (General Provident Fund) Rules, 1999
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Coastal Development Authority Employees (General Provident Fund) for employees of the Authority in Sindh. They define terms related to subscriptions, family members, and fund administration while outlining procedures for nominations, withdrawals, and investments.

name: Coastal Development Authority Employees (Welfare Funds) Rule ,1999.

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority Employees (Welfare Fund) Rules, 1999
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Coastal Development Authority Employees Welfare Fund and define the contributions required from employees and the Authority. The document outlines procedures for insuring employees, making nominations for death benefits, and determining how funds are utilized upon an employee's death.

name: Coastal Development Authority Employees Benavelent Fund Rules, 1999.

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority Employees Benevolent Fund Rules, 1999
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Coastal Development Authority Employees Benevolent Fund and define its constitution, subscription rates, and utilization for employee welfare. The document outlines procedures for financial assistance regarding illness, death, invalidation, education, marriage, and other exceptional cases for employees of the Authority.

name: COASTAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY EMPLOYEES(aPPOINTMENT,PROMOTION AND TRANSFER) REGULATIONS, 2000.

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority Employees (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Regulations, 2000
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the appointment, promotion, and transfer of employees within the Coastal Development Authority. They establish the methods for selection, the qualifications required, age limits, and the specific authorities responsible for making appointments.

name: Coastal Development Authority Employeeses Medical Attendance) Rules, 1999

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority Employees (Medical Attendance) Rules, 1999
metadata.summary: These rules govern the free of charge medical attendance and treatment provided to employees of the Coastal Development Authority by an authorized medical officer. They define key terms such as 'employee', 'family', and 'treatment', and outline procedures for reimbursement when costs are initially paid by the employee or specialist practitioners.

name: COASTAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY VEHICLES (USE AND MAINTENANCE) RULES, 1999.

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority Vehicles (Use & Maintenance) Rules, 1999
metadata.summary: These rules govern the use, maintenance, and identification of vehicles belonging to the Coastal Development Authority. They establish procedures for official usage, private hire charges, log book maintenance, and accident reporting.

name: COASTAN DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY EMPLOYEES (EFFICIENCY AND DISCIPLINE) REGULATIONS,2000.

metadata.title: The Coastal Development Authority Employee (Efficiency & Discipline) Regulations, 2000
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for imposing penalties on employees of the Coastal Development Authority due to inefficiency, misconduct, or corruption. They define key terms, outline grounds for penalty, list minor and major penalties, and specify the inquiry procedures to be followed by authorized officers.

metadata.title: The Sindh Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the Board of Trustees under the Sindh Companies Profits (Workers' Participation) Act, 2015. They define the composition, election process, duties, and functions of the Board, as well as the responsibilities of the Secretary to the Fund.

metadata.title: The Crash Helmet (Specifications) Rules, 1978
metadata.summary: These rules establish the specifications for crash helmets used in motor vehicles within Sind. The requirements mandate that helmets be made of specific materials and meet Pakistan Standard No. 1402 of 1978, which was established by the Pakistan Standards Institution.

metadata.title: The District Council Export Tax Rules, 1976
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the assessment and collection of export tax within District Councils in Sind. They define administrative structures including tax limits, barriers, offices, staff roles, and procedures for inspections and seizure of goods.

metadata.title: The Sind Educational Institutions (Council of Students) Rules, 1984
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for Council of Students, subject societies, sports clubs, and class representatives in educational institutions within Sindh. They define the composition, election procedures, terms of office, and specific functions for these student bodies to promote welfare, academic pursuits, and recreational activities.

metadata.title: The Election (FO, WCA, DBG) Regulations, 2004
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for conducting elections for the Board of Management of Farmers Organizations, Watercourse Associations, and Drainage Beneficiary Groups in Sindh. They define key terms, set out qualifications and disqualifications for candidates, and outline procedures regarding election committees, returning officers, and ballot counting.

metadata.title: The Environmental Samples Rules, 2014
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Sindh Environment Protection Agency under the powers of the Sindh Environmental Protection Act, 2014. They establish procedures for authorization, entry, inspection, search, and the collection and analysis of environmental samples.

metadata.title: The Sindh Fertilizer (Control) Rules, 1999
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of Sindh under the powers of the Sindh Fertilizer (Control) Act, 1994 to regulate the sale, distribution, and stocking of fertilizers. They establish procedures for obtaining licenses, maintaining records, conditions for advertising, and mechanisms for suspension or cancellation of licenses.

metadata.title: The Hazardous Substances Rules, 2014
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe hazardous substances and establish the framework for issuing licenses to handle them. They mandate environmental impact assessments, safety plans, and specific conditions for premises and worker safety.

name: HEALTH FOUNDATION (GRANT LOANS AND LAND) RULES, 1994.

metadata.title: The Sindh Health Foundation (Grants, Loans and Land) Rules, 1994
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the Sindh Health Foundation to provide assistance in the form of grants, loans, or land leases to recipients. The document outlines specific terms and conditions for applicants, including financial guarantees, audit requirements, and restrictions on altering project scopes or selling assets acquired with assistance.

name: HIGH COURT OF SIND BENCHES RULES, 1987.

metadata.title: The High Court of Sind Benches Rules, 1987
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for Benches within the High Court of Sind, defining terms such as 'Bench', 'Chief Justice', and 'Judge'. They grant the Chief Justice powers to assign areas to Benches, transfer cases, and manage judicial proceedings across different seats.

metadata.title: The Sindh Hospital Waste Management Rules, 2014
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for managing hospital waste generated by various healthcare facilities in Sindh, including clinics and laboratories. They define specific categories of waste, assign responsibility to owners and operators, and mandate the creation of a Hospital Waste Management Plan based on recognized environmental standards.

name: IND (NON-GAZETTED) CIVIL SERVICES (NATIONAL SCALES OF PAY) RULES, 1972.

metadata.title: The Sind (Non-Gazetted) Civil Services (National Scales of Pay) Rules, 1972
metadata.summary: These rules establish the National Scales of Pay for non-gazetted civil servants in Sindh, excluding teaching staff. They provide Government servants with the right to choose between existing pay scales or the new national scales, effective from March 29, 1972.

name: IND (NON-GAZETTED) CIVIL SERVICES (NATIONAL SCALES OF PAY) RULES, 1972.

metadata.title: The Sind (Non-Gazetted) Civil Services (National Scales of Pay) Rules, 1972
metadata.summary: These rules establish the National Scales of Pay for non-gazetted civil servants in Sindh, excluding teaching staff. They provide Government servants with the right to choose between existing pay scales or the new national scales, effective from March 29, 1972.

name: IND REGIONAL PLAN ORGANIZATION EMPLOYEES (TRAVELLING ALLOWANCE) RULES, 1989.

metadata.title: The Sind Regional Plan Organization Employees (Travelling Allowance) Rules, 1989
metadata.summary: These rules grant travelling allowance to employees of the Sind Regional Plan Organization to cover expenses incurred while travelling in the interest of the organization. The document defines various terms such as controlling officer, daily allowance, and mileage allowance, and outlines specific conditions for admissibility, rates, and calculations for different modes of transport.

metadata.title: The Sindh Compulsory Primary Education Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of Sindh to facilitate the implementation of the Sindh Compulsory Primary Education Ordinance, 2001. They establish the functions of the Authority regarding school inspections, record maintenance, and ensuring regular student attendance through notices and orders.

metadata.title: The Sindh Industrial Relations Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Government of Sindh under the powers of section 78 of the Sindh Industrial Relations Act, 2013. They establish procedures for the registration of trade unions and federations, define key terms related to agriculture and workers, and mandate the maintenance of registers, accounts, and minutes books.

name: INSTITUTE OF OPHTHALMOLOGY AND VISUAL SCIENCES ACADEMIC COUNCIL (CONDUCT OF BUSINESS) RULES, 2021

metadata.title: Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Academic Council (Conduct of Business) Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the rules for the conduct of business within the Academic Council of the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences. The document defines key terms, outlines meeting frequencies and quorum requirements, and details procedures for agenda preparation, voting, and motion handling.

name: INSTITUTE OF OPHTHALMOLOGY AND VISUAL SCIENCES EMPLOYEES (SIGNING OF MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING) REGULATIONS, 2021

metadata.title: Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences (Signing of Memorandum of Understanding) Regulations, 2021
metadata.summary: These regulations empower the Board of Directors of the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences to enter into Memorandums of Understanding with public and private bodies for collaboration in academics, research, and services. They define specific conditions under which the Institute may establish joint degree programmes, facilitate faculty training, and conduct research projects with external partners.

metadata.title: The Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority Rules, 1999
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority regarding the inventory, title, and use of transferred assets and liabilities. They also govern conditions for disposing of infrastructure, determining water service charges, and transferring employees to Area Water Boards.

metadata.title: The K.D.A. (Disposal of Land) Rules, 1971
metadata.summary: These rules govern the disposal of residential and commercial plots by the Karachi Development Authority in Sindh. They establish specific reservation percentages for government employees, defense personnel, construction companies, and the general public based on plot size.

name: KARACHI WATER & SEWERAGE BOARD EMPLOYEES (PROBATION,CONFIRMATION & SENIORITY) RULES, 1987.

metadata.title: The Karachi Water and Sewerage Board Employees (Probation, Confirmation & Seniority) Rules, 1987
metadata.summary: These rules govern the probation periods, confirmation processes, and seniority lists for employees of the Karachi Water and Sewerage Board. They specify the duration of probation based on appointment type, procedures for terminating unsatisfactory service, and eligibility requirements for permanent confirmation.

name: KARACHI WATER AND SEWERAGE BOARD EMPLOYEES (APPOINTMENT, PROMOTION AND TRANSFER) RULES, 1987

metadata.title: The Karachi Water and Sewerage Board Employees (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules, 1987
metadata.summary: These rules govern the appointment, promotion, and transfer of employees of the Karachi Water and Sewerage Board. They establish the methods for initial appointments, define appointing authorities based on pay scales, and set out requirements regarding qualifications and age limits.

metadata.title: Sindh Colonization and Disposal of Government Lands Rules, 2005
metadata.summary: These rules govern the grant of land for non-agricultural purposes by the Government of Sindh under the Colonization and Disposal of Government Lands Act, 1912. They establish committees for determining market prices and outline procedures for auctions, lease agreements, and the resumption of land for public use.

metadata.title: Sindh Legal Practitioners and Bar Council Rules, 1991
metadata.amends: Sindh Legal Practitioners and Bar Council Rules
metadata.repeals: Sindh Legal Practitioners and Bar Council Rules
metadata.summary: These rules reframe the Sindh Legal Practitioners and Bar Council Rules with certain modifications. They establish definitions, procedures for meetings, elections of officers, and the functions of the Chairman, Vice-Chairman, and Secretary.

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government (Citizen Community Boards) Rules, 2004
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the registration, constitution, and operation of Citizen Community Boards in Sindh. They outline procedures for name availability, charter subscription, project proposal processing, and financial management including audits.

name: LOCAL GOVERNMENT NAZIMS, NAIB NAZIMS & MEMBERS (HONORARIA AND PRIVILAGES) RULES, 2001

metadata.title: The Sindh Local Government Nazims, Naib Nazims & Members (Honoraria and Privileges) Rules, 2001
metadata.repeals: The Sindh Local Councils Mayor and Chairman (Honoraria & privileges) Rules, 1980
metadata.summary: These rules establish the honoraria, house rent allowances, and official vehicle usage for Nazims, Naib Nazims, and Members in Sindh. They also define entitlements regarding travel and daily allowances, telephone facilities, medical care, office staff, and leave of absence.

name: Market Committee, non-unfilled, Employees (Efficiency and discipline) Byelaws, 1985.

metadata.title: The Market Committee, non-unfilled, Employees (Efficiency and discipline) Byelaws, 1985
metadata.summary: These byelaws establish the rules for efficiency and discipline regarding employees of the Market Committee. They define key terms such as misconduct, corruption, and penalties, outlining both minor and major sanctions that can be imposed. The document also details the inquiry procedures to be followed when an employee is accused of subversion, corruption, or misconduct.

metadata.title: Market Committee Employees Service Bye-Laws, 1984
metadata.summary: These Bye-Laws regulate the service of employees within Market Committees in Sindh. They establish definitions, procedures for appointment by promotion or initial recruitment, probation periods, and rules regarding confirmation to permanent posts.

metadata.title: The Sindh Minimum Wages Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Sindh Minimum Wages Act, 2015 to regulate minimum wage rates and allowances for workers in industrial and commercial undertakings. They define key terms such as 'Board', 'Chairperson', and 'Inspector', and establish procedures for appointing Board members representing employers and workers.

name: NARA CANAL AREA WATER BOARD ELECTION (CHAIRMAN) REGULATINS, 2004.

metadata.title: The Nara Canal Area Water Board Election (Chairman) Regulations, 2004
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for electing the chairman of the Nara Canal Area Water Board. They define eligibility criteria, disqualifications, and procedural rules for conducting elections under the Sindh Water Management Ordinance, 2002.

metadata.title: The Sind Paddy Development Fee Rules, 1976
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the assessment and collection of paddy development fees by rice husking mills in Sind. They define key terms, mandate registration of mills, prescribe specific forms for recording transactions and issuing receipts, and outline procedures for submitting weekly returns and conducting inspections.

metadata.title: The Panchayat (Appeal) Rules, 1981
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for filing appeals against orders made by Panchayats. An aggrieved person may file an appeal to a Magistrate of the First Class within thirty days of the order, following specific forms and procedures outlined in the document.

metadata.title: The People's Local Councils (Land) Rules, 1975
metadata.summary: These rules define the land that vests in People's Local Councils and establish terms for existing leases. They provide a framework for granting new leases for cultivation, special purposes, and building sites, including provisions for rent fixation and lease renewal.

name: PROCEDURE OF THE BUSINESS OF THE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL OF SINDH,1980

metadata.title: The Procedure of the Business of the Provincial Council of Sind, 1980
metadata.summary: This notification establishes the constitution, functions, and procedural rules for the Provincial Council of Sind under Martial Law. It details the composition of the council, meeting requirements, notice periods, and financial allowances for members.

metadata.title: The Provincial Assembly of Sind (Finance Committee) Rules, 1973
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the procedure of the Finance Committee of the Provincial Assembly of Sind. They define the committee's composition, functions regarding budget preparation and expenditure advice, and establish protocols for meetings, quorum, and decision-making.

metadata.title: Provincial Ombudsman (Employees) Short title and Service Rules, 1997
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the method, qualifications, and conditions of employment for posts in the Secretariat and Regional Offices of the Provincial Ombudsman (Mohtasib) Sindh. They apply to all employees except casual or work-charge staff and cover procedures for initial appointment, promotion, transfer, and acting charge appointments.

name: REGISTRATION OF FARMERS ORGANIZATION, WATER COURSE ASSOCIATION AND DRAINAGE BENEFICIARY GROUP REGULATIONS , 2004.

metadata.title: The Registration of Farmers' Organization, Water Course Association and Drainage Beneficiary Groups Regulations, 2004
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for registering farmers' organizations, water course associations, and drainage beneficiary groups in Sindh. They outline specific requirements, application procedures, and information that must be furnished to the regulatory authority for successful registration.

metadata.title: The Employees (Efficiency & Discipline) Rules, 1999
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for imposing penalties on employees of the Sindh Agricultural Supplies Organization (SASO) due to inefficiency, misconduct, or corruption. They define specific grounds for penalties, list minor and major penalty types, and outline the inquiry procedures that must be followed when an employee is accused of subversion or other offenses.

metadata.title: The SIDA Election (Members) Regulations, 2004
metadata.summary: These regulations govern the election of members for the Sindh Irrigation and Drainage Authority (SIDA). They establish qualifications and disqualifications for candidates, define the roles of election committees and returning officers, and outline voting procedures including nomination, polling, and result communication.

name: SIND zakat committees (chairman and members) (review application) rules, 1985.

metadata.title: The Sind Zakat Committees (Chairman and Members) (Review Application) Rules, 1985
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for filing and disposing of applications for review by a Chairman or member of a Sind Zakat Committee who has ceased to hold office. The document outlines the requirements for submitting an application, the process for hearing the applicant, and the conditions under which a decision is made and reinstatement occurs.

name: Sind (Gazetted) Civil Services (National Scales of Pay) Rules, 1974.

metadata.title: The Sind (Gazetted) Civil Services (National Scales of Pay) Rules, 1974
metadata.summary: These rules establish the National Scales of Pay for gazetted civil servants serving in the Province of Sind. They provide existing servants with the right to opt for these new scales or retain their existing pay scales, effective from March 1, 1972.

metadata.title: Sind Assembly Secretariat (Recruitment) Rules, 1974
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the recruitment of persons to the Secretariat of the Provincial Assembly of Sind. They establish the structure of the Secretariat, define methods for recruitment including promotion, transfer, and direct appointment, and outline qualifications and procedures.

metadata.title: The Sind Cinematograph Rules, 1982
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of Sind to regulate public exhibitions by cinematograph within the province. They establish definitions, conditions for granting licenses and no objection certificates, safety standards, fees, and procedures for appeals.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants (Appeal) Rules, 1980
metadata.repeals: The Sind Civil Servants (Appeal) Rules, 1975
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for civil servants in Sindh to prefer appeals against orders relating to their terms and conditions of service. They define the competent and appellate authorities, specify the requirements for filing an appeal memorandum, and outline the process for hearing and deciding such appeals.

name: SIND CIVIL SERVANTS (CHANGE IN NOMENCLATURE OF SERVICES AND ABOLITION OF CLASSES) RULES, 1974

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants (Change in Nomenclature of Services and Abolition of Classes) Rules, 1974
metadata.summary: These rules change the nomenclature of civil services in Sindh to the Sind Unified Basic Scales and abolish existing service classes. They also eliminate reservations for specific cadres or posts and redefine references to gazetted/non-gazetted posts based on corresponding basic scales.

name: SIND CIVIL SERVANTS (PROBATION, CONFIRMATION AND SENIORITY) RULES, 1975

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants (Probation, Confirmation and Seniority) Rules, 1975
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the probation periods, confirmation procedures, and seniority lists for civil servants in Sind. They establish specific timelines for probation based on appointment type and outline the conditions under which confirmation is granted or deferred.

name: SIND CIVIL SERVANTS (RESTRICTION ON MARRIAGE WITH FOREIGN NATIONALS)RULES, 1982

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants (Restriction on Marriage with Foreign Nationals) Rules, 1982
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Government Servants (Restriction on Marriages with Foreign Nationals) Rules, 1963
metadata.summary: These rules prohibit civil servants in Sind from marrying foreign nationals without prior government permission. Marrying a foreign national without such permission is considered misconduct and liable to major penalties under the Sind Civil Servants (Efficiency & Discipline) Rules, 1973.

name: SIND CIVIL SERVANTS LANGUAGE EXAMIANTION RUELS 1981

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants Language Examination Rules, 1981
metadata.repeals: The Sind Government Servants Language Examination Rules, 1963
metadata.summary: These rules mandate that civil servants in Sind must pass an examination in Urdu or Sindhi, depending on their mother tongue, within two years of appointment. The regulations specify the required educational standards for different grades, outline exemptions for senior officers and those over forty, and establish a reward system for passing the exam.

name: Sind Civil Servants Welfare Fund Rules, 1980.

metadata.title: The Sind Civil Servants Welfare Fund Rules, 1980
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for contributions to the Sind Civil Servants Welfare Fund by civil servants in Sindh. They define terms, specify contribution amounts and payment methods, outline procedures for nominations upon death, and detail how death benefits are calculated and paid to nominees or relatives.

metadata.title: The Sind Co-operative Housing Authority Rules, 1986
metadata.summary: These rules establish the administrative framework for the Sind Co-operative Housing Authority, including its office structure, inquiry procedures, and staff appointments. They also outline requirements for budget preparation, fund management, annual reporting, and investment of surplus funds.

name: Sind Coal and Metalliferous Mines (Supplementary) Regulations 1986.

metadata.title: The Sind Coal and Metalliferous Mines (Supplementary) Regulations, 1986
metadata.amends: Coal Mines Regulations, 1926 and Metalliferous Mines Regulations, 1926
metadata.summary: These regulations supplement the existing Coal Mines and Metalliferous Mines Regulations of 1926 for mines in Sindh employing 250 or more persons. They establish requirements for appointing Welfare and Safety Officers, including specific qualifications and duties related to employee welfare, safety supervision, and maintaining harmonious relations between management and workers.

metadata.title: The Sindh Councils (Appeals) Rules, 1982
metadata.repeals: Government of West Pakistan Basic Democracies and Local Government Department Notification No. SOXI-64/80, dated the 31st December, 1960
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for filing and disposing of appeals against orders passed under the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979. They define key terms, appoint tribunals consisting of district judges or former district judges, set a thirty-day limitation period for appeals, and outline the procedure for presenting appeals in writing with specific grounds.

metadata.title: The Sind Drainage Rates Rules, 1983
metadata.summary: This document establishes the rules for levying drainage rates on cultivated land within specific Salinity Control and Reclamation Projects in Sindh. It defines terms such as 'Assessing Authority' and outlines the procedure for issuing assessment bills, payment deadlines, and provisions for remission due to crop failure.

metadata.title: The Sind Factories (Adult Exemption) Rules, 1973
metadata.summary: These rules define specific categories of persons in factories who are deemed to hold supervisory, management, or confidential positions. They also establish conditions under which adult male workers employed on urgent repairs or preparatory/complementary work are exempted from certain provisions of the Factories Act, 1934 regarding working hours and holidays.

metadata.title: Sind Land Commission (Pre-emption) Rules, 1974
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for tenants to claim their first right of pre-emption regarding land sold within their tenancy. They outline the application process to the Revenue Court exercising Tribunal powers and the conditions under which relief is granted.

name: Sind Land Revenue Flat Rate Assessment Rules, 1973.

metadata.title: The Sind Land Revenue Flat Rate Short title and Assessment Rules, 1973
metadata.summary: These rules establish the flat rate for land revenue assessment in Sind based on average Jamabandi figures from the five years ending the agricultural year 1970-71. They define specific terms related to land classification, irrigation methods, and exemptions for small holders or those affected by natural disasters.

name: SIND LOCAL, TALUKA AND SUB-DIVISIONAL ZAKAT AND USHR COMMITTEES (CONSTITUTION) RULES, 1979.

metadata.title: The Sind Local, Taluka and Sub-Divisional Zakat and Ushr Committees (Constitution) Rules, 1979
metadata.summary: These Rules provide for the constitution of Local, Taluka, and Sub-Divisional Zakat and Ushr Committees in the Province of Sind. They outline the procedures for selecting members and electing Chairmen through local gatherings, including definitions, delimitation of localities, team organization, and objection handling.

name: Sind Market Committees Unified Grade Service Rules, 1983.

metadata.title: The Sind Market Committees Unified Short title and Grade Service Rules, 1983
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Sind Market Committees Unified Short title and Grade Service, defining terms related to appointments, promotions, and recruitment within the service. They outline procedures for forming promotion and selection committees, setting age limits for initial appointments, and determining seniority lists for members of the service.

metadata.title: The Sind Paddy Development Fee Rules, 1976
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the assessment and collection of paddy development fees by rice husking mills in Sind. They define key terms, mandate registration of mills, prescribe specific forms for recording transactions and issuing receipts, and outline procedures for submitting weekly returns and conducting inspections.

name: SIND PENCHAYATS ( FUNCTIONS AND CONDUCT OF BUSINESS) RULES, 1980.

metadata.title: The Sind Panchayats (Functions and Conduct of Business) Rules, 1980
metadata.summary: These rules define the functions and conduct of business for Panchayats in Sind. They establish procedures for meetings, quorum requirements, record-keeping, and the administration of oaths to members.

name: Sind People’s Local Council Service Welfare Fund Rules, 1973.

metadata.title: The Sind People's Local Council Service Welfare Fund Rules, 1973
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Sind People's Local Council Service Welfare Fund to manage contributions from employees and local councils. The fund is primarily utilized for arranging group insurance for employees, with remaining sums available for financial relief in exceptional cases.

metadata.title: Sind Permanent Residence Certificate Rules, 1971
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for obtaining a Certificate of Permanent Residence in Sindh, required for admission to educational institutions or recruitment to public services. They define eligibility criteria based on birthplace, parental domicile, residence duration, or government service, and outline the application process involving District Magistrates.

metadata.title: Sind Private Colleges Service Rules, 1970
metadata.summary: These rules govern the service conditions for teachers in private colleges within the province of Sind. They cover topics including academic qualifications, appointment procedures, pay scales, increments, and disciplinary measures such as dismissal or termination.

name: SIND PRIVATE COLLEGES (ELECTION OF THE CHAIRMAN) RULES, 1970

metadata.title: Sind Private Colleges (Election of the Chairman) Rules, 1970
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure for electing the Chairman of Governing Bodies in private colleges under the Sind Private Colleges (Management and Control) Ordinance, 1970. They cover the date of elections, meeting convening, candidate nomination, voting by ballot, and the resolution of election disputes.

name: SIND PRIVATE COLLEGES CONTRIBUTORY PROVIDENT FUND RULES, 1970

metadata.title: The Sind Private Colleges Contributory Provident Fund Rules, 1970
metadata.summary: These rules establish a contributory provident fund for private colleges in Sind. They define the composition of the managing committee, subscription rates for teachers, management contributions, and procedures for nominations and account maintenance.

name: SIND PROFESSIONS, TRADES, CALLINGS AND EMPLOYMENT TAX RULES, 1976.

metadata.title: The Sind Professions, Trades, Callings and Employment Tax Rules, 1976
metadata.amends: The Sind Professions, Trades, Callings and Employment Tax Rules, 1965
metadata.repeals: The Sind Professions, Trades, Callings and Employment Tax Rules, 1965
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for enrolling persons liable to tax on professions, trades, callings, and employment in Sindh. They define key terms, outline procedures for issuing assessee cards, mandate inspections by authorized officers, and specify mechanisms for collecting tax alongside land revenue.

name: Sind Public Service Commission (Conditions of Service) Rules, 1981.

metadata.title: The Sind Public Service Commission (Conditions of Service) Rules, 1981
metadata.repeals: The Sind Public Service Commission (Conditions of Service) Rules, 1974
metadata.summary: These rules establish the conditions of service for the Chairman and members of the Sind Public Service Commission. They cover matters including pay scales, residential accommodation, staff cars, pension eligibility, provident fund subscriptions, leave entitlements, travelling and medical allowances.

name: Sind Re-inbursement of Medical Charges Rules, 1972.

metadata.title: The Sind Re-inbursement of Medical Charges Rules, 1972
metadata.summary: These Rules define the entitlement of government servants to medical amenities and clarify that reimbursement for purchased medicines is not admissible. They also establish procedures for obtaining medicines from hospitals or through local purchase when stock is unavailable, requiring separate accounts to be kept by authorized medical attendants.

name: Sind Regional Plan Organization Employees (General Conditions of Service) Rules, 1987.

metadata.title: Sind Regional Plan Organization Employees (General Conditions of Service) Rules, 1987
metadata.summary: These rules establish the general conditions of service for employees of the Sind Regional Plan Organization. They define key terms related to employment, pay, and allowances, and set out provisions regarding initial pay fixation, promotion transfers, and the commencement of duties.

name: Sind Road Transport Corporation (General Conditions of Service) Rules. 1986.

metadata.title: The Sind Road Transport Corporation (General Conditions of Service) Rules, 1986
metadata.summary: These rules establish the general conditions of service for employees of the Sind Road Transport Corporation. They define key terms related to employment, pay, and posts, and classify the service into specific categories such as executives, officers, supervisory staff, workers, security staff, and ministerial staff.

name: Sind Standard Weights and Measures Enforcement Rules 1976.

metadata.title: The Sind Standard Weights and Measures Enforcement Rules, 1976
metadata.amends: The Sind Standard Weights and Measures Enforcement Act, 1975
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for working and secondary standards used in trade within Sindh. They specify requirements for the construction, custody, and verification of weighing instruments and commercial weights to ensure accuracy.

name: SIND TEXTBOOK BOARD EMPLOYEES (EFFICIENCY AND DISCIPLINE)RULES, 1977.

metadata.title: The Sind Textbook Board Employees (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 1977
metadata.summary: These rules establish the grounds for imposing penalties on employees of the Sind Textbook Board, including inefficiency, misconduct, corruption, and subversive activities. They define various types of minor and major penalties such as censure, withholding promotion, removal from service, and dismissal.

metadata.title: The Sind University Employees Pension Statutes
metadata.summary: This document contains the Statutes relating to the University of Sind Employees Pension, framed under Section 10(5) of the University of Sindh Act 1972. The statutes apply to current and future employees of the University of Sindh who opt for these provisions, excluding those covered by existing Provident Fund Statutes or specific contract terms.

name: Sind Wildlife Management Board Financial Rules 1972.

metadata.title: The Sind Wildlife Management Board Financial Rules, 1972
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Governor of Sind under the powers of the Sind Wildlife Protection Ordinance, 1972 to establish financial regulations for the Sind Wildlife Management Board. They define the composition of the Board Fund, authorize fees for park entry, outline budget submission procedures, and set requirements for auditing and account maintenance.

name: SIND ZAKAT AND USHR COMMITTEES (PROCEDURE) RULES, 1980.

metadata.title: The Sind Zakat and Ushr Committees (Procedure) Rules, 1980
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the proceedings of District, Taluka, Sub-divisional, and Local Zakat and Ushr Committees in the province of Sind. They cover topics such as committee seats, meeting frequency and notice periods, quorum requirements, voting procedures, and the disclosure of interests by members.

metadata.title: The Sindh Auqaf (Employees Pension) Rules, 1990
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Sindh Auqaf Employees Pension Fund and define eligibility for various types of pensions, including superannuation, retiring, invalid, and compassionate pensions. They also outline the composition of the fund, investment procedures, and medical certification requirements for invalidity.

name: SINDH GOVERNMENT LAND (CANCELLATION OF ALLOTMENTS, CONVERSIONS, EXCHANGES) RULES, 2003

metadata.title: The Sindh Government Land (Cancellation of Allotments, Conversions, Exchanges), Rules, 2003
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of Sindh to regulate the cancellation, conversion, and exchange of government land allotments. They establish procedures for determining market prices, calculating losses, paying compensation, and resuming land when payments are not made.

metadata.title: The Sindh Juvenile Justice Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for juvenile justice within the Province of Sindh, specifically regarding borstal institutions. They define terms related to juvenile detention, mandate legal assistance for child offenders, and set standards for accommodation, medical care, and discipline.

name: SINDH REGULATION AND CONTROL (USE OF PLOTS AND CONSTRCUTION OF BUILDINGS) RULES , 2002..

metadata.title: The Sindh Regulation and Control (Use of Plots and Construction of Buildings) Rules, 2002
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of Sindh to regulate the use of plots and the construction of buildings within the province. They establish fees for converting residential, industrial, or commercial plots based on land categories and provide a framework for regularizing buildings constructed in violation of existing ordinances.

metadata.title: The Sindh (Fiscal Transfer) Rules, 2004
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001 to establish definitions and procedures for local government finance. They come into force immediately upon publication in the official gazette.

name: Sindh and Punjab Judicial Services Rules, 1994

metadata.title: Sindh Judicial Service Rules, 1994
metadata.summary: These rules regulate recruitment to the Sindh Judicial Service and prescribe conditions of service for appointed persons. They establish the constitution of the service, define selection grades, and set specific qualifications and age limits for initial appointments and promotions.

name: Sindh Boiler Attendants and Boiler Engineers Rules, 1989.

metadata.title: The Sindh Boiler Attendants and Engineers Rules, 1989
metadata.repeals: all other rules on the subject
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for granting competency certificates to boiler attendants and engineers in Sindh. They define specific qualifications and limits on the number of boilers an individual can manage based on their certificate class.

metadata.title: The Sindh Censorship of Film Rules, 2014
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the Sindh Board of Film Censors, including its office structure, appointment of officials, and delegation of powers. They outline procedures for film certification, examination ratings, record preservation, and the duties of inspectors regarding public exhibitions.

name: SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS HOUSING FOUNDATION, RULES, 2008

metadata.title: Sindh Civil Servants Housing Foundation Rules, 2008
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the Sindh Civil Servants Housing Foundation, defining eligibility criteria for civil servants to become members and outlining conditions for membership termination. The document also sets out procedures for the appointment, removal, and resignation of Directors and the Managing Director.

metadata.title: The Sind Council (Budget) Rules, 1985
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for preparing and presenting the budget of the Sind Council. They define key financial terms, specify the structure of revenue and expenditure estimates, and mandate various schedules and forms to be included in the budget volumes.

metadata.title: The Sindh Council (Conduct of Business) Rules, 2016
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Government of Sindh under the powers conferred by the Sindh Local Government Act, 2013. They establish the framework for council meetings, including provisions for ordinary, special, and emergent meetings, as well as requirements for notices and agendas.

name: SINDH COUNCILS (IMPOSITION, ASSESSMENT, COLLECTION AND ADMINISTRATION OF TAXES, RATES, TOLL AND FEES) RULES, 2016

metadata.title: The Sindh Councils (Imposition, Short title and Assessment, Collection and Administration of Taxes, Rates, Toll and Fees) Rules, 2016
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for councils in Sindh to formulate, publish, and consider proposals regarding the imposition, abolition, or modification of taxes, rates, tolls, and fees. The document outlines requirements for public notice, objection hearings, committee reports, and final government sanction before such financial measures come into force.

name: Sindh Councils Unified Grade Service Departmental Examination & Training Rules, 1996.

metadata.title: Sindh Councils Unified Grade Service Departmental Examination & Training Rules, 1996
metadata.amends: Sindh Councils Unified Grade Service (Departmental Examination & Training), Rules, 1994
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for departmental examinations and training for members of the Sindh Councils Unified Grades Service. They define key terms, specify examination syllabi including subjects for the medical/health branch, and outline the roles of the Academy in conducting exams and providing training.

name: Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure [Cess] Rules, 1994

metadata.title: The Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure [Cess] Rules, 1994
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for assessing and collecting a development cess on goods entering or leaving Sindh from outside the country. They define key terms, specify declaration requirements, outline payment procedures via challans, and set penalties for non-payment or unauthorized removal of goods.

name: SINDH DISTRICT GOVERNMENTS (CONDUCT OF BUSINESS) RULES, 2001

metadata.title: The Sindh District Governments (Conduct of Business) Rules, 2001
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the conduct of business within the District Governments of Sindh. They define key terms, allocate administrative duties among various offices, and outline the specific functions and powers of officials such as the Zila Nazim and Executive District Officers.

name: Sindh Education Foundation (Grant of Loans and lease of land) Rules, 1993.

metadata.title: Sindh Education Foundation (Grant of Loans and lease of land) Rules, 1993
metadata.summary: These rules empower the Government of Sindh to provide assistance in the form of grants, loans, or land leases to non-governmental organizations for establishing and running educational institutions. The document outlines specific eligibility criteria, including registration requirements, ideological beliefs of staff, minimum student enrollment numbers, and necessary facility standards.

metadata.title: Sindh Enquiries and Anti-Corruption Rules, 1993
metadata.summary: These rules establish the constitution, functions, and meeting schedules for Provincial, Divisional, and District Anti-Corruption Committees in Sindh. They define key terms related to anti-corruption inquiries and outline the jurisdiction and powers of officers conducting investigations.

name: SINDH ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION (COMPOSITION OF OFENCES AND PAYMENT OF AMDINISTRATIVE PENALTY) RULES, 2014.

metadata.title: The Sindh Environmental Protection (Composition of Offences and Payment of Administrative Penalty) Rules, 2014
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedure for compounding offences and paying administrative penalties under the Sindh Environmental Protection Act, 2014. They define key terms, outline the application process to the Director General or Environmental Protection Tribunal, and specify requirements for show cause notices.

name: SINDH ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY (REVIEW OF INITIAL ENVIRONMENTAL EXAMINATION AND ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENT) REGULATIONS, 2014

metadata.title: The Sindh Environmental Protection Agency (Review of Initial Environmental Examination and Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations, 2014
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the Sindh Environmental Protection Agency to review Initial Environmental Examinations (IEE) and Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA). They define specific categories of projects requiring IEE, EIA, or checklists, outline filing procedures, and set guidelines for public participation and review fees.
