metadata.title: Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Employees (Efficiency and Discipline) Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for imposing penalties on employees of the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences regarding inefficiency, misconduct, and corruption. They define specific grounds for penalty, including subversive activities and unauthorized business engagements, and categorize sanctions into minor and major penalties such as censure, removal from service, and dismissal.

name: INSTITUTE OF OPHTHALMOLOGY AND VISUAL SCIENCES EMPLOYEES (STUDENTS DISCIPLINE, CONDUCT, WELFARE AND CODE OF HONOR) RULES, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences (Students Discipline, Conduct, Welfare and Code of Honor) Regulations, 2021
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the code of honor, discipline, and welfare standards for students at the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences in Hyderabad. They define specific acts of indiscipline and outline the expected conduct regarding morality, respect for authority, and adherence to institute rules.

metadata.title: Agricultural Produce Markets Rules, 1940
metadata.summary: These rules provide the short title and definitions for terms used in the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 within West Pakistan (excluding Tribal Areas). They establish procedures for notifying markets, publishing notifications, obtaining dealer licences, and managing expenses related to these activities.

name: INSTITUTE OF OPHTHALMOLOGY AND VISUAL SCIENCES ADMINISTRATIVE STRUCTURE, POWERS AND DUTIES OF INSTITUTE OFFICERS RULES, 2021

metadata.title: Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Administrative Structure, Powers and Duties of Institute Officers Rules 2021
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the functioning of the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences and define the duties and powers of its officers. They establish the Executive Director as the chief executive and principal accounting officer, outlining their appointment terms, responsibilities, and delegation of authority.

name: INSTITUTE OF OPHTHALMOLOGY AND VISUAL SCIENCES EMPLOYEES PAY SCALES RULES, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Employees Pay Scales Rules, 2021
subjects: Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the pay scales, allowances, fringe benefits, perks, and privileges for employees of the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences. They apply to all institute employees except those under specific contracts, deputation, or special orders exempted by the Board.

name: INSTITUTE OF OPHTHALMOLOGY AND VISUAL SCIENCES, ACADEMIC SETUP REGULATIONS RULES, 2021

metadata.title: Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology Visual Sciences, Academic Setup Regulations 2021
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the academic setup for the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences as an independent degree-awarding institute. They define key terms, outline the institute's role in instruction and research, and mandate specific rotation programs for FCPS and MS trainees across various medical disciplines.

name: INSTITUTE OF OPHTHALMOLOGY AND VISUAL SCIENCES EMPLOYEES( STUDENT'S EXAMINATION CONDUCT AND DISCIPLINE) RULES, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences (Student's Examination Conduct and Discipline) Regulations 2021
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for student examination conduct and discipline at the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences. They define various forms of unfair means, such as plagiarism and bribery, and create an Examination Discipline Committee to handle cases of misconduct.

name: INSTITUTE OF OPHTHALMOLOGY AND VISUAL SCIENCES EMPLOYEES( LEAVE) RULES, 2021

metadata.title: Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Employees (Leave) Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules govern the leave entitlements for employees of the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences, excluding contractual staff and those on specific agreements. They define terms related to pay, service, and various types of leave, including earned leave, medical leave, and study leave.

metadata.title: The Sindh Child Protection Authority Rules, 2016
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Sindh Child Protection Authority to carry into effect the provisions of the Sindh Child Protection Authority Act, 2011. The document establishes definitions, nomination and removal procedures for members, meeting protocols, office establishment, and guidelines for advisors.

name: SINDH DEVELOPMENT AND MAINTENANCE OF INFRASTRUCTURE CESS RULES 2019

metadata.title: Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure Cess Rules, 2019
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for assessing and collecting a cess on goods entering or leaving Sindh province. They define terms, outline procedures for automated or manual challan generation, specify declaration requirements, and detail penalties for non-payment.

name: KARACHI FISHERIES HARBOUR AUTHORITY EMPLOYEES (SERVICE) RULES, 2013

metadata.title: Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority commencement Short title, and Employees (Service) Rules, 2013
metadata.summary: These rules govern the service conditions for employees of the Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority in Sindh. They define key terms related to appointments, pay scales, and posts, and establish procedures for creating schedules of establishment.

name: Sindh Disposal of Firearms and other Weapons Rules, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh Disposal of Firearms and other Weapons Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules establish a Bureau in Karachi for the storage and disposal of illicit weapons recovered, confiscated, or forfeited under the Sindh Arms Act, 2013. The document also mandates the maintenance of District Malkhanas by Senior Superintendents of Police and defines procedures for categorizing, repairing, and recording firearms and ammunition.

name: SINDH DISPOSAL OF FIREAMS AND OTHER WEAPONS RULES 2022

metadata.title: The Sindh Disposal of Firearms and other Weapons Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules establish a Bureau in Karachi for the storage and disposal of illicit weapons recovered, confiscated, or forfeited under the Sindh Arms Act, 2013. The document also mandates the maintenance of District Malkhanas by Senior Superintendents of Police and defines procedures for categorizing, repairing, and recording firearms and ammunition.

metadata.title: Sindh Education Foundation (Employees Gratuity Rules) 2021
metadata.summary: These rules establish the entitlement of gratuity for employees of the Sindh Education Foundation. They define key terms such as 'Board', 'Employee', and 'Family' to prescribe the manners in which gratuity is paid.

metadata.title: The Sindh Hazardous Occupations (Silicon) Rules, 2019
metadata.summary: These rules declare specific operations involving silicon compounds as hazardous within factories in Sindh. They establish requirements for material testing, sampling procedures, and define key terms related to factory management and inspection.

name: MAJID BHURGRI LANGUAGE ENGINNEERING INSTITUTE EMPLOYEES (SERVICES) RULES, 2018

metadata.title: The Majid Bhurgri Language Engineering Institute Employees (Service) Rules, 2018
metadata.summary: These rules govern the service conditions for employees of the Majid Bhurgri Language Engineering Institute, excluding those with specific contracts or on deputation. They establish procedures for appointments, promotions, and transfers, defining terms such as 'pay', 'cadre', and 'appointing authority' in accordance with the parent Act of 2018.

name: SINDH HIGH DENSITY DEVELOPMENT BOARD ACT, 2010 (REGULATIONS, 2022

metadata.title: The Sindh High Density Development Board Act, 2010 (Regulations, 2022)
metadata.summary: These regulations amend the existing Karachi Building & Town Planning Regulations-2002 to address specific issues in High Density Zones. The amendments include changes to land use conversion, plot amalgamation, recreational space requirements, building setbacks, and commercial building bulk standards.

name: SINDH LOCAL COUNCILS (AUCTIONING OF COLLECTION RIGHTS) RULES, 2016

metadata.title: Sindh Local Councils (Auctioning of Collection Rights) Rules, 2016
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure for Local Councils in Sindh to award contracts for the collection of income through public auctions. They define key terms, establish requirements for auction notices and participant eligibility, and set guidelines for determining reserve prices and accepting bids.

name: SINDH KATCHI ABADIS AUTHORITY LAW-COST HOUSING SCHEME REGULATION, 2009

metadata.title: SKAA Low-Cost Housing Scheme Regulations 2008
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for low-cost housing schemes sponsored by the Government of Sindh or the Sind Katchi Abadis Authority. They define key terms, outline the powers and functions of the Authority and its field offices, and specify methods for raising funds and managing land allocation.

name: SINDH LOCAL COUNCILS (AUCTIONING OF COLLECTION RIGHTS) RULES, 2016

metadata.title: Sindh Local Councils (Auctioning of Collection Rights) Rules, 2016
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure for Local Councils in Sindh to award contracts for the collection of income through public auctions. They define key terms, establish requirements for auction notices and participant eligibility, and set guidelines for determining reserve prices and accepting bids.

metadata.title: The Sindh Industrial Relations Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Government of Sindh under the powers of section 78 of the Sindh Industrial Relations Act, 2013. They establish general provisions regarding the short title, definitions, application for trade union registration, maintenance of registers and accounts, and limits on executive members.

name: SINDH OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH RUES, 2019

metadata.title: The Sindh Occupational Safety and Health Rules, 2019
metadata.summary: This document establishes the Sindh Occupational Safety and Health Rules, 2019, made under the powers of the Sindh Occupational Safety and Health Act, 2017. It provides definitions for key terms such as 'construction site', 'lifting equipment', and 'trade union', along with instructions on safety signs and working hours.

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Service Commission (Functions) Rules, 2022
metadata.amends: The Sindh Public Service Commission (Functions) Rules, 1990
metadata.summary: These rules define the functions of the Sindh Public Service Commission regarding initial recruitment and appointments for civil posts. They establish procedures for conducting tests, defining key terms like 'appointing authority' and 'basic pay scale', and outline the process for accepting or rejecting the Commission's advice on appointments.

metadata.title: Sindh Public Service Commission Regulations 2021
metadata.summary: These regulations establish the framework for the Sindh Public Service Commission regarding general procedures, definitions, and abbreviations related to recruitment. They outline specific terms such as 'candidate', 'application', 'interview', and various roles within the selection process.

name: SINDH REGISTRATION AND REGULATION OF FISHING JETTIES RULES 2022

metadata.title: The Sindh Registration and Regulation of Fishing Jetties Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the registration, documentation, and notification of all jetties operating along the Sindh coast. They define key terms related to fishing operations, including crew cards, logbooks, and various types of jetties, while mandating that no jetty be constructed or altered without prior departmental approval.

name: SINDH SALE TAX SPECIAL PROCEDURE (ONLINE INTEGRATION OF BUSINESS) RULES,2022

metadata.title: The Sindh Sales Tax Special Procedure (Online Integration of Business) Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules establish procedures for the online integration of business with the Sindh Revenue Board's computerized system for real-time sales reporting. They apply to registered service providers and online marketplaces, mandating POS integration within 45 days of notification.

name: SINDH SALE TAX SPECIAL PROCEDURE (ONLINE INTEGRATION OF BUSINESS) RULES,2022

metadata.title: The Sindh Sales Tax Special Procedure (Online Integration of Business) Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules establish procedures for the online integration of business with the Sindh Revenue Board's computerized system for real-time sales reporting. They apply to registered service providers and online marketplaces, mandating POS integration within 45 days of notification.

name: SINDH MINES AND MINERALS GOVERNANCE RULES, 2023

metadata.title: The Sindh Mines and Minerals Governance Rules, 2023
metadata.summary: These rules are made by the Government of Sindh under section 50 of the Sindh Mines and Minerals Governance Act, 2021. They establish the legal framework for mineral titles, define key terms related to mining operations, and constitute the Mines Committee to administer these provisions.

metadata.title: The Sindh Trust Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the powers of section 118 of the Sindh Trust Act, 2020 to regulate the registration and administration of trusts in Sindh. They specify the required documents for registration, including trust deeds, memorandums, affidavits, and proof of address, as well as verification procedures involving police and assistant directors.

metadata.title: The Sindh Cooperative Societies Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Sindh Cooperative Societies Act, 2020 to regulate the registration of societies and their bye-laws. They specify requirements for applications, including member details and undertakings regarding the society's objectives. The document also outlines the matters in which societies must make bye-laws and the procedures for amending them.

metadata.title: The Sindh Workers Compensation Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These rules establish the procedures for reviewing half-monthly compensation payments and the commutation of such payments into lump sums. They also outline requirements for employers depositing compensation, including necessary forms and statements, as well as processes for dependents to claim deposits following a worker's death.

name: SINDH PRISONS AND CORRECTIONS SERVICES RULES, 2019

metadata.title: The Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services Rules, 2019
metadata.summary: These rules are framed by the Government of Sindh under section 80 of the Sindh Prisons and Corrections Services Act, 2019. They establish the classification, establishment, and management of prisons and correctional facilities within the province.

name: SINDH WILDLIFE PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND M MANAGEMENT RULES 2022

metadata.title: The Sindh Wildlife Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the powers of the Sindh Wildlife Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management Act, 2020. They provide definitions for terms related to wildlife conservation, trade permits, and specific activities like falconry within the province.

metadata.title: The Hindu Marriage Rules, 2017
metadata.number: No. SO Sindh (GYMASindh Hindus Marriage Act. 2016
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure for registering Hindu marriages in Sindh in accordance with the Hindu Marriage Act, 2016. They define key terms used in the Act and mandate that marriage registers be maintained by Union Councils in a specific quadruplicate format.

name: Essential Commodities Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 2005

metadata.title: The Sindh Essential Commodities Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 2005
metadata.amends: The Sindh Essential Commodities Price Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 2005
metadata.summary: This Act provides for the price control and prevention of profiteering on and hoarding of essential commodities in Sindh. It also covers matters ancillary to these primary objectives, including the powers of government officers to regulate prices and distribution.

metadata.title: The Sindh Child Marriages Restraint Rules, 2016
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of Sindh under Section 10 of the Sindh Child Marriages Restraint Act, 2013. They establish procedures for verifying the age of contracting parties through CNICs or medical certificates and define key terms related to child marriage.

name: PROVINCIAL DISASTER MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY SINDH SERVICE RULES 2016

metadata.title: The Provincial Disaster Management Authority Sindh Service Rules, 2016
metadata.summary: These rules establish the service conditions for employees of the Provincial Disaster Management Authority in Sindh. They cover initial appointments, probation periods, confirmation procedures, and definitions related to pay and duties.

metadata.title: The Sindh Senior Citizens Welfare Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules are framed under the Sindh Senior Citizens Welfare Act, 2014 to establish procedures for the Sindh Senior Citizens Council. They define key terms, outline the process for issuing Azadi Cards, and set forth regulations regarding the convening, notice periods, and agenda preparation for ordinary, special, and emergency council meetings.

name: THE SINDH CENSARSHIP OF FILM RULES, 2014

metadata.title: The Sindh Censorship of Film Short title and Rules, 2014
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the powers conferred by section 19 of the Sindh Motion Pictures Act, 2011. They establish procedures for the certification of films for public exhibition in Pakistan and define key terms related to film inspection and licensing.

name: THE SINDH EDUCATION FOUNDATION (EMPLOYEES SERVICE) RULES, 2021

metadata.title: Sindh Education Foundation (Employees Service) Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of Sindh under Section 16 of the Sindh Education Foundation Act, 1992 to regulate employee services within the foundation. They define key terms related to appointments, promotions, allowances, and deputation, and establish conditions for recruitment including citizenship requirements.

name: SINDH LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION AND SUCCESSION CERTIFICATES RULES, 2020

metadata.title: The Sindh Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Rules, 2020
metadata.summary: These rules prescribe the procedure for applying for Letters of Administration or Succession Certificates in Sindh. They define key terms, outline the required documentation for applications, establish processes for public notice and verification, and detail provisions for issuing duplicate or amended certificates along with associated fees.

name: NEW CAPTIVE POWER PLANTS SUBSIDY RULES, 2017

metadata.title: Sindh New Captive Power Plants Subsidy Rules, 2017
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Sindh New Captive Power Plants Subsidy Committee to review and scrutinize applications for tariff differential amounts under the Sindh New Captive Power Plants Subsidy Act, 2017. They prescribe the procedure for claimants to submit applications, including required documents like invoices and certificates from approved chartered accountants, and outline the committee's timeline for approval or seeking clarification.

name: INSTITUTE OF OPHTHALMOLOGY AND VISUAL SCIENCES EMPLOYEES (TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF SERVICE) RULES, 2021

metadata.title: Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Employees (Terms and Conditions of Service) Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules establish the terms and conditions of service for employees of the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences. They define specific categories such as permanent, temporary, and tenure posts, along with procedures for recruitment, promotion, and appointment authorities based on pay scales.

metadata.title: The Sindh Human Rights Commission Rules, 2013
metadata.summary: These rules regulate the conduct of business for the Sindh Human Rights Commission constituted under the Sindh Protection of Human Rights Act, 2011. They define key terms, establish headquarters in Karachi, outline the powers and functions of the Commission, and prescribe procedures for holding ordinary and special meetings.

name: SINDH NEW CAPTIVE POWER PLANTS SUBSIDY RULES, 2017

metadata.title: Sindh New Captive Power Plants Subsidy Rules, 2017
metadata.summary: These rules are made under the Sindh New Captive Power Plants Subsidy Act, 2017 to carry out its purposes. They establish a committee to review applications for tariff differential amounts and prescribe the method for submitting such claims along with required documents.

name: SINDH PROSCUTOTORS (APPOINTMENT AND CONDITIONS OF SERVICE) RULES, 2006

metadata.title: The Sindh Prosecutors (Appointment Short title and Conditions of Service) Rules, 2006
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the appointment, promotion, and conditions of service for prosecutors in Sindh. They define the composition of selection committees, procedures for contract-based appointments, and guidelines for departmental promotions.

name: SINDH PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION (APPOINTMENT OF CHAIRPERSON AND MEMBERS) RULES, 2022

metadata.title: The Sindh Public Service Commission (Appointment of Chairperson and Members) Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for appointing the Chairperson and Members of the Sindh Public Service Commission. They define the qualifications, eligibility criteria, and the procedure involving a High Powered Committee to select these officials.

name: SINDH WORKERS WELFARE BOARD EMPLOYEES (SERVICE) RULES, 2021

metadata.title: The Sindh Workers Welfare Board Employees (Service) Rules, 2021
metadata.summary: These rules regulate and administer the services of employees of the Sindh Workers Welfare Board. They define key terms related to appointments, pay scales, leave, and duties applicable to regular whole-time employees.

name: THE DOMESTIC VIOLENCE (PREVENTION AND PROTECTION) RULES, 2016

metadata.title: The Domestic Violence (Prevention and Protection) Rules 2016
metadata.summary: These rules establish the Domestic Violence Commission in Karachi to exercise powers and perform functions under Section 4 of the Domestic Violence (Prevention and Protection) Act, 2013. The document defines key terms, outlines the composition and qualifications of the Commission's members, and sets procedures for appointment, resignation, removal, and acting chairpersonship.

name: THE SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS ( PROVINCIAL MANAGEMENT SERVICE) RULES 2018

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants (Provincial Management Service) Rules, 2018
metadata.repeals: The West Pakistan Civil Service (Executive Branch) Rules, 1964
metadata.summary: These rules establish the framework for the Provincial Management Service (PMS) within the Government of Sindh, defining post nomenclature, appointment methods, and qualifications. They repeal previous rules regarding Deputy Secretary and Section Officer appointments while maintaining specific transitional provisions for existing incumbents.

name: THE SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS PROMOTION (BPS-18 TO BPS-21) RULES, 2022

metadata.title: The Sindh Civil Servants Promotion (BPS-10 to BPS-21) Rules, 2022
metadata.summary: These rules govern the promotion of Civil Servants to posts within Basic Pay Scales 10 to 21 in the Government of Sindh. They define key terms such as 'promotion', 'deferment', and 'supersession' while establishing the composition and constitution of Provincial Selection Boards (PSB-I, PSB-II) and Departmental Promotion Committees (DPC).

name: THE SINDH PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS (REGULATION & CONTROL) RULES, 2005.

metadata.title: The Sindh Private Educational Institutions (Regulation & Control) Rules, 2005
metadata.summary: These rules were made by the Government of Sindh under section 15 of the Sindh Private Educational Institutions (Regulation and Control) Ordinance, 2001. They establish procedures for the registration, inspection, and renewal of private educational institutions in Sindh.
